NCT05720117.summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests PYX-201, an antibody-drug conjugate, in adults with advanced solid tumors that have returned or spread. How it is given, and how often or for how long, is not stated. The study measures the recommended dose(s) of PYX-201 and the objective response rate (ORR) when used alone.
NCT05720117.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa PYX-201, un conjugado anticuerpo-fármaco, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados que han regresado o se han diseminado. No se indica cómo se administra ni con qué frecuencia o durante cuánto tiempo. El estudio mide la(s) dosis recomendada(s) de PYX-201 y la tasa de respuesta objetiva (ORR) cuando se usa como único agente.
who_for: Adults aged 18 years or older.
Confirmed solid tumor, including certain breast, triple-negative breast, head and neck, or other tumor types with prior treatment line limits.
ECOG performance status of 0 to 1.
At least one measurable lesion by RECIST v1.1.
Life expectancy over 3 months in the investigator's opinion.
not_for: Known symptomatic brain metastases.
Significant cardiovascular disease within 6 months before starting study drug.
Known active hepatitis B, hepatitis C, HIV or AIDS.
Grade above 1 neuropathy of any cause.
Prior solid organ or bone marrow transplant.
cancer_types: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma

NCT05624918.summary_en: This study tests NovoTTF-200T(P), a device also called TTFields in the summary, combined with gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel before surgery. It is for resectable pancreatic adenocarcinoma. Nab-paclitaxel and gemcitabine are given by IV on days 1, 8, and 15 of 28-day cycles for 3 cycles, and the device is worn more than 18 hours a day from cycle 1 day 1 through cycle 3. If stable disease or better, surgery follows, and if the result is R0 or R1, 3 more cycles are given. This is a Phase 2 study; the record mentions two co-primary endpoints without naming them, and secondary measures include overall response rate (ORR), adverse events, and overall survival (OS).
NCT05624918.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa NovoTTF-200T(P), un dispositivo también llamado TTFields en el resumen, combinado con gemcitabina y nab-paclitaxel antes de la cirugía. Va dirigido al adenocarcinoma de páncreas resecable. El nab-paclitaxel y la gemcitabina se administran por vía intravenosa los días 1, 8 y 15 de ciclos de 28 días, durante 3 ciclos, y el dispositivo se usa más de 18 horas al día desde el día 1 del ciclo 1 hasta el ciclo 3. Si la enfermedad está estable o mejor, se realiza la cirugía, y si el resultado es R0 o R1, se dan 3 ciclos más. Es un estudio de Fase 2; el registro menciona dos criterios principales co-primarios sin nombrarlos, e incluye como medidas secundarias la tasa de respuesta global (ORR), los eventos adversos y la supervivencia global (OS).
who_for: Age 18 or older, with Karnofsky performance status of 70% or higher.
Pathology-confirmed pancreatic adenocarcinoma with a resectable primary tumor on imaging.
Measurable disease by RECIST v1.1.
No prior surgery, radiation, chemotherapy, targeted or investigational therapy for pancreatic cancer.
Adequate blood counts, kidney function, and liver function.
not_for: Evidence of distant metastasis.
Electrical implanted device in the torso, such as a pacemaker or defibrillator.
Significant uncontrolled heart disease or symptomatic arrhythmia.
Known allergy to medical adhesives or conductive hydrogel.
Pregnancy or breastfeeding, or another malignancy that could interfere with the study.

NCT04691817.summary_en: This study tests tocilizumab given together with atezolizumab in adults with advanced non-small cell lung cancer that did not respond to first-line immune checkpoint inhibitor-based therapy. Atezolizumab 1200 mg and tocilizumab 6 mg/kg (or 4 mg/kg) are given by IV infusion every 21 days; how long treatment continues is not stated. The study is Phase 1/Phase 2 and aims to evaluate safety and effectiveness; the specific main outcome measure is not stated.
NCT04691817.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa tocilizumab administrado junto con atezolizumab en adultos con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas avanzado que no respondió a la terapia de primera línea basada en inhibidores de puntos de control inmunitario. Atezolizumab 1200 mg y tocilizumab 6 mg/kg (o 4 mg/kg) se administran por infusión intravenosa cada 21 días; no se indica cuánto tiempo continúa el tratamiento. El estudio es de Fase 1/Fase 2 y busca evaluar la seguridad y la eficacia; la medida de resultado principal específica no se indica.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with advanced non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer (Stage IV or recurrent after curative-intent therapy).
Has had at least one prior line of therapy.
Received a checkpoint inhibitor in the line of therapy immediately before joining the trial.
ECOG performance status 0 to 2.
not_for: Has a driver mutation that responds to targeted therapy.
Had prior immunotherapy side effects above grade 3.
Has another active invasive cancer needing ongoing treatment.
Has progressing or untreated brain metastases, or leptomeningeal disease.
Has a history of autoimmune disease or interstitial pulmonary fibrosis (IPF).

NCT06726148.summary_en: This study is testing ECI830 alone and in combination with ribociclib and fulvestrant in patients with advanced HR-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer, advanced CCNE1-amplified solid tumors, and extensive-stage small cell lung cancer. The record does not state how ECI830 is given, how often, or for how long. The main goals are safety and tolerability with a dose range in Phase I, and anti-tumor activity in Phase II (Phase 1/2 study).
NCT06726148.summary_es: Este estudio prueba ECI830 solo y en combinación con ribociclib y fulvestrant en pacientes con cáncer de mama avanzado HR positivo y HER2 negativo, tumores sólidos avanzados con amplificación de CCNE1 y cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas en etapa extensa. El registro no indica cómo se administra ECI830, con qué frecuencia ni por cuánto tiempo. Los objetivos principales son la seguridad y tolerabilidad, con un rango de dosis en la Fase I, y la actividad antitumoral en la Fase II (estudio de Fase 1/2).
who_for: Adults aged 18 years or older.
HR-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer that progressed on hormone therapy with a CDK4/6 inhibitor (Phase I), or on an aromatase inhibitor or tamoxifen with a
Advanced solid tumor with a CCNE1 amplification, confirmed by biopsy or cytology (Phase I).
Extensive-stage small cell lung cancer that progressed on or after standard treatment (Phase I).
Measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 (Phase II); some breast cancer patients without measurable disease need a predominantly lytic bone lesion.
not_for: Previous treatment with a CDK2 inhibitor at any time.
Inadequate bone marrow or organ function based on out-of-range lab values.
Clinically significant uncontrolled heart disease or heart rhythm (repolarization) abnormality, including long QT syndrome.
Symptomatic brain metastases, or brain metastases needing local therapy or rising steroid doses within 2 weeks before entry.
Women who are pregnant or nursing, or who could become pregnant and will not use highly effective contraception; also patients using hormone replacement therapy

NCT07532525.summary_en: This phase 1 study tests pomalidomide given after CD19-directed CAR T-cell therapy in patients with relapsed or refractory CD19+ B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia or B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. Pomalidomide is taken by mouth once a day for 10 doses, as long as the disease does not progress and side effects are not unacceptable. The record does not state a main outcome measure; it is a phase 1 study.
NCT07532525.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 prueba la pomalidomida administrada después de la terapia con células CAR T dirigidas a CD19 en pacientes con leucemia linfoblástica aguda de células B o linfoma no Hodgkin de células B, CD19+, recidivantes o refractarios. La pomalidomida se toma por vía oral una vez al día, durante 10 dosis, siempre que la enfermedad no progrese y la toxicidad no sea inaceptable. El registro no indica el resultado principal del estudio; se trata de un estudio de fase 1.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with relapsed or refractory CD19+ B-cell leukemia or lymphoma
Received an approved commercial CD19 CAR T-cell product
Enrolled 28 to 56 days after CAR T-cell infusion
Able to swallow pills or tablets
Karnofsky performance score of at least 50%
not_for: Known progressive or refractory disease
Active grade 2 or higher graft versus host disease, cytokine release syndrome, or neurotoxicity
Current cigarette smoking
Stem cell transplant or rescue after the most recent CD19 CAR T-cell therapy
Pregnancy, or HIV positive by PCR within 8 weeks of screening

NCT07397338.summary_en: This study tests the RAS(ON) inhibitors daraxonrasib, elironrasib, and zoldonrasib combined with ivonescimab in adults with advanced or metastatic solid tumors that have a RAS mutation, including non-small cell lung cancer and colorectal cancer. The RAS(ON) inhibitors are taken as oral tablets, and ivonescimab is given by IV infusion, with some groups also receiving carboplatin or cisplatin with pemetrexed, or cetuximab, by IV infusion; how often and how long treatment lasts is not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and early antitumor activity, and it is a Phase 1/2 study.
NCT07397338.summary_es: Este estudio prueba los inhibidores RAS(ON) daraxonrasib, elironrasib y zoldonrasib combinados con ivonescimab en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados o metastásicos que tienen una mutación RAS, incluido cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas y cáncer colorrectal. Los inhibidores RAS(ON) se toman como tabletas orales, e ivonescimab se administra por infusión intravenosa; algunos grupos también reciben carboplatino o cisplatino con pemetrexed, o cetuximab, por infusión intravenosa. La frecuencia y la duración del tratamiento no se indican. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética y la actividad antitumoral preliminar, y es un estudio de fase 1/2.
who_for: Adults 18 or older who have given informed consent
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1
Advanced or metastatic solid tumor with a RAS mutation in KRAS, HRAS, or NRAS
Measurable disease per RECIST v1.1
Able to take oral medications
not_for: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
Conditions that may affect taking or absorbing the study drug
Major surgery within 4 weeks before study drug
Unable or unwilling to follow required study visits or procedures
Other inclusion or exclusion criteria may apply (not stated in detail)

NCT06956690.summary_en: The study tests HMBD-501, a HER3-targeted antibody-drug conjugate, in adults with advanced or relapsed HER3-expressing solid tumors, including melanoma, non-small cell lung cancer, and breast cancer. It is given as an intravenous injection once every 3 weeks, and higher doses are tested in successive cohorts during the dose-escalation part. The study measures safety and tolerability in the dose-escalation phase and preliminary efficacy in the dose-expansion phase; it is a Phase 1/2 trial.
NCT06956690.summary_es: El estudio evalúa HMBD-501, un conjugado anticuerpo-fármaco dirigido a HER3, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados o recidivantes que expresan HER3, incluidos melanoma, cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas y cáncer de mama. Se administra como inyección intravenosa una vez cada 3 semanas, y en cohortes sucesivas se prueban dosis más altas durante la fase de escalado de dosis. El estudio mide la seguridad y la tolerabilidad en la fase de escalado de dosis y la eficacia preliminar en la fase de expansión; es un ensayo de fase 1/2.
who_for: Advanced HER3-positive melanoma, EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer, or breast cancer.
Disease that has relapsed or is refractory to standard therapy, or for which standard therapy is not an option.
ECOG performance status 0 to 2.
Body weight at least 40 kg.
Willing to have a fresh tumor biopsy for HER3 testing if no HER3 report is available.
not_for: Recent anti-tumor drug, investigational drug, or major surgery within the stated time windows.
Prior HER3-targeted ADC, or exatecan-type ADC, as last line of therapy.
Prior topoisomerase I inhibitor as last line of therapy.
History of non-infectious drug-induced pneumonitis or interstitial lung disease.
Known HIV, hepatitis B, or hepatitis C infection, or symptomatic or uncontrolled brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease.

NCT06789848.summary_en: This study tests ligufalimab (AK117) given together with cadonilimab (AK104) in advanced hepatocellular carcinoma (liver cancer) and biliary tract cancer that has failed prior therapy. Both drugs are given by intravenous infusion in the clinic on day 1 of every 21-day cycle, with ligufalimab infused over 120 minutes and cadonilimab over 60 minutes, starting at least 30 minutes after ligufalimab. Treatment continues if evaluations show the disease has not gotten worse, and the main outcome measure is not stated; this is a Phase 2 study.
NCT06789848.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa ligufalimab (AK117) administrado junto con cadonilimab (AK104) en cáncer de hígado avanzado (carcinoma hepatocelular) y cáncer de vías biliares que ha fracasado a tratamientos previos. Ambos medicamentos se administran por infusión intravenosa en la clínica el día 1 de cada ciclo de 21 días, con ligufalimab durante 120 minutos y cadonilimab durante 60 minutos, iniciando al menos 30 minutos después de ligufalimab. El tratamiento continúa si las evaluaciones muestran que la enfermedad no ha empeorado, y la medida de resultado principal no está indicada; es un estudio de fase 2.
who_for: Advanced or metastatic liver or biliary cancer not suitable for surgery or local therapy, or progressed after these treatments.
Disease that is refractory to or has relapsed after prior anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1 antibody therapy.
At least one measurable lesion of at least 1 cm on contrast imaging.
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance score of 0 to 1.
Adequate blood counts, organ function and albumin; Child-Pugh A or B7 for the liver cancer cohort.
not_for: Prior liver transplant or other solid-organ transplant.
Stopped prior immune checkpoint inhibitor due to Grade 4 toxicity, or due to Grade 2 or higher serious immune-related toxicity.
Active autoimmune disease or autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment in the past 2 years.
Known active tuberculosis, known HIV positive status, or pregnancy or breastfeeding.
Symptomatic or clinically active brain metastases, leptomeningeal disease, or carcinomatous meningitis.

NCT05725291.summary_en: This phase 1 study is testing AMT-116, a drug given to adults with advanced solid tumors. AMT-116 is given into a vein (intravenously), and how often and for how long it is given is not stated. The study measures the maximum tolerated dose and recommended phase 2 dose, safety, tolerability, anti-tumor activity, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics and immunogenicity.
NCT05725291.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 prueba AMT-116, un medicamento que se administra a adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados. AMT-116 se administra por vena (intravenosa), y la frecuencia y la duración del tratamiento no se indican. El estudio mide la dosis máxima tolerada y la dosis recomendada para fase 2, la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la actividad antitumoral, la farmacocinética, la farmacodinamia y la inmunogenicidad.
who_for: Adults aged 18 years or older.
Unresectable advanced solid tumor confirmed by tissue examination.
Disease progressed after at least one systemic therapy, with no further standard therapy available or standard therapy not tolerated.
At least one measurable lesion as defined by RECIST version 1.1.
ECOG performance status of 0 to 1.
not_for: Prior antibody-drug conjugate based on a Top1 inhibitor.
Central nervous system metastasis.
Active or chronic skin disorder requiring systemic therapy, or history of Stevens-Johnson syndrome or toxic epidermal necrolysis.
Active eye conditions requiring treatment or close monitoring.
Pregnant or breast-feeding females, or significant cardiac disease.

NCT05074290.summary_en: The study tests Epidiferphane given together with taxane chemotherapy (paclitaxel, nab-paclitaxel, or docetaxel) in people with breast cancer. Epidiferphane is taken as tablets by mouth three times daily, for a maximum of three months. The record does not list a primary outcome measure; it says the study will look at side effects and tumor response rate, and it is a Phase 1/Phase 2 study.
NCT05074290.summary_es: El estudio evalúa Epidiferphane administrado junto con quimioterapia con taxanos (paclitaxel, nab-paclitaxel o docetaxel) en personas con cáncer de mama. Epidiferphane se toma en tabletas por vía oral tres veces al día, durante un máximo de tres meses. El registro no enumera una medida de resultado principal; indica que el estudio observará los efectos secundarios y la tasa de respuesta tumoral, y es un estudio de Fase 1/Fase 2.
who_for: At least 18 years old.
Breast cancer. Phase I: starting neoadjuvant chemotherapy or metastatic breast cancer. Phase II: breast cancer of any stage.
About to start paclitaxel, nab-paclitaxel, or docetaxel at UF Health at the listed doses.
ECOG performance status 3 or less, per treating physician.
Will continue cancer therapy at UF Health for at least the next three months.
not_for: Receiving any other investigational agent.
Pregnant or breastfeeding.
Grade 2 or higher peripheral sensory or motor neuropathy, or grade 1 or higher paresthesia.
ALT or AST above 2.5 times the upper limit of normal, bilirubin above set limits, or GFR under 50 mL/min.
Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors such as tacrolimus or verapamil, or known allergy to turmeric, broccoli, or green tea.

NCT05801913.summary_en: This phase 1 study tests CMV-specific CD19 CAR T cells given with a CMV-MVA triplex vaccine in people with relapsed or refractory intermediate or high grade B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. Patients have leukapheresis, then lymphodepleting chemotherapy on days -10 to -3, CAR T cells by IV on day 0, and the vaccine by IM on days 28 and 56. The study measures safety and feasibility, and the phase is 1.
NCT05801913.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa células T CAR CD19 específicas para CMV, administradas junto con la vacuna triple CMV-MVA, en personas con linfoma no Hodgkin de células B de grado intermedio o alto que recayó o es refractario. Los pacientes se someten a leucaféresis, luego reciben quimioterapia de linfodepleción entre los días -10 y -3, células CAR T por vía IV el día 0, y la vacuna por vía IM los días 28 y 56. El estudio mide la seguridad y la factibilidad, y la fase es 1.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older
Relapsed or refractory intermediate or high-grade B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma
Not eligible for, refuses, or previously received autologous stem cell transplant
CMV seropositive
Karnofsky performance status of 70 or higher and life expectancy of at least 16 weeks
not_for: Prior allogeneic stem cell transplant with active graft versus host disease
Current systemic steroids or chronic immunosuppressant use
Active central nervous system disease, seizure disorder, or central nervous system masses
HIV positive or active viral hepatitis
Pregnant or breastfeeding

NCT07406633.summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests KQB198 taken together with imatinib in people with advanced or metastatic gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST). Both drugs are taken by mouth, and the dosing schedule and length of treatment are not stated. The study aims to assess safety, tolerability and how well the combination works; a main outcome measure is not stated.
NCT07406633.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa KQB198 administrado junto con imatinib en personas con tumor del estroma gastrointestinal (GIST) avanzado o metastásico. Ambos medicamentos se toman por vía oral, y el esquema de dosis y la duración del tratamiento no se indican. El estudio busca evaluar la seguridad, la tolerabilidad y qué tan eficaz es la combinación; no se indica una medida de resultado principal.
who_for: Unresectable or metastatic disease, with GIST confirmed by tissue.
A KIT or PDGFRA mutation found by local blood or tumor testing.
Measurable disease according to RECIST v1.1.
Being in first-line treatment for advanced or metastatic disease.
Age 18 or older, with adequate organ function and performance status.
not_for: Has a KIT exon 9 mutation or the PDGFRA D842V mutation.
Unable to swallow, or has a GI condition that prevents absorption.
Other active malignancy within the last 2 years.
History of hypersensitivity to any component of KQB198 or imatinib.

NCT07337525.summary_en:
The study tests PLT012, an anti-CD36 monoclonal antibody, in adults with advanced solid tumors. It is a Phase 1, first-in-human, open-label dose-escalation study with no placebo group.
PLT012 is given by intravenous infusion once every 3 weeks and continues until the disease worsens or the participant cannot tolerate it, with more frequent clinic visits during the first 12 weeks.
The study measures side effects and toxicities at different doses, blood levels of PLT012 over time, and effects on tumor size or cancer progression.
NCT07337525.summary_es:
El estudio evalúa PLT012, un anticuerpo monoclonal anti-CD36, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados. Es un estudio de Fase 1, de primera administración en humanos, abierto y de escalamiento de dosis, sin grupo de placebo.
PLT012 se administra por infusión intravenosa una vez cada 3 semanas y continúa hasta que la enfermedad empeore o el participante no pueda tolerarlo; durante las primeras 12 semanas las visitas a la clínica son más frecuentes.
El estudio mide los efectos secundarios y toxicidades con distintas dosis, los niveles de PLT012 en sangre a lo largo del tiempo y los efectos sobre el tamaño del tumor o la progresión del cáncer.
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older who gave written informed consent.
Histologically or cytologically confirmed advanced solid tumor, except primary CNS malignancies.
At least one measurable lesion per RECIST v1.1.
ECOG performance status of 0 to 1.
Life expectancy of 12 weeks or more.
not_for: Ongoing grade 2 or higher toxicity from prior treatment, with some exceptions.
Another malignancy diagnosed within 2 years, with some exceptions.
Uncontrolled HIV, uncontrolled hepatitis B, or uncontrolled acute hepatitis C.
Unstable, uncontrolled, or untreated CNS metastasis.
Active or recent (within 3 years) autoimmune disease requiring medical treatment.

NCT06569147.summary_en: This study tests elranatamab in people with relapsed or refractory AL amyloidosis. It is a Phase I/II study. Elranatamab is given under the skin in 28-day cycles, for 6 cycles total. The study measures safety, tolerability and efficacy.
NCT06569147.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa elranatamab en personas con amiloidosis AL recidivante o refractaria. Es un estudio de Fase I/II. Elranatamab se administra debajo de la piel en ciclos de 28 días, por un total de 6 ciclos. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad y la eficacia.
who_for: Diagnosed with AL amyloidosis that has relapsed or not responded after at least one prior line of therapy.
Light chain disease progression, with dFLC above 20 mg/L.
Age 18 or older, with ECOG status 2 or better, or Karnofsky score of 60% or more.
Blood counts, liver function and kidney function within the limits the record defines.
Prior treatment with daratumumab plus CyBorD.
not_for: Prior BCMA-targeting bispecific antibody or BCMA-targeting CAR-T therapy.
Refractory to belantamab mafodotin, or belantamab as the most recent prior line.
Active cancer or malignancy, with listed exceptions.
Pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning pregnancy during the study.
Heart problems such as LVEF below 30%, recent acute coronary syndrome, or uncontrolled arrhythmias.

NCT04131413.summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests a DNA vaccine called pNGVL4aCRTE6E7L2 in women with HPV16-positive high-grade cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN2 or CIN3). The vaccine is given as an intramuscular injection with TriGrid electroporation at escalating doses of 0.3 mg, 1.0 mg, and 3.0 mg, and how often doses are given is not stated. The main goal is to measure safety and tolerability.
NCT04131413.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa una vacuna de ADN llamada pNGVL4aCRTE6E7L2 en mujeres con neoplasia cervical intraepitelial de alto grado (CIN2 o CIN3) positiva para VPH16. La vacuna se aplica como inyección intramuscular con electroporación TriGrid, en dosis crecientes de 0,3 mg, 1,0 mg y 3,0 mg, y no se indica con qué frecuencia se aplican las dosis. El objetivo principal es medir la seguridad y la tolerabilidad.
who_for: Adult women aged 19 or older with biopsy-confirmed CIN2 or CIN3 on colposcopy.
Cervical sample positive for HPV16 on an FDA-approved genotyping test.
HIV-negative, or HIV-positive with documented HIV-1 infection and willingness to take effective antiretroviral therapy.
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1 and life expectancy greater than 4 months.
Normal blood counts and organ function within 45 days of enrollment.
not_for: HPV16-negative high-grade cervical lesions.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women.
Active or chronic hepatitis B or hepatitis C infection.
Metal implants at the injection site or electronic stimulation devices such as pacemakers.
Active autoimmune disease such as lupus, celiac disease, or multiple sclerosis.

NCT07492680.summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests navlimetostat (BMS-986504) alone and with other anti-cancer drugs in people with advanced or metastatic solid tumors that have MTAP deletion. The record does not state the route, dose amount, or how long or how often treatment is given; it only says the drugs are given at a specified dose on specified days. The study will assess safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and preliminary anti-tumor activity.
NCT07492680.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa navlimetostat (BMS-986504) solo y con otros medicamentos contra el cáncer en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados o metastásicos que tienen deleción de MTAP. El registro no indica la vía, la dosis, ni con qué frecuencia o durante cuánto tiempo se administra el tratamiento; solo señala que los medicamentos se dan en una dosis específica en días específicos. El estudio evaluará la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética, la farmacodinámica y la actividad antitumoral preliminar.
who_for: Advanced or metastatic solid tumor with homozygous MTAP deletion or MTAP loss in tumor tissue
Progression after prior therapy, or no prior systemic therapy, depending on the cohort
At least one measurable tumor lesion on RECIST v1.1 or mRECIST, and RANO 2.0 where applicable
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1
INR and APTT at or below 1.5 times upper limit of normal (2 times if liver involvement)
not_for: Prior treatment with a PRMT5 or MAT2A inhibitor
Active brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis (treated, stable brain metastases may be allowed)
Gastrointestinal conditions in the past 6 months that could affect absorption or swallowing pills
Inadequate organ function on screening lab tests
Active hepatitis B or hepatitis C

NCT06013423.summary_en: This Phase 2 trial is testing an umbilical cord blood transplant given with cyclophosphamide, fludarabine, and total-body irradiation. It is for people aged 6 months to 65 years with high-risk blood cancers and related conditions. Drugs are given into a vein, and cyclosporine can be given by vein or by mouth. How often and for how long is not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated.
NCT06013423.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 2 estudia un trasplante de sangre de cordón umbilical administrado junto con ciclofosfamida, fludarabina y radiación corporal total. Está dirigido a personas de 6 meses a 65 años con cánceres de la sangre de alto riesgo y condiciones relacionadas. Los medicamentos se administran por vena, y la ciclosporina puede administrarse por vena o por vía oral. La frecuencia y la duración no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica.
who_for: Aged 6 months to 65 years at time of consent.
Acute leukemia (AML, ALL, or related types) in first or later remission, with low marrow blast levels.
Chronic myeloid leukemia in first chronic phase that did not respond to or could not tolerate tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapy.
Certain MDS, MPD, non-Hodgkin lymphoma, or BPDCN cases meeting remission or disease criteria.
Adequate performance status and kidney, liver, heart, and lung function.
not_for: Myelofibrosis or moderate-severe bone marrow fibrosis.
Prior allogeneic transplant, two prior stem cell transplants, or an autologous transplant within 12 months.
Checkpoint inhibitor use in the last 12 months.
Active uncontrolled infection or HIV infection.
Pregnancy or breastfeeding, or inability to give informed consent or follow the protocol.

NCT06814496.summary_en: This study tests tarlatamab given with radiation therapy in people with tumors that express DLL3, including small cell lung cancer and several other cancer types. Tarlatamab is given by infusion, starting with a 1 mg step-up dose on Cycle 1 Day 1, then 10 mg on Cycle 1 Days 8 and 15 and every 2 weeks after that, until progression or up to 24 months. Radiation is given as standard of care, starting between Cycle 1 Day 16 and Cycle 2 Day 28. The main measure is safety, and a nested phase II part also measures objective response rate (ORR) in tumors that are not small cell lung cancer.
NCT06814496.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa tarlatamab administrado junto con radioterapia en personas con tumores que expresan DLL3, incluido el cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas y otros tipos de cáncer. Tarlatamab se administra por infusión, comenzando con una dosis inicial escalonada de 1 mg en el Ciclo 1 Día 1, luego 10 mg en el Ciclo 1 Días 8 y 15, y cada 2 semanas después, hasta la progresión o hasta 24 meses. La radioterapia se administra como tratamiento estándar, comenzando entre el Ciclo 1 Día 16 y el Ciclo 2 Día 28. La medida principal es la seguridad, y una parte de fase II anidada también mide la tasa de respuesta objetiva (ORR) en tumores que no son cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas.
who_for: Relapsed or refractory small cell lung cancer or other tumors with small cell histology.
Certain high-grade neuroendocrine tumors with high DLL3 prevalence, or DLL3-positive tumors by IHC.
Progressed or recurred after at least one line of therapy.
ECOG performance status 0 to 2 and life expectancy of at least 12 weeks.
Measurable lesion and eligible for external beam radiation to an unirradiated lesion.
not_for: Interstitial lung disease or active, non-infectious pneumonitis.
Recurrent grade 2 or higher pneumonitis, or severe immune-mediated reactions on immuno-oncology agents.
Planned re-irradiation of a previously irradiated site.
Leptomeningeal disease requiring craniospinal irradiation.
Myocardial infarction or symptomatic heart failure within 12 months of first dose.

NCT07221474.summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests intismeran autogene (V940) with pembrolizumab and chemotherapy, compared with placebo, as first-line treatment for metastatic squamous non-small cell lung cancer. Intismeran autogene is given as an injection into the muscle on Days 1 and 22 of cycles, up to 2 doses in induction and up to 7 doses in maintenance, while pembrolizumab is given by IV infusion every 6 weeks for up to 15 doses in maintenance. The study measures whether participants live longer overall and go longer without the cancer growing or spreading, compared with participants who receive placebo.
NCT07221474.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa intismeran autogene (V940) con pembrolizumab y quimioterapia, comparado con placebo, como tratamiento de primera línea para el cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas de tipo escamoso metastásico. Intismeran autogene se administra como inyección en el músculo los días 1 y 22 de los ciclos, hasta 2 dosis en la fase de inducción y hasta 7 dosis en la fase de mantenimiento, mientras que pembrolizumab se administra por infusión intravenosa cada 6 semanas, hasta 15 dosis durante el mantenimiento. El estudio mide si los participantes viven más tiempo en general y pasan más tiempo sin que el cáncer crezca o se propague, en comparación con los participantes que reciben placebo.
who_for: Has squamous non-small cell lung cancer that is stage IV (metastatic).
Has measurable disease based on RECIST 1.1 criteria.
Has a tissue sample from a site not previously treated with radiation.
Has an ECOG performance status of 0 to 1.
Has a life expectancy of at least 3 months and is 18 years or older.
not_for: Has received a prior cancer vaccine, including another personalized cancer vaccine.
Has received prior systemic anticancer therapy for metastatic lung cancer.
Has received prior anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, or anti-PD-L2 therapy, with limited exceptions for early-stage treatment.
Has active central nervous system metastases or carcinomatous meningitis.
Has active autoimmune disease that needed systemic treatment in the past 2 years.

NCT05967182.summary_en: This study tests pembrolizumab added to the chemotherapy drugs gemcitabine and cisplatin, given before and after surgery, in people with potentially resectable intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma. All three drugs are given by IV (into a vein) in 4 cycles of 21 days each, during 9 months of chemotherapy. The main aim is to see whether adding pembrolizumab improves long-term response after surgery, compared with surgery and standard chemotherapy alone.
NCT05967182.summary_es: Este estudio prueba pembrolizumab agregado a los medicamentos quimioterapéuticos gemcitabina y cisplatino, administrados antes y después de la cirugía, en personas con colangiocarcinoma intrahepático potencialmente resecable. Los tres medicamentos se administran por vía intravenosa (en una vena), en 4 ciclos de 21 días cada uno, durante 9 meses de quimioterapia. El objetivo principal es saber si agregar pembrolizumab mejora la respuesta a largo plazo después de la cirugía, en comparación con la cirugía y la quimioterapia estándar sola.
who_for: Age 18 or older and able to give written informed consent
Confirmed intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma that can be measured on scans
High-risk but resectable tumor limited to the liver, bile duct, and/or regional lymph nodes
ECOG performance status of 0 to 1
Adequate blood counts, liver function, and kidney function
not_for: Prior anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, or anti-PD-L2 therapy, or other T-cell checkpoint therapy
Previous systemic therapy for intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
Small cell, neuroendocrine, lymphoma, sarcoma, mixed histology, or mucinous cystic neoplasm
Active central nervous system metastases or carcinomatous meningitis
Active hepatitis B and hepatitis C infection together

NCT05732103.summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests CTX-712, a drug taken by mouth, in adults with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (AML) or higher risk myelodysplastic syndromes (HR-MDS). Patients take 20 mg tablets once or twice a week, depending on their dose level, during each 28-day cycle, and how long treatment continues is not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics in the dose-finding part, and the later Phase 2 part will evaluate therapeutic activity.
NCT05732103.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa CTX-712, un medicamento que se toma por vía oral, en adultos con leucemia mieloide aguda (LMA) recidivante o refractaria, o con síndromes mielodisplásicos (SMD) de mayor riesgo. Los pacientes toman tabletas de 20 mg una o dos veces por semana, según su nivel de dosis, durante cada ciclo de 28 días, y no se indica por cuánto tiempo continúa el tratamiento. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética y la farmacodinamia en la parte de búsqueda de dosis, y la siguiente parte de fase 2 evaluará la actividad terapéutica.
who_for: Adults aged 18 years or older.
Diagnosis of AML, higher risk MDS, or MDS/MPN with high marrow blast count, including CMML.
Prior treatment with 1 to 4 lines of therapy (1 to 3 in expansion cohorts).
Adequate organ function by lab values, and ECOG performance status of 2 or less.
Women who can have children must have a negative pregnancy test and use effective contraception; men with such partners must use contraception or abstain.
not_for: Diagnosis of acute promyelocytic leukemia.
Isolated extramedullary relapse (Phase 2 only).
Active leukemia in the central nervous system.
History of other cancer (malignancy).
Certain heart or lung conditions, pregnancy or breastfeeding, recent major surgery, prior organ or stem cell transplant, CAR-T or modified T cell therapy, or ac

NCT06926920.summary_en: This study tests sacituzumab govitecan-hziy (SG), given at an alternative dose and schedule, in people with advanced triple-negative breast cancer. SG is given into a vein (intravenously), and participants receive it until progression, death, unacceptable toxicity, or another stop criterion is met; the specific dose and how often it is given are not stated. The study measures safety and tolerability, objective response rate, and progression-free survival (Phase 1/2).
NCT06926920.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa sacituzumab govitecan-hziy (SG), administrado en una dosis y un esquema alternativos, en personas con cáncer de mama triple negativo avanzado. El SG se administra por vena (intravenosa) y los participantes lo reciben hasta progresión de la enfermedad, muerte, toxicidad inaceptable u otro criterio de suspensión; la dosis específica y la frecuencia no se indican. El estudio mide la seguridad y la tolerancia, la tasa de respuesta objetiva y la supervivencia libre de progresión (Fase 1/2).
who_for: Adults 18 or older who can give written informed consent.
Confirmed triple-negative breast cancer that is unresectable, locally advanced, or metastatic.
Phase 1: refractory or relapsed after at least one prior systemic therapy; UGT1A1 wild-type during safety run-in.
Phase 2: no prior systemic therapy for advanced disease, and PD-L1 CPS below 10 (exceptions apply for CPS 10 or higher).
Measurable disease, ECOG 0 or 1, and adequate blood counts, liver and kidney function.
not_for: Prior treatment with a topoisomerase 1 inhibitor or an antibody-drug conjugate containing one.
Prior treatment with a TROP2-directed antibody-drug conjugate.

NCT06807086.summary_en: This study tests a virtual cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBT-I) program, the Survivorship Sleep Program, in cancer survivors with chronic insomnia. It is compared with enhanced usual care, which includes a sleep hygiene handout and a referral for CBT-I. The program is given in 4 weekly virtual sessions led by a trained facilitator, plus 1 booster session at week 6. The main outcome measured is insomnia severity.
NCT06807086.summary_es: Este estudio prueba un programa virtual de terapia cognitivo-conductual para el insomnio (TCC-I), llamado Survivorship Sleep Program, en sobrevivientes de cáncer con insomnio crónico. Se compara con la atención habitual mejorada, que incluye un folleto de higiene del sueño y una referencia para TCC-I. El programa se ofrece en 4 sesiones virtuales semanales dirigidas por un facilitador capacitado, más 1 sesión de refuerzo en la semana 6. El resultado principal que se mide es la gravedad del insomnio.
who_for: Cancer survivors with a solid or blood cancer that has not spread, after primary treatment is complete or during current treatment.
Cancer survivors with metastatic cancer taking hormonal, maintenance, oral, or immunotherapy drugs to prevent progression.
Chronic insomnia according to DSM-5 criteria.
Age 18 years or older.
not_for: Self-reported inability to speak and write English.
Undertreated sleep disorder other than insomnia, such as sleep apnea.
Undertreated epilepsy, serious mental illness, or suicidality, or psychiatric hospitalization in the past year.
Unwilling or unable to stop night shift work.

NCT03122197.summary_en: This phase 0/1 study tests letrozole, given together with standard therapy, in people with recurrent high grade gliomas, a type of brain tumor. Letrozole is taken by mouth once daily, starting at 2.5 mg in the dose-finding part and at 15 mg in the expansion cohort, where it is combined with temozolomide 50 mg/m2 by mouth once daily after a 7-day letrozole lead-in; total treatment duration is not stated. The study measures how well letrozole penetrates the blood brain barrier and concentrates in gliomas, along with its safety and tolerability.
NCT03122197.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 0/1 evalúa letrozol, administrado junto con terapia estándar, en personas con gliomas de alto grado recurrentes, un tipo de tumor cerebral. El letrozol se toma por vía oral una vez al día, comenzando con 2,5 mg en la parte de ajuste de dosis y con 15 mg en la cohorte de expansión, donde se combina con temozolomida 50 mg/m2 por vía oral una vez al día tras un periodo previo de 7 días con letrozol; la duración total del tratamiento no se indica. El estudio mide qué tan bien el letrozol atraviesa la barrera hematoencefálica y se concentra en los gliomas, así como su seguridad y tolerabilidad.
who_for: Recurrent high grade glioma, with a plan for resection or biopsy
Age over 18 years
ECOG performance status 0 to 2 (Karnofsky above 60%)
Adequate blood counts, liver and kidney function within set limits
Able to understand and sign written informed consent
not_for: Receiving any other investigational agents
Allergic reaction attributed to letrozole or other study agents (TMZ in sub-study)
Uncontrolled illness, such as recent heart events in last 6 months, active infection, hepatitis B or C, AIDS, or psychiatric illness
Pregnant or nursing women, or patients attempting to conceive
Negative pregnancy test required within 2 weeks for women of childbearing potential

NCT05419089.summary_en: This study tests transoral robotic surgery (TORS) alone for HPV-related oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma in patients whose HPV circulating tumor DNA is undetectable after surgery. The treatment is robotic surgical removal of the tumor through the mouth, and how long or how often it is given is not stated. The study aims to determine whether cancer control and survival are comparable to those reported with standard therapy, and it is a Phase 2 trial.
NCT05419089.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la cirugía robótica transoral (TORS) sola para el carcinoma de células escamosas de orofaringe relacionado con VPH, en pacientes cuyo ADN tumoral circulante de VPH es indetectable después de la cirugía. El tratamiento consiste en la extirpación quirúrgica robótica del tumor a través de la boca, y no se indica cuánto tiempo ni con qué frecuencia se administra. El estudio busca determinar si el control del cáncer y la supervivencia son comparables a los reportados con la terapia estándar, y es un ensayo de Fase 2.
who_for: Resectable p16-positive oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma, early or intermediate stage without distant spread
Detectable pre-surgery HPV circulating tumor DNA (at least 10 fragments/mL)
Undetectable HPV circulating tumor DNA after surgery (under 5 fragments/mL)
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 or 1
Adequate blood counts and kidney function; no active smoking in past 5 years and under 20 pack-years
not_for: Advanced nodal stage, unresectable disease, or unequivocal distant metastases
Non-high-risk HPV subtype, or p16- or HPV-negative cancer
5 or more positive lymph nodes on final pathology
Detectable HPV circulating tumor DNA (over 5 fragments/mL) 1 to 5 weeks after surgery
Pregnancy, breastfeeding, or concurrent anti-cancer therapy

NCT06738303.summary_en: This Phase 2 study compares cabazitaxel with or without carboplatin against 177Lu-PSMA-617 in men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer that is PSMA-positive. Cabazitaxel 20 mg/m2 is given as a one-hour IV infusion every three weeks, and carboplatin AUC 4 mg/mL/min is given every three weeks, each for up to 10 cycles or until progression or unacceptable toxicity. 177Lu-PSMA-617 7.4 GBq is given IV on Day 1 of each 6-week cycle for up to 6 cycles; the main outcome is not stated.
NCT06738303.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 compara cabazitaxel con o sin carboplatino frente a 177Lu-PSMA-617 en hombres con cáncer de próstata metastásico resistente a la castración que es positivo para PSMA. El cabazitaxel 20 mg/m2 se administra en infusión intravenosa de una hora cada tres semanas, y el carboplatino AUC 4 mg/mL/min se administra cada tres semanas, en ambos casos por hasta 10 ciclos o hasta progresión o toxicidad inaceptable. El 177Lu-PSMA-617 7.4 GBq se administra por vía intravenosa el Día 1 de cada ciclo de 6 semanas, por hasta 6 ciclos; el resultado principal no está indicado.
who_for: Prostate adenocarcinoma confirmed by pathology or cytology.
Metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer that progressed on an androgen receptor pathway inhibitor.
PSMA-positive on PET scan, with at least one site SUVmax 10 or higher.
Baseline PSMA SUVmean below 10, or visceral metastasis, or 5 or more bone metastases, or a TP53 or PTEN mutation.
Age over 18 years and ECOG performance status 0 to 2.
not_for: Evidence of hormone-sensitive prostate cancer.
Evidence of small cell prostate cancer.
Receiving any other investigational agents.
Another clinically significant malignancy within the previous 2 years, with listed exceptions.
Uncontrolled illness, or prior treatment toxicity not resolved to grade 2 or lower.

NCT05401097.summary_en: This Phase 2 study compares two orders of treatment for patients aged 18 and older with newly diagnosed IDH1 or IDH2 mutated acute myeloid leukemia who are not candidates for intensive induction therapy. Patients receive either an IDH inhibitor (ivosidenib or enasidenib) with azacitidine first, followed by azacitidine with venetoclax, or the reverse order; ivosidenib is taken by mouth once daily on days 1 to 28 of each 28-day cycle, and azacitidine is given IV or SC on set days per cycle. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record; the study is Phase 2.
NCT05401097.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 compara dos órdenes de tratamiento para pacientes de 18 años o más con leucemia mieloide aguda de diagnóstico reciente y con mutación IDH1 o IDH2 que no son candidatos a quimioterapia de inducción intensiva. Los pacientes reciben primero un inhibidor de IDH (ivosidenib o enasidenib) con azacitidina, seguido de azacitidina con venetoclax, o el orden inverso; el ivosidenib se toma por vía oral una vez al día en los días 1 a 28 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y la azacitidina se administra por vía IV o SC en días establecidos de cada ciclo. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia with an IDH1 or IDH2 mutation
Not a candidate for, or refuses, intensive induction therapy
ECOG performance status of 0 to 2
Creatinine clearance above 40 mL/min and liver and bilirubin levels within the listed limits
Age 18 years or older
not_for: Acute promyelocytic leukemia
Known active leukemia involving the central nervous system
Any other active cancer needing therapy that would interfere with study results
Uncontrolled infection, or uncontrolled hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or HIV
Pregnancy or breastfeeding

NCT05470491.summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests whether cyclophosphamide, bortezomib, and maraviroc can prevent graft-versus-host disease after a half-matched bone marrow transplant in people with HIV and blood cancers. Patients receive preparation drugs for about 2 weeks before the transplant and other drugs after it, and they stay in the hospital for 6 weeks or longer. The first phase checks whether the drug combination is safe, and the second phase checks how well it protects against graft-versus-host disease.
NCT05470491.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa si la ciclofosfamida, el bortezomib y la maraviroc pueden prevenir la enfermedad de injerto contra huésped después de un trasplante de médula ósea con donante medio compatible, en personas con VIH y cánceres de la sangre. Los pacientes reciben medicamentos de preparación durante unas 2 semanas antes del trasplante y otros medicamentos después, y permanecen en el hospital por 6 semanas o más. La primera fase revisa si la combinación de medicamentos es segura, y la segunda fase revisa qué tan bien protege contra la enfermedad de injerto contra huésped.
who_for: Adults and older teens living with HIV whose viral load is under 400 copies/mL on a stable HIV regimen
Hematologic malignancy with a standard indication for transplant, such as certain leukemias, lymphomas, or myelodysplastic syndrome
Karnofsky performance score of at least 50 percent
At least one potentially suitable half-matched (haploidentical) family or related donor
Adequate heart, lung, liver, and kidney function
not_for: Leukemia or myeloma not in remission, or lymphoma not responding to treatment
Pregnancy, or breastfeeding without willingness to stop before treatment
Known prohibitive allergy to any study drug
Grade 3-4 motor or sensory neuropathy
Active psychiatric disorder that could affect compliance with the transplant plan

NCT04105270.summary_en: This Phase 2 trial tests oral Restorative Microbiota Therapy (RMT) capsules or placebo, given with durvalumab and chemotherapy, in people with untreated advanced or metastatic lung adenocarcinoma. RMT or placebo capsules are taken weekly for 16 doses, durvalumab 1500 mg IV is given every 4 weeks until progression or for up to two years, and cisplatin or carboplatin with pemetrexed is given every 3 weeks for 4 cycles. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is Phase 2.
NCT04105270.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa cápsulas orales de terapia restauradora de microbiota (RMT) o placebo, combinadas con durvalumab y quimioterapia, en personas con adenocarcinoma de pulmón avanzado o metastásico que no han recibido tratamiento. Las cápsulas de RMT o placebo se toman una vez por semana durante 16 dosis; durvalumab 1500 mg por vía intravenosa se administra cada 4 semanas hasta la progresión o por un máximo de dos años, y cisplatino o carboplatino con pemetrexed se administra cada 3 semanas durante 4 ciclos. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with untreated advanced or metastatic lung adenocarcinoma, stage IIIB/C or IV.
Measurable disease according to RECIST 1.1.
No EGFR sensitizing mutation and no ALK or ROS1 translocation.
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
Archived unstained tumor tissue available, with known PD-L1 TC status assayed by Ventana SP263.
not_for: Squamous, large cell, NSCLC NOS, or mixed tumor histology.
Untreated brain metastasis or active leptomeningeal carcinomatosis.
Prior anti-PD-1, PD-L1, or durvalumab treatment, except certain adjuvant therapy more than six months ago.
Daily probiotic use within 4 weeks before the first dose.
Active or prior autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment within 2 years, or interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis needing steroids.

NCT01853631.summary_en: This phase 1 study tests CD19-specific CAR T cells, which are a patient's own T cells changed to target CD19, in people with non-Hodgkin lymphoma, chronic lymphocytic leukemia, or acute lymphocytic leukemia that has returned or has not gone away. The cells are given by infusion at stated dose levels of 1×10^6, 5×10^6, or 2×10^7 cells/m² in the dose-escalation phase, and at the maximum tolerated dose in the expansion phase; how long and how often are not stated. The study aims to find the highest safe dose and to measure how long the cells last, side effects, and whether the therapy might help.
NCT01853631.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 prueba células T con receptor quimérico específico para CD19, que son células T propias del paciente modificadas para atacar CD19, en personas con linfoma no Hodgkin, leucemia linfocítica crónica o leucemia linfoblástica aguda que han recidivado o no han desaparecido. Las células se administran por infusión en niveles de dosis indicados de 1×10^6, 5×10^6 o 2×10^7 células/m² en la fase de escalado de dosis, y en la dosis máxima tolerada en la fase de expansión; no se indica la duración ni la frecuencia. El estudio busca encontrar la dosis más alta segura y medir cuánto tiempo duran las células, los efectos secundarios y si la terapia podría ayudar.
who_for: Recurrent B-cell lymphoma, or ALL or CLL that has come back or not gone away
Newly diagnosed ALL or CLL when standard therapy cannot be given or completed
Relapsed or refractory aggressive B-cell lymphoma with a planned high-dose therapy and stem cell transplant
Tumor is CD19-positive
Age 75 or younger; the first 3 patients must be adults 18 or older
not_for: Active infection needing antibiotics, or active HIV or HTLV infection
Other cancer history unless treated with curative intent at least 2 years before entry
Investigational agents or tumor vaccines within the previous 6 weeks
Allergy to murine (mouse) protein-containing products; pregnant or breastfeeding
Tumor location where enlargement could cause airway obstruction

NCT07200102.summary_en: This study tests selinexor, given as maintenance treatment after CAR-T cell therapy (cilta-cel) in adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma, a blood cancer. Selinexor is taken orally as tablets on Days 1, 8, 15, and 22 of each 28-day cycle, for up to 12 cycles, starting at Day 30 or after Day 58 after the CAR-T infusion. The study aims to measure the safety and toxicity of selinexor; this is a Phase 1 study.
NCT07200102.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa selinexor, administrado como tratamiento de mantenimiento después de la terapia con células CAR-T (cilta-cel) en adultos con mieloma múltiple recidivante o refractario, un cáncer de la sangre. El selinexor se toma por vía oral en tabletas los días 1, 8, 15 y 22 de cada ciclo de 28 días, por hasta 12 ciclos, comenzando el día 30 o después del día 58 tras la infusión de CAR-T. El estudio busca medir la seguridad y la toxicidad del selinexor; es un estudio de Fase 1.
who_for: Multiple myeloma that returned or did not respond, after at least one prior line including a proteasome inhibitor and an immunomodulatory agent.
Myeloma refractory to lenalidomide.
High-risk features such as certain chromosome or gene changes, high beta-2-microglobulin, or extramedullary disease, or MRD-positive disease in standard-risk my
Received or planning to receive standard cilta-cel CAR-T therapy, with ability to monitor response by ClonoSEQ MRD testing.
Age 18 or older, ECOG performance status 2 or less, and adequate blood counts and organ function.
not_for: Active myeloma involving the central nervous system.
Confirmed disease progression after CAR-T therapy.
Unresolved cytokine release syndrome or CAR-T neurologic toxicity.
Prior selinexor or another XPO1 inhibitor after CAR-T therapy.
Uncontrolled infection, serious heart problems, pregnancy, or breastfeeding.

NCT06789159.summary_en: This Phase Ib study tests VK-2019 in adults with relapsed or refractory EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. VK-2019 is taken by mouth once daily in three dose groups: 600 mg, 1200 mg, or 1800 mg per day, in 28-day cycles until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. The record states this is a Phase Ib study and does not state a main outcome measure.
NCT06789159.summary_es: Este estudio de fase Ib evalúa VK-2019 en adultos con linfoma difuso de células B grandes con virus de Epstein-Barr (EBV) positivo que recayó o no respondió al tratamiento. VK-2019 se toma por vía oral una vez al día en tres grupos de dosis: 600 mg, 1200 mg o 1800 mg al día, en ciclos de 28 días hasta progresión de la enfermedad o toxicidad inaceptable. El registro indica que es un estudio de fase Ib y no señala una medida de resultado principal.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older
Relapsed or refractory EBV-positive DLBCL after at least 2 prior systemic therapy regimens
Standard treatment options exhausted
Measurable disease by IWG 2007 criteria
ECOG performance status 2 or less
not_for: Metastatic disease with active brain or leptomeningeal involvement
Severe or active symptomatic heart or lung disease, or significant psychiatric disorder
Current use of drugs that inhibit or induce OATP1B1 or OATP1B3, or proton pump inhibitors
Pregnancy or breastfeeding
QTcF above 470 ms, or post-transplant lymphoproliferative disease

NCT05534646.summary_en: This Phase 2 study compares standard androgen receptor blockade (apalutamide or enzalutamide) with and without carotuximab in patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer that has progressed on an androgen receptor signaling inhibitor. Apalutamide or enzalutamide is taken by mouth once daily on days 1 to 28 of each 28-day cycle, and carotuximab is given intravenously, with escalating doses in cycle 1 and 15 mg/kg every 4 weeks after cycle 2. The main outcome measured is progression-free survival, compared between the two groups using RECIST 1.1 and Prostate Cancer Working Group 3 criteria.
NCT05534646.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 compara el bloqueo estándar del receptor de andrógenos (apalutamida o enzalutamida) con y sin carotuximab en pacientes con cáncer de próstata metastásico resistente a la castración que progresó con un inhibidor de la vía del receptor de andrógenos. La apalutamida o la enzalutamida se toman por vía oral una vez al día durante los días 1 a 28 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y el carotuximab se administra por vía intravenosa, con dosis que aumentan en el ciclo 1 y de 15 mg/kg cada 4 semanas después del ciclo 2. El resultado principal que se mide es la supervivencia libre de progresión, comparada entre los dos grupos según los criterios RECIST 1.1 y del Grupo de Trabajo de Cáncer de Próstata 3.
who_for: Castration-resistant prostate cancer with rising PSA while on a contemporary androgen receptor signaling inhibitor.
PSA rise of 0.2 ng/mL or higher on at least 2 occasions more than 1 week apart.
Surgically castrated, or testosterone under 50 ng/dL while on LHRH analog therapy.
Declined or ineligible for taxane therapy, in the treating physician's opinion.
ECOG performance status of 0 to 1.
not_for: Non-PSA-producing prostate cancers, such as small cell, or radiographic progression without PSA rise.
Other prior malignancy that needs active anticancer therapy.
Prior exposure to carotuximab or any CD105-targeted antibody.
Uncontrolled high blood pressure, high bleeding risk, or acute cardiovascular event within 6 months.
Untreated brain or spinal cord involvement with cancer, or carcinomatous meningitis.

NCT06265727.summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests CRB-701, an antibody-drug conjugate that targets nectin-4, in adults with advanced solid tumors that express nectin-4. CRB-701 is given as an intravenous infusion over 30 minutes, and some arms also receive an anti-PD-1 infusion; how many times and how often is not stated. The main goal is to find a safe and effective dose of CRB-701, and the record does not state a specific primary outcome measure.
NCT06265727.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa CRB-701, un conjugado anticuerpo-fármaco que se dirige a nectin-4, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados que expresan nectin-4. CRB-701 se administra como infusión intravenosa durante 30 minutos, y algunos grupos también reciben una infusión de anti-PD-1; no se indica cuántas veces ni con qué frecuencia. El objetivo principal es encontrar una dosis segura y eficaz de CRB-701, y el registro no indica una medida de resultado principal específica.
who_for: Confirmed diagnosis of select advanced or metastatic solid tumors that express nectin-4
Disease has progressed after all appropriate lines of therapy, or no other standard therapy with proven clinical benefit exists
Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma participants may enroll as first-line therapy in Part C
Age 18 years or older
not_for: Active or uncontrolled brain metastases
History of solid tumors other than the diseases under study
Cardiovascular events or conditions in the previous 6 months, or neuropathy of grade 2 or higher before study
HbA1c of 8% or higher, uncontrolled diabetes, or known diabetic neuropathy
Active eye disease at baseline, severe chronic liver disease or cirrhosis, or interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis within 6 months

NCT05987241.summary_en: This phase 2/3 study tests whether a blood test that measures circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) can identify people who need more immunotherapy after surgery to remove the bladder, kidney, ureter, or urethra for muscle-invasive urothelial cancer. It also compares nivolumab alone with nivolumab plus relatlimab in some groups. Nivolumab is given by IV over 30 minutes on day 1 of each 28-day cycle, for up to 12 cycles, and relatlimab is given by IV in one arm. The record does not state a primary outcome measure; it is a phase 2/3 trial.
NCT05987241.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2/3 evalúa si una prueba de sangre que mide el ADN tumoral circulante (ctDNA) puede identificar a las personas que necesitan más inmunoterapia después de una cirugía para extirpar la vejiga, el riñón, el uréter o la uretra por cáncer urotelial de invasión muscular. También compara nivolumab solo con nivolumab más relatlimab en algunos grupos. El nivolumab se administra por vía intravenosa durante 30 minutos el día 1 de cada ciclo de 28 días, hasta 12 ciclos, y el relatlimab se administra por vía intravenosa en un brazo. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; es un estudio de fase 2/3.
who_for: Muscle-invasive urothelial cancer of the urethra, bladder, ureter, or renal pelvis treated with radical surgery.
Surgery done about 3 to 12 weeks (or up to 16 weeks, commercial test) before pre-registration.
Surgery pathology shows high-risk features, such as node-positive or advanced tumor stage.
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 to 2.
Blood counts, kidney, and liver tests within the stated limits.
not_for: Partial cystectomy used as the definitive treatment.
Gross cancer at surgical margins, or residual cancer or metastasis after surgery.
Adjuvant systemic therapy or adjuvant radiation after surgery.
Prior LAG-3 blockade, or prior grade 3 or higher immune-related adverse event from PD-1 or PD-L1 blockade.
Current or past myocarditis, or active or recurring autoimmune disease; pregnancy or nursing.

NCT05103683.summary_en: This Phase 1 first-in-human study tests TORL-1-23, an antibody drug conjugate, in adults with advanced cancer, including advanced solid tumors, ovarian cancer, endometrial cancer, and non-small cell lung cancer. The record does not state how the drug is given or how often or how long it is given. The study will evaluate safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and antitumor activity.
NCT05103683.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 en humanos por primera vez evalúa TORL-1-23, un conjugado anticuerpo-fármaco, en adultos con cáncer avanzado, incluidos tumores sólidos avanzados, cáncer de ovario, cáncer de endometrio y cáncer de pulmón no microcítico. El registro no indica cómo se administra el fármaco ni con qué frecuencia o durante cuánto tiempo. El estudio evaluará la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética y la actividad antitumoral.
who_for: Advanced solid tumor
Measurable disease according to RECIST v1.1
ECOG performance status 0 to 1
Adequate organ function
not_for: Has not recovered to grade 1 or lower from acute side effects of earlier therapy (except hair loss)
Chemotherapy, investigational, or other cancer therapy within 14 days (small molecule) or 28 days (biologic) before first dose
Progressive or symptomatic brain metastases
Serious uncontrolled medical disorder, nonmalignant systemic disease, or active uncontrolled infection; significant cardiac disease history
History of myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS) or AML, or another cancer within 3 years (some low-risk cancers are not excluded)

NCT05355051.summary_en: This Phase II study tests azacitidine together with pembrolizumab in people with relapsed or refractory Hodgkin lymphoma. Both drugs are given into a vein: pembrolizumab over about 30 minutes every 3 weeks, and azacitidine over about 60 to 90 minutes on Days 1 to 7 of each 28-day cycle. The main outcome is not stated; the study aims to assess efficacy, safety, and tolerability.
NCT05355051.summary_es: Este estudio de fase II prueba azacitidina junto con pembrolizumab en personas con linfoma de Hodgkin recidivante o refractario. Ambos medicamentos se administran por vena: pembrolizumab durante unos 30 minutos cada 3 semanas, y azacitidina durante unos 60 a 90 minutos los días 1 al 7 de cada ciclo de 28 días. El resultado principal no está indicado; el estudio busca evaluar la eficacia, la seguridad y la tolerabilidad.
who_for: Relapsed or progressed Hodgkin lymphoma
Relapsed Hodgkin lymphoma involving extranodal sites
Hodgkin lymphoma patients not regarded as candidates for high-dose conventional chemotherapy
Age 1 year or older; ECOG performance status 3 or lower, or Lansky 50 or higher
AML with relapse or progression is also listed in the inclusion criteria; the record does not explain this
not_for: Allergy to azacitidine or pembrolizumab or their components
Known HIV infection, or active hepatitis B or C
Pregnant or breastfeeding
Known active CNS metastases or carcinomatous meningitis
Active or prior autoimmune disease within the past 2 years, or immunosuppressive medication within 14 days before the first pembrolizumab dose

NCT07175441.summary_en: This study tests RBS2418 added to the STRIDE regimen (tremelimumab plus durvalumab) in adults with advanced, unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma. RBS2418 is taken by mouth at 200 mg or 800 mg twice daily, and tremelimumab 300 mg IV is given once on cycle 1 day 1, while durvalumab 1500 mg IV is given every 4 weeks; total treatment duration is not stated. The main outcome is not stated in the record, and the study is Phase 2 (described as Phase 2a).
NCT07175441.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa RBS2418 añadido al régimen STRIDE (tremelimumab más durvalumab) en adultos con carcinoma hepatocelular avanzado e irresecable. RBS2418 se toma por vía oral a dosis de 200 mg o 800 mg dos veces al día, tremelimumab 300 mg por vía intravenosa se administra solo en el día 1 del ciclo 1 y durvalumab 1500 mg por vía intravenosa cada 4 semanas; la duración total del tratamiento no está indicada. El resultado principal no está indicado en el registro, y el estudio es de Fase 2 (descrito como Fase 2a).
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older at the time of consent
Advanced, unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma
Eligible to receive the STRIDE regimen as first-line therapy
Willing to provide a pre-treatment tissue sample (archival or fresh)
not_for: BCLC stage D disease at screening or before the first dose
Child-Pugh class equal to or higher than B8 at screening or within 7 days before the first dose
Eligible for curative treatments such as surgical resection, liver transplantation, or local ablation
Rapid progression on prior therapy with rapid clinical deterioration

NCT07729150.summary_en: This study tests the Embr Wave, a wearable thermal device that gives a cooling sensation on the wrist, for hot flashes in men with prostate cancer who are receiving androgen deprivation therapy. Participants are randomized 1:1 to use the device right away for 12 weeks or to start it after 6 weeks of usual care. The study aims to find out whether the device reduces hot flash symptoms, measured with patient-reported outcomes; the phase is not applicable (NA).
NCT07729150.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa el Embr Wave, un dispositivo térmico portátil que produce una sensación de enfriamiento en la muñeca, para los sofocos en hombres con cáncer de próstata que reciben terapia de privación androgénica. Los participantes se asignan al azar en una proporción 1:1 para usar el dispositivo de inmediato durante 12 semanas o para empezarlo después de 6 semanas de atención habitual. El estudio busca determinar si el dispositivo reduce los síntomas de sofocos, medidos con resultados reportados por los pacientes; la fase no aplica (NA).
who_for: Men with prostate cancer on androgen deprivation therapy for at least 4 weeks
Must stay on androgen deprivation therapy for the 12-week study
At least 28 hot flashes per week, at least moderately bothersome, for 30 days or more before entry
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status of 2 or less
Able to understand and willing to sign written informed consent
not_for: Pregnant or nursing women
Another diagnosis, including a separate cancer, that may limit life expectancy to under 6 months
Systemic cancer therapy other than approved androgen receptor pathway inhibitors, radioligand therapy, or immunotherapy
Clinical trial participation using standard options in those therapy categories is allowed

NCT07680764.summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests imzokitug combined with pumitamig and platinum-doublet chemotherapy, compared with pumitamig and platinum-doublet chemotherapy alone, as first-line treatment for locally advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer. The record says the study drugs are given at specified doses on specified days, but the route and full schedule are not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated; the record describes the study's purpose as assessing safety, tolerability, and efficacy.
NCT07680764.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa imzokitug combinado con pumitamig y quimioterapia con doble esquema de platino, en comparación con pumitamig y quimioterapia con doble esquema de platino solos, como tratamiento de primera línea para el cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas localmente avanzado o metastásico. El registro indica que los medicamentos del estudio se administran en dosis y días específicos, pero la vía y el esquema completo no se indican. La medida de resultado principal no se indica; el registro describe el propósito del estudio como la evaluación de la seguridad, la tolerabilidad y la eficacia.
who_for: Stage IV non-small cell lung cancer, squamous or non-squamous, or recurrent unresectable disease
No prior systemic anti-cancer therapy for advanced or metastatic disease
Tumor tissue (fresh or archival) obtained within 5 months of consent must be submitted
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1
Measurable disease per RECIST v1.1
not_for: Documented actionable genomic alterations with approved first-line targeted therapies
Prior treatment with immuno-oncology therapies
Untreated central nervous system metastases
Other protocol-defined inclusion or exclusion criteria apply

NCT06072781.summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares avutometinib plus defactinib with a treatment chosen by the investigator in recurrent low-grade serous ovarian cancer that has progressed after platinum-based therapy. Avutometinib is taken by mouth as 3.2 mg twice weekly and defactinib as 200 mg twice daily, each for 21 days on and 7 days off in 28-day cycles; the comparison arm uses pegylated liposomal doxorubicin IV, paclitaxel IV, anastrozole by mouth, or letrozole by mouth on the schedules listed. The record says the study will assess safety and efficacy, but the main outcome measure is not stated.
NCT06072781.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 compara avutometinib más defactinib con un tratamiento elegido por el investigador en cáncer de ovario seroso de bajo grado recurrente que progresó después de una terapia basada en platino. Avutometinib se toma por vía oral en dosis de 3.2 mg dos veces por semana y defactinib en dosis de 200 mg dos veces al día, ambos durante 21 días seguidos de 7 días sin tratamiento, en ciclos de 28 días; el brazo de comparación usa doxorrubicina liposomal pegilada IV, paclitaxel IV, anastrozol oral o letrozol oral según los esquemas indicados. El registro indica que el estudio evaluará la seguridad y la eficacia, pero el resultado principal no se indica.
who_for: Histologically proven low-grade serous cancer of the ovary, fallopian tube, or peritoneum
KRAS mutation status documented by a validated tumor tissue test
Progression or recurrence after at least one prior systemic therapy for metastatic disease
Measurable disease per RECIST v1.1 and ECOG performance status of 1 or less
Age 18 years or older and suitable for at least one investigator's choice treatment
not_for: Co-existing high-grade serous ovarian cancer or mixed histology
Prior avutometinib, defactinib, or other FAK inhibitor treatment
Systemic anti-cancer therapy within 4 weeks before the first study dose
History of interstitial lung disease, pneumonitis, or pulmonary fibrosis
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or known hypersensitivity to study drug ingredients

NCT07107230.summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests JNJ-95437446, alone or with amivantamab in some participants, in people with advanced-stage solid tumors. The route, dose, and schedule of JNJ-95437446 are not stated in the record. The study aims to find recommended phase 2 doses (RP2Ds) and to evaluate the safety of those doses.
NCT07107230.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa JNJ-95437446, solo o junto con amivantamab en algunos participantes, en personas con tumores sólidos en etapa avanzada. La vía, la dosis y el calendario de JNJ-95437446 no se indican en el registro. El estudio busca determinar las dosis recomendadas para fase 2 (RP2D) y evaluar la seguridad de esas dosis.
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older
Diagnosed with unresectable, locally advanced, or metastatic NSCLC, colorectal carcinoma, or head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
NSCLC adenocarcinoma and colorectal cancer need local EGFR or KRAS/NRAS/BRAF mutation testing
Measurable or evaluable disease (Part 2 requires at least one RECIST v1.1 measurable lesion)
ECOG performance status 0 to 1 and adequate blood, kidney, and liver function
not_for: Prior interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis that needed systemic steroids
Toxicity from prior cancer therapy not resolved to Grade 1 or lower
Clinically significant active infection needing systemic treatment within 7 days before first dose
Clinically significant cardiovascular disease within 6 months before consent
Second malignancy likely to interfere with safety or efficacy endpoints

NCT06675136.summary_en: This phase 1 trial tests nab-paclitaxel given as pressurized intraperitoneal aerosolized chemotherapy (PIPAC), together with paclitaxel and ramucirumab, in stomach cancer that has spread to the peritoneum. Nab-paclitaxel is given into the abdomen over 40 minutes on day 1 of each 8-week cycle, paclitaxel and ramucirumab are given by vein on set days, and cycles repeat for up to 3 cycles before the schedule changes to 28-day cycles. The study looks at safety, side effects, and the best dose.
NCT06675136.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 1 prueba nab-paclitaxel administrado como quimioterapia intraperitoneal presurizada en aerosol (PIPAC), junto con paclitaxel y ramucirumab, en el cáncer de estómago que se ha extendido al peritoneo. El nab-paclitaxel se administra en el abdomen durante 40 minutos el día 1 de cada ciclo de 8 semanas, mientras que el paclitaxel y el ramucirumab se administran por vena en días indicados, y los ciclos se repiten hasta 3 veces antes de cambiar a ciclos de 28 días. El estudio evalúa la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la mejor dosis.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older
Gastric adenocarcinoma with visible peritoneal metastatic disease
Got worse on first-line therapy with a fluoropyrimidine and platinum-based treatment
ECOG performance status 0 or 1
Blood counts, liver, kidney and clotting tests within set limits
not_for: Intolerance to taxanes or allergy to similar compounds
Any history of brain or subdural metastases
Bowel obstruction needing total parenteral nutrition
History of gastrointestinal perforation
History of heart attack or stroke

NCT06757634.summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares gedatolisib plus palbociclib and endocrine therapy with ribociclib and endocrine therapy as first-line treatment for HR-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer. Gedatolisib is given intravenously once weekly for 3 weeks (days 1, 8, and 15), followed by 1 week off; palbociclib and ribociclib are taken by mouth on days 1-21 of each 28-day cycle, and fulvestrant is given by intramuscular injection. The record does not state a primary outcome; it describes the study as evaluating efficacy and safety.
NCT06757634.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 compara gedatolisib más palbociclib y terapia endocrina con ribociclib y terapia endocrina como tratamiento de primera línea para el cáncer de mama avanzado HR positivo y HER2 negativo. El gedatolisib se administra por vía intravenosa una vez por semana durante 3 semanas (días 1, 8 y 15), seguido de 1 semana sin tratamiento; el palbociclib y el ribociclib se toman por vía oral los días 1 a 21 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y el fulvestrant se administra por inyección intramuscular. El registro no indica un resultado principal; describe el estudio como una evaluación de la eficacia y la seguridad.
who_for: Adults with HR-positive, HER2-negative metastatic or locally advanced breast cancer.
Disease progression during or within 12 months after (neo)adjuvant endocrine therapy, or after 12 months.
Archival or fresh tumor tissue, or liquid biopsy, available for PIK3CA mutation testing.
Radiologically measurable disease per RECIST v1.1.
ECOG performance status 0-2 and life expectancy over 6 months.
not_for: Prior PI3K, Akt, or mTOR inhibitor, or other SERD except fulvestrant, in the (neo)adjuvant setting.
Prior systemic anticancer therapy for advanced breast cancer.
Type 1 diabetes, or type 2 diabetes uncontrolled and requiring daily insulin.
Known untreated or active brain or leptomeningeal metastases.
Other concurrent malignancy (except adequately treated non-melanoma skin cancer), or prior drug-induced interstitial lung disease or hepatitis.

NCT07223034.summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests lutetium-177-PSMA-617, a radiopharmaceutical therapy, in adults with IDH wild type gliomas that express PSMA, after standard treatment. Patients take temozolomide by mouth on the first 5 days of each 28-day cycle, and 177Lu-PSMA-617 is given as 2 to 6 total doses, spaced about 4 weeks apart, on day 2 of the first two cycles. The record does not state a primary outcome measure; the brief summary says the study aims to find out whether the treatment is safe.
NCT07223034.summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 evalúa lutecio-177-PSMA-617, una terapia con radiofármacos, en adultos con gliomas IDH silvestre que expresan PSMA, después del tratamiento estándar. Los pacientes toman temozolomida por vía oral durante los primeros 5 días de cada ciclo de 28 días, y el 177Lu-PSMA-617 se administra en 2 a 6 dosis totales, separadas aproximadamente 4 semanas, el día 2 de los primeros dos ciclos. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; el resumen breve señala que el estudio busca saber si el tratamiento es seguro.
who_for: Confirmed WHO grade 2-4 glioma that is IDH1 R132H-wildtype, of a listed type
PSMA-positive tumor sample by immunohistochemistry from a pre-radiotherapy biopsy or resection
Completed standard treatment, including surgery where possible and adjuvant radiation therapy
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 2 or less
Adequate kidney, liver, and blood counts, and able to understand and sign consent
not_for: Known non-canonical IDH mutations other than R132H
Target lesion within 5 mm of the brainstem, optic chiasm, or optic nerves
