Receipt of bevacizumab as part of initial glioma treatment
Life expectancy less than 12 weeks
Current or planned pregnancy, or refusal to follow contraception requirements

NCT06625034.summary_en: This Phase III trial compares radiation therapy planned with RapidPlan, a knowledge-based planning tool, to radiation therapy planned by a dosimetrist (human-driven planning) in people with prostate cancer. Patients receive radiation therapy over 15 to 30 minutes on 5 to 44 fractions, per standard of care. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record.
NCT06625034.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase III compara la radioterapia planificada con RapidPlan, una herramienta de planificación basada en conocimiento, con la radioterapia planificada por un dosimetrista (planificación humana), en personas con cáncer de próstata. Los pacientes reciben radioterapia durante 15 a 30 minutos en 5 a 44 fracciones, según la atención estándar. El resultado principal del estudio no se indica en el registro.
who_for: At least 18 years old
Prostate cancer confirmed by tissue (histologically confirmed)
Clinical or pathologic stage T1c to T3b with specified nodal and metastasis categories
Planned definitive radiation to the prostate or prostate bed
ECOG performance status 0 to 2 within 90 days of enrollment
not_for: Previous pelvic radiation greater than 5 Gy or planned radiation to pelvic lymph nodes
Planned prostate brachytherapy
Active rectal diverticulitis, Crohn's disease affecting the rectum, or ulcerative colitis
Prior hip replacement or penile implant
Major medical, addictive, or psychiatric illness that the investigator judges will prevent consent, treatment, or follow-up; indwelling or intermittent urinary

NCT07219212.summary_en: This phase 1b study tests JNJ-90301900, injected directly into tumors, together with chemotherapy and radiation therapy in people with locally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. JNJ-90301900 is given by injection into the tumor and/or lymph node, along with cisplatin, or carboplatin with paclitaxel, and intensity-modulated radiation therapy; how long and how often are not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated, and the registry lists this study as Phase 1.
NCT07219212.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1b evalúa JNJ-90301900, inyectado directamente en los tumores, junto con quimioterapia y radioterapia en personas con carcinoma de células escamosas de cabeza y cuello localmente avanzado. JNJ-90301900 se administra por inyección en el tumor o en el ganglio linfático, junto con cisplatino, o carboplatino con paclitaxel, y radioterapia de intensidad modulada; la duración y la frecuencia no se indican. El resultado principal que mide el estudio no se indica, y el registro clasifica este estudio como fase 1.
who_for: Squamous cell cancer of the oral cavity, hypopharynx, supraglottic larynx, or p16-negative oropharynx
Stage III, IVA, or IVB disease under AJCC 8th edition
Candidate for definitive concurrent chemoradiation as judged by the investigator
At least one measurable target lesion (primary tumor or involved lymph node) per RECIST 1.1
ECOG performance status 0 or 1, and age 18 to 74 years
not_for: Tumor starting in the nasopharynx, paranasal sinuses, salivary glands, thyroid, parathyroid, skin, or unknown primary site
Non-squamous histology
Stage 0, I, II, or IVC disease, recurrent disease, or a second primary within 2 months
Not eligible for platinum-based chemotherapy
Known or suspected allergy or hypersensitivity to JNJ-90301900 or its excipients
cancer_types: squamous cell carcinoma of head and neck

NCT04031677.summary_en: This trial tests whether chemotherapy given before surgery, compared with surgery alone, helps people with high-risk retroperitoneal dedifferentiated liposarcoma or leiomyosarcoma. Before surgery, patients receive doxorubicin or epirubicin with ifosfamide (liposarcoma) or with dacarbazine (leiomyosarcoma), given every 3 weeks; the number of cycles is not stated. The study measures disease-free survival, and it is a Phase 3 trial.
NCT04031677.summary_es: Este ensayo evalúa si la quimioterapia administrada antes de la cirugía, en comparación con la cirugía sola, ayuda a personas con liposarcoma dediferenciado o leiomiosarcoma retroperitoneal de alto riesgo. Antes de la cirugía, los pacientes reciben doxorubicina o epirubicina con ifosfamida (liposarcoma) o con dacarbazina (leiomiosarcoma), cada 3 semanas; el número de ciclos no se indica. El estudio mide la supervivencia libre de enfermedad y es un ensayo de fase 3.
who_for: Histologically proven high-risk leiomyosarcoma or liposarcoma of the retroperitoneum or pelvic infra-peritoneal space.
Tumor is resectable and has radiologically measurable disease.
Age 18 or older with WHO performance status 2 or lower.
Agrees to provide tumor tissue and blood samples for research, and gives written informed consent.
Women of childbearing potential have a negative pregnancy test and use highly effective birth control.
not_for: Sarcoma originating from bone, or from abdominal or gynecological organs.
Metastatic disease.
Prior surgery, radiotherapy or systemic therapy for the current tumor (diagnostic biopsy allowed).
Prior anthracycline use at or above the stated maximum cumulative dose, or hypersensitivity to the study drugs.
Congestive heart failure, angina, recent heart attack within 1 year, uncontrolled arrhythmia, or uncontrolled hypertension.

NCT06998407.summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests AVZO-023, an oral CDK4 inhibitor, alone and with AVZO-021 (an oral CDK2 inhibitor) and/or endocrine therapy, in advanced solid tumors, including HR+/HER2- breast cancer. AVZO-023 is taken by mouth twice daily in 28-day cycles, with escalating doses; the total length of treatment is not stated. The study aims to measure safety and tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, maximum tolerated dose, and anti-tumor effects.
NCT06998407.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa AVZO-023, un inhibidor oral de CDK4, solo y combinado con AVZO-021 (un inhibidor oral de CDK2) y/o terapia endocrina, en tumores sólidos avanzados, incluido el cáncer de mama HR+/HER2-. AVZO-023 se toma por vía oral dos veces al día en ciclos de 28 días, con dosis crecientes; la duración total del tratamiento no se indica. El estudio busca medir la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética, la farmacodinamia, la dosis máxima tolerada y los efectos antitumorales.
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 to 1 and life expectancy over 3 months.
Advanced solid tumor with histologic or cytologic proof of malignancy.
Adequate kidney, liver, and bone marrow function.
Agrees to provide molecular test results and archival tumor sample or fresh biopsy.
Measurable disease is preferred in dose escalation; bone-only disease is allowed in dose escalation.
not_for: Prior treatment with a selective investigational CDK2, CDK4, or CDK2/4/6 inhibitor.
Known active brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease.
Other invasive cancer, or one treated within 3 years before first dose, with listed exceptions.
History of drug-induced pneumonitis or interstitial lung disease.
Confirmed loss-of-function mutation or deletion of the RB1 gene.

NCT05887609.summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests mirvetuximab soravtansine-gynx combined with olaparib as maintenance therapy for platinum-sensitive recurrent ovarian, peritoneal, or fallopian tube cancer. Mirvetuximab soravtansine-gynx is given by IV infusion on Day 1 of every 3-week cycle at 5 mg/kg, and olaparib is taken by mouth at 300 mg twice daily; treatment continues until progression, unacceptable toxicity, withdrawal of consent, or death. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is Phase 2.
NCT05887609.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa mirvetuximab soravtansina-gynx combinado con olaparib como terapia de mantenimiento para cáncer de ovario, peritoneal o de trompas de Falopio recurrente y sensible al platino. El mirvetuximab se administra por vía intravenosa el día 1 de cada ciclo de 3 semanas, a 5 mg/kg, y el olaparib se toma por vía oral a 300 mg dos veces al día; el tratamiento continúa hasta progresión, toxicidad inaceptable, retiro del consentimiento o muerte. El registro no indica la medida principal de resultado; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Women aged 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 or 1.
High-grade serous or endometrioid ovarian, primary peritoneal, or fallopian tube cancer.
Platinum-sensitive disease, with progression more than 6 months after the last prior platinum dose.
Complete or partial response, or stable disease, after the last line of platinum therapy.
Archival tissue confirming folate receptor alpha (FRα) high or medium expression.
not_for: Clear cell, mucinous, sarcomatous, borderline, germ cell, or sex-cord stromal ovarian tumors.
Progression through the most recent chemotherapy regimen (stable disease is allowed).
Prior treatment with mirvetuximab or other FRα-targeting agents.
Untreated or symptomatic brain or central nervous system metastases.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women, or those unwilling to use highly effective contraception.

NCT06137144.summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests AZD3470, a PRMT5 inhibitor, alone or with other anticancer drugs, in people with blood cancers such as Hodgkin lymphoma and peripheral T-cell lymphoma. AZD3470 is taken by mouth, and the record does not state how long or how often it is given. The study measures safety, tolerability, how the body processes the drug, its effects on the body, and early signs of benefit.
NCT06137144.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa AZD3470, un inhibidor de PRMT5, solo o con otros medicamentos contra el cáncer, en personas con cánceres de la sangre como el linfoma de Hodgkin y el linfoma periférico de células T. AZD3470 se toma por vía oral, y el registro no indica cuánto tiempo ni con qué frecuencia se administra. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, cómo el cuerpo procesa el medicamento, sus efectos en el organismo y las primeras señales de beneficio.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with relapsed or refractory classical Hodgkin lymphoma after at least two prior lines, including BV and anti-PD1 therapy.
Adults 50 or older with stage III or IV classical Hodgkin lymphoma that reached at least a partial response to first-line therapy.
Adults 18 or older with relapsed or refractory PTCL-NOS, ALCL, or AITL after at least one prior line of therapy.
Adults 18 or older with relapsed or refractory classical Hodgkin lymphoma after at least one prior line, for the pembrolizumab combination module.
Participants must provide baseline tumour tissue and have at least one measurable or FDG-avid lymphoma lesion.
not_for: Active lymphoma in the brain, spinal cord, or leptomeninges.
Active hepatitis B or C, or known HIV positive.
Heart failure grade II to IV, cardiomyopathy, or resting QTcF above 470 msec.
History of another primary malignancy.
Prior PRMT5 or MAT2A inhibitor, or anti-lymphoma therapy within 21 days.

NCT06780137.summary_en: This study tests gocatamig, ifinatamab deruxtecan (I-DXd), and durvalumab, given alone or in combination, in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer that has relapsed or stopped responding to prior treatment. All study drugs are given by intravenous (IV) infusion until disease progression or stopping criteria are met; the exact schedule is not stated. The study looks at safety and how well the drugs are tolerated, and whether the cancer gets smaller or goes away; it is a Phase 1b/2 study.
NCT06780137.summary_es: Este estudio prueba gocatamig, ifinatamab deruxtecan (I-DXd) y durvalumab, solos o combinados, en cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas en etapa extensa que reapareció o dejó de responder a un tratamiento previo. Todos los medicamentos del estudio se administran por infusión intravenosa (IV) hasta que la enfermedad progrese o se cumplan los criterios para suspenderlos; el horario exacto no se indica. El estudio evalúa la seguridad y la tolerancia a los medicamentos, y si el cáncer se reduce o desaparece; es un estudio de fase 1b/2.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older
Extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (stage IV) confirmed by tissue testing
Cancer progressed or stopped responding after at least one prior line of treatment that included platinum-based chemotherapy
Able to provide an archival tumor sample or a fresh biopsy sample
If HIV-positive, HIV must be well controlled on antiretroviral therapy
not_for: Pleural effusion, pericardial effusion, or ascites needing repeated drainage
Any history of interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis (with a narrow exception for radiation pneumonitis without steroids)
Active or past immune deficiency, except well-controlled HIV on antiretroviral therapy
Certain heart events or arterial clots within 6 months before the first dose
Untreated or symptomatic brain metastases, or active viral hepatitis

NCT06796907.summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests Mocertatug Rezetecan (Mo-Rez) combined with other anti-cancer medicines in advanced solid tumors, including gynecological cancers. Mo-Rez, dostarlimab, and bevacizumab are given by intravenous (IV) infusion, and how often and for how long is not stated. The record does not state a primary outcome, but the study looks at safety, tolerability, how the body handles the drug, and how well it works.
NCT06796907.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa Mocertatug Rezetecan (Mo-Rez) combinado con otros medicamentos contra el cáncer en tumores sólidos avanzados, incluidos cánceres ginecológicos. Mo-Rez, dostarlimab y bevacizumab se administran por infusión intravenosa (IV), y no se indica con qué frecuencia ni durante cuánto tiempo. El registro no indica un resultado principal, pero el estudio analiza la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, cómo el cuerpo maneja el medicamento y qué tan bien funciona.
who_for: Adults 18 or older who can give signed informed consent.
Advanced solid tumor confirmed by pathology, with no more than 4 prior lines of systemic therapy.
At least one measurable target lesion per RECIST 1.1.
Life expectancy of at least 12 weeks, per investigator assessment.
Endometrial, ovarian, fallopian tube, or peritoneal cancer after failed or intolerant standard treatment (module-specific criteria).
not_for: Prior B7H4-targeted therapy or prior topoisomerase-1 inhibitor therapy.
Untreated brain or CNS metastases, or rapidly progressing brain or CNS metastases.
Current or past interstitial lung disease or non-infectious pneumonitis.
Known HIV.
Uterine sarcoma (endometrial arm).

NCT06158139.summary_en: This phase 1 study tests autologous CAR-T cells that target B7-H3 (iC9.CAR.B7-H3 T cells) in people with refractory pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. The cells are made from each participant's own blood and given by intravenous infusion over 5 to 10 minutes, and how often they are given is not stated. The study measures safety and tolerability, as stated in its purpose, and it is a phase 1 study.
NCT06158139.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 prueba células CAR-T autólogas dirigidas contra B7-H3 (células iC9.CAR.B7-H3) en personas con adenocarcinoma ductal de páncreas refractario. Las células se fabrican a partir de la sangre de cada participante y se administran por vía intravenosa en 5 a 10 minutos; la frecuencia con la que se administran no se indica. El estudio mide la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, según se indica en su objetivo, y es un estudio de fase 1.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older who give written informed consent.
Histological or cytological confirmation of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
ECOG performance status of 0 to 1.
Women who could become pregnant must abstain or use two effective contraception methods until 6 months after treatment stops.
Men with female partners must have had a vasectomy or use an adequate contraception method during and for 3 months after cell infusion.
not_for: Prior or current other cancer whose course or treatment could interfere with safety or efficacy assessment.
Not willing or able to follow study procedures, based on investigator judgment.

NCT04742634.summary_en: This study tests decitabine plus cedazuridine (DEC-C) in adults with myelodysplastic syndromes who had an allogeneic stem cell transplant and still have detectable mutations, called measurable residual disease. DEC-C is taken by mouth once daily on days 1 to 3 or days 1 to 4 of a 28-day cycle, with up to 5 cycles before the Day 180 check and up to 6 more cycles if mutations remain. The study measures relapse rates and progression-free survival.
NCT04742634.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa decitabina más cedazuridina (DEC-C) en adultos con síndromes mielodisplásicos que recibieron un trasplante alogénico de células madre y que aún tienen mutaciones detectables, llamadas enfermedad residual medible. DEC-C se toma por vía oral una vez al día durante los días 1 a 3 o los días 1 a 4 de un ciclo de 28 días, con hasta 5 ciclos antes de la evaluación del día 180 y hasta 6 ciclos adicionales si persisten las mutaciones. El estudio mide las tasas de recaída y la supervivencia libre de progresión.
who_for: Diagnosed with myelodysplastic syndromes and had an allogeneic stem cell transplant.
Aged 18 to 75 years.
Gene panel testing before transplant found at least one mutation that the MyeloSeq-HD panel can detect.
Day 30 marrow test shows a pre-transplant mutation at 0.2% or higher (intervention arm).
Transplant day 42 to 100, 5% or fewer marrow blasts, adequate blood counts, and GVHD grade 2 or lower (intervention arm).
not_for: Currently receiving other investigational agents.
Past allergic reaction to compounds similar to DEC-C or other study agents.
Taking drugs metabolized by cytidine deaminase.
Active grade 3 or higher GVHD (intervention arm).
Uncontrolled illness, pregnancy, or breastfeeding.

NCT04020575.summary_en: This study tests autologous T cells engineered to express a chimeric antigen receptor, either huMNC2-CAR44 or huMNC2-CAR22, which target a cleaved form of MUC1 (MUC1*) in advanced metastatic breast cancer. The engineered cells are given by infusion, with the dose tested in cohorts of 3 patients, and how often and for how long they are given is not stated. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the registry lists the study as Phase 1, and the brief summary describes it as Phase I/II.
NCT04020575.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa células T autólogas modificadas para expresar un receptor de antígeno quimérico, huMNC2-CAR44 o huMNC2-CAR22, que actúan contra una forma escindida de MUC1 (MUC1*) en cáncer de mama metastásico avanzado. Las células modificadas se administran por infusión, y la dosis se prueba en grupos de 3 pacientes; la frecuencia y la duración del tratamiento no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el registro clasifica el estudio como Fase 1, y el resumen breve lo describe como Fase I/II.
who_for: Breast cancer confirmed by pathology, with MUC1* membrane expression of at least 30% by immunohistochemistry.
Received standard metastatic systemic therapy; hormone receptor positive patients need at least 3 endocrine therapies and 2 chemotherapy lines.
HER2-positive patients need at least 3 HER2-directed therapies; triple negative patients need at least 2 chemotherapy lines.
Age 18 or older, able to give written informed consent, with Karnofsky performance status of at least 60%.
Measurable disease by RECIST 1.1 on CT or MRI, or bone-only disease measurable by FDG PET.
not_for: Daily corticosteroid use above 15 mg prednisone per day or equivalent.
Major organ dysfunction, such as high creatinine, high bilirubin, high liver enzymes, or reduced lung function.
Significant heart problems, such as NYHA class III or IV heart failure, or ejection fraction below 45%.
Low blood counts: ANC under 1000/mm³, hemoglobin under 9, or platelets under 75,000/mm³.
HIV positive, uncontrolled active infection, untreated brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis, or anticipated survival under 3 months.

NCT07288112.summary_en: This study tests DOC1021, a dendritic cell immunotherapy, in people with refractory melanoma. DOC1021 is injected near nearby lymph nodes two times, two weeks apart, and pIFN (peginterferon alfa-2a) 180 mcg is given under the skin once a week for 4 doses. The study measures safety and tumor responses; Phase 1 checks safety and Phase 2 assesses efficacy.
NCT07288112.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa DOC1021, una inmunoterapia con células dendríticas, en personas con melanoma refractario. DOC1021 se inyecta cerca de los ganglios linfáticos cercanos en dos ocasiones, con dos semanas de diferencia, y pIFN (peginterferón alfa-2a) de 180 mcg se administra debajo de la piel una vez por semana durante 4 dosis. El estudio mide la seguridad y las respuestas tumorales; la Fase 1 verifica la seguridad y la Fase 2 evalúa la eficacia.
who_for: Unresectable or metastatic melanoma that progressed after at least one prior systemic therapy, including anti-PD-1
Age 18 years or older
Tumor available for biopsy or resection, with enough tissue, and at least one measurable lesion
ECOG performance score 0 or 1
Willing to withhold anti-PD-1 treatment from enrollment through at least 6 weeks after the first DOC1021 dose
not_for: Pregnant or breastfeeding
Known active HIV or hepatitis infection
Systemic autoimmune disorder requiring immunosuppression, or other severe uncontrolled condition
Residual immune-related toxicity from prior immunotherapy above Grade 1
Treatment with another investigational drug within the last 30 days

NCT07225036.summary_en: This study tests adding low-dose radiation to the liver in people with melanoma or non-small cell lung cancer that has spread to the liver and who are receiving immunotherapy. The liver radiation is given the week before cycles 1, 2 and 3 of standard immunotherapy. The study measures progression-free survival (PFS), which is the main outcome.
NCT07225036.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa agregar radiación de dosis baja al hígado en personas con melanoma o cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas que se ha extendido al hígado y que reciben inmunoterapia. La radiación al hígado se administra la semana antes de los ciclos 1, 2 y 3 de la inmunoterapia estándar. El estudio mide la supervivencia libre de progresión (PFS), que es el resultado principal.
who_for: Age 18 years or older.
ECOG performance status 2 or lower, or Karnofsky 60% or higher.
Biopsy-proven non-small cell lung cancer or melanoma.
Radiographic evidence of liver metastases.
Planning to receive PD-1 or PD-L1 checkpoint immunotherapy throughout the radiation treatment.
not_for: Adjuvant immunotherapy for NSCLC or melanoma delivered within 6 months of enrollment.
NSCLC with EGFR, ALK, ROS1 or RET driver mutations (for cohort 1).
Uncontrolled illness that the investigator judges makes participation unreasonably hazardous.
Prior or concurrent malignancy that the investigator judges could interfere with safety or efficacy assessment.
Pregnant women.

NCT05877430.summary_en: This study tests CJRB-101, a live biotherapeutic product, given together with pembrolizumab in people with advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer, head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, or melanoma. CJRB-101 is taken by mouth as one or two capsules daily in Phase 1, and pembrolizumab is given as a 200 mg intravenous infusion once every 3 weeks; the treatment duration is not stated. The study assesses response, dose-limiting toxicities, pharmacodynamics, and effects on microbiome biomarkers, and the record does not name a primary outcome measure.
NCT05877430.summary_es: Este estudio prueba CJRB-101, un producto biológico vivo, administrado junto con pembrolizumab en personas con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas avanzado o metastásico, carcinoma de células escamosas de cabeza y cuello, o melanoma. CJRB-101 se toma por vía oral como una o dos cápsulas diarias en la Fase 1, y el pembrolizumab se administra como infusión intravenosa de 200 mg una vez cada 3 semanas; la duración del tratamiento no se indica. El estudio evalúa la respuesta, las toxicidades limitantes de dosis, la farmacodinamia y los efectos sobre biomarcadores del microbioma, y el registro no menciona una medida de resultado principal.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older who can give informed consent.
Advanced or metastatic NSCLC, head and neck SCC, or melanoma with at least one measurable lesion.
Untreated patients meeting PD-L1 or BRAF criteria, depending on cancer type.
Patients whose cancer progressed after at least 2 cycles of anti-PD-1 or PD-L1 therapy.
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
not_for: NSCLC with EGFR or ALK genomic aberrations, or nasopharyngeal cancer.
Uncontrolled or untreated brain metastasis or leptomeningeal disease.
Active autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment in the past 2 years.
Pregnancy or breastfeeding.
Known HIV infection, or active hepatitis B or C under the listed limits.
cancer_types: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma

NCT04389632.summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests sigvotatug vedotin (SGN-B6A) alone and with pembrolizumab, with or without carboplatin or cisplatin, in advanced solid tumors such as lung, head and neck, HER2-negative breast, esophageal, gastric, bladder, cervical, ovarian, pancreatic and skin squamous cell cancers. All study drugs are given into a vein (IV); pembrolizumab is given every 3 weeks or every 6 weeks, cisplatin 75 mg/m2 and carboplatin AUC 5 mg/mL per min every 3 weeks, and how long treatment continues is not stated. The study aims to learn about the side effects of sigvotatug vedotin and whether it works to treat solid tumors, and the main outcome measure is not stated.
NCT04389632.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa sigvotatug vedotin (SGN-B6A) solo y con pembrolizumab, con o sin carboplatino o cisplatino, en tumores sólidos avanzados como cáncer de pulmón, de cabeza y cuello, de mama HER2 negativo, de esófago, gástrico, de vejiga, de cuello uterino, de ovario, de páncreas y carcinoma epidermoide de piel. Todos los medicamentos del estudio se administran por vena (IV); el pembrolizumab se administra cada 3 semanas o cada 6 semanas, el cisplatino a 75 mg/m2 y el carboplatino con AUC 5 mg/mL por min cada 3 semanas, y no se indica cuánto tiempo continúa el tratamiento. El estudio busca conocer los efectos secundarios de sigvotatug vedotin y si funciona para tratar tumores sólidos, y no se indica la medida principal de resultado.
who_for: Metastatic or unresectable solid tumor of a listed type, confirmed by biopsy or cytology.
Relapsed or refractory disease, or intolerance to standard therapy (Parts A and B).
Treatment-naive for locally advanced or metastatic systemic therapy (Parts C and D).
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
Measurable disease per RECIST v1.1 and a tumor site accessible for biopsy.
not_for: Previous treatment with an MMAE-containing agent or an agent targeting integrin beta-6.
Known active brain metastases, with some exceptions for treated or small asymptomatic lesions.
Carcinomatous meningitis.
Another malignancy within 3 years before first dose, or residual disease from one.
Pre-existing neuropathy above the stated grade limit, or noninfectious lung disease needing steroids or current lung disease.
cancer_types: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma

NCT07292298.summary_en: This single-arm Phase 2 study tests an internal radiation boost called high-dose-rate rectal brachytherapy, using Iridium-192, in people with low-lying residual rectal adenocarcinoma after total neoadjuvant therapy. The boost is given through an intracavitary applicator in three weekly outpatient fractions, for a total dose of 21 Gy. The study measures whether the treatment is safe and whether it improves organ preservation, meaning patients avoid surgical resection.
NCT07292298.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 de un solo grupo evalúa un refuerzo de radiación interna llamado braquiterapia rectal de alta tasa de dosis, con Iridio-192, en personas con adenocarcinoma rectal residual de localización baja después de la terapia neoadyuvante total. El refuerzo se administra mediante un aplicador intracavitario en tres fracciones semanales ambulatorias, para una dosis total de 21 Gy. El estudio mide si el tratamiento es seguro y si mejora la preservación del órgano, es decir, si los pacientes evitan la resección quirúrgica.
who_for: Adults aged 18 to 100 with MMR-proficient low or mid rectal adenocarcinoma, cT1-4 N0-2 M0.
Incomplete or near-complete response after total neoadjuvant therapy, with surgery expected to be APR or low LAR.
Residual tumor under 4 cm long and 1.2 cm thick, under 50% circumference, above the dentate line.
Restaging 4 to 16 weeks after total neoadjuvant therapy; ECOG 0 to 3.
Platelets above 50, hemoglobin above 8 g/dL, and neutrophil count above 500 meet the stated thresholds.
not_for: History of ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease.
Pelvic radiation given before the rectal cancer external beam radiation.
Prior colorectal surgery with an anastomosis at or near the brachytherapy target.
Uncontrolled severe illness, or life expectancy under 3 years per provider.
Concurrent cytotoxic chemotherapy, immunotherapy, or targeted cancer drugs; pregnancy.

NCT06105554.summary_en: This study tests belumosudil mesylate, given alone and with dexamethasone, in adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. Belumosudil mesylate is taken by mouth; how long or how often it is given is not stated. The main outcome is not stated; this is a Phase 1/Phase 2 study.
NCT06105554.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa belumosudil mesilato, administrado solo y con dexametasona, en adultos con mieloma múltiple recidivante o refractario. El belumosudil mesilato se toma por vía oral; la duración o la frecuencia no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica; este es un estudio de Fase 1/Fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with symptomatic multiple myeloma.
Measurable disease, as defined in the record.
Relapsed or refractory disease after at least 3 prior lines, including triple-class refractory disease.
ECOG performance status 0, 1, or 2, or 3 due to disease burden or symptoms.
Adequate blood counts, liver, heart, and kidney function as defined in the record.
not_for: Currently receiving another investigational agent with known or suspected activity against myeloma.
Known allergy to compounds similar to belumosudil mesylate.
Known clinically active hepatitis A, B, or C infection, with listed exceptions.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women.
Uncontrolled illness not related to myeloma, in the opinion of the Principal Investigator.

NCT07405801.summary_en: This Phase II study tests inavolisib plus ribociclib and fulvestrant against placebo plus ribociclib and fulvestrant in advanced HR-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer. The drugs are given on the schedule set in the protocol, and the exact schedule and duration are not stated. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is Phase II and evaluates efficacy and safety.
NCT07405801.summary_es: Este estudio de fase II compara inavolisib más ribociclib y fulvestrant con placebo más ribociclib y fulvestrant en cáncer de mama avanzado con receptores hormonales positivos y HER2 negativo. Los medicamentos se administran según el esquema indicado en el protocolo; el esquema exacto y la duración no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es de fase II y evalúa la eficacia y la seguridad.
who_for: Women or men with locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer that cannot be cured with surgery or radiation.
Estrogen and/or progesterone receptor-positive tumor, with at least 1% of tumor cells positive.
No prior systemic treatment for advanced breast cancer; progressed during adjuvant endocrine therapy or within 12 months after finishing it.
Tumor has no PIK3CA mutation and has heterozygous loss of chromosome 8p, confirmed by central lab testing.
Measurable disease according to RECIST v1.1.
not_for: Metaplastic breast cancer.
Radiotherapy within 2 weeks before randomization.
Appropriate for cytotoxic chemotherapy at study entry, such as those with visceral crisis.
Type 1 diabetes at any time, or type 2 diabetes needing ongoing systemic treatment at entry.
Untreated or active brain metastases, or any history of leptomeningeal disease or carcinomatous meningitis.

NCT06898905.summary_en: This study tests two radiation schedules given as a bridge before CAR T-cell or bispecific antibody therapy in adults with relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. Each patient's tumor is split, so one part gets once-daily radiation and the other part gets twice-daily radiation, with both areas treated daily; the total length of treatment is not stated. The study measures feasibility and safety, and the phase is not applicable (NA).
NCT06898905.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa dos esquemas de radioterapia usados como puente antes de la terapia con células CAR T o anticuerpos biespecíficos en adultos con linfoma difuso de células B grandes recidivante o refractario. Cada tumor se divide: una parte recibe radioterapia una vez al día y la otra parte recibe radioterapia dos veces al día, y ambas áreas se tratan diariamente; la duración total no se indica. El estudio mide la factibilidad y la seguridad, y la fase no aplica (NA).
who_for: Adults aged 18 years or older.
Confirmed relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with a planned CAR T or bispecific antibody therapy at Yale New Haven Hospital.
ECOG performance status 0 to 3.
Able to attend once or twice daily weekday radiation therapy without radiotherapy contraindications.
Women of childbearing potential need a negative pregnancy test and must agree to effective pregnancy precautions.
not_for: Pregnant or currently breastfeeding.
Prior research radiation exposure in the past year that would exceed FDA annual limits.
Unable to safely receive the FDG PET tracer.
Any condition that the investigator judges would interfere with participation or pose significant risk.
Not expected to benefit from bridging radiotherapy, unable to have twice daily radiotherapy, or has a radiation contraindication.

NCT04686305.summary_en: This study tests trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) with immunotherapy drugs, with or without chemotherapy, as first-line treatment for advanced or metastatic non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer with HER2 overexpression. All study drugs are given as an IV infusion, and how often and for how long is not stated. The main goal is to measure safety and tolerability, and this is a Phase 1 (Phase Ib) study where efficacy is a secondary measure.
NCT04686305.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) con medicamentos de inmunoterapia, con o sin quimioterapia, como tratamiento de primera línea para el cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas avanzado o metastásico, no escamoso, con sobreexpresión de HER2. Todos los medicamentos del estudio se administran por infusión intravenosa, y no se indica con qué frecuencia ni durante cuánto tiempo. El objetivo principal es medir la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, y es un estudio de fase 1 (fase Ib) en el que la eficacia es una medida secundaria.
who_for: Unresectable locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer
HER2 overexpression confirmed by central review of tumor tissue
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1
Measurable disease by RECIST 1.1
Age 18 or older; some parts require body weight of at least 35 kg
not_for: Current or past non-infectious interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis needing steroids
Known HIV, or active hepatitis B or C with the stated conditions
Active infection, including tuberculosis, needing IV treatment
Untreated, symptomatic brain metastases or spinal cord compression
Prior anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, anti-CTLA-4 or anti-TIGIT therapy (for some parts)

NCT07579195.summary_en: This phase 1/phase 2 pilot feasibility trial tests consolidation treatment after enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab in people with muscle invasive bladder cancer that cannot be removed by surgery, has spread to nearby lymph nodes, or has spread to a limited number of distant sites. Patients with remaining disease receive either chemoradiation (IMRT or VMAT, 55 Gy in 20 fractions) to the bladder with or without pelvic lymph nodes, or radical cystectomy, based on shared decision-making, and metastatic sites may receive SBRT before observation or maintenance pembrolizumab. The main outcome measure is not stated; the record describes the study's goals as safely eliminating residual disease and delaying progression.
NCT07579195.summary_es: Este ensayo piloto de viabilidad en fase 1/fase 2 evalúa un tratamiento de consolidación después de enfortumab vedotina más pembrolizumab en personas con cáncer de vejiga que invade el músculo, que no puede extirparse con cirugía, que se ha extendido a ganglios linfáticos cercanos o que se ha extendido a un número limitado de sitios distantes. Los pacientes con enfermedad residual reciben quimiorradioterapia (IMRT o VMAT, 55 Gy en 20 fracciones) a la vejiga con o sin ganglios pélvicos, o cistectomía radical, según una decisión compartida, y los sitios metastásicos pueden recibir SBRT antes de observación o pembrolizumab de mantenimiento. La medida de resultado principal no se indica; el registro describe como objetivos del estudio eliminar de forma segura la enfermedad residual y retrasar la progresión.
who_for: Adults 18 or older who can understand and sign written consent.
Muscle invasive bladder cancer at diagnosis, with specified clinical stage criteria.
Radiographic complete or partial response after 3 to 9 cycles of enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab.
If metastatic after treatment, 5 or fewer sites, all outside the brain.
Candidate for pelvic radiation or cystectomy, ECOG 0-2, and life expectancy over 6 months.
not_for: Prior radiation with a field that overlaps the planned radiation field.
Brain (intracranial) metastasis.
Any small cell component, or mostly sarcomatoid or plasmacytoid histology.
Other active cancer, or clinically relevant cancer within the past 2 years.
Uncontrolled HIV, active hepatitis B or C, or conditions that increase radiation sensitivity.

NCT06282575.summary_en: This Phase 3 study tests zanidatamab added to cisplatin and gemcitabine, with or without durvalumab or pembrolizumab, compared with that standard treatment alone, in advanced HER2-positive biliary tract cancer. All study drugs are given by intravenous (IV) infusion, and the record does not state how long or how often. The record does not state the main outcome measure; the study is Phase 3.
NCT06282575.summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 3 evalúa zanidatamab añadido a cisplatino y gemcitabina, con o sin durvalumab o pembrolizumab, en comparación con ese tratamiento estándar solo, en colangiocarcinoma o cáncer de vías biliares avanzado con HER2 positivo. Todos los medicamentos del estudio se administran por infusión intravenosa (IV), y el registro no indica por cuánto tiempo ni con qué frecuencia. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de Fase 3.
who_for: Advanced, unresectable, or metastatic biliary tract cancer not eligible for curative resection, transplant, or ablation.
HER2-positive tumor, defined as IHC 3+, or IHC 2+ with ISH positive.
No more than 2 cycles of cisplatin and gemcitabine, with or without a PD-1/L1 inhibitor, for advanced disease.
Assessable disease (measurable or non-measurable) per RECIST 1.1.
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 or 1.
not_for: Prior treatment with a HER2-targeted agent.
Prior checkpoint inhibitor treatment other than durvalumab or pembrolizumab.
Certain rare biliary histologic subtypes, such as small cell, neuroendocrine, lymphoma, or sarcoma.
Use of systemic corticosteroids, brain metastases, or history of interstitial lung disease or non-infectious pneumonitis.
Use of phenytoin, or breastfeeding.

NCT07052695.summary_en: This pilot study tests mosunetuzumab, a CD20xCD3 bispecific antibody, in adults with chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) or small lymphocytic lymphoma (SLL), given alone or with a BTK inhibitor. Mosunetuzumab is given as a subcutaneous injection for up to 17 cycles; cycle length is not stated, and participants on a BTK inhibitor continue it during treatment. The study aims to evaluate clearance of detectable minimal residual disease; the primary outcome measure is not stated, and the study is listed as Phase 1/Phase 2.
NCT07052695.summary_es: Este estudio piloto evalúa mosunetuzumab, un anticuerpo biespecífico CD20xCD3, en adultos con leucemia linfocítica crónica (LLC) o linfoma linfocítico pequeño (LLP), administrado solo o junto con un inhibidor de BTK. Mosunetuzumab se administra como inyección subcutánea por hasta 17 ciclos; la duración de cada ciclo no se indica, y los participantes que toman un inhibidor de BTK continúan con él durante el tratamiento. El estudio busca evaluar la eliminación de la enfermedad mínima residual detectable; la medida de resultado principal no se indica, y el estudio figura como Fase 1/Fase 2.
who_for: Diagnosis of CLL or SLL under 2018 iwCLL guidelines
BTK inhibitor arm: on continuous BTK inhibitor for over 12 months, with over 2 months at a stable dose
BCL2 inhibitor arm: finished BCL2 inhibitor-based therapy less than 12 months before enrollment
Detectable minimal residual disease of at least 10e-4 in blood or bone marrow by NGS assay
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 2 or lower
not_for: Bulky disease with any lymph node over 5 cm or absolute lymphocyte count over 100,000/microliter
Clinical progression of CLL at enrollment
CAR T-cell therapy within 30 days, or radioimmunotherapy within 12 weeks, before study therapy
History of solid organ or allogeneic stem cell transplant
Known or suspected Richter's transformation or CNS involvement of CLL

NCT06591819.summary_en: This study is testing hypofractionated whole pelvis proton therapy with a brachytherapy boost in men with prostate cancer that is high risk or unfavorable intermediate risk, with an elevated risk of lymph node involvement. The brachytherapy boost is given first, followed by whole pelvis proton radiation therapy in 5 fractions, while the standard treatment uses 25 fractions. The study measures safety, as stated in the official title; the specific safety outcome measures are not stated.
NCT06591819.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la radioterapia de pelvis completa con protones en hipofraccionamiento, con un refuerzo de braquiterapia, en hombres con cáncer de próstata de riesgo alto o intermedio desfavorable, con mayor riesgo de afectación de ganglios linfáticos. Primero se administra el refuerzo de braquiterapia, seguido de radioterapia de pelvis completa con protones en 5 fracciones, mientras que el tratamiento estándar usa 25 fracciones. El estudio mide la seguridad, según se indica en el título oficial; las medidas específicas de seguridad no se indican.
who_for: Pathologic evidence of prostate cancer
High risk or unfavorable intermediate risk prostate cancer
Appropriate for whole pelvis radiation per the treating oncologist or lymph node nomogram
Candidate for definitive external beam radiation with no prior radiation to the study region
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0-2
not_for: Evidence of distant metastatic disease
History of inflammatory bowel disease or active connective tissue disorders
Prior radiation to the pelvis
Second invasive cancer within five years, other than non-melanoma skin cancer
Known severe, active comorbidity that the investigators judge would interfere with study treatment

NCT06610344.summary_en: This study tests β-hydroxybutyrate (BHB) supplementation in adults with large B-cell lymphoma who are receiving anti-CD19 CAR T-cell therapy. Participants take 35 mL of HVMN Ketone-IQ by mouth three times daily, with each dose containing 10 grams of R-1,3-Butanediol; the duration is not stated. The study aims to measure feasibility, safety and tolerability, and whether BHB supplementation changes the gut microbiome and peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs). Phase: not applicable (NA).
NCT06610344.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la suplementación con β-hidroxibutirato (BHB) en adultos con linfoma de células B grandes que reciben terapia con células T CAR anti-CD19. Los participantes toman por vía oral 35 mL de HVMN Ketone-IQ tres veces al día, y cada dosis contiene 10 gramos de R-1,3-Butanediol; la duración no se indica. El estudio busca medir la factibilidad, la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, y si la suplementación con BHB cambia el microbioma intestinal y las células mononucleares de sangre periférica (PBMC). Fase: no aplica (NA).
who_for: Age 18 years or older with pathologically confirmed large B-cell lymphoma
Planned treatment with an anti-CD19 CAR-T product (Yescarta or Kymriah)
Performance status ECOG 2 or less and adequate organ function per investigator
At least one measurable lesion documented before leukapheresis
Toxicities from prior therapy resolved to a grade that does not contraindicate participation
not_for: Pregnant or breastfeeding
History of allergy to energy drinks
History of inflammatory bowel disease
History of type 1 diabetes or need for insulin
History of chronic kidney disease with eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73m2

NCT07224672.summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests belantamab mafodotin given with cyclophosphamide, bortezomib, and dexamethasone in adults with newly diagnosed AL amyloidosis. How the drugs are given, and how often or for how long, is not stated; the study has a dose optimization phase, in which participants receive one of two belantamab mafodotin dose levels, and a dose expansion phase. The main outcome is not stated; the record says the study aims to evaluate efficacy and safety.
NCT07224672.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa belantamab mafodotina administrada junto con ciclofosfamida, bortezomib y dexametasona en adultos con amiloidosis AL recién diagnosticada. La vía de administración y la frecuencia o duración del tratamiento no se indican; el estudio tiene una fase de optimización de dosis, en la que los participantes reciben uno de dos niveles de dosis de belantamab mafodotina, y una fase de expansión de dosis. El resultado principal no se indica; el registro señala que el objetivo es evaluar la eficacia y la seguridad.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with newly diagnosed AL amyloidosis.
Histologically confirmed AL amyloidosis with an amyloid-related systemic syndrome.
Measurable clonal disease based on serum monoclonal protein or free light chain levels.
Not a candidate for high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell transplant as first-line therapy.
ECOG performance status 0, 1, or 2, with adequate blood, liver, and kidney function.
not_for: Symptomatic multiple myeloma, POEMS syndrome, or IgM-related AL amyloidosis.
Any non-AL amyloidosis, including transthyretin amyloidosis.
NYHA class IIIb or IV heart failure, or clinically significant untreated arrhythmia.
Prior therapy for AL amyloidosis or multiple myeloma, other than limited corticosteroid exposure.
Previous or current malignancy other than AL amyloidosis, unless considered medically stable for at least 2 years.

NCT05661201.summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests NEROFE given together with doxorubicin in people with advanced or metastatic solid tumors that have a KRAS mutation and ST2 expression. NEROFE is given into a vein weekly over 60 minutes at dose levels from 48 to 288 mg/m2, and doxorubicin is given weekly at a fixed 8 mg/m2 by intravenous push over 3 minutes. The main question is to find the recommended dose and schedule for the combination; the record does not state a specific outcome measure.
NCT05661201.summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 evalúa NEROFE administrado junto con doxorrubicina en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados o metastásicos que tienen una mutación de KRAS y expresión de ST2. NEROFE se administra semanalmente por vena durante 60 minutos, en niveles de dosis de 48 a 288 mg/m2, y la doxorrubicina se administra semanalmente a una dosis fija de 8 mg/m2 por inyección intravenosa rápida durante 3 minutos. La pregunta principal es encontrar la dosis y el esquema recomendados para la combinación; el registro no indica una medida de resultado específica.
who_for: Advanced, unresectable, or metastatic solid tumor with a KRAS mutation.
Tumor shows ST2 expression on immunohistochemistry testing.
Progression or intolerance to standard therapies, with 2 or fewer lines of systemic therapy for advanced disease.
ECOG performance status of 0 to 2.
Measurable disease by RECIST 1.1 and disease amenable to serial core biopsies.
not_for: Prior exposure to anthracycline chemotherapy.
Anti-cancer therapy within 3 weeks before the first study dose, or active anti-cancer therapy during study treatment.
Brain metastases, unless previously treated and shown inactive on baseline MRI.
Active hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or HIV, with specified exceptions.
Significant heart disease, LVEF under 50%, or QTcF over 480 msec.

NCT03802695.summary_en: This study tests Orca-Q, an engineered donor graft, in people getting allogeneic stem cell transplant for blood cancers. The conditions listed are acute myeloid leukemia, myelodysplastic syndromes, mixed phenotype acute leukemia, and acute lymphoblastic leukemia. The record does not state how Orca-Q is given or how long or how often it is given. The study evaluates safety, tolerability, and efficacy, and it is a Phase 1 study.
NCT03802695.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa Orca-Q, un injerto de donante modificado, en personas que reciben un trasplante alogénico de células madre por cánceres de la sangre. Las afecciones enumeradas son leucemia mieloide aguda, síndromes mielodisplásicos, leucemia aguda de fenotipo mixto y leucemia linfoblástica aguda. El registro no indica cómo se administra Orca-Q ni durante cuánto tiempo o con qué frecuencia. El estudio evalúa la seguridad, la tolerabilidad y la eficacia, y es un estudio de Fase 1.
who_for: Ages 12 to 78 years; some transplant arms have an upper limit of 65 years.
Acute myeloid, lymphoblastic, or mixed phenotype leukemia, or high or very high risk MDS, in remission or with 10% or fewer blasts in marrow.
Indicated for allogeneic stem cell transplant.
Matched to a 8/8 or 7/8 related or unrelated donor, or a related haploidentical donor.
Kidney, heart, lung, liver function and performance score within limits set for each arm.
not_for: Prior allogeneic stem cell transplant.
Currently receiving immunosuppressive therapy, other than disease-specific therapy or steroids at 10 mg/day or less.
Planned donor lymphocyte infusion or planned T cell depletion.
Positive anti-donor HLA antibodies against a mismatched allele in the selected donor.
Uncontrolled infection or autoimmune disease, HIV, HTLV, hepatitis B or C positivity, recent other cancer, myelofibrosis history, pregnancy or breastfeeding.

NCT06724237.summary_en: This phase 3 trial compares high dose chemotherapy followed by a transplant of the patient's own stem cells with observation only, in people with peripheral T-cell lymphoma who reached complete remission after first-line chemotherapy. Patients in the transplant arm first receive stem cell mobilization therapy and leukapheresis, then high dose chemotherapy and the stem cell transplant; how long or how often is not stated. The study measures survival, as stated in the trial title.
NCT06724237.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 3 compara la quimioterapia de dosis alta seguida de un trasplante de las propias células madre del paciente con solo observación, en personas con linfoma de células T periféricas que alcanzaron una remisión completa después de la quimioterapia inicial. Los pacientes del brazo de trasplante primero reciben terapia de movilización de células madre y leucoaféresis, y luego quimioterapia de dosis alta y el trasplante de células madre; la duración o la frecuencia no se indican. El estudio mide la supervivencia, según se indica en el título del ensayo.
who_for: Age 18 to 75 years.
ECOG performance status 0 to 2.
Peripheral T-cell lymphoma of a listed type: ALK-negative anaplastic large cell, angioimmunoblastic, nodal follicular helper T-cell, or not otherwise specified.
Treated with anthracycline-based induction and in radiologic complete remission by PET-CT after induction.
Eligible for high dose chemotherapy and stem cell transplant under the enrolling center's guidelines.
not_for: Active infection needing intravenous antimicrobial treatment at randomization.
Pregnant or breastfeeding.
Absolute neutrophil count below 1000/mcL or platelets below 75,000/mcL.
Total bilirubin above 1.5 times the upper limit of normal, or AST/ALT above 3 times the upper limit of normal.
Childbearing potential without a pregnancy test or effective contraception as required.
cancer_types: peripheral t-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified

NCT06937177.summary_en: This phase 2 study tests mifomelatide (TCMCB07) against placebo in adults with newly diagnosed, advanced, unresectable colorectal cancer or pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma who are starting chemotherapy. The study drug is given as a daily subcutaneous injection at 12.5 mg, 25 mg, or 50 mg, or as placebo, for 12 weeks, with an optional open-label extension of up to 26 more weeks at 25 mg daily. The study is designed to measure effects on weight, body composition and BMI.
NCT06937177.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 compara mifomelatida (TCMCB07) con placebo en adultos con cáncer colorrectal o adenocarcinoma ductal de páncreas recién diagnosticado, avanzado e irresecable, que están por iniciar quimioterapia. El medicamento del estudio se administra como inyección subcutánea diaria de 12.5 mg, 25 mg o 50 mg, o como placebo, durante 12 semanas, con una extensión opcional de hasta 26 semanas más con 25 mg diarios sin enmascaramiento. El estudio está diseñado para medir los efectos sobre el peso, la composición corporal y el IMC.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with ECOG performance status of 2 or less.
Newly diagnosed, unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic colorectal or pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
Starting a listed first-line chemotherapy regimen and ready to receive the second dose.
Able to self-inject daily, or to be injected by a caregiver.
Has evaluable disease by RECIST 1.1 and adequate organ function per listed lab values.
not_for: Receiving second-line or later systemic cancer treatment.
History of bulimia, anorexia, or weight loss surgery such as gastric stapling or bypass.
Chronic use of corticosteroids at 5 mg or more of prednisone equivalent per day.
Known brain or central nervous system metastases.
Pregnancy, lactation, plans to become pregnant, or concurrent participation in another clinical trial.

NCT07637630.summary_en: This study tests four digital components to encourage HPV vaccination among U.S. Vietnamese parents of adolescents who have not started the vaccine, with the aim of reducing HPV-related cancers. Parents receive 0 to 4 components, delivered through a study website as videos and an online task, and the motivational interviewing component includes two phone or Zoom calls with a trained health educator; overall duration is not stated. The main outcome is the feasibility and acceptability of each component, and the phase is listed as NA in this pilot optimization trial.
NCT07637630.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa cuatro componentes digitales para animar a padres vietnamita-estadounidenses de adolescentes que aún no han iniciado la vacuna contra el VPH, con el objetivo de reducir los cánceres relacionados con el VPH. Los padres reciben entre 0 y 4 componentes, que se entregan por un sitio web del estudio en forma de videos y una tarea en línea, y el componente de entrevista motivacional incluye dos llamadas telefónicas o por Zoom con un educador de salud capacitado; la duración total no se indica. El resultado principal es la factibilidad y aceptabilidad de cada componente, y la fase figura como NA en este ensayo piloto de optimización.
who_for: Self-identify as U.S. Vietnamese
Parent of a youth aged 9 to 18 who has not started the HPV vaccine series
Lived in the U.S. for 12 months or more
Only one parent per household can participate
not_for: Planning to move out of the U.S. within the next 6 months
Not fluent in spoken and written Vietnamese or spoken and written English
Unable to provide informed consent

NCT06996119.summary_en: This phase 1 study tests emapalumab with post-transplant cyclophosphamide, tacrolimus, and mycophenolate mofetil to prevent graft-versus-host disease in patients with acute myeloid leukemia or myelodysplastic syndrome after a reduced-intensity donor stem cell transplant. Emapalumab is given by IV over 1 hour on days -8, -7, -1, 14 and 21, cyclophosphamide IV on days 3 and 4, tacrolimus IV or by mouth on days 5 to 95, and mycophenolate mofetil IV or by mouth on days 5 to 35, after chemotherapy before the transplant on day 0. The record does not state a main outcome measure; it says the study tests safety, side effects and effectiveness.
NCT06996119.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa emapalumab junto con ciclofosfamida después del trasplante, tacrolimus y micofenolato mofetilo para prevenir la enfermedad de injerto contra huésped en pacientes con leucemia mieloide aguda o síndrome mielodisplásico después de un trasplante de células madre de donante con intensidad reducida. El emapalumab se administra por vía intravenosa durante 1 hora los días -8, -7, -1, 14 y 21, la ciclofosfamida por vía intravenosa los días 3 y 4, el tacrolimus por vía intravenosa o por boca los días 5 a 95, y el micofenolato mofetilo por vía intravenosa o por boca los días 5 a 35, después de la quimioterapia previa al trasplante el día 0. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; dice que el estudio evalúa la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la eficacia.
who_for: Adults aged 18 to 75 years
Acute myeloid leukemia or myelodysplastic syndrome in complete remission
Planned reduced-intensity conditioning and transplant from an 8 of 8 matched donor using mobilized peripheral blood stem cells
Karnofsky performance status of at least 70%
Left ventricular ejection fraction of at least 50%
not_for: Prior allogeneic stem cell transplant
Other cancer therapy within two weeks before conditioning, with some targeted agents allowed up to one day before
Allergy to compounds similar to the study drug
Active uncontrolled infection or other active malignancy
Pregnant or breastfeeding females

NCT07392957.summary_en: This study tests CTX-009 alone and CTX-009 combined with CTX-471 in adults with recurrent glioblastoma. CTX-009 is given into a vein over 60 minutes (plus or minus 5 minutes) every 2 weeks in 28-day cycles, and CTX-471 is given into a vein over 30 minutes every 2 weeks on days 1 and 15 in the combination arms. The record does not name a primary outcome; it states that the study will evaluate safety and efficacy, and it is a Phase 1/Phase 2 study.
NCT07392957.summary_es: Este estudio prueba CTX-009 solo y CTX-009 combinado con CTX-471 en adultos con glioblastoma recurrente. CTX-009 se administra por vena durante 60 minutos (más o menos 5 minutos) cada 2 semanas en ciclos de 28 días, y CTX-471 se administra por vena durante 30 minutos cada 2 semanas, los días 1 y 15, en los brazos de combinación. El registro no indica un resultado principal; señala que el estudio evaluará la seguridad y la eficacia, y es un estudio de Fase 1/Fase 2.
who_for: Recurrent grade 4 IDH wild-type glioma after standard treatment, with no more than 2 recurrences.
At least 18 years old.
Karnofsky performance status (KPS) of 60% or higher.
Blood counts, liver and kidney function within the limits defined in the record.
Agree to use adequate contraception during the study and for 4 months after treatment ends.
not_for: Progressed on bevacizumab, or stopped an anti-VEGF therapy because of a clinically significant reaction.
Chemotherapy within 4 weeks, or other anti-cancer, investigational, or immunotherapy within set time windows.
History of intraparenchymal or subdural hemorrhage.
Certain heart conditions in the past 5 years, such as heart failure, heart attack, or uncontrolled arrhythmia.
Pregnant or breastfeeding.

NCT06375044.summary_en: This study tests SIM0500, given alone, in adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. SIM0500 is given in 28-day cycles until disease progression, intolerable toxicity, withdrawal from treatment, or end of study, and the method of administration is not stated. The study evaluates safety and tolerability, efficacy, and pharmacokinetics, and it is a Phase 1 trial.
NCT06375044.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa SIM0500, administrado solo, en adultos con mieloma múltiple recidivante o refractario. SIM0500 se administra en ciclos de 28 días hasta la progresión de la enfermedad, toxicidad intolerable, retiro del tratamiento o fin del estudio, y el método de administración no está indicado. El estudio evalúa la seguridad y tolerabilidad, la eficacia y la farmacocinética, y es un ensayo de Fase 1.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older.
Documented relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma per IMWG criteria, after failing all established standard of care.
Life expectancy of at least 12 weeks.
ECOG performance score of 0 or 1.
Adequate blood, liver, and kidney function.
not_for: Active hepatitis B or hepatitis C infection.
Known HIV or AIDS.
Pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning to conceive or father a child during the trial.
Active or suspected autoimmune disease, with some listed exceptions.
Other cancer within 3 years, with listed exceptions.

NCT07723209.summary_en: This study tests partial breast irradiation (radiation to part of the breast) in women with early-stage invasive ductal breast cancer who had breast-conserving surgery without sentinel node biopsy or axillary dissection. The radiation is given using 3D, 3D/IMRT or IMRT techniques after breast-conserving surgery, and the dose and number of treatments are not stated. The study measures safety, and patients complete the BCTOS-13 and financial toxicity questionnaires at baseline and at 2 years.
NCT07723209.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la radioterapia parcial de mama (radiación a una parte de la mama) en mujeres con cáncer de mama invasivo de tipo ductal en etapa temprana que se sometieron a cirugía conservadora sin biopsia del ganglio centinela ni disección axilar. La radiación se administra con técnicas 3D, 3D/IMRT o IMRT después de la cirugía conservadora; la dosis y el número de sesiones no se indican. El estudio mide la seguridad, y las pacientes completan los cuestionarios BCTOS-13 y de toxicidad financiera al inicio y a los 2 años.
who_for: Women assigned female at birth, age 40 or older
Planned breast-conserving surgery without sentinel node biopsy or axillary lymph node dissection
Invasive ductal carcinoma with pathologic tumor size under 3 cm
No palpable nodes and negative axillary imaging
Performance status 0 to 2
not_for: Men, transgender, or non-binary individuals
Mastectomy
Metastatic disease
History of breast cancer in either breast
Obstacles to informed consent or regular follow-up

NCT05641831.summary_en: This Phase 2 trial tests whether canakinumab can prevent progression to cancer in people with clonal cytopenia of undetermined significance (CCUS), a blood condition with long-term low blood counts. Canakinumab is given as a subcutaneous injection, compared with a placebo injection given the same way; how often and for how long are not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record; the study is a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2 trial.
NCT05641831.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 2 evalúa si canakinumab puede prevenir la progresión a cáncer en personas con citopenia clonal de significado indeterminado (CCUS), una condición de la sangre con conteos sanguíneos bajos por un período prolongado. Canakinumab se administra como inyección subcutánea, en comparación con una inyección de placebo aplicada de la misma forma; la frecuencia y la duración no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es un ensayo de fase 2 aleatorizado, doble ciego y controlado con placebo.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with high-risk CCUS
Unexplained low blood counts in at least one blood cell type, lasting more than 4 months
Specified gene mutations found on sequencing and bone marrow tests
ECOG performance status 0, 1, or 2
Able to understand and sign the written consent form
not_for: Current cancer in need of active systemic treatment
Diagnosis of MDS or another myeloid malignancy at any time
Known allergy or hypersensitivity to canakinumab or similar drugs
Active infection or history of recurrent infections
Active liver disease, hepatitis B or C, or positive HIV test

NCT06327477.summary_en: This study tests proton-spatially fractionated radiotherapy (P-SFRT) given with standard radiation therapy (IG-IMRT) in adults with newly diagnosed retroperitoneal soft tissue sarcoma. Patients receive one P-SFRT treatment, then IG-IMRT over 25 to 28 fractions across 35 to 42 days, followed by surgical removal of the tumor 21 to 35 days after radiation. This is a Phase 1/Phase 2 trial; the record does not state a specific main outcome, but it names side effects, best dose, and how well the treatment works.
NCT06327477.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la radioterapia espacialmente fraccionada con protones (P-SFRT) administrada junto con la radioterapia estándar (IG-IMRT) en adultos con sarcoma de tejidos blandos retroperitoneal de diagnóstico reciente. Los pacientes reciben una sesión de P-SFRT, luego IG-IMRT en 25 a 28 fracciones durante 35 a 42 días, seguida de la extirpación quirúrgica del tumor entre 21 y 35 días después de la radiación. Es un ensayo de Fase 1/Fase 2; el registro no indica un resultado principal específico, pero menciona los efectos secundarios, la dosis óptima y qué tan bien funciona el tratamiento.
who_for: Age 18 years or older
Newly diagnosed, untreated retroperitoneal soft tissue sarcoma at least 3 cm, confirmed by imaging within 30 days
Measurable disease according to RECIST version 1.1
ECOG performance status 0 or 1, or Karnofsky score above 70%
Agree to contraception if able to become pregnant or father a child
not_for: Prior radiation therapy to the affected area
Certain sarcoma subtypes where neoadjuvant chemotherapy is standard care
Chemotherapy, radiotherapy, or other anticancer agents within 14 days before planned start
Unresolved side effects above grade 1 from prior cancer treatment, except alopecia
Active tuberculosis, or active hepatitis B or hepatitis C infection

NCT07228273.summary_en: This phase 2 trial compares fludarabine, cytarabine, idarubicin, and venetoclax with standard cytarabine and daunorubicin in newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia. Fludarabine, cytarabine, idarubicin, and daunorubicin are given through a vein (IV), and venetoclax is taken by mouth; the number of cycles and how often doses are given are not stated. The main outcome measured is not stated; the study is a randomized phase II trial.
NCT07228273.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 2 compara fludarabina, citarabina, idarubicina y venetoclax con el tratamiento estándar de citarabina y daunorubicina en leucemia mieloide aguda de diagnóstico reciente. La fludarabina, la citarabina, la idarubicina y la daunorubicina se administran por vena (IV), y el venetoclax se toma por vía oral; el número de ciclos y la frecuencia de las dosis no se indican. El resultado principal que mide el estudio no se indica; se trata de un ensayo aleatorizado de fase II.
who_for: Newly diagnosed, previously untreated acute myeloid leukemia or myelodysplastic syndrome with at least 10% marrow blasts.
Age 18 to 65 years at consent.
ECOG performance status of 0 to 1.
Willing to undergo hematopoietic stem cell transplant.
Adequate kidney, liver, and heart function, and able to take medicines by mouth or feeding tube.
not_for: Acute promyelocytic leukemia, or FLT3 ITD or core binding factor mutations.
Another active malignancy within 5 years, except treated early skin cancers, unless investigator decides otherwise.
Known active central nervous system involvement with AML.
Prior BCL-2 inhibitor treatment within 12 months.
NYHA class III or IV heart failure, or ejection fraction below 40%.

NCT06498973.summary_en: This Phase 1 trial tests tagraxofusp combined with azacitidine as maintenance therapy after a donor stem cell transplant in people with CD123-positive acute myeloid leukemia or myelodysplastic syndrome. Both drugs are given into a vein (IV): tagraxofusp over 15 minutes once daily on days 1 to 3, and azacitidine once daily on days 1 to 5 of each 28-day cycle, for up to 6 cycles. The study measures safety, side effects, best dose and effectiveness, as described in the record.
NCT06498973.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 1 evalúa tagraxofusp combinado con azacitidina como terapia de mantenimiento después de un trasplante de células madre de donante, en personas con leucemia mieloide aguda o síndrome mielodisplásico positivos para CD123. Ambos medicamentos se administran por vena (IV): tagraxofusp durante 15 minutos una vez al día los días 1 a 3, y azacitidina una vez al día los días 1 a 5 de cada ciclo de 28 días, hasta 6 ciclos. El estudio mide la seguridad, los efectos secundarios, la mejor dosis y la efectividad, según describe el registro.
who_for: Adults aged 18 to 75 years.
Acute myeloid leukemia or myelodysplastic syndrome with high-risk features, or minimal residual disease positive at transplant, after a first or second donor tr
CD123 positive on flow cytometry at diagnosis or before transplant.
ECOG performance status of 2 or less.
Complete response or minimal residual disease positive on day 30 bone marrow biopsy, and fully recovered blood counts after transplant.
not_for: History of allergic reaction to compounds similar to tagraxofusp or azacitidine.
Pregnant or breastfeeding.
Active malignancy, or recent cancer history with substantial potential for recurrence.
Clinically significant heart disease, uncontrolled lung disease, or known active or suspected central nervous system disease.
Active hepatitis B or C, or HIV infection.

NCT06710288.summary_en: This phase 2 single-arm study tests autologous M-CENK adoptive cell therapy and N-803 (an IL-15 superagonist) together with gemcitabine in people with recurrent platinum-resistant high-grade ovarian cancer. M-CENK is given by IV infusion on Day 1 of each 4-week cycle for as long as cells are available, N-803 is given under the skin at a fixed 1.2 mg dose on Days 1 and 15 starting in Cycle 2, and gemcitabine 800 mg/m2 is given IV on Days 1, 8, and 15 of each cycle. The study measures safety and preliminary efficacy.
NCT06710288.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2, de un solo grupo, evalúa la terapia celular adoptiva autóloga M-CENK y N-803 (un superagonista de IL-15) junto con gemcitabina en personas con cáncer de ovario recurrente de alto grado resistente al platino. M-CENK se administra por infusión IV el Día 1 de cada ciclo de 4 semanas mientras haya células disponibles, N-803 se administra por vía subcutánea a una dosis fija de 1.2 mg los Días 1 y 15 a partir del Ciclo 2, y la gemcitabina de 800 mg/m2 se administra por vía IV los Días 1, 8 y 15 de cada ciclo. El estudio mide la seguridad y la eficacia preliminar.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older and younger than 85 years.
Platinum-resistant high-grade epithelial ovarian, primary peritoneal, or fallopian tube cancer, relapsed within 6 months of 1 to 3 platinum regimens.
At least one measurable lesion by RECIST v1.1.
Prior treatment with bevacizumab, and prior FRα testing with mirvetuximab offered if positive.
ECOG performance status of 1 or less.
not_for: Clear cell, mucinous, sarcomatous, low grade, or borderline ovarian tumors.
Distant spread outside the abdominal and pelvic cavity, such as to brain, lung, or bone.
Presence or history of ascites or bowel obstruction.
HIV, active uncontrolled hepatitis B or C, or interstitial lung disease or non-infectious pneumonitis.
Autoimmune disease such as inflammatory bowel disease, rheumatoid arthritis, or lupus.

NCT07218341.summary_en: This study tests pirtobrutinib (LY3527727) in adults with previously treated chronic lymphocytic leukemia or small lymphocytic lymphoma. Pirtobrutinib is given orally every 4 weeks, and the study is expected to last about 5 years. The study looks at the long-term safety of pirtobrutinib; the primary outcome measure is not stated, and this is a Phase 4 study.
NCT07218341.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa pirtobrutinib (LY3527727) en adultos con leucemia linfocítica crónica o linfoma linfocítico de células pequeñas previamente tratados. Pirtobrutinib se administra por vía oral cada 4 semanas, y se espera que el estudio dure unos 5 años. El estudio mide la seguridad a largo plazo de pirtobrutinib; el resultado principal no se indica, y es un estudio de fase 4.
who_for: Currently taking part in study LOXO-BTK-20020 (J2N-MC-JZNN)
Age 18 years or older

NCT06340737.summary_en: This Phase 1b study tests autologous CD22 CAR T cells, a treatment made from the patient's own cells, in adults with relapsed or refractory B cell lymphomas and related B cell cancers. The treatment is given as an infusion after lymphodepleting chemotherapy, and participants stay in the hospital about 5 to 7 days (plus or minus 2); how often it is given is not stated. The study measures safety and efficacy, and participants are followed for overall survival, progression-free survival, and duration of response.
NCT06340737.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1b evalúa las células CAR T autólogas dirigidas a CD22, un tratamiento elaborado con las propias células del paciente, en adultos con linfomas de células B recidivantes o refractarios y cánceres relacionados de células B. El tratamiento se administra como infusión después de quimioterapia de linfodepleción, y los participantes permanecen en el hospital aproximadamente de 5 a 7 días (más o menos 2); la frecuencia de administración no se indica. El estudio mide la seguridad y la eficacia, y los participantes son seguidos para supervivencia global, supervivencia libre de progresión y duración de la respuesta.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with a confirmed B cell lymphoma or related cancer listed in the study.
Relapsed or refractory disease after prior systemic therapy, as defined for each cancer type.
Measurable disease, or leukemic cells or disease above 2% by flow cytometry, depending on the cancer type.
Archival tissue available, or willingness to have a biopsy, to check CD22 expression.
Adequate performance status (ECOG 0, 1, or 2, or Karnofsky above 60%).
not_for: Rapidly progressive disease that could prevent completing study therapy.
Other active cancer, with limited exceptions such as non-melanoma skin cancer.
Active infection needing intravenous antimicrobials.
Ongoing HIV, HBV, or HCV infection.
Pregnant or breastfeeding.

NCT05952453.summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests carboplatin, paclitaxel and pembrolizumab given before surgery, followed by olaparib and pembrolizumab, in newly diagnosed stage III or IV ovarian cancer. Carboplatin, paclitaxel and pembrolizumab are given before surgery to remove the tumor, and olaparib and pembrolizumab are given after surgery as maintenance; how long or how often is not stated. The main outcome measured is not stated, and the study is Phase 2.
NCT05952453.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa carboplatino, paclitaxel y pembrolizumab administrados antes de la cirugía, seguidos de olaparib y pembrolizumab, en cáncer de ovario en estadio III o IV de diagnóstico reciente. Carboplatino, paclitaxel y pembrolizumab se administran antes de la cirugía para extirpar el tumor, y olaparib y pembrolizumab se administran después de la cirugía como tratamiento de mantenimiento; la duración o la frecuencia no están indicadas. El resultado principal que se mide no está indicado, y el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Newly diagnosed stage III or IV epithelial ovarian, peritoneal or fallopian tube cancer
Candidate for carboplatin and paclitaxel before planned interval debulking surgery
CA-125 to CEA ratio of 25 or greater, or a negative workup if lower
Female, at least 18 years old
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1
not_for: Mucinous, germ cell or borderline ovarian tumor
Prior treatment for advanced or metastatic ovarian cancer
Prior olaparib or any other PARP inhibitor
Known HIV, hepatitis B, or active hepatitis C infection
Known active brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis

NCT05765851.summary_en: This study tests DS-1103a, given alone at increasing doses and then with T-DXd, in adults with advanced solid tumors. Later, DS-1103a is given with T-DXd to people with specific HER2-altered advanced solid tumor types. Both drugs are given as an IV infusion every 3 weeks (each cycle is 21 days), and the total duration is not stated. The record does not state a main outcome; it says the study will evaluate safety and efficacy, and the study is Phase 1.
NCT05765851.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa DS-1103a, administrado solo en dosis crecientes y luego junto con T-DXd, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados. Más adelante, DS-1103a se administra con T-DXd a personas con tipos específicos de tumores sólidos avanzados con alteraciones de HER2. Ambos medicamentos se dan por infusión intravenosa cada 3 semanas (cada ciclo dura 21 días), y la duración total no se indica. El registro no indica un resultado principal; dice que el estudio evaluará la seguridad y la eficacia, y el estudio es de Fase 1.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older who signed informed consent.
HER2-expressing or HER2-mutated solid tumor that is unresectable or metastatic.
At least one measurable lesion on CT or MRI by RECIST v1.1.
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
Left ventricular ejection fraction of 50% or higher.
not_for: Prior treatment with an anti-CD47 or anti-SIRPα therapy.
Prior antibody-drug conjugate with an exatecan derivative (topoisomerase I inhibitor) in the expansion phase.
History of non-infectious interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis needing steroids, or current ILD or pneumonitis.
Active or uncontrolled HIV, hepatitis B, or hepatitis C, or uncontrolled infection needing IV antibiotics, antivirals, or antifungals.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women.

NCT07149857.summary_en: This study tests ciltacabtagene autoleucel (cilta-cel) in people with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma, using either a fludarabine-free conditioning regimen or a cyclophosphamide and fludarabine regimen. Participants first receive 1 to 2 more cycles of standard induction therapy, then cyclophosphamide is given by IV infusion daily for 3 days, followed by cilta-cel IV infusion on Day 1. The main outcome measure is not stated; the study is Phase 2.
NCT07149857.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa ciltacabtagene autoleucel (cilta-cel) en personas con mieloma múltiple de diagnóstico reciente, usando un régimen de acondicionamiento sin fludarabina o un régimen de ciclofosfamida y fludarabina. Los participantes reciben primero de 1 a 2 ciclos más de terapia de inducción estándar, luego ciclofosfamida por infusión intravenosa diaria durante 3 días, seguida de la infusión intravenosa de cilta-cel el Día 1. La medida de resultado principal no está indicada; el estudio es de Fase 2.
who_for: Newly diagnosed multiple myeloma with measurable disease at diagnosis
Not a candidate for high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell transplant (for example, due to older age, other health conditions, or refusal)
