Definite evidence of metastatic disease outside the pelvic nodes on conventional imaging.
Prior pelvic radiotherapy, or prior prostate treatment such as total prostatectomy or cryotherapy.
Life expectancy under 5 years or another condition that would preclude curative-intent radiation.
Invasive pelvic or other malignancy within 5 years, unless it is non-melanomatous skin cancer.

NCT07396584.summary_en: This Phase 1/2a study tests HMPL-A580 in adults with advanced or metastatic solid tumors. The study has a dose escalation part (Part A) with 6 predefined dose levels and a dose expansion part (Part B); the route, schedule and duration are not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, immunogenicity and preliminary efficacy.
NCT07396584.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2a evalúa HMPL-A580 en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados o metastásicos. El estudio tiene una parte de escalado de dosis (Parte A) con 6 niveles de dosis predefinidos y una parte de expansión de dosis (Parte B); la vía de administración, el esquema y la duración no se indican. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética, la inmunogenicidad y la eficacia preliminar.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with histologically confirmed, unresectable, advanced or metastatic solid tumor.
At least one measurable lesion per RECIST v1.1.
Life expectancy of at least 12 weeks.
ECOG performance status of 0 to 1.
Able to understand the study and voluntarily sign the informed consent form.
not_for: Established type 1 diabetes or uncontrolled type 2 diabetes.
Use of strong CYP3A4, P-gp or BCRP inhibitors shortly before the first dose.
Major surgery within 28 days before the first dose.
Active infection requiring systemic treatment.
Received a live product within 3 months before enrollment (type not specified in the record).

NCT05983432.summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests BL-B01D1 in adults with metastatic or unresectable non-small cell lung cancer and other solid tumors. BL-B01D1 is given by intravenous infusion every 3 weeks, on Day 1 or on Day 1 and Day 8, and the total length of treatment is not stated. The stated objective is to evaluate safety, tolerability, and efficacy, and the specific main outcome measure is not stated.
NCT05983432.summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 evalúa BL-B01D1 en adultos con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas metastásico o no resecable y otros tumores sólidos. BL-B01D1 se administra por infusión intravenosa cada 3 semanas, el Día 1 o el Día 1 y el Día 8, y la duración total del tratamiento no se indica. El objetivo declarado es evaluar la seguridad, la tolerabilidad y la eficacia, y la medida de resultado principal específica no se indica.
who_for: Age 18 years or older with a life expectancy of at least 3 months.
Incurable, locally advanced or metastatic cancer of the listed types, with disease progression after prior treatment.
At least one measurable lesion according to RECIST v1.1.
ECOG performance status of 0 to 1.
Adequate blood counts, liver, kidney and clotting function, and no serious heart dysfunction.
not_for: Symptomatic heart failure, prior heart attack, unstable angina, or prolonged QT interval.
History of interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis, or grade 3 lung disease.
Active autoimmune or inflammatory disease requiring systemic treatment.
Other malignant tumors diagnosed within 5 years, with some skin cancer exceptions.
Active or untreated brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis.
cancer_types: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma

NCT06686043.summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests an HPV L1 vaccine combined with imiquimod and metformin, given alongside standard chemoradiation, for HPV-associated cervical, vaginal, or vulvar cancer. The vaccine is injected into the tumor and under the skin, metformin tablets are taken twice daily for two weeks, and imiquimod cream is applied at home three nights per week, with visits during and after radiation. The record does not state a primary outcome measure; the study aims to see whether the combination helps the body fight the cancer and to record side effects.
NCT06686043.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa una vacuna contra el VPH con proteína L1, combinada con imiquimod y metformina, administrada junto con quimiorradiación estándar, para el cáncer de cuello uterino, vagina o vulva asociado al VPH. La vacuna se inyecta en el tumor y debajo de la piel, la metformina se toma en tabletas dos veces al día durante dos semanas, y la crema de imiquimod se aplica en casa tres noches por semana, con visitas durante y después de la radiación. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; el estudio busca saber si la combinación ayuda al cuerpo a combatir el cáncer y registrar los efectos secundarios.
who_for: Newly diagnosed cervical, vaginal, or vulvar carcinoma that is locally advanced or metastatic.
Not considered a primary surgical candidate, or responding after neoadjuvant therapy.
Measurable disease by RECIST criteria.
ECOG performance status of 2 or less.
Aged 18 to 64 years with adequate organ function.
not_for: Currently receiving other investigational agents.
Untreated, new, or progressive brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease.
Past allergic reaction to compounds similar to study agents.
Uncontrolled intercurrent illness.
Psychiatric or social situations that would limit compliance; pregnant or breastfeeding.

NCT07685717.summary_en: This phase 2 study tests pirtobrutinib, a BTK inhibitor, in adults aged 75 and older with chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL). Pirtobrutinib is taken by mouth once a day on days 1 to 28 of each 28-day cycle, and cycles repeat every 28 days if the disease does not progress and side effects are acceptable. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record; the study is a phase 2 trial.
NCT07685717.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa pirtobrutinib, un inhibidor de BTK, en adultos de 75 años o más con leucemia linfocítica crónica (LLC). El pirtobrutinib se toma por vía oral una vez al día durante los días 1 a 28 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y los ciclos se repiten cada 28 días si la enfermedad no progresa y los efectos secundarios son aceptables. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Men or women aged 75 years or older
Diagnosis of CLL or small lymphocytic lymphoma per 2018 iwCLL criteria
No prior treatment for CLL, with listed exceptions
Needs treatment according to 2018 iwCLL guidelines
ECOG performance status of 3 or less
not_for: Active Richter's transformation
Recent serious heart problems, such as class III or IV heart failure, unstable angina, or heart attack within 3 months
Positive HIV test
Active hepatitis B or hepatitis C infection
Taking warfarin or similar anticoagulant

NCT06634589.summary_en: This study tests tacabrutideg (BGB-16673) given together with other medicines in adults with relapsed or refractory B-cell malignancies. Tacabrutideg is taken by mouth, and it is combined with sonrotoclax, zanubrutinib, mosunetuzumab, or glofitamab, with obinutuzumab given before glofitamab; how long or how often treatment is given is not stated. The study measures safety, preliminary antitumor activity, pharmacokinetics, and pharmacodynamics; the study is Phase 1/2.
NCT06634589.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa tacabrutideg (BGB-16673) administrado junto con otros medicamentos en adultos con neoplasias de células B recidivantes o refractarias. Tacabrutideg se toma por vía oral y se combina con sonrotoclax, zanubrutinib, mosunetuzumab o glofitamab, y se administra obinutuzumab antes de glofitamab; no se indica cuánto tiempo ni con qué frecuencia se da el tratamiento. El estudio mide la seguridad, la actividad antitumoral preliminar, la farmacocinética y la farmacodinamia; es un estudio de Fase 1/2.
who_for: Confirmed relapsed or refractory B-cell malignancy
Measurable disease as defined by the protocol
ECOG performance status of 0 to 2
Adequate organ function
Adequate kidney function (eGFR of at least 50 mL/min, or at least 30 mL/min in substudy 2)
not_for: Treatment-naive B-cell malignancy
Active leptomeningeal disease or uncontrolled, untreated brain metastasis
Other cancer within 2 years before first dose, unless treated curatively or it is the cancer under study
Autologous stem cell transplant or CAR T-cell therapy within 3 months before screening
Prior Bcl-2 inhibitor treatment (substudy 1), or prior CD20 x CD3 T-cell engager treatment (substudies 3 and 4)

NCT05972135.summary_en: This phase 2 study tests outpatient use of teclistamab or talquetamab, both antibody drugs, in adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. Teclistamab or talquetamab is given under the skin, with step-up doses followed by repeat dosing in 28-day cycles, and tocilizumab and oral dexamethasone are given as pretreatment. The record does not state the main outcome measure; the study is phase 2.
NCT05972135.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa la administración ambulatoria de teclistamab o talquetamab, dos fármacos de tipo anticuerpo, en adultos con mieloma múltiple recidivante o refractario. Teclistamab o talquetamab se administra debajo de la piel, con dosis de inicio escalonadas seguidas de dosis repetidas en ciclos de 28 días, y tocilizumab y dexametasona oral se dan como medicamentos previos. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with multiple myeloma diagnosed by IMWG criteria.
Prior myeloma treatment: at least 2 therapies including PI, IMiD and CD38 antibody (talquetamab or tocilizumab arms); 1 or more for the teclistamab with oral de
ECOG performance status 0 to 1 (teclistamab or talquetamab with tocilizumab); 0 to 2 (teclistamab with oral dexamethasone).
Measurable disease at screening, such as M-protein level or light chain disease criteria.
Body weight over 35 kg, and able to stay near the site with a competent adult for a set time after dosing.
not_for: Rapidly progressing disease per the investigator.
Plasma cell leukemia, Waldenström's macroglobulinemia, POEMS syndrome, or primary amyloid light-chain amyloidosis.
Known active brain or nervous system involvement, or meningeal involvement of myeloma.
Grade 3 or higher blood side effects or clinically significant non-blood side effects.
Fever or active infection at enrollment, or hepatitis B or active hepatitis C infection.

NCT07187778.summary_en: This Phase II trial tests belzutifan alone, pembrolizumab alone, or the two drugs together, given before a partial or total nephrectomy, in locally advanced clear cell renal cell carcinoma. Both drugs are listed as oral medicines, and the record lists evaluations at baseline and at 3, 6, 9, and 12 weeks after treatment starts, but how long or how often the drugs are taken is not stated. The main outcome the study measures is not stated; the trial is Phase II.
NCT07187778.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase II evalúa belzutifan solo, pembrolizumab solo, o ambos medicamentos juntos, administrados antes de una nefrectomía parcial o total, en el carcinoma de células renales de células claras localmente avanzado. Ambos medicamentos figuran como de administración oral, y el registro indica evaluaciones al inicio y a las 3, 6, 9 y 12 semanas después de comenzar el tratamiento, pero no se indica por cuánto tiempo ni con qué frecuencia se toman los medicamentos. El resultado principal que mide el estudio no se indica; el ensayo es de fase II.
who_for: Biopsy or archival tissue confirms clear cell renal cell carcinoma
Intermediate-high risk, high risk, or M1 disease by the stated tumor, node, metastasis, and grade criteria
Evaluated by urology and approved as a candidate for nephrectomy
Age 18 or older and able to give written consent
No distant metastases on chest, abdomen, and pelvis imaging within 42 days of enrollment
not_for: Prior chemotherapy or radiotherapy for kidney cancer
Prior anti-PD-1, PD-L1, PD-L2, or CTLA-4 therapy
Prior treatment with belzutifan or another HIF-2 alpha inhibitor
Pregnant or breastfeeding
Another cancer that is progressing or needed active treatment within the past 3 years

NCT07413939.summary_en: This study compares RO7771950 with tucatinib, each given together with trastuzumab and capecitabine, in people with HER2-positive breast cancer that is locally advanced or metastatic. RO7771950 is taken by mouth twice a day at one of two doses, and tucatinib is also taken by mouth twice a day. Trastuzumab is given by IV or under the skin as local prescribing information directs, capecitabine is taken by mouth twice a day, and how long treatment lasts is not stated. This is a phase 2/3 study that aims to assess efficacy and safety, and the main outcome measure is not stated.
NCT07413939.summary_es: Este estudio compara RO7771950 con tucatinib, cada uno administrado junto con trastuzumab y capecitabina, en personas con cáncer de mama HER2 positivo que es localmente avanzado o metastásico. RO7771950 se toma por vía oral dos veces al día en una de dos dosis, y tucatinib también se toma por vía oral dos veces al día. El trastuzumab se administra por vía intravenosa o debajo de la piel según la información de prescripción local, la capecitabina se toma por vía oral dos veces al día, y no se indica cuánto dura el tratamiento. Este es un estudio de fase 2/3 que busca evaluar la eficacia y la seguridad, y la medida de resultado principal no se indica.
who_for: Locally advanced, inoperable or metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer confirmed by central lab.
At least one prior line of anti-HER2 therapy for advanced disease.
Brain or leptomeningeal metastases allowed, whether previously treated or untreated.
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
Baseline left ventricular ejection fraction of 50% or higher.
not_for: Anti-cancer or investigational treatment within 28 days before starting study treatment.
Prior tyrosine kinase inhibitor treatment for advanced or metastatic disease.
Active untreated hepatitis B or C, or chronic liver disease.
Significant heart disease, including heart failure with NYHA class II or higher.
Concomitant strong CYP3A4 or CYP2C8 inhibitors or inducers, or oral coumarin-derivative anticoagulants.

NCT06416007.summary_en: This study tests lattice radiation therapy (LRT) in people with large, bulky solid tumors that are locally advanced or metastatic. LRT is given in 5 fractions; the total treatment length and the time between fractions are not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated; the record describes this as a Phase 2 study.
NCT06416007.summary_es: Este estudio prueba la radioterapia en celosía (LRT) en personas con tumores sólidos grandes y voluminosos que están localmente avanzados o son metastásicos. La LRT se administra en 5 fracciones; la duración total del tratamiento y el tiempo entre fracciones no se indican. El resultado principal que mide el estudio no se indica; el registro describe un estudio de Fase 2.
who_for: Solid tumor with a clinical indication for radiation
Has measurable disease
Has a target lesion that suits a lattice therapy plan
Age 18 or older, ECOG performance status 2 or lower, life expectancy over 3 months
Agrees to avoid pregnancy and can sign written consent
not_for: Received cytotoxic chemotherapy or known radiosensitizing agents within 5 days before or after lattice therapy
Has a blood cancer (such as lymphoma or leukemia) or a primary or metastatic brain or spinal cord cancer
Has a history of conditions that increase radiation toxicity or a known contraindication to radiation
Has uncontrolled illness that is not related to the cancer
Is pregnant

NCT04892277.summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests CD19-directed CAR-T cell therapy, called IC19/1563, in adults with relapsed or refractory B cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma, chronic lymphocytic leukemia, or small lymphocytic lymphoma. Before the cell infusion, patients receive chemotherapy through a vein: cyclophosphamide and fludarabine on days -5 to -3, or bendamustine on days -4 and -3, followed by IC19/1563 on day 0. The record does not state a main outcome measure; it is a Phase 1 dose escalation trial.
NCT04892277.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa la terapia con células CAR-T dirigidas a CD19, llamada IC19/1563, en adultos con linfoma de células B no Hodgkin, leucemia linfocítica crónica o linfoma linfocítico pequeño recidivante o refractario. Antes de la infusión de células, los pacientes reciben quimioterapia por vía intravenosa: ciclofosfamida y fludarabina en los días -5 a -3, o bendamustina en los días -4 y -3, seguidas de IC19/1563 el día 0. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; se trata de un estudio de fase 1 de escalada de dosis.
who_for: Age 18 years or older.
Relapsed or refractory CD19-positive B cell lymphoma, CLL, SLL, or Richter transformation of CLL.
Prior lines of therapy required, including an anthracycline-containing regimen for most lymphoma patients.
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
At least one measurable lesion larger than 1.5 cm on CT portion of PET/CT.
not_for: Pregnant or nursing persons, or women of childbearing potential unwilling to use highly effective contraception.
Patients able to obtain a market-approved CD19 CAR T-cell therapy.
History of seizure disorder, stroke-like cerebrovascular event, dementia, or cerebellar disease.
Current need for systemic steroids above 20 mg/day prednisone or equivalent.
Clinically significant active infection, or IV antibiotics within 7 days before registration.

NCT06028828.summary_en: This study tests a conditioning regimen of fludarabine, melphalan, and total body irradiation (TBI) before an allogeneic stem cell transplant in people with hematologic malignancies. Fludarabine is given on days -5 to -2, melphalan on day -5, and TBI on day -1, and the melphalan and TBI doses vary based on the Hematopoietic Cell Transplant - Composite Risk score, age, and Karnofsky performance status. The record does not state a main outcome; it is a single-arm phase 2 study.
NCT06028828.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa un régimen de acondicionamiento con fludarabina, melfalán e irradiación corporal total antes de un trasplante alogénico de células madre en personas con neoplasias hematológicas. La fludarabina se administra en los días -5 a -2, el melfalán el día -5 y la irradiación corporal total el día -1; las dosis de melfalán e irradiación varían según la puntuación de riesgo compuesto del trasplante de células madre, la edad y el estado de desempeño de Karnofsky. El registro no indica el resultado principal; es un estudio de fase 2 de un solo grupo.
who_for: Age 18 to 70 years.
Diagnosis of AML, ALL, MDS, CML, NHL, Hodgkin lymphoma, or CLL that needs transplant.
Has a matched related, matched unrelated, haploidentical, or one-antigen mismatched unrelated donor.
Karnofsky performance status above 70%.
Adequate kidney, liver, heart, and lung function, and able to give written informed consent.
not_for: Unable to follow medical recommendations or follow-up.
Pregnant.
Active or uncontrolled bacterial or viral infection, as judged by the principal investigator.
Active brain, spinal, or eye disease within 3 months, or primary CNS lymphoma.
Needs changes to the conditioning regimen.

NCT06824064.summary_en: This Phase 2 study compares RBS2418, described as an immune modulator, with placebo in adults with advanced, metastatic, progressive colorectal cancer. Participants take two 200 mg RBS2418 capsules by mouth twice a day, or matching placebo capsules, plus best supportive care; how long treatment lasts is not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record; the study is listed as Phase 2.
NCT06824064.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 compara RBS2418, descrito como un modulador inmunitario, con placebo en adultos con cáncer colorrectal avanzado, metastásico y progresivo. Los participantes toman dos cápsulas de 200 mg de RBS2418 por vía oral dos veces al día, o cápsulas de placebo iguales, además de cuidados de soporte; la duración del tratamiento no se indica. El resultado principal que mide el estudio no se indica en el registro; el estudio figura como fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with advanced, metastatic, progressive colorectal cancer.
Have received, been ineligible for, intolerant to, or declined all approved standard therapies for metastatic colorectal cancer.
Documented disease progression on two scans performed within 2 to 4 months of study start.
Colorectal cancer confirmed by pathology report.
Willing to provide a pre-treatment tissue sample.
not_for: Anti-cancer therapy, chemotherapy, targeted therapy, immunotherapy, or radiation within 2 weeks before the first dose.
Not recovered to grade 1 or baseline from side effects of a previous treatment.
Rapid progression on prior therapy with rapid clinical deterioration.
Other malignancies within 3 years before Day 1, with listed exceptions.

NCT07673887.summary_en: This Phase 3 study is testing ASP2138 added to chemotherapy and pembrolizumab as first-line treatment for adults with HER2-negative, CLDN18.2-positive gastric or gastroesophageal junction (GEJ) adenocarcinoma that is locally advanced unresectable or metastatic. ASP2138 is given as a subcutaneous injection, pembrolizumab by intravenous infusion, and chemotherapy (CAPOX or mFOLFOX6) in 42-day cycles, and treatment continues until the cancer worsens or a stop rule applies. The main aim is to measure progression-free survival and whether participants live longer (overall survival), compared with placebo plus chemotherapy with or without pembrolizumab.
NCT07673887.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 evalúa ASP2138 añadido a quimioterapia y pembrolizumab como tratamiento de primera línea para adultos con adenocarcinoma gástrico o de la unión gastroesofágica (GEJ) HER2 negativo y CLDN18.2 positivo, localmente avanzado no resecable o metastásico. ASP2138 se administra como inyección subcutánea, pembrolizumab por infusión intravenosa y la quimioterapia (CAPOX o mFOLFOX6) en ciclos de 42 días, y el tratamiento continúa hasta que el cáncer empeore o se aplique una regla de suspensión. El objetivo principal es medir la supervivencia libre de progresión y si los participantes viven más tiempo (supervivencia global), en comparación con placebo más quimioterapia con o sin pembrolizumab.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older.
Gastric or GEJ adenocarcinoma that is locally advanced unresectable or metastatic.
Tumor is HER2-negative.
Tumor is CLDN18.2-positive by central testing.
ECOG performance status 0 to 1.
not_for: Mixed histology or non-adenocarcinoma gastric or GEJ cancer.
Known active brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis (some stable, treated brain metastases are allowed).
The record text is cut off; other exclusion criteria are not stated.

NCT03675893.summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests letrozole and abemaciclib, alone or with metformin or gedatolisib, in estrogen receptor positive (ER+) endometrial cancer. Abemaciclib is taken by mouth twice a day and letrozole is taken by mouth once a day; metformin is taken by mouth once a day in one arm, and gedatolisib is given into a vein on days 1, 8 and 15 of a 28-day cycle in other arms. The record does not state the main outcome measure, and the study is Phase 2.
NCT03675893.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa letrozol y abemaciclib, solos o con metformina o gedatolisib, en cáncer de endometrio con receptor de estrógeno positivo (ER+). El abemaciclib se toma por boca dos veces al día y el letrozol se toma por boca una vez al día; la metformina se toma por boca una vez al día en un grupo, y el gedatolisib se administra en una vena los días 1, 8 y 15 de un ciclo de 28 días en otros grupos. El registro no indica la medida principal de resultado, y el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Endometrial cancer that is recurrent or metastatic, or resistant to standard treatments, or with no standard treatment available
Tumor that is estrogen receptor positive, with at least 1 percent of cells positive
Disease that can be measured on scan or exam
Age 18 or older with performance status score of 0 or 1
Adequate blood counts and organ function
not_for: Prior CDK4/6 inhibitor treatment, except Cohort 7, which requires it
Current metformin use for Cohort 3
Known brain metastases
Pregnancy or breastfeeding
For Cohorts 6 and 7: type 1 diabetes, uncontrolled type 2 diabetes, or prior PI3K pathway inhibitor

NCT06268665.summary_en: This study tests tart cherry juice, given at a high dose or a low dose, to see whether it can prevent peripheral neuropathy, a nerve side effect, caused by paclitaxel chemotherapy in people with breast or ovarian cancer. Patients take tart cherry juice concentrate diluted in water up to 8 oz, by mouth, either 1 oz (high dose) or ¼ oz (low dose), and how long or how often they take it is not stated. The record does not state the main outcome measure; this is a Phase 2 randomized study.
NCT06268665.summary_es: Este estudio prueba jugo de cereza ácida, en dosis alta o baja, para ver si puede prevenir la neuropatía periférica, un efecto secundario en los nervios, causado por la quimioterapia con paclitaxel en personas con cáncer de mama o de ovario. Los pacientes toman concentrado de jugo de cereza ácida diluido en agua hasta 8 oz, por vía oral, ya sea 1 oz (dosis alta) o ¼ oz (dosis baja), y no se indica por cuánto tiempo ni con qué frecuencia lo toman. El registro no indica la medida principal de resultado; es un estudio aleatorizado de Fase 2.
who_for: Invasive breast or ovarian cancer, stage I to IV
Planning weekly paclitaxel for 12 weeks
Age 18 years or older
ECOG 0-1 or Karnofsky score of 70% or higher
Willing to avoid any other cherry or cherry juice during the study
not_for: Prior taxane, vinca alkaloid, eribulin, ixabepilone, or platinum therapy
Active or past peripheral neuropathy, or chronic diseases linked to it such as diabetes
Currently taking an anticoagulant medication
Taking certain listed supplements or medicines unless agreed to stop at registration
Known allergy to cherries

NCT06406465.summary_en: This study tests belinostat, given with cisplatin and etoposide, in people with high-grade neuroendocrine carcinoma, with the belinostat dose chosen by UGT1A1 gene status. All three drugs are given by intravenous infusion in 21-day cycles; belinostat is given as a 48-hour continuous infusion on days 1 to 3, and after cycle 6 belinostat may continue alone for up to 5 years. The title names belinostat pharmacokinetics and toxicity as the focus, and a main outcome is not stated.
NCT06406465.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa belinostat, administrado junto con cisplatino y etopósido, en personas con carcinoma neuroendocrino de alto grado, con la dosis de belinostat elegida según el estado del gen UGT1A1. Los tres medicamentos se administran por infusión intravenosa en ciclos de 21 días; el belinostat se administra como infusión continua de 48 horas los días 1 a 3, y después del ciclo 6 el belinostat puede continuar solo por hasta 5 años. El título indica que el enfoque son la farmacocinética y la toxicidad del belinostat, y no se indica un resultado principal.
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older with extrapulmonary high-grade neuroendocrine neoplasm.
No known standard therapy that can extend life expectancy for the disease.
Measurable or non-measurable disease per RECIST 1.1.
ECOG performance status 2 or lower at screening.
Blood counts, liver and kidney function within limits set in the record.
not_for: Platinum-refractory disease.
Another histone deacetylase inhibitor taken within 2 weeks before enrollment.
Investigational drug, chemotherapy, immunotherapy or radiotherapy within 14 days before first dose.
New York Heart Association class III or IV heart disease, or QTc above 450 msec.
Pregnancy, or allergy to compounds similar to study drugs.

NCT06693336.summary_en: This study tests SMS001, a new form of the drug paclitaxel, in people with non-small cell lung cancer. SMS001 is given once, during scheduled lung cancer surgery, and the dose is raised in steps until a pre-defined suitable dose is reached. The main outcome is not stated; the study is Phase 2 and aims to find a safe dose and see how well SMS001 works.
NCT06693336.summary_es: Este estudio prueba SMS001, una nueva forma del medicamento paclitaxel, en personas con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas. SMS001 se administra una sola vez, durante la cirugía programada de cáncer de pulmón, y la dosis aumenta por etapas hasta llegar a una dosis predefinida adecuada. El resultado principal no se indica; el estudio es de Fase 2 y busca encontrar una dosis segura y ver qué tan bien funciona SMS001.
who_for: Confirmed non-small cell lung cancer by tissue exam
Stage Ia to IIIa (N2) per AJCC 8th edition
Age 18 or older and suitable for lung cancer surgery
No prior chemotherapy or chest radiation
Surgeon judges complete surgical removal of the cancer is possible
not_for: Locally advanced T3 or T4 lung cancer or distant spread
Need for pneumonectomy or sleeve resection
Cancer diagnosed within the last 5 years, except non-melanoma skin cancer
Chemotherapy or radiation before surgery
Pregnant or nursing, or known sensitivity to study agent components

NCT07539311.summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests Rina-S (rinatabart sesutecan) by itself in adults with advanced gastrointestinal cancers. Rina-S is given through an IV, and each cycle lasts 21 days. The average treatment period is expected to be about 12 months, and participants may continue while the cancer stays the same or gets better and there are no serious problems. The main outcome is not stated; this is a Phase 2 study.
NCT07539311.summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 2 evalúa Rina-S (rinatabart sesutecan) por sí solo en personas con cánceres gastrointestinales avanzados. Rina-S se administra por vía intravenosa, y cada ciclo dura 21 días. Se espera que el tratamiento dure en promedio unos 12 meses, y los participantes pueden seguir recibiéndolo mientras el cáncer se mantenga igual o mejore y no haya problemas graves. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; es un estudio de Fase 2.
who_for: Confirmed gastrointestinal cancer that has spread (metastatic) or cannot be removed by surgery with curative intent.
Measurable disease on imaging, and imaging shows the disease has grown after the most recent treatment.
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1 and life expectancy of at least 3 months.
Able to provide a newly obtained or archival tumor tissue sample.
Adequate organ and bone marrow function based on laboratory tests before Rina-S.
not_for: Non-cancer bowel conditions such as ulcerative colitis, inflammatory bowel disease, or diarrhea above grade 1.
Recent significant GI bleeding, fistula, abscess, or perforation, or current cancer-related ulcers.
Any other past or current cancer, or residual disease from a previous cancer.
Unstable or symptomatic central nervous system metastases, or a history of carcinomatous meningitis.
Prior treatment with a topoisomerase-1 inhibitor antibody-drug conjugate, or anticancer treatment within 28 days before the first dose.

NCT05549297.summary_en: This study compares tebentafusp alone and tebentafusp with pembrolizumab against the investigator's choice of therapy, in adults with previously treated advanced non-ocular melanoma. How often and for how long each drug is given is not stated. The main outcome is not stated; the study is described as a randomized Phase 2/3 study.
NCT05549297.summary_es: Este estudio compara tebentafusp solo y tebentafusp con pembrolizumab frente a la elección del investigador, en adultos con melanoma avanzado no ocular que ya recibieron tratamiento. La frecuencia y la duración de cada medicamento no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica; el estudio se describe como un estudio aleatorizado de fase 2/3.
who_for: Positive for HLA-A*02:01
Unresectable stage III or stage IV non-ocular melanoma
Archival tumor sample or new biopsy of a tumor lesion provided
ECOG performance status score of 0 or 1
Age 18 years or older
not_for: Ocular or metastatic uveal melanoma
Untreated or symptomatic brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis
Has not progressed on an anti-PD(L)1 antibody treatment
BRAF V600 mutation without prior BRAF/MEK inhibitor regimen
Active autoimmune disease requiring immunosuppressive treatment

NCT07535463.summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests ivonescimab with chemotherapy and stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS) in non-small cell lung cancer that has spread to the brain. Ivonescimab is given intravenously on Day 1 of cycle 1 with chemotherapy, starting at 10 mg/kg and escalating to 15 and 20 mg/kg as tolerated, and SRS (9 Gy in 3 fractions) starts on Days 7-10. The record does not state a main outcome; the first part aims to find a dose with few or mild side effects, and the second part tests whether that dose is effective.
NCT07535463.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa ivonescimab junto con quimioterapia y radiocirugía estereotáctica (SRS) en cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas que se ha extendido al cerebro. Ivonescimab se administra por vía intravenosa el Día 1 del primer ciclo, con quimioterapia, comenzando con 10 mg/kg y subiendo a 15 y 20 mg/kg según se tolere; la SRS (9 Gy en 3 fracciones) comienza entre los días 7 y 10. El registro no indica un resultado principal; la primera parte busca una dosis con efectos secundarios leves o pocos, y la segunda parte prueba si esa dosis es eficaz.
who_for: Non-small cell lung cancer, including squamous and non-squamous types, confirmed by tissue or cell testing.
At least one brain metastasis measuring 1.0 to 3.5 cm, judged safe for SRS by a radiation oncologist.
PD-L1 tumor proportion score available.
ECOG performance status 0 to 1.
Age 18 years or older.
not_for: Small cell lung cancer.
Previous immunotherapy, with limited exceptions listed in the record.
Brainstem brain metastasis 1.0 cm or larger, or leptomeningeal disease.
Another malignant tumor within 3 years before enrollment, with exceptions.
Poorly controlled blood pressure, recent significant bleeding or clotting events, or other major conditions listed.

NCT03945162.summary_en: This Phase II study tests Ruvidar (TLD-1433) with photodynamic therapy (PDT) in adults with non-muscle invasive bladder cancer that is carcinoma in situ, with or without papillary disease (Ta, T1), and that is unresponsive to or intolerant of BCG. Ruvidar is infused into the bladder for about 60 minutes, then rinsed out, and the bladder wall is treated with PDT light using the TLC-3200 system; one procedure is given, with up to two re-induction procedures based on response. The record does not state the main outcome measure; the study is Phase II, single-arm and open-label.
NCT03945162.summary_es: Este estudio de fase II evalúa Ruvidar (TLD-1433) con terapia fotodinámica (PDT) en adultos con cáncer de vejiga no músculo invasivo, con carcinoma in situ, con o sin enfermedad papilar (Ta, T1), que no responde a BCG o no lo tolera. Ruvidar se infunde en la vejiga durante unos 60 minutos y luego se enjuaga; después, la pared de la vejiga se trata con luz PDT usando el sistema TLC-3200, y se realiza un procedimiento, con hasta dos procedimientos de re-inducción según la respuesta. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de fase II, de un solo brazo y abierto.
who_for: Bladder carcinoma in situ, with or without papillary disease, that is BCG-unresponsive or BCG-intolerant
Not a candidate for cystectomy on medical grounds, or refuses radical cystectomy
ECOG performance score of 0 to 2
Satisfactory bladder function and able to retain the study drug for at least 60 minutes
Age 18 years or older
not_for: Past or current muscle-invasive or metastatic urothelial carcinoma
Active gross hematuria
Another malignancy that is progressing or needs active treatment
Participation in an investigational agent or device study within 1 month
Active infection requiring systemic therapy, or pregnancy or breastfeeding

NCT07181161.summary_en: This study tests AZD0516 alone and in combination with AZD9574 in participants with metastatic prostate cancer. AZD0516 is given by intravenous infusion, and AZD9574 is given by mouth; how long or how often is not stated. The main outcome is safety and tolerability, and the study is Phase 1/Phase 2.
NCT07181161.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa AZD0516 solo y en combinación con AZD9574 en participantes con cáncer de próstata metastásico. AZD0516 se administra por infusión intravenosa y AZD9574 por vía oral; la duración o la frecuencia no están indicadas. El resultado principal es la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, y el estudio es de Fase 1/Fase 2.
who_for: Confirmed metastatic prostate adenocarcinoma, with focal high-grade neuroendocrine features allowed.
Measurable PSA of at least 1 ng/mL at screening.
Surgically or medically castrated, with testosterone at or below 50 ng/dL, or ongoing hormone therapy.
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
Documented progression of metastatic castration-resistant disease at screening.
not_for: Spinal cord compression, symptomatic brain metastases, or leptomeningeal carcinomatosis.
Unresolved grade 2 or higher side effects from prior therapy.
Uncontrolled intercurrent illness in the last 12 months, or significant cardiovascular disorders.
History of non-infectious interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis, or active tuberculosis, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or HIV.
Prior STEAP2-targeting treatment or topoisomerase-inhibiting chemotherapy, or MDS/AML.

NCT06627270.summary_en: This study tests the antibiotic metronidazole and a chlorhexidine mouth rinse in people with oral cancer (squamous cell carcinoma of the mouth). The study is Phase 2 and uses one group of participants. Participants take metronidazole 500 mg three times a day and rinse with 10 mL of chlorhexidine three times a day, both for 10 days, before surgery to remove the tumor. The main goal is to measure how much these antibiotics reduce the amount of bacteria inside the tumor; a separate outcome measure is not stated.
NCT06627270.summary_es: Este estudio prueba el antibiótico metronidazol y un enjuague bucal de clorhexidina en personas con cáncer oral (carcinoma de células escamosas de la boca). El estudio es de Fase 2 y usa un solo grupo de participantes. Los participantes toman metronidazol de 500 mg tres veces al día y se enjuagan con 10 mL de clorhexidina tres veces al día, ambos durante 10 días, antes de la cirugía para extirpar el tumor. El objetivo principal es medir cuánto reducen estos antibióticos la cantidad de bacterias dentro del tumor; no se indica una medida de resultado por separado.
who_for: Pathologically confirmed squamous cell carcinoma of the oral cavity
Planned surgery with curative intent
Age 18 years or older
Able to understand and willing to sign written informed consent
not_for: Known allergy to metronidazole or chlorhexidine
Severe liver or kidney disease
Actively drinking alcohol and unable to stop during the 10-day antibiotic period
Recurrent oral cancer after radiation or chemoradiation, or unresectable oral cancer
Unable to use oral rinse or take metronidazole by mouth or feeding tube, took other antibiotics in the prior 30 days, or pregnant

NCT07276880.summary_en: This phase 2 study tests two doses of a radiation boost (9 Gy or 24 Gy) given with pembrolizumab and chemotherapy before surgery in people with node-positive, triple negative breast cancer. Radiation is given to the breast tumor in 3 daily fractions over 3 days, and pembrolizumab is given intravenously at 200 milligrams per square meter. The study aims to find the best radiation dose to trigger an immune response; the primary outcome measure is not stated.
NCT07276880.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 prueba dos dosis de un refuerzo de radiación (9 Gy o 24 Gy) administrado junto con pembrolizumab y quimioterapia antes de la cirugía, en personas con cáncer de mama triple negativo con ganglios positivos. La radiación se administra al tumor de mama en 3 fracciones diarias durante 3 días, y el pembrolizumab se administra por vena a 200 miligramos por metro cuadrado. El estudio busca encontrar la mejor dosis de radiación para provocar una respuesta inmunitaria; la medida de resultado principal no está indicada.
who_for: Written informed consent and willing to comply with study procedures
Age 18 years or older
ECOG or Karnofsky performance status of 0 or 1
Operable, lymph node-positive, triple negative breast cancer
Candidate for standard neoadjuvant chemo-immunotherapy based on KEYNOTE-522
not_for: Active infection requiring systemic therapy
Pregnant or breastfeeding
Prior ipsilateral invasive breast, chest wall or thoracic radiotherapy
Prior ipsilateral invasive breast cancer, contralateral breast cancer, or another invasive malignancy that is progressing or required active treatment in the la

NCT06047886.summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests an infusion of CD34-selected blood stem cells, processed with the automated CliniMACS Prodigy system, in people who had an allogeneic stem cell transplant for a blood cancer. The cells are given by infusion as a stem cell boost for graft failure or low graft function, with or without preceding conditioning with fludarabine and total body irradiation at the clinician's discretion; how often or how long is not stated. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is listed as Phase 1.
NCT06047886.summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 prueba una infusión de células madre de sangre seleccionadas por CD34, procesadas con el sistema automatizado CliniMACS Prodigy, en personas que recibieron un trasplante alogénico de células madre por un cáncer de la sangre. Las células se administran por infusión como un refuerzo de células madre por falla del injerto o función baja del injerto, con o sin acondicionamiento previo con fludarabina y radiación corporal total a criterio del clínico; la frecuencia o la duración no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio aparece como Fase 1.
who_for: Ages 4 weeks to 75 years
Prior allogeneic stem cell transplant with graft failure or low graft function needing a CD34-selected stem cell boost
Certain blood cancers in remission, such as AML, ALL, lymphoma, CLL, MDS, CML, or myelofibrosis, per listed criteria
Negative donor-specific antibody test within 28 days of conditioning, or adequate for standard desensitization
not_for: Patients who are not compliant
No appropriate caregiver identified
Uncontrolled medical or psychiatric disorder, per attending physician
Known allergy to DMSO
Pregnant or breastfeeding women

NCT07156227.summary_en: This Phase I study tests camonsertib, a drug also called an ATR inhibitor, combined with stereotactic body radiation therapy for head and neck squamous cell cancer that has come back or cannot be removed by surgery. Camonsertib is taken by mouth once a day on the day of and the day after each radiation treatment, and radiation is given in 4 or 5 sessions, twice a week, over about 3 weeks. The study measures safety, side effects, and the best dose, and it is a Phase I trial.
NCT07156227.summary_es: Este estudio de fase I evalúa camonsertib, un medicamento también llamado inhibidor de ATR, combinado con radioterapia corporal estereotáctica para el carcinoma de células escamosas de cabeza y cuello que ha regresado o que no puede extirparse con cirugía. El camonsertib se toma por vía oral una vez al día, el día del tratamiento de radiación y el día siguiente, y la radiación se administra en 4 o 5 sesiones, dos veces por semana, durante unas 3 semanas. El estudio mide la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la dosis más adecuada, y es un estudio de fase I.
who_for: Recurrent or unresectable head and neck squamous cell carcinoma of the oral cavity, oropharynx, larynx, hypopharynx, or paranasal sinus, or neck nodes with unkn
Recurrence within a previously irradiated area that received 30 to 80 Gy.
Radiation to the head and neck completed at least 6 months before enrollment.
At least one measurable lesion per RECIST version 1.1.
Age 18 or older, ECOG performance status 2 or better, and adequate blood counts and organ function.
not_for: Distant metastatic disease.
More than one prior course of head and neck radiation overlapping the treated region.
Disease surrounding more than 180 degrees of the carotid artery.
Tumor invading the mandible or causing gross skin ulceration.
Pregnancy or breastfeeding.
cancer_types: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma

NCT05613413.summary_en: This study tests cabozantinib plus pembrolizumab as maintenance (ongoing) treatment for metastatic squamous non-small cell lung cancer in people whose disease was controlled after four cycles of induction treatment. Cabozantinib is taken by mouth at 40 mg daily on days 1-21 of each 21-day cycle, and pembrolizumab is given as a 200 mg IV infusion on day 1 of each cycle; the total duration is not stated. The study is a Phase II trial that assesses efficacy, safety, and health-related quality of life.
NCT05613413.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa cabozantinib más pembrolizumab como tratamiento de mantenimiento (continuación) para el cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas de tipo escamoso metastásico, en personas cuya enfermedad se controló después de cuatro ciclos de tratamiento de inducción. El cabozantinib se toma por vía oral a 40 mg diarios en los días 1 a 21 de cada ciclo de 21 días, y el pembrolizumab se administra como infusión intravenosa de 200 mg el día 1 de cada ciclo; la duración total no se indica. El estudio es de Fase II y evalúa la eficacia, la seguridad y la calidad de vida relacionada con la salud.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with stage IV squamous non-small cell lung cancer
No prior treatment for stage IV lung cancer, apart from induction therapy in this study
Complete response, partial response, or stable disease after induction therapy
ECOG performance status of 0, 1, or 2
Tumor tested for PD-L1 expression and adequate organ function
not_for: Prior treatment with cabozantinib
Targetable genomic changes with an FDA-approved targeted therapy available
Central cavitating lung lesions or known endotracheal or endobronchial disease
Known brain metastases or cranial epidural disease not adequately treated and stable
Clinically significant bleeding within 12 weeks before first dose

NCT04802603.summary_en: This study tests a spine stereotactic body radiotherapy regimen for localized metastases to the spinal column from solid tumors. Patients receive 40 Gy in 5 fractions (5 treatments), with cohort 2 patients who had prior spine radiotherapy receiving a risk-adapted spinal cord dose based on that earlier treatment; the total treatment period is not stated. The study aims to measure feasibility and tolerability, and the record does not name a primary outcome measure; the phase is not applicable.
NCT04802603.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa un régimen de radioterapia corporal estereotáctica de columna para metástasis localizadas en la columna vertebral originadas en tumores sólidos. Los pacientes reciben 40 Gy en 5 fracciones (5 tratamientos), y los pacientes del grupo 2 que recibieron radioterapia previa en la columna reciben una dosis de médula espinal ajustada al riesgo según ese tratamiento previo; el periodo total de tratamiento no se indica. El estudio busca medir la factibilidad y la tolerabilidad, y el registro no nombra una medida de resultado principal; la fase no aplica.
who_for: Zubrod performance status 0 to 2.
Localized spine metastasis from a solid tumor, from C1 to L5, with limits on number of sites.
Pain score of 5 or higher at the treated site when not taking pain medication.
Cohort 2: prior spine radiotherapy, with at least 6 months since re-irradiation.
Age 18 years or older.
not_for: Radiosensitive cancers: myeloma, lymphoma, germ cell tumors, or small cell lung cancer.
Non-ambulatory patients.
Over 50% loss of vertebral body height or spinal instability from pathologic compression fracture.
Frank spinal cord compression, cord displacement, or epidural extension within 2 mm of the cord.
Rapid neurologic decline, spine MRI contraindicated, or pregnancy.

NCT06109870.summary_en: This study tests a community-based strategy called PRECEDE-PROCEED, which offers self-sampling for HPV testing to help women get cervical cancer screening. The intervention is behavioral, and how it is given, how long it lasts, and how often are not stated. The study looks at the feasibility of this approach and at factors that may influence women's decisions to join self-sample HPV testing and follow-up.
NCT06109870.summary_es: Este estudio prueba una estrategia comunitaria llamada PRECEDE-PROCEED, que ofrece la autotoma para la prueba de VPH y así ayudar a las mujeres a hacerse el tamizaje de cáncer cervical. La intervención es conductual, y no se indica cómo se administra, cuánto dura ni con qué frecuencia. El estudio evalúa la viabilidad de este enfoque y los factores que podrían influir en la decisión de las mujeres de participar en la autotoma para la prueba de VPH y en su seguimiento.
who_for: Women age 25 or older who live in the RGV or another low-resource Texas community.
Willing to follow all study procedures and sign the consent form.
Have not had a hysterectomy that removed the cervix.
No history of cervical cancer or high-grade dysplasia.
No Pap test in the past 3.5 years, or no Pap/HPV co-test in the past 5.5 years.
not_for: Cannot communicate in English or Spanish.
No valid telephone contact information.
Currently pregnant.

NCT07422480.summary_en: This study compares elritercept with epoetin alfa to treat anemia in adults with lower-risk myelodysplastic syndrome who need regular red blood cell transfusions. Elritercept is given as a subcutaneous injection starting at 3.75 mg/kg once every 4 weeks, with a possible increase to 5.0 mg/kg, while epoetin alfa is given as a subcutaneous injection starting at 450 IU/kg once weekly, with a possible increase up to 1050 IU/kg (maximum 80,000 IU). The main aim is to measure how much elritercept reduces the need for red blood cell transfusions and raises hemoglobin levels, and this is a Phase 3 study.
NCT07422480.summary_es: Este estudio compara elritercept con epoetina alfa para tratar la anemia en adultos con síndrome mielodisplásico de bajo riesgo que necesitan transfusiones regulares de glóbulos rojos. El elritercept se administra como inyección subcutánea a partir de 3,75 mg/kg una vez cada 4 semanas, con posible aumento a 5,0 mg/kg, mientras que la epoetina alfa se administra como inyección subcutánea a partir de 450 UI/kg una vez por semana, con posible aumento hasta 1050 UI/kg (máximo 80 000 UI). El objetivo principal es medir cuánto reduce el elritercept la necesidad de transfusiones de glóbulos rojos y cuánto eleva los niveles de hemoglobina, y este es un estudio de Fase 3.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with lower-risk myelodysplastic syndrome (very low, low, or intermediate IPSS-R risk).
Needs 2 to 6 red blood cell transfusions over at least 8 weeks before randomization.
Hemoglobin below 11.0 g/dL before randomization.
ECOG performance score of 0, 1, or 2.
Has not had prior epoetin alfa or darbepoetin, or only within the limits the protocol allows.
not_for: Myelodysplastic syndrome with del(5q), unclassifiable, or secondary myelodysplastic syndrome.
Known history of acute myeloid leukemia.
Anemia from other known causes, such as thalassemia or hemolytic anemia.
Significant heart disease, recent clotting event, or ejection fraction below 35%.
Other cancer within the past 3 years, apart from the exceptions listed in the criteria.

NCT06386146.summary_en: This study tests JAB-30355, a drug taken by mouth, in adults with advanced solid tumors that have a TP53 Y220C mutation. It is taken orally; how long or how often it is taken is not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, how the drug moves through the body, and early signs of antitumor activity; it is a Phase 1/2a study.
NCT06386146.summary_es: Este estudio prueba JAB-30355, un medicamento que se toma por vía oral, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados que tienen una mutación TP53 Y220C. Se toma por vía oral; no se indica cuánto tiempo ni con qué frecuencia se toma. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, cómo se mueve el medicamento por el cuerpo y las primeras señales de actividad antitumoral; es un estudio de Fase 1/2a.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with advanced solid tumors.
Confirmed TP53 Y220C mutation.
Received at least one line of systemic therapy for their tumor type and stage.
At least one measurable lesion per RECIST v1.1, and ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
Adequate blood, kidney, liver and clotting function, and able to swallow and retain oral medicine.
not_for: Active brain or spinal metastases, or a primary brain or spinal cord tumor.
Active infection needing systemic treatment within 7 days.
Active hepatitis B or hepatitis C.
Any severe or uncontrolled medical condition.
LVEF 50% or lower, or QTcF above 470 msec.

NCT07541079.summary_en: This study is testing giredestrant, a pill, in people with estrogen receptor positive, HER2 negative early breast cancer who could not tolerate prior aromatase inhibitor treatment. Giredestrant is taken by mouth at 30 mg once daily on days 1 to 28 of each 28-day cycle, for up to 4.5 years or until disease recurrence or unacceptable toxicity, whichever comes first. The study looks at treatment adherence, tolerability, and patient-reported outcomes, and it is a Phase IIIb, single-arm, open-label study.
NCT07541079.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa giredestrant, una píldora, en personas con cáncer de mama temprano positivo para receptor de estrógeno y negativo para HER2 que no toleraron un tratamiento previo con inhibidores de la aromatasa. El giredestrant se toma por vía oral a 30 mg una vez al día, los días 1 al 28 de cada ciclo de 28 días, durante hasta 4.5 años o hasta que ocurra una recurrencia de la enfermedad o toxicidad inaceptable, lo que ocurra primero. El estudio analiza la adherencia al tratamiento, la tolerabilidad y los resultados reportados por los pacientes, y es un estudio de Fase IIIb, de un solo brazo y abierto.
who_for: Postmenopausal women with ER-positive, HER2-negative early breast cancer, stage I to III.
Prior adjuvant aromatase inhibitor use for at least 6 months, including 3 consecutive months before consent.
Participant and investigator agree current aromatase inhibitor symptoms are intolerable and warrant a switch.
Grade 2 or 3 adverse events judged by the investigator to be linked to aromatase inhibitor intolerance.
ECOG performance status 0 or 1.
not_for: Prior fulvestrant or any oral selective estrogen receptor degrader (SERD).
Rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, or other inflammatory connective tissue disease.
Active cardiac disease or history of cardiac dysfunction.
Child-Pugh Class B or C liver disease, active viral hepatitis, current alcohol abuse, or cirrhosis.
Strong CYP3A inhibitors or inducers within 14 days or 5 drug elimination half-lives before study treatment.

NCT06465069.summary_en: The study tests LY4052031, an antibody-drug conjugate targeting Nectin-4, in people with advanced or metastatic urothelial cancer or other solid tumors. It is given intravenously (into a vein), and some arms also receive pembrolizumab by the same route; the study lasts up to about 4 years, and how often doses are given is not stated. The study looks at whether the drug is safe, tolerable and effective, the main outcome measure is not stated in the record, and it is a Phase 1 study.
NCT06465069.summary_es: El estudio evalúa LY4052031, un conjugado anticuerpo-fármaco dirigido a Nectin-4, en personas con cáncer urotelial avanzado o metastásico u otros tumores sólidos. El medicamento se administra por vía intravenosa, y algunos grupos también reciben pembrolizumab por la misma vía; el estudio dura hasta aproximadamente 4 años, y la frecuencia de las dosis no está indicada. El estudio busca saber si el fármaco es seguro, tolerable y eficaz; la medida de resultado principal no está indicada en el registro, y es un estudio de fase 1.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with one of the listed advanced or metastatic solid tumors.
Prior treatment rules differ by group; some need prior standard therapy, and one group must be treatment-naive for urothelial cancer.
Measurable disease required under RECIST 1.1 criteria.
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
Adequate archival tumor tissue or a screening biopsy if allowed.
not_for: Known or suspected uncontrolled brain metastases.
Uncontrolled hypercalcemia or uncontrolled diabetes.
Corneal keratopathy, keratitis, or history of corneal transplant.
Serious unresolved toxicity from prior therapy, significant cardiovascular disease, or recent thromboembolic event or bleeding disorder.
QTcF of 470 ms or higher, history of pneumonitis or interstitial lung disease, or pregnancy or breastfeeding.
cancer_types: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma

NCT07518186.summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares JNJ-79635322 with teclistamab in adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma who have had 1 to 3 prior lines of therapy, including an anti-CD38 antibody and lenalidomide. Both drugs are given as subcutaneous injections; JNJ-79635322 is given for a finite duration or until intolerable toxicity, whichever comes first, and teclistamab is given until progressive disease or intolerable toxicity. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record; the study is Phase 3.
NCT07518186.summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 3 compara JNJ-79635322 con teclistamab en adultos con mieloma múltiple recidivante o refractario que han recibido de 1 a 3 líneas previas de tratamiento, incluido un anticuerpo anti-CD38 y lenalidomida. Ambos medicamentos se administran como inyecciones subcutáneas; JNJ-79635322 se administra por una duración finita o hasta toxicidad intolerable, lo que ocurra primero, y teclistamab se administra hasta progresión de la enfermedad o toxicidad intolerable. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de Fase 3.
who_for: Diagnosed with multiple myeloma by IMWG criteria, with measurable disease at screening
Received 1 to 3 prior antimyeloma therapy lines, including an anti-CD38 antibody and lenalidomide
ECOG performance status of 0 to 2 at screening and before the first dose
Clinical laboratory values meeting protocol criteria during screening and within 1 day of treatment start
not_for: Major surgery or significant traumatic injury within 2 weeks before first dose, or planned surgery during the study
Allergy or hypersensitivity to JNJ-79635322, teclistamab, or their excipients
Ongoing myelodysplastic syndrome or a B-cell malignancy other than myeloma
Other malignancy at high risk of recurrence needing systemic therapy, or other active malignancy in the last 24 months
Known active or prior central nervous system involvement or signs of meningeal myeloma

NCT06834373.summary_en: This phase 2 study tests golcadomide with rituximab as bridging treatment before CAR T-cell therapy in adults with relapsed or refractory aggressive B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. Golcadomide is taken by mouth once daily on days 1 to 14 of each cycle, and rituximab is given by vein on days 1, 8, 15 and 22 of cycle 1 and then on day 1 of later cycles; the total duration is not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record.
NCT06834373.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa golcadomida con rituximab como tratamiento puente antes de la terapia con células T CAR en adultos con linfoma no Hodgkin de células B agresivo que recayó o no respondió al tratamiento previo. La golcadomida se toma por vía oral una vez al día en los días 1 a 14 de cada ciclo, y el rituximab se administra por vena en los días 1, 8, 15 y 22 del ciclo 1 y luego el día 1 de los ciclos siguientes; la duración total no se indica. El resultado principal que mide el estudio no se indica en el registro.
who_for: Age 18 years or older
Relapsed, progressive or refractory aggressive B-cell lymphoma after one or two prior lines of standard therapy
Measurable disease on PET-CT, with a lesion larger than 1.5 cm
Potentially eligible for CAR T-cell therapy as judged by the treating physician
ECOG performance status 0, 1 or 2
not_for: Pregnant or nursing persons
Persons of childbearing potential not using adequate contraception
Richter transformation
Prior CAR T or other T-cell targeting therapy within 4 weeks
Life expectancy under 3 months

NCT06561386.summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares nivolumab and relatlimab given with chemotherapy against pembrolizumab given with chemotherapy as first-line treatment for stage IV or recurrent non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer with PD-L1 expression of 1% or more. The record says the drugs are given at specified doses on specified days, but the exact schedule and duration are not stated. The main outcome is not stated; the record says the study aims to compare efficacy between the two treatment groups.
NCT06561386.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 compara nivolumab y relatlimab administrados con quimioterapia contra pembrolizumab administrado con quimioterapia, como tratamiento de primera línea para cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas no escamoso en estadio IV o recurrente, con expresión de PD-L1 de 1% o más. El registro indica que los medicamentos se dan en dosis específicas en días específicos, pero el horario exacto y la duración no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica; el registro señala que el estudio busca comparar la eficacia entre los dos grupos de tratamiento.
who_for: Stage IV or recurrent non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer.
No prior systemic therapy for advanced or metastatic disease as primary treatment.
PD-L1 tumor cell score of 1% or more on central laboratory testing.
Measurable disease on CT or MRI per RECIST v1.1.
ECOG performance status of 1 or less and life expectancy of at least 3 months.
not_for: Pregnant or breastfeeding.
EGFR, ALK, or ROS1 mutations sensitive to available targeted inhibitors, or unknown status for these.
Known sensitive BRAF V600E, activating RET mutation, or NTRK fusion; unknown BRAF, RET, or NTRK status does not exclude.
Untreated brain metastases or leptomeningeal metastases.
Prior anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, anti-PD-L2, or anti-CTLA-4 therapy, with some adjuvant or neoadjuvant exceptions.

NCT05795101.summary_en: This study tests trastuzumab deruxtecan given together with durvalumab before surgery in people with stage III inflammatory breast cancer that is HER2-positive or HER2-low. Both drugs are given by IV once every 21-day cycle, for up to eight cycles, before surgery. The record does not state a main outcome measure; it is a Phase II study.
NCT05795101.summary_es: Este estudio prueba trastuzumab deruxtecan junto con durvalumab antes de la cirugía en personas con cáncer de mama inflamatorio en etapa III que es HER2 positivo o HER2 bajo. Ambos medicamentos se administran por vía intravenosa una vez en cada ciclo de 21 días, hasta ocho ciclos, antes de la cirugía. El registro no indica un resultado principal; es un estudio de Fase II.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with stage III inflammatory breast cancer diagnosed within the past 6 months.
Tumor is HER2-positive or HER2-low, as defined in the record.
No prior systemic treatment for this inflammatory breast cancer diagnosis.
ECOG performance status 0 to 1 and life expectancy of at least 12 weeks.
Willing to undergo two research tumor biopsies and sign informed consent.
not_for: Prior chemotherapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapy, radiotherapy, or surgery for this cancer.
Active or prior autoimmune or inflammatory disorders, with limited listed exceptions.
Current or past non-infectious lung inflammation (ILD/pneumonitis) needing steroids, or suspected ILD not ruled out.
QTc interval above 470 msec or other factors raising arrhythmia risk.
Active infection, including tuberculosis, or hepatitis B or C, under the rules stated in the record.

NCT04523857.summary_en: This Phase 2 trial tests abemaciclib, with or without hydroxychloroquine, to target disseminated tumor cells in the bone marrow of people with breast cancer. Both drugs are taken as pills twice a day; abemaciclib is 150 mg twice daily in one arm and 100 or 150 mg twice daily in the other, and the length of treatment is not stated. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is a Phase 2 pilot trial.
NCT04523857.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 2 evalúa abemaciclib, con o sin hidroxicloroquina, para atacar las células tumorales diseminadas en la médula ósea de personas con cáncer de mama. Ambos medicamentos se toman como pastillas dos veces al día; el abemaciclib es de 150 mg dos veces al día en un grupo y de 100 o 150 mg dos veces al día en el otro, y la duración del tratamiento no se indica. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es un ensayo piloto de fase 2.
who_for: Invasive primary breast cancer diagnosed within 5 years of entry into companion protocol UPCC 28115.
Meets a listed high-risk criterion based on lymph nodes, receptor status, or residual disease after treatment.
Completed primary therapy at least 4 weeks before study entry, with side effects resolved or improving.
Bone marrow test shows detectable disseminated tumor cells.
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status of 2 or less.
not_for: Enrolled in another investigational therapy or trial within 30 days or 5 half-lives.
Prior abemaciclib, or a CDK4/6 inhibitor stopped less than 6 months before screening.
Known hypersensitivity to hydroxychloroquine or its derivatives.
Currently taking tamoxifen, or major surgery within 14 days before randomization.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or of reproductive potential without effective birth control.

NCT03907475.summary_en: This Phase 2 trial tests durvalumab given with chemotherapy in patients with locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors. Durvalumab is given into a vein with one of several chemotherapy drugs, in cycles of 21 or 28 days that repeat while the disease does not progress and side effects are not unacceptable. The official title says the study evaluates safety and pharmacodynamics, and a primary outcome measure is not stated.
NCT03907475.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 2 evalúa durvalumab administrado junto con quimioterapia en pacientes con tumores sólidos localmente avanzados o metastásicos. Durvalumab se administra por vena junto con uno de varios medicamentos de quimioterapia, en ciclos de 21 o 28 días que se repiten mientras la enfermedad no progrese y los efectos secundarios no sean inaceptables. El título oficial indica que el estudio evalúa la seguridad y la farmacodinamia, y no se indica una medida de resultado principal.
who_for: Metastatic or locally advanced solid tumor that progressed after at least one line of standard therapy.
Tumor that can be biopsied, and willingness to undergo a biopsy.
Measurable disease on imaging scan.
Age 18 or older, with ECOG performance status of 2 or less.
Adequate blood counts, liver function and kidney function, as defined in the criteria.
not_for: Prior checkpoint inhibitor stopped because of a serious adverse event.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women.
Currently receiving other investigational agents.
Pancreatic, prostate, or MSS colorectal cancer: durvalumab alone is not given, but chemotherapy combinations are allowed.

NCT06194929.summary_en: The study tests defactinib and avutometinib, with or without encorafenib, in people with cutaneous melanoma that has spread to the brain. Defactinib and avutometinib are taken by mouth in 28-day cycles, with 3 weeks of dosing followed by 1 week of rest; avutometinib is 3.2 mg twice a week and defactinib is 200 mg twice a day, while encorafenib is taken by mouth daily in a dose-finding part of the study. The study measures preliminary response rate and safety and tolerability, and it is a Phase 1b/2 trial.
NCT06194929.summary_es: El estudio evalúa defactinib y avutometinib, con o sin encorafenib, en personas con melanoma cutáneo que se ha extendido al cerebro. Defactinib y avutometinib se toman por vía oral en ciclos de 28 días, con 3 semanas de tratamiento seguidas de 1 semana de descanso; avutometinib es de 3.2 mg dos veces por semana y defactinib es de 200 mg dos veces al día, mientras que encorafenib se toma por vía oral todos los días en una parte del estudio para definir la dosis. El estudio mide la tasa de respuesta preliminar y la seguridad y tolerabilidad, y es un ensayo de Fase 1b/2.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with melanoma that has spread to the brain.
At least one brain metastasis that has not been treated, sized 0.5 cm to 4 cm on MRI.
Tumor with a known RAS, BRAF, or NF1 mutation, or triple wild-type status.
Received at least one prior line of immunotherapy.
ECOG performance status 0 or 1, or Karnofsky score 70 or higher.
not_for: Uveal or mucosal melanoma.
Current or past leptomeningeal metastases.
Symptomatic brain metastasis with neurologic symptoms of grade 2 or higher.
History of interstitial lung disease or certain other lung conditions.
Uncontrolled or severe heart disease, or blood pressure above 160/100 despite treatment.

NCT07808151.summary_en: This Phase 2 trial tests two dose schedules of porustobart given with pembrolizumab before surgery in adults with resectable pMMR/MSS colon cancer. Both groups receive pembrolizumab by vein on Day 1 and Day 22, and porustobart is given by vein on Day 1 only in one group or on Day 1 and Day 22 in the other, with surgery 6 to 9 weeks after starting treatment. The study measures how well the medicines destroy the cancer before surgery and what side effects occur.
NCT07808151.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 2 evalúa dos esquemas de dosis de porustobart administrados junto con pembrolizumab antes de la cirugía en adultos con cáncer de colon pMMR/MSS resecable. Ambos grupos reciben pembrolizumab por vena el Día 1 y el Día 22; el porustobart se administra por vena solo el Día 1 en un grupo, o el Día 1 y el Día 22 en el otro, y la cirugía se realiza entre 6 y 9 semanas después de iniciar el tratamiento. El estudio mide qué tan bien los medicamentos destruyen el cáncer antes de la cirugía y qué efectos secundarios ocurren.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older at the time of consent.
Colon adenocarcinoma with pMMR/MSS status.
T3 or T4 tumor, any node status, no distant spread (M0), and disease that can be surgically removed.
ECOG performance status 0 to 1.
Adequate tumor tissue sample with pathology report, and adequate blood, liver and kidney function.
not_for: Investigational agent taken within 3 weeks of the first dose.
Imminent or urgent need for surgery.
Prior treatment with a CTLA-4, PD-1, or PD-L1 immune checkpoint inhibitor.
Systemic corticosteroid or immunosuppressive therapy within 1 week of first dose (some exceptions apply).
Interstitial lung disease, pneumonitis needing corticosteroids, or severe hypersensitivity to a fully human antibody.

NCT03701581.summary_en: This Phase 2/3 study tests 4-aminopyridine, given as FDA-approved 10 mg dalfampridine tablets, in men with prostate cancer who are having surgery to remove the prostate. The tablets are taken by mouth daily, starting the day after surgery and continuing for 2 months (60 days), with no more than 2 tablets in 24 hours, and a placebo look-alike is used for comparison. The record does not state a main outcome measure; the study aims to test whether 4-aminopyridine speeds recovery from nerve injury after the surgery.
NCT03701581.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2/3 evalúa la 4-aminopiridina, administrada como tabletas de dalfampridina de 10 mg aprobadas por la FDA, en hombres con cáncer de próstata que se someterán a la cirugía para extirpar la próstata. Las tabletas se toman por vía oral todos los días, comenzando el día después de la cirugía y continuando durante 2 meses (60 días), sin más de 2 tabletas en 24 horas, y se usa un placebo de apariencia similar para la comparación. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; el estudio busca comprobar si la 4-aminopiridina acelera la recuperación de la lesión nerviosa después de la cirugía.
who_for: Men with organ-confined, non-metastatic prostate cancer (cT1c-T2c) planning robotic bilateral nerve-sparing prostatectomy
PSA under 15 ng/mL within the last 12 months, with no adjuvant therapy expected after surgery
Age 45 to 75 years
IIEF-5 score of 17 or higher at screening, with regular sexual activity in the prior 6 months and 12 weeks
Willing to avoid erectile dysfunction treatments until 3 months after surgery and able to give informed consent
not_for: Planned adjuvant therapy based on stage T3 or higher, positive lymph nodes, or positive surgical margins
Neoadjuvant therapy before prostatectomy, or recurrent prostate cancer
History of seizures, multiple sclerosis, stroke, or other diagnosed neurological disorder
Penile surgery other than circumcision or endoscopic urethral stricture surgery, or hypersensitivity to 4-AP
Renal impairment (calculated GFR under 60 mL/min) or use of other aminopyridine medications

NCT05332002.summary_en: This phase 2 study tests sFOLFOXIRI, an alternating schedule of FOLFOX and FOLFIRI chemotherapy, with or without nivolumab, in people with HER2-negative advanced gastric or esophageal cancer. Treatment is given into a vein in 28-day cycles, alternating mFOLFOX6 and FOLFIRI with doses on days 1 and 15 of each cycle; optional nivolumab is 240 mg every 2 weeks, and the total study length is not stated. The main outcome measured is objective response rate (ORR); the study also looks at progression-free survival, overall survival, and side effects.
NCT05332002.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa sFOLFOXIRI, un esquema alterno de quimioterapia FOLFOX y FOLFIRI, con o sin nivolumab, en personas con cáncer avanzado de estómago o esófago HER2 negativo. El tratamiento se administra por vena en ciclos de 28 días, alternando mFOLFOX6 y FOLFIRI con dosis los días 1 y 15 de cada ciclo; el nivolumab opcional es de 240 mg cada 2 semanas, y la duración total del estudio no se indica. El resultado principal que se mide es la tasa de respuesta objetiva (ORR); el estudio también evalúa la supervivencia libre de progresión, la supervivencia global y los efectos secundarios.
who_for: Adenocarcinoma of the esophagus, gastroesophageal junction, or stomach that is metastatic or unresectable, confirmed by tissue or cell testing
HER2 negative tumor by standard local testing
ECOG performance status of 0 to 2
Measurable disease by RECIST v1.1
No prior systemic therapy for this cancer in the metastatic setting; up to two prior mFOLFOX6 cycles allowed
not_for: Known brain metastases that are untreated
Grade 2 or greater peripheral neuropathy
Another active cancer within the past three years that could affect therapy or imaging
Active systemic corticosteroid use of 10 mg/day prednisone equivalent or more, for those receiving nivolumab
Active autoimmune disease, history of interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis, or prior organ or bone marrow transplant, for those receiving nivolumab

NCT06965114.summary_en: This Phase 1/Phase 2 study tests tovorafenib with rituximab in classical hairy cell leukemia that has come back or did not respond to prior treatment. It also compares this combination with cladribine plus rituximab in patients who have not had treatment yet. Tovorafenib is taken by mouth and rituximab is given through a vein, with weekly dosing for up to 16 weeks in one arm and 28-day cycles for up to 4 cycles in another, while the cladribine arm uses 28-day cycles for up to 3 cycles. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record; the study is described as testing safety, side effects, and effectiveness, and is listed as Phase 1/Phase 2.
NCT06965114.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/fase 2 evalúa tovorafenib con rituximab en leucemia de células pilosas clásica que volvió a aparecer o que no respondió a tratamientos previos. También compara esta combinación con cladribina más rituximab en pacientes que aún no han recibido tratamiento. El tovorafenib se toma por vía oral y el rituximab se administra por vena, con dosis semanales durante hasta 16 semanas en un brazo y ciclos de 28 días por hasta 4 ciclos en otro, mientras que el brazo de cladribina usa ciclos de 28 días por hasta 3 ciclos. La medida principal de resultado no se indica en el registro; el estudio se describe como una prueba de seguridad, efectos secundarios y efectividad, y figura como fase 1/fase 2.
who_for: Classical hairy cell leukemia with a confirmed BRAF V600E mutation.
Age 18 years or older.
Phase 1: prior purine nucleoside analog treatment, unless contraindicated; prior vemurafenib alone is allowed in the relapsed or refractory group.
Phase 2: no prior hairy cell leukemia treatment for the front-line group.
Meets stated criteria for needing treatment, such as low neutrophils, low platelets, or low hemoglobin.
not_for: BRAF V600E mutation negative or variant hairy cell leukemia.
Platelets below 50,000/mcL.
Taking warfarin or direct oral anticoagulants.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or unwilling to use adequate contraception.
Prior allergic reaction to similar compounds or severe infusion reaction to rituximab.

NCT06465316.summary_en: This phase 1b study tests the safety, side effects, and best dose of iberdomide given with teclistamab for multiple myeloma that has come back or does not respond to treatment (relapsed or refractory). Teclistamab is given under the skin, and iberdomide is taken by mouth daily on days 1 to 21 starting in cycle 2; cycles repeat every 28 days for up to 4 years if the disease does not progress and side effects are acceptable. The study measures safety, side effects, and the best dose, as stated in the brief summary; the primary outcome measure is not stated.
NCT06465316.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1b evalúa la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la mejor dosis de iberdomida administrada junto con teclistamab para el mieloma múltiple que ha recidivado o que no responde al tratamiento (recidivante o refractario). Teclistamab se aplica debajo de la piel, e iberdomida se toma por vía oral a diario los días 1 al 21 a partir del ciclo 2; los ciclos se repiten cada 28 días durante hasta 4 años si la enfermedad no progresa y los efectos secundarios son aceptables. El estudio mide la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la mejor dosis, según indica el resumen breve; la medida de resultado principal no se indica.
who_for: Multiple myeloma that has come back or does not respond to treatment.
Disease got worse after at least 4 prior treatment lines, including a proteasome inhibitor, an immunomodulatory drug, and an anti-CD38 antibody.
Measurable disease by serum or urine M-protein or free light chain levels.
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status of 2 or better.
Blood counts, liver tests, and kidney function within the required ranges.
not_for: Active plasma cell leukemia, AL amyloidosis, POEMS syndrome, or Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia.
Prior anti-BCMA directed bispecific antibody therapy.
Prior treatment with a cereblon E3 ligase modulator.
Prior allogeneic stem cell transplant.
Live vaccine within 30 days, or unresolved toxicity grade 2 or higher from prior treatment.

NCT07020221.summary_en: This study tests VS-7375, an oral KRAS G12D (ON/OFF) inhibitor, alone and in combination with other drugs, in adults with advanced solid tumors that have a KRAS G12D mutation, including pancreatic, lung, and colorectal cancer.
