Los pacientes con prueba de ctDNA negativa no reciben más medicamento del estudio y se hacen pruebas de ctDNA cada 3 meses durante 3 años, mientras que los pacientes con prueba positiva continúan el tratamiento estándar según lo decida su médico; la medida principal de resultado no está indicada.
who_for: Early HER2-positive or triple-negative breast cancer, stage T1-4, N0-2a, M0, with no clinical metastatic disease
Completed pre-surgery treatment and surgery with pathologic complete response (ypT0-Tis, ypN0)
Willing to stop standard adjuvant trastuzumab with or without pertuzumab, or adjuvant pembrolizumab
Adequate archival tumor tissue from the core diagnostic biopsy
Age 18 or older, ECOG performance status 2 or better
not_for: Clinical node stage cN2b or cN3
Cancer other than breast cancer in the past 5 years, with listed exceptions
Known cancer metastases from any site
Receiving other investigational anti-cancer agents
Received 4 or more cycles of standard adjuvant trastuzumab/pertuzumab or pembrolizumab

NCT06529822.summary_en: This phase 1 study tests a personalized cancer vaccine made of synthetic long peptides matched to each patient's cancer neoantigens, given with poly-ICLC. It is studied in muscle-invasive bladder cancer or upper tract urothelial carcinoma, gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma, melanoma, and non-small cell lung cancer, in patients with molecular residual disease. The vaccine is given as intramuscular injections on Days 1, 4, 8, 15, 29, 57, 85, 113, 141, and 169, co-administered with poly-ICLC by a trained healthcare provider. The study is designed to measure safety, feasibility, and immune response (immunogenicity).
NCT06529822.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa una vacuna personalizada contra el cáncer, formada por péptidos sintéticos largos que coinciden con los neoantígenos tumorales de cada paciente, administrada junto con poly-ICLC. Se estudia en cáncer de vejiga músculo-invasivo o carcinoma urotelial del tracto superior, adenocarcinoma gastroesofágico, melanoma y cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas, en pacientes con enfermedad residual molecular. La vacuna se aplica como inyecciones intramusculares en los días 1, 4, 8, 15, 29, 57, 85, 113, 141 y 169, junto con poly-ICLC, administradas por un profesional de salud capacitado. El estudio está diseñado para medir la seguridad, la factibilidad y la respuesta inmunitaria.
who_for: Age 18 or older with ECOG ≤2 (Karnofsky ≥60%)
Muscle-invasive bladder cancer or upper tract urothelial carcinoma with complete surgical resection (Cohort 1)
Stage II or III gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma with complete resection within 3 years (Cohort 2)
Positive ctDNA result by Signatera
No residual disease or metastasis on conventional imaging
not_for: Known allergy or serious reaction to vaccines
Autoimmune disease requiring immunosuppression
Known HIV positivity
Positive hepatitis B surface antigen or hepatitis C with active infection
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or receiving other investigational agents

NCT04878029.summary_en: This Phase I/Ib trial is testing cabozantinib given together with enfortumab vedotin in urothelial cancer that is locally advanced or metastatic. Cabozantinib is taken by mouth once daily on days 1 to 28, and enfortumab vedotin is given by IV on days 1, 8, and 15 of each 28-day cycle, repeated while the disease does not progress and toxicity is not unacceptable. The main outcome measure is not stated; the record says the study seeks the best dose and possible benefits and side effects, and it is a Phase I/Ib study.
NCT04878029.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase I/Ib está probando cabozantinib combinado con enfortumab vedotina en cáncer urotelial localmente avanzado o metastásico. El cabozantinib se toma por vía oral una vez al día los días 1 a 28, y la enfortumab vedotina se administra por vía intravenosa los días 1, 8 y 15 de cada ciclo de 28 días, que se repite mientras la enfermedad no progrese y la toxicidad no sea inaceptable. La medida de resultado principal no está indicada; el registro dice que el estudio busca la mejor dosis y los posibles beneficios y efectos secundarios, y que es un estudio de fase I/Ib.
who_for: Urothelial carcinoma confirmed by tissue examination, metastatic or unresectable locally advanced.
Prior treatment with a PD-1 or PD-L1 checkpoint inhibitor, alone or in combination.
Prior platinum-containing chemotherapy, or not eligible for it at enrollment.
ECOG performance status of 2 or less, age 18 or older, and measurable disease by RECIST 1.1.
not_for: Prior treatment with cabozantinib.
Prior enfortumab vedotin or other MMAE-based antibody-drug conjugate.
Known brain metastases unless adequately treated and stable.
Stroke, heart attack, or blood clot within 6 months, or uncontrolled high blood pressure.
Ongoing sensory or motor neuropathy grade 2 or higher, or pregnancy or breastfeeding.
cancer_types: bladder urothelial carcinoma with squamous differentiation

NCT07222267.summary_en: This Phase 1 study is testing BG-75202, a KAT6A/B inhibitor, alone and with other cancer medicines, in adults with advanced solid tumors, including breast cancer. BG-75202 is taken by mouth, and the other drugs in the combinations are given by mouth or by injection; how long or how often is not stated. The study evaluates safety, tolerability, how the drug moves through and acts in the body, and early signs of antitumor activity.
NCT07222267.summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 evalúa BG-75202, un inhibidor de KAT6A/B, solo y junto con otros medicamentos contra el cáncer, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados, incluido el cáncer de mama. BG-75202 se toma por vía oral, y los otros medicamentos de las combinaciones se administran por vía oral o inyectable; la duración o la frecuencia no se indican. El estudio evalúa la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, cómo el medicamento se distribuye y actúa en el organismo, y las señales tempranas de actividad antitumoral.
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older with advanced or metastatic breast cancer or other advanced solid tumors
Breast cancer with 1 to 3 prior lines of treatment in the metastatic setting, with limits on prior chemotherapy
Some cohorts: no prior CDK4/6 inhibitor and no prior systemic treatment for advanced disease, in regions where CDK4/6 inhibitors are not available first-line
Women with metastatic breast cancer must be postmenopausal or receiving ovarian function suppression
Measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 and ECOG performance status of 0 or 1
not_for: Prior exposure to KAT6A/B or KAT7 inhibitors or degraders
Active leptomeningeal disease
Uncontrolled, untreated brain metastases
Any other malignancy within 3 years before screening, with listed exceptions
Other protocol-defined exclusion criteria may apply

NCT06072612.summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares the Bria-IMT regimen plus the checkpoint inhibitor retifanlimab with physician's choice chemotherapy in advanced metastatic breast cancer. Bria-IMT includes a single intravenous dose of cyclophosphamide 2 to 3 days before four intradermal inoculations of the experimental SV-BR-1-GM product, with interferon at each site, and retifanlimab is given by infusion; cycle length and total number of cycles are not stated. The main outcome measured is overall survival.
NCT06072612.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 compara el régimen Bria-IMT más el inhibidor de punto de control retifanlimab con quimioterapia elegida por el médico en cáncer de mama metastásico avanzado. Bria-IMT incluye una dosis intravenosa única de ciclofosfamida 2 a 3 días antes de cuatro inoculaciones intradérmicas del producto experimental SV-BR-1-GM, con interferón en cada sitio, y retifanlimab se administra por infusión; la duración del ciclo y el número total de ciclos no se indican. El resultado principal que se mide es la supervivencia global.
who_for: Adult, at least 18 years old, who signed informed consent.
Breast cancer that is unresectable locally recurrent or metastatic, after failing prior therapy.
Prior treatment requirements depend on HER2, hormone receptor, triple negative, BRCA or HER2-low status.
Brain metastases allowed if clinically stable, without steroids for at least 2 weeks.
Expected survival of at least 4 months and ECOG performance status 0, 1 or 2.
not_for: Chemotherapy, immunotherapy or major surgery within 21 days before the first dose.
Radiotherapy within 14 days before the first dose.
Unresolved toxicity from prior therapy, or grade 3 or higher toxicity from prior checkpoint inhibitor.
Known hypersensitivity to study therapies, beef, or components of SV-BR-1-GM.
Active autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment in the past year, or pregnancy or nursing.

NCT07194044.summary_en: This study tests a staged sequence of chemotherapy drugs in patients with metastatic Ewing sarcoma that has spread widely. Treatment is given in stages over weeks 1 to 38, followed by a maintenance phase of alternating 28-day blocks planned through week 104. Some stages use IV drugs, some use oral drugs, and one stage includes radiation to the primary site; this is a Phase 1 study, the main outcome is not stated, and the record says it is designed to show feasibility.
NCT07194044.summary_es: Este estudio prueba una secuencia por etapas de medicamentos de quimioterapia en pacientes con sarcoma de Ewing metastásico que se ha diseminado ampliamente. El tratamiento se administra en etapas durante las semanas 1 a 38, seguido de una fase de mantenimiento con bloques alternos de 28 días planificados hasta la semana 104. Algunas etapas usan medicamentos intravenosos, otras usan medicamentos orales, y una etapa incluye radiación al sitio primario; este es un estudio de Fase 1, el resultado principal no está indicado y el registro señala que está diseñado para demostrar la viabilidad.
who_for: Age over 1 year, with no upper age limit
New diagnosis of widely metastatic Ewing sarcoma or metastatic CIC-rearranged sarcoma
Enough tumor tissue available for correlative testing
No prior systemic therapy, except possibly one cycle of VDC started before enrollment
Healthy enough to tolerate protocol therapy, in the investigator's opinion
not_for: Localized disease, or lung-only metastases in Ewing sarcoma
Central nervous system tumors, primary or metastatic
Currently receiving other investigational agents for the cancer
Prior cancer treated with myelosuppressive chemotherapy or radiation
Pregnant or breast-feeding, or uncontrolled intercurrent illness

NCT07869836.summary_en: This Phase 3 trial tests T-bren (trastuzumab brengitecan, also listed as BL-M07D1), an antibody drug conjugate, against standard platinum-based chemotherapy. It is for people with HER2-expressing metastatic urothelial (bladder) cancer whose disease progressed on or after anti-PD-(L)1 therapy. T-bren is given into a vein on day 1 of each 21-day cycle at one of two dose levels, while the comparison arm receives gemcitabine on days 1 and 8 plus cisplatin or carboplatin on day 1 of each 21-day cycle; the total duration is not stated. The record does not state a primary outcome; it says the study aims to evaluate the efficacy and safety of T-bren.
NCT07869836.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 3 evalúa T-bren (trastuzumab brengitecan, también listado como BL-M07D1), un conjugado anticuerpo-fármaco, frente a la quimioterapia estándar a base de platino. Está dirigido a personas con cáncer urotelial (de vejiga) metastásico que expresa HER2 y cuya enfermedad progresó durante o después de una terapia anti-PD-(L)1. T-bren se administra por vena el día 1 de cada ciclo de 21 días, en uno de dos niveles de dosis, mientras que el brazo de comparación recibe gemcitabina los días 1 y 8, más cisplatino o carboplatino el día 1 de cada ciclo de 21 días; la duración total no se indica. El registro no indica un desenlace primario; señala que el estudio busca evaluar la eficacia y la seguridad de T-bren.
who_for: Metastatic or surgically unresectable urothelial (transitional cell) cancer, confirmed by tests
Disease progressed during or after anti-PD-(L)1-based therapy
HER2 expression confirmed by central laboratory testing
Eligible to receive gemcitabine with cisplatin or carboplatin
At least one measurable lesion, ECOG performance status 0 to 1, and adequate organ and clotting function
not_for: Prior topoisomerase inhibitor-based antibody drug conjugate therapy
Primary brain or spinal tumors, active or untreated brain metastases, or carcinomatous meningitis
Bladder cancer with small cell histology
Clinically significant bleeding or stomach or intestinal perforation within 6 months of randomization
Active autoimmune or inflammatory disease, or current or steroid-treated interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis

NCT04295863.summary_en: This study compares nivolumab or pembrolizumab given on a standard schedule with the same drugs given on a less frequent extended schedule, in people with locally advanced or metastatic cancer. The drugs are given by IV, nivolumab 240 mg every 2 weeks or 480 mg every 4 weeks (standard) versus 240 mg every 4 weeks or 480 mg every 8 weeks (extended), and pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks or 400 mg every 6 weeks (standard) versus 200 mg every 6 weeks (extended). The study measures drug levels in the blood (pharmacokinetics), and the registry lists the phase as Phase 1.
NCT04295863.summary_es: Este estudio compara nivolumab o pembrolizumab administrados con un esquema estándar frente a los mismos medicamentos administrados con un esquema extendido, con menor frecuencia, en personas con cáncer localmente avanzado o metastásico. Los medicamentos se administran por vía intravenosa: nivolumab 240 mg cada 2 semanas o 480 mg cada 4 semanas (estándar) frente a 240 mg cada 4 semanas o 480 mg cada 8 semanas (extendido), y pembrolizumab 200 mg cada 3 semanas o 400 mg cada 6 semanas (estándar) frente a 200 mg cada 6 semanas (extendido). El estudio mide los niveles del medicamento en la sangre (farmacocinética), y el registro indica que la fase es la Fase 1.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older
Locally advanced or metastatic cancer
A physician has determined the person is a candidate for nivolumab or pembrolizumab
Measurable disease per RECIST criteria
not_for: Previously received an immune checkpoint inhibitor
Previously received an investigational monoclonal antibody therapy
Planned treatment with ipilimumab or another anti-CTLA4 antibody combined with nivolumab or pembrolizumab

NCT04879121.summary_en: This Phase II study tests larotrectinib, a drug taken by mouth, in people aged 16 or older with NTRK gene amplification-positive solid tumors that are locally advanced or metastatic. The study drug is taken twice a day on days 1 to 28 of each 28-day cycle, and cycles repeat in the absence of unacceptable toxicity. The record does not state the main outcome measure; the study is Phase II.
NCT04879121.summary_es: Este estudio de fase II evalúa larotrectinib, un medicamento que se toma por vía oral, en personas de 16 años o más con tumores sólidos localmente avanzados o metastásicos que tienen amplificación del gen NTRK. El medicamento se toma dos veces al día los días 1 a 28 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y los ciclos se repiten si no hay toxicidad inaceptable. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de fase II.
who_for: Age 16 years or older.
Locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor with NTRK1, NTRK2, or NTRK3 gene amplification of at least 7 copies.
Prior standard therapy for the tumor type and stage, or unlikely to tolerate or benefit from standard care.
At least one measurable lesion by RECIST v1.1.
ECOG score of 3 or less, with archived tumor tissue or an attempted biopsy.
not_for: Prior disease progression on an approved or investigational TRK inhibitor.
Symptomatic or unstable brain metastases that need corticosteroids.
Uncontrolled second cancer that would limit assessment of study results.
Uncontrolled infection, unstable heart disease, heart attack or stroke within 3 months.
Pregnancy or lactation, or inability to stop strong CYP450 or CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers.

NCT05501704.summary_en: This study compares different endocrine (hormone-blocking) treatments given before surgery for men with hormone receptor-positive breast cancer. The drugs tested are tamoxifen, anastrozole, degarelix and abemaciclib, given alone or in combination. Tamoxifen and anastrozole are taken by mouth, degarelix is an injection under the skin, and abemaciclib is taken by mouth; some arms last 21 days and others last 4 cycles of 28 days (about 4 months). The record does not state a main outcome measure, so this is a Phase 2 study.
NCT05501704.summary_es: Este estudio compara distintos tratamientos endocrinos (que bloquean las hormonas) administrados antes de la cirugía a hombres con cáncer de mama positivo para receptores hormonales. Los medicamentos evaluados son tamoxifeno, anastrozol, degarelix y abemaciclib, administrados solos o combinados. El tamoxifeno, el anastrozol y el abemaciclib se toman por vía oral, y el degarelix es una inyección debajo de la piel; algunos grupos duran 21 días y otros 4 ciclos de 28 días (unos 4 meses). El registro no indica un resultado principal, y se trata de un estudio de Fase 2.
who_for: Men 18 years or older with invasive breast cancer
Primary tumor and axillary nodes not yet surgically removed
Stage I, II, or III breast cancer
Hormone receptor-positive and HER2-negative breast cancer
ECOG performance status of 2 or less
not_for: Inflammatory breast cancer (T4d)
Prior endocrine, chemotherapy, radiation, or investigational therapy for this breast cancer
Severe heart disease or heart failure (NYHA Class III or higher)
Personal history of certain heart rhythm problems or sudden cardiac arrest
Active systemic bacterial, fungal, or uncontrolled infection

NCT07000084.summary_en: This phase III trial tests adding gemcitabine to BCG given into the bladder, compared with BCG alone, in people with recurrent high grade non-muscle invasive bladder cancer that came back after prior BCG. Gemcitabine is given into the bladder over 1 hour, on weeks 1, 4, 7 and 10, and BCG is given over 2 hours on weeks 2, 3, 6, 8 and 9, with repeat treatment at months 3, 6 and 12 if there is no disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. The record does not state the main outcome measure; the study is phase III.
NCT07000084.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase III evalúa agregar gemcitabina a la BCG administrada en la vejiga, en comparación con la BCG sola, en personas con cáncer de vejiga de alto grado no músculo invasivo que reapareció después de una terapia previa con BCG. La gemcitabina se administra en la vejiga durante 1 hora en las semanas 1, 4, 7 y 10, y la BCG se administra durante 2 horas en las semanas 2, 3, 6, 8 y 9, con repetición del tratamiento en los meses 3, 6 y 12 si no hay progresión de la enfermedad ni toxicidad inaceptable. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de fase III.
who_for: High grade bladder cancer limited to the lining (Ta, T1 or carcinoma in situ), confirmed within 120 days before randomization.
Recurrence within 24 months of prior BCG, without meeting the BCG-unresponsive definition.
Visible papillary tumors removed by TURBT within 90 days of randomization.
Prior BCG exposure is required; prior intravesical chemotherapy or other NMIBC treatments are allowed.
Age 18 years or older.
not_for: Any small cell or large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma component.
BCG-unresponsive bladder cancer, as defined in the record.
Past intolerance to BCG or other intravesical therapy.
Muscle-invasive, locally advanced unresectable, or metastatic urothelial carcinoma on recent imaging.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or of childbearing potential without a pregnancy test within 14 days.

NCT06769126.summary_en: This phase II study tests maintenance treatment with durvalumab, with or without saruparib, ceralasertib, or monalizumab, chosen by biomarker tests, for extensive stage small cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC). Maintenance durvalumab is given by IV over 60 minutes on day 1 of each 28-day cycle, and some arms add saruparib or ceralasertib by mouth or monalizumab by IV, repeating until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. The record does not state the main outcome measure; the study is phase II.
NCT06769126.summary_es: Este estudio de fase II evalúa el tratamiento de mantenimiento con durvalumab, con o sin saruparib, ceralasertib o monalizumab, seleccionado mediante pruebas de biomarcadores, para el cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas en etapa extensa (ES-SCLC). El durvalumab de mantenimiento se administra por vía intravenosa durante 60 minutos el día 1 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y algunos brazos añaden saruparib o ceralasertib por vía oral o monalizumab por vía intravenosa, repitiéndose hasta la progresión de la enfermedad o toxicidad inaceptable. El registro no indica el resultado principal que se mide; el estudio es de fase II.
who_for: Extensive stage small cell lung cancer, not yet treated or after 1 to 3 cycles of platinum and etoposide
Age 18 years or older
Zubrod performance status 0 to 2 within 28 days before registration
Tumor subtype A or N with SLFN11 positive, or subtype P, or subtype I, depending on study arm
Able to safely receive platinum, etoposide, and durvalumab
not_for: Prior or current cancer that the treating doctor feels could interfere with study assessment
History of limited stage small cell lung cancer
Anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1 treatment for SCLC other than durvalumab in frontline therapy
Unresolved toxicity grade 2 or higher from prior anticancer therapy, except alopecia and vitiligo
Pregnant or nursing
cancer_types: extensive stage small cell lung cancer

NCT07409272.summary_en: This study tests setidegrasib (ASP3082) given with mFOLFIRINOX or NALIRIFOX chemotherapy, compared with placebo given with the same chemotherapy, as first-line treatment for adults with metastatic pancreatic cancer that has a KRAS G12D mutation. Setidegrasib or placebo is given once weekly by slow infusion into a vein, and chemotherapy is given on a 28-day cycle, with treatment continuing until the cancer worsens or other stopping reasons apply. The main aim is to learn whether people live longer when given setidegrasib with chemotherapy than when given placebo with chemotherapy. This is a Phase 3 study.
NCT07409272.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa setidegrasib (ASP3082) administrado con quimioterapia mFOLFIRINOX o NALIRIFOX, en comparación con placebo administrado con la misma quimioterapia, como tratamiento de primera línea para adultos con cáncer de páncreas metastásico que tiene una mutación KRAS G12D. Setidegrasib o placebo se administra una vez por semana mediante infusión lenta en una vena, y la quimioterapia se administra en ciclos de 28 días; el tratamiento continúa hasta que el cáncer empeora u ocurre otro motivo para suspenderlo. El objetivo principal es saber si las personas viven más tiempo cuando reciben setidegrasib con quimioterapia que cuando reciben placebo con quimioterapia. Este es un estudio de fase 3.
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older
Metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma with a KRAS G12D mutation
Surgery or radiotherapy cannot cure the cancer
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1
Agrees not to join another interventional study while on study treatment
not_for: Cancer cells spread to the lining of the brain and spinal cord, or symptoms of cancer in the brain or nervous system
Neuroendocrine, acinar, or squamous/adenosquamous pancreatic cancer
Another cancer needing active treatment within the previous 2 years, with limited exceptions
Prior systemic therapy for metastatic disease, or prior KRAS G12D-targeted agent
Corrected QT interval (QTcF) above 470 msec on screening ECG

NCT07121595.summary_en: This Phase 2 pilot study tests personalized radiation to the opposite side of the neck, guided by sentinel lymph node biopsy, in people with oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma. The listed treatments include radiation therapy and the IV drugs carboplatin, cisplatin, and paclitaxel, and the number of doses and how often they are given are not stated. The main outcome is not stated in the record, and the study is a Phase 2 trial.
NCT07121595.summary_es: Este estudio piloto de fase 2 evalúa radioterapia personalizada del lado contralateral del cuello, guiada por biopsia del ganglio centinela, en personas con carcinoma de células escamosas de cavidad oral. Los tratamientos listados incluyen radioterapia y los medicamentos por vía intravenosa carboplatino, cisplatino y paclitaxel, y no se indica el número de dosis ni la frecuencia. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro, y el estudio es un ensayo de fase 2.
who_for: Biopsy-proven squamous cell carcinoma of the oral cavity
Clinical stage cT1-4a N0-2b M0 with documented lateralized primary tumor
ECOG performance status 0-2
Age over 18
Planned surgery with ipsilateral neck dissection and SPECT-CT-guided sentinel node biopsy
not_for: Evidence of distant metastatic disease
Evidence of contralateral neck disease on staging imaging
Prior systemic chemotherapy for this cancer
Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma of the oropharynx, nasopharynx, hypopharynx, or larynx
Currently participating in another investigational therapeutic trial

NCT04267848.summary_en: This Phase III trial tests adding pembrolizumab, an immunotherapy, to usual chemotherapy for non-small cell lung cancer in stage II or III that has been removed by surgery. Patients get one of four platinum-based chemotherapy regimens IV for up to 4 cycles, each 21 days apart, with pembrolizumab IV over 25 to 40 minutes on day 1 of each cycle, followed by pembrolizumab alone every 21 days for 13 cycles or every 6 weeks for 12 cycles for patients enrolled after 10/14/2020. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record; it is a Phase III study.
NCT04267848.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase III evalúa agregar pembrolizumab, una inmunoterapia, a la quimioterapia habitual para el cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas en etapa II o III que fue extirpado por cirugía. Los pacientes reciben uno de cuatro regímenes de quimioterapia a base de platino por vena (IV) durante hasta 4 ciclos, cada 21 días, con pembrolizumab IV durante 25 a 40 minutos el día 1 de cada ciclo, seguido de pembrolizumab solo cada 21 días por 13 ciclos o cada 6 semanas por 12 ciclos para los pacientes inscritos después del 14/10/2020. La medida de resultado principal no se indica en el registro; es un estudio de fase III.
who_for: Lung cancer completely removed by surgery, stage IIA, IIB, IIIA, or IIIB, with clear margins
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 to 1
Enrolled 30 to 77 days after surgery, with no prior treatment for this lung cancer
Local tests show no EGFR exon 19 deletion or L858R, and no ALK rearrangement (non-squamous only)
Blood counts, kidney function, and liver tests within the stated limits
not_for: Known N2 lymph node disease before surgery
Uncontrolled illness, such as serious active infection or symptomatic heart failure
Current pneumonitis, or past non-infectious pneumonitis that needed steroids
Active autoimmune disease that needed systemic treatment in the last 2 years
Pregnant or nursing

NCT07579221.summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests navlimetostat given together with pumitamig in adults with MTAP-deficient advanced non-small cell lung cancer. Navlimetostat is taken by mouth once daily, and pumitamig is given by IV infusion every 3 weeks in 21-day cycles until disease progression or the treatment is not tolerated. The goal is to find a safe and tolerable dose, and the study will also look at how well the drugs work; a specific primary outcome measure is not stated.
NCT07579221.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa navlimetostat administrado junto con pumitamig en adultos con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas avanzado y deficiencia de MTAP. Navlimetostat se toma por vía oral una vez al día, y pumitamig se administra por infusión intravenosa cada 3 semanas, en ciclos de 21 días, hasta la progresión de la enfermedad o hasta que el tratamiento no se tolere. El objetivo es encontrar una dosis segura y tolerable, y el estudio también evaluará qué tan bien funcionan los medicamentos; no se indica una medida de resultado principal específica.
who_for: Age 18 years or older.
Advanced non-small cell lung cancer confirmed by tissue or cell testing.
MTAP loss shown by homozygous deletion or absent MTAP protein expression.
ECOG performance status 0 to 1.
Prior systemic therapy for advanced disease and at least one measurable lesion.
not_for: Prior treatment with PRMT5 or MAT2A inhibitors.
Prior treatment with anti-PD-1/VEGF or anti-PD-L1/VEGF bispecific antibodies.
Systemic anticancer therapy within 21 days or 5 half-lives before enrollment.
Significant risk of lung bleeding, or recent intracranial, spinal or GI bleeding within 3 months.
Uncontrolled hypertension, poorly controlled diabetes, or average QTc above 470 msec.

NCT07819136.summary_en: This study tests REC-7735, a study drug, in people with unresectable, locally advanced, or metastatic solid tumors that have the PIK3CA H1047R mutation. REC-7735 is taken by mouth twice daily (BID), and the total length of treatment is not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and preliminary anti-tumor activity; it is a Phase 1/2 study.
NCT07819136.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa REC-7735, un medicamento en investigación, en personas con tumores sólidos irresecables, localmente avanzados o metastásicos que tienen la mutación PIK3CA H1047R. REC-7735 se toma por vía oral dos veces al día (BID), y la duración total del tratamiento no está indicada. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética, la farmacodinamia y la actividad antitumoral preliminar; es un estudio de fase 1/2.
who_for: Unresectable, locally advanced, or metastatic solid tumor with the PIK3CA H1047R mutation in tumor tissue or blood ctDNA.
For Phase 1A and some Phase 1B cohorts: progressed on, relapsed after, or did not tolerate at least one standard systemic treatment, or considered ineligible fo
Toxicities from prior cancer treatment have resolved to Grade 1 or lower, or to prior baseline, except alopecia and peripheral neuropathy.
Age 18 years or older (no upper age limit stated).
not_for: Disease progression on a PI3K, AKT, or mTOR inhibitor, unless the investigator and sponsor agree it is suitable.
Known PTEN loss-of-function mutation or PTEN loss, or activating AKT mutations, unless deemed suitable.
Major surgery within 6 weeks of starting treatment.
Serious medical or psychiatric condition that would preclude informed consent or treatment, or recent or ongoing serious infection.
Uncontrolled diabetes: HbA1c 8% or higher, currently requiring insulin, or fasting blood glucose 140 mg/dL or higher in the past 30 days (not applicable to the

NCT07220616.summary_en: This phase 1/2 study tests DS3790a, an antibody-drug conjugate (DXd-ADC) that targets CD37, in adults with hematological malignancies, including B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. The drug is given as specified in the protocol, alone or with a combination regimen whose drugs are not named, and the dose schedule and duration are not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated; the study is designed to assess safety, preliminary efficacy, and pharmacokinetics.
NCT07220616.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa DS3790a, un conjugado anticuerpo-fármaco (DXd-ADC) que apunta a CD37, en adultos con neoplasias hematológicas, incluido el linfoma no Hodgkin de células B. El fármaco se administra según lo especificado en el protocolo, solo o con un régimen de combinación cuyos medicamentos no se nombran, y la frecuencia y la duración de las dosis no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica; el estudio está diseñado para evaluar la seguridad, la eficacia preliminar y la farmacocinética.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older who sign the consent form
Histologically documented hematologic malignancy per WHO 5th edition classification
ECOG performance status of 0, 1 or 2
LVEF of at least 50% within 28 days before the trial starts
Life expectancy of at least 3 months
not_for: Prior allogeneic stem cell transplant
Prior solid organ transplantation
Brain or leptomeningeal disease, unless treated with no progression within 4 weeks
Current or past non-infectious lung inflammation (ILD/pneumonitis) needing steroids, or suspected and not ruled out
Another malignancy diagnosed within the previous 3 years

NCT07407933.summary_en: The study tests YL201 given together with atezolizumab in people with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC) who have not had prior systemic treatment for it. YL201 and atezolizumab are both given by IV infusion on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle, and treatment continues until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity, or withdrawal of consent. The main measure in the first part is safety and tolerability, and this is a Phase 1/2 study that also lists efficacy and pharmacokinetics.
NCT07407933.summary_es: El estudio evalúa YL201 combinado con atezolizumab en personas con cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas en etapa extensa (ES-SCLC) que no han recibido tratamiento sistémico previo para esta enfermedad. YL201 y atezolizumab se administran por infusión intravenosa el día 1 de cada ciclo de 21 días, y el tratamiento continúa hasta la progresión de la enfermedad, toxicidad inaceptable o retiro del consentimiento. La medida principal en la primera parte es la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, y este es un estudio de fase 1/2 que también incluye eficacia y farmacocinética.
who_for: Age 18 years or older.
Confirmed extensive-stage small cell lung cancer (ES-SCLC).
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
Adequate blood count and organ function.
No prior systemic anti-cancer treatment for ES-SCLC.
not_for: Prior treatment targeting B7H3.
Prior topoisomerase I inhibitor treatment.
Clinically active brain metastases or spinal cord compression.
Current or past interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis.
Clinically significant heart disease, such as NYHA class II to IV heart failure.

NCT06493552.summary_en: This trial tests sEphB4-HSA, an EphrinB2 inhibitor, combined with immunotherapy and other treatment regimens in patients with EphrinB2-high solid tumors. The listed conditions are muscle-invasive bladder carcinoma and metastatic urothelial carcinoma. sEphB4-HSA is given by intravenous infusion over 60 minutes on days 1 and 8 of each cycle, and treatment continues until the prespecified number of cycles is completed, the disease progresses, or toxicity becomes unacceptable. The primary objective is to demonstrate additive therapeutic benefit from sEphB4-HSA, and the study is Phase 2/3.
NCT06493552.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa sEphB4-HSA, un inhibidor de EphrinB2, combinado con inmunoterapia y otros esquemas de tratamiento en pacientes con tumores sólidos de alta expresión de EphrinB2. Las condiciones listadas son carcinoma de vejiga músculo-invasivo y carcinoma urotelial metastásico. sEphB4-HSA se administra por infusión intravenosa durante 60 minutos los días 1 y 8 de cada ciclo, y el tratamiento continúa hasta completar el número de ciclos prespecificado, hasta que la enfermedad progrese o hasta que la toxicidad sea inaceptable. El objetivo principal es demostrar un beneficio terapéutico aditivo de sEphB4-HSA, y el estudio es de Fase 2/3.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older who are willing and able to give informed consent
Tumor must express EphrinB2, as assessed by the central lab
Zubrod performance status of 1 or less
Urothelial carcinoma, not pure small cell, with no systemic cancer therapy in the previous 12 months
Adequate organ function on labs obtained within 14 days before randomization
not_for: Symptomatic brain metastases requiring systemic corticosteroids, with some exceptions
Active or past autoimmune disorders, or conditions that impair the immune system
Known active bacterial, fungal or viral infection, including hepatitis B or C, or HIV
Any known active chronic liver disease
Active second cancer requiring systemic therapy, or severe reaction to a monoclonal antibody

NCT04678648.summary_en: This Phase 1a/1b study tests RSC-1255, alone or with hydroxychloroquine, in adults with advanced solid tumors such as lung, colon, pancreatic cancer, and glioblastoma. The study drug is taken by mouth twice a day in 21-day cycles, and Phase 1a enrolls 40-80 participants while Phase 1b enrolls 48-94. The main aims are to find the dose-limiting toxicity and recommended dose in Phase 1a, and to study safety, pharmacology, and clinical efficacy in Phase 1b.
NCT04678648.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1a/1b evalúa RSC-1255, solo o con hidroxicloroquina, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados como cáncer de pulmón, de colon, de páncreas y glioblastoma. El medicamento del estudio se toma por vía oral dos veces al día en ciclos de 21 días; la fase 1a incluye de 40 a 80 participantes y la fase 1b de 48 a 94. Los objetivos principales son identificar la toxicidad limitante de dosis y la dosis recomendada en la fase 1a, y estudiar la seguridad, la farmacología y la eficacia clínica en la fase 1b.
who_for: Pathology-confirmed advanced or metastatic cancer that is intolerant of, refractory to, or has progressed on standard therapy.
Has measurable or evaluable tumor(s) on standard scans or lab tests.
Has adequate performance status (ECOG).
Is 18 years of age or older.
Has a solid tumor with documented RAS mutation, or glioblastoma with or without RAS mutation.
not_for: Currently receiving cancer therapy at enrollment.
Clinically significant disease affecting a major organ system, significant heart disease, or ECG abnormalities.
Known Gilbert's disease or intermittent low potassium (hypokalemia).
Current or prior (within 2 years) malignancy other than the target cancer.
Grade 1 or higher nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea at baseline due to the underlying disease.

NCT05610735.summary_en: This study tests liposomal doxorubicin (DOXIL) combined with Ashwagandha, also called withaferin A, in recurrent ovarian cancer. DOXIL is given into a vein every four weeks for 4 cycles, or until progression or unacceptable toxicity, to a maximum of 10 cycles, and Ashwagandha tablets are taken by mouth twice a day for up to 2 years. The study measures survival rate, complete response, and partial response in part 2, and feasibility and tolerance of three Ashwagandha doses in part 1; it is a Phase 1/Phase 2 study.
NCT05610735.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa doxorrubicina liposomal (DOXIL) combinada con Ashwagandha, también llamada withaferina A, en cáncer de ovario recurrente. DOXIL se administra en una vena cada cuatro semanas durante 4 ciclos, o hasta progresión o toxicidad inaceptable, con un máximo de 10 ciclos, y las tabletas de Ashwagandha se toman por vía oral dos veces al día durante hasta 2 años. El estudio mide la tasa de supervivencia, la respuesta completa y la respuesta parcial en la parte 2, y la viabilidad y tolerancia de tres dosis de Ashwagandha en la parte 1; es un estudio de Fase 1/Fase 2.
who_for: Women with recurrent ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer
Received first-line platinum-containing chemotherapy and became platinum resistant or refractory
Age 18 years or older
Life expectancy greater than 6 months
ECOG performance status 0, 1, or 2
not_for: Previous treatment with liposomal doxorubicin
Prior use of other anthracyclines or anthracenediones
Parenchymal brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease
Known congestive heart failure, unstable angina, or heart attack within the past 6 months
Allergy to withaferin A or Ashwagandha

NCT06997029.summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests BMS-986500 alone or with palbociclib and fulvestrant in advanced solid tumors, including advanced breast cancer and advanced ovarian cancer. The record does not state the dose, route, or how often or how long the drugs are given; it only lists a specified dose on specified days. The main outcome is not stated; this is a Phase 1 study.
NCT06997029.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa BMS-986500 solo o con palbociclib y fulvestrant en tumores sólidos avanzados, incluido el cáncer de mama avanzado y el cáncer de ovario avanzado. El registro no indica la dosis, la vía ni la frecuencia o duración del tratamiento; solo menciona una dosis específica en días específicos. El resultado principal no se indica; se trata de un estudio de fase 1.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older
Histologically confirmed locally advanced, unresectable, or metastatic solid tumor
Measurable disease per RECIST v1.1
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1
For Part 2A only: CCNE1-amplified ovarian cancer
not_for: Active brain metastasis
Impaired cardiac function or clinically significant cardiac disease
Bleeding disorder or clinically significant bleeding within the prior 3 months
Grade 2 or higher peripheral neuropathy

NCT06152575.summary_en: This study is testing elranatamab and comparing it with other medicines for multiple myeloma that has come back or did not respond to earlier treatment. Elranatamab is given as a shot under the skin at the study clinic about once a week, and this may change to fewer shots later; the comparison medicines are taken by mouth and/or given as shots or through a vein, and treatment continues until the myeloma stops responding. The record does not list a main outcome measure, but it says the study will look at safety and how well elranatamab works, and it is a Phase 3 study.
NCT06152575.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa elranatamab y lo compara con otros medicamentos para el mieloma múltiple que ha regresado o que no respondió a tratamientos previos. Elranatamab se aplica como inyección debajo de la piel en la clínica del estudio, aproximadamente una vez por semana, y esto podría cambiar a menos inyecciones más adelante; los medicamentos de comparación se toman por vía oral y/o se administran como inyección o por vena, y el tratamiento continúa hasta que el mieloma deje de responder. El registro no indica un resultado principal, pero señala que el estudio观察 la seguridad y qué tan eficaz es elranatamab, y que es un estudio de Fase 3.

NCT07108998.summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests epcoritamab added to standard drugs as consolidation therapy in chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) or small lymphocytic lymphoma (SLL) after a second-generation BTK inhibitor, with or without obinutuzumab. Epcoritamab is given under the skin (subcutaneously), with step-up doses in cycle 1 and then doses on set days through cycles 2 to 12, while the BTK inhibitor is taken by mouth every day during the trial period. The record does not state a main outcome measure; it is listed as a Phase 2 study.
NCT07108998.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa epcoritamab añadido a medicamentos estándar como terapia de consolidación en leucemia linfocítica crónica (LLC) o linfoma linfocítico de pequeñas células (LLPC), después de un inhibidor de BTK de segunda generación, con o sin obinutuzumab. Epcoritamab se administra debajo de la piel (subcutánea), con dosis escalonadas en el ciclo 1 y luego dosis en días establecidos durante los ciclos 2 a 12, mientras que el inhibidor de BTK se toma por vía oral todos los días durante el período del estudio. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; el estudio figura como de fase 2.
who_for: Diagnosis of CLL or SLL, or a listed variant, after at least 12 months of acalabrutinib or zanubrutinib, with or without obinutuzumab
Partial response or better, but detectable disease in blood or bone marrow by ClonoSEQ
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 2 or better
Adequate blood counts, liver and kidney function
Agrees to contraception rules and signs informed consent
not_for: Complete response, or nodal partial response, with no detectable disease by ClonoSEQ
No CD20 expression on CLL cells before treatment
Prior treatment with any CD3xCD20 bispecific antibody
Active Richter's transformation
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or currently taking warfarin

NCT07456046.summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests D3S-003 in adults with advanced solid tumors that have a KRAS p.G12D mutation. The drug is taken by mouth as a tablet, in one arm once daily and in another twice daily; how long treatment lasts is not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and preliminary efficacy in this first-in-human, open-label, dose-escalation trial.
NCT07456046.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa D3S-003 en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados que tienen una mutación KRAS p.G12D. El medicamento se toma por vía oral en tableta, en un grupo una vez al día y en otro dos veces al día; la duración del tratamiento no se indica. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética, la farmacodinamia y la eficacia preliminar en este ensayo abierto de escalada de dosis en humanos por primera vez.
who_for: Locally advanced, recurrent, or metastatic cancer that did not respond to adequate standard treatment, or with no effective standard treatment available.
KRAS p.G12D mutation found by a local test on tumor tissue or blood collected within the last 5 years.
Measurable disease according to RECIST v1.1.
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
Adequate organ and marrow function during screening.
not_for: Prior treatment with a specific KRAS G12D inhibitor or degrader, or a pan RAS inhibitor or degrader.
Uncontrolled illness, such as serious chronic gastrointestinal conditions with diarrhea, active infections, significant uncontrolled heart disease, autoimmune o
Uncontrolled or untreated brain metastases.
Active gastrointestinal disease that could significantly interfere with absorption of oral therapy.

NCT06479811.summary_en: This study tests the study drug [212Pb]VMT-Alpha-NET in people with metastatic or inoperable tumors that have somatostatin receptors, including gastrointestinal neuroendocrine tumors, pheochromocytoma/paragangliomas, small cell lung cancer, kidney cancer, and head and neck cancers. The drug is given through a vein (IV) on Day 1 of each of 4 eight-week cycles, with doses escalated in Phase I and set at the maximum tolerated dose in dose expansion. The main outcome is not stated in the record; this is a Phase I study.
NCT06479811.summary_es: Este estudio prueba el medicamento [212Pb]VMT-Alpha-NET en personas con tumores metastásicos o no operables que tienen receptores de somatostatina, incluidos tumores neuroendocrinos gastrointestinales, feocromocitomas/paragangliomas, cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas, cáncer de riñón y cáncer de cabeza y cuello. Se administra por vena (IV) el día 1 de cada uno de 4 ciclos de 8 semanas, con dosis que aumentan por etapas en la fase I y se fijan en la dosis máxima tolerada en la expansión. El resultado principal no está indicado en el registro; es un estudio de fase I.
who_for: Adults aged 18 years or older.
Metastatic or inoperable tumor of a listed type with somatostatin receptor expression on at least 50% of visible tumor.
Small cell lung cancer: at least one prior line of standard systemic treatment.
Kidney cancer: prior therapy requirements apply, including a PD1/PDL1 inhibitor and a VEGF-pathway agent for most renal cell cancers.
ECOG performance status of 1 or less, with adequate blood and organ function.
not_for: Prior systemic radioligand therapy given for definitive treatment.
Pregnancy, or a positive pregnancy test in people who can become pregnant.
QTc above 450 ms on EKG at screening.
Active or untreated secondary malignancy, except nonmelanoma skin cancer and cervical carcinoma in situ.
Allergic reaction to compounds similar to VMT-Alpha-NET.

NCT06225427.summary_en: This phase I study tests gilteritinib, a drug already FDA approved for a type of leukemia, in people with stage IV ALK-positive non-small cell lung cancer who have progressed on other treatments. Gilteritinib is taken by mouth once daily on days 1 to 21 of each 21-day cycle, and cycles repeat if the disease does not progress and side effects are acceptable. The study looks at safety, side effects and the best dose; no separate outcome measure is stated.
NCT06225427.summary_es: Este estudio de fase I evalúa gilteritinib, un medicamento que ya cuenta con aprobación de la FDA para un tipo de leucemia, en personas con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas con ALK positivo en etapa IV que han progresado con otros tratamientos. El gilteritinib se toma por vía oral una vez al día durante los días 1 a 21 de cada ciclo de 21 días, y los ciclos se repiten si la enfermedad no progresa y los efectos secundarios son aceptables. El estudio analiza la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la dosis más adecuada; no se indica una medida de resultado por separado.
who_for: Stage IV non-small cell lung cancer with an ALK fusion (adenocarcinoma, squamous, adenosquamous, or NOS)
Prior ALK inhibitor treatment, in one of three defined cohorts; later cohorts also need prior chemotherapy
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 to 2
Measurable disease per RECIST v1.1 on screening imaging
Blood counts, kidney, liver and albumin levels within the listed limits
not_for: Prior treatment with a FLT3 inhibitor
Active, symptomatic brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis
Child-Pugh class C cirrhosis or untreated hepatitis B or C
Use of strong CYP3A inducers or certain P-gp drugs
Pregnancy, breastfeeding, or QTc over 480 ms

NCT07465757.summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests alisertib taken together with paclitaxel in adults with small cell lung cancer. Alisertib is taken by mouth twice a day on Days 1 to 7, and paclitaxel is given through a vein on Days 1 and 8 of each 21-day cycle. The main measure is the percentage of side effects, mild and serious, graded by NCI CTCAE version 5.0, to see how well participants tolerate the combination at different alisertib doses.
NCT07465757.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa alisertib combinado con paclitaxel en adultos con cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas. El alisertib se toma por vía oral dos veces al día del día 1 al 7, y el paclitaxel se administra por vena los días 1 y 8 de cada ciclo de 21 días. El resultado principal es el porcentaje de efectos secundarios, leves y graves, clasificados según los CTCAE del NCI versión 5.0, para medir qué tan bien toleran los participantes la combinación con distintas dosis de alisertib.
who_for: Age 18 years or older at consent
Pathologically confirmed small cell lung cancer
Prior platinum-based chemotherapy and anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1 immunotherapy
Up to one additional systemic therapy for SCLC, for a total of up to 2 prior regimens
Measurable disease as defined by RECIST v1.1
not_for: Prior treatment with an AURKA-specific or pan-Aurora targeted agent, including alisertib, in any setting

NCT06627244.summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests tebentafusp given together with yttrium-90 radioembolization in people with metastatic uveal melanoma that has spread mainly to the liver. Participants first receive yttrium-90 radioembolization, followed by a 14 to 28 day recovery period, and then tebentafusp once a week in 28-day cycles for up to 24 months or 24 cycles. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is Phase 2.
NCT06627244.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa tebentafusp combinado con radioembolización de itrio-90 en personas con melanoma uveal metastásico que se ha diseminado principalmente al hígado. Los participantes reciben primero la radioembolización de itrio-90, seguida de un período de recuperación de 14 a 28 días, y luego tebentafusp una vez por semana en ciclos de 28 días, por hasta 24 meses o 24 ciclos. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Metastatic uveal melanoma mainly in the liver, confirmed by pathology review.
Bilirubin under 2 mg/dl; AST and ALT under 5 times the upper limit of normal.
Angiogram shows radioembolization is feasible and safe to perform.
HLA-A*02:01 positive, age 18 or older, and ECOG performance status 0-1.
Measurable or non-measurable disease per RECIST 1.1 and ability to give written consent.
not_for: Any tumor larger than 8 cm.
Liver enzyme, bilirubin, or blood count results outside the listed limits.
Significant heart disease, uncontrolled blood pressure, uncontrolled atrial fibrillation, or prolonged QT interval.
Symptomatic or untreated brain or CNS metastases, or active hepatitis B or C.
Prior radioembolization or other liver-directed therapy to the same site.

NCT04893109.summary_en: This study compares two HER2-directed treatment plans after surgery for stage I HER2-positive breast cancer. One plan gives trastuzumab emtansine (T-DM1, Kadcyla) by vein, followed by subcutaneous trastuzumab, and the other gives weekly paclitaxel by vein with subcutaneous trastuzumab. T-DM1 is given every 3 weeks for 6 cycles (18 weeks), then subcutaneous trastuzumab every 3 weeks for 11 cycles, while the paclitaxel arm gets weekly paclitaxel for 12 weeks (4 cycles) with subcutaneous trastuzumab every 3 weeks for 17 cycles. The main outcome measure is not stated, and the study is a Phase 2 trial.
NCT04893109.summary_es: Este estudio compara dos planes de tratamiento dirigidos a HER2 después de la cirugía para el cáncer de mama en etapa I con HER2 positivo. Un plan administra trastuzumab emtansina (T-DM1, Kadcyla) por vena, seguido de trastuzumab subcutáneo, y el otro administra paclitaxel semanal por vena con trastuzumab subcutáneo. T-DM1 se da cada 3 semanas durante 6 ciclos (18 semanas), y luego trastuzumab subcutáneo cada 3 semanas durante 11 ciclos, mientras que el grupo de paclitaxel recibe paclitaxel semanal durante 12 semanas (4 ciclos) con trastuzumab subcutáneo cada 3 semanas durante 17 ciclos. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro, y el estudio es un ensayo de Fase 2.
who_for: Stage I invasive breast cancer that is HER2-positive, with no nodal spread or micrometastases only.
HER2-positive status must be confirmed by central review before treatment starts.
Age 18 or older, with ECOG performance status 0 or 1.
Breast surgery (mastectomy or lumpectomy) done no more than 90 days before planned treatment start.
Adequate blood counts, liver function, and left ventricular ejection fraction of at least 50%.
not_for: Locally advanced tumor at diagnosis, such as tumor fixed to the chest wall or skin changes.
Prior invasive breast cancer, or chemotherapy in the past 5 years.
Any history of paclitaxel therapy.
Active liver disease, such as hepatitis B or C or sclerosing cholangitis.
Pregnant or nursing, or unwilling to use required contraception.

NCT04065399.summary_en: The study tests revumenib, also called SNDX-5613, in people with relapsed or refractory acute leukemia, including leukemias with a KMT2A gene rearrangement or an NPM1 mutation. Revumenib is taken by mouth, and the dosing schedule and treatment length are not stated. Phase 1 finds the maximum tolerated dose and recommended Phase 2 dose, and Phase 2 measures efficacy, short- and long-term safety, and tolerability.
NCT04065399.summary_es: El estudio evalúa revumenib, también llamado SNDX-5613, en personas con leucemia aguda recidivante o refractaria, incluidas las leucemias con reordenamiento del gen KMT2A o mutación de NPM1. Revumenib se toma por vía oral, y el esquema de dosis y la duración del tratamiento no se indican en el registro. La fase 1 determinará la dosis máxima tolerada y la dosis recomendada para la fase 2, y la fase 2 medirá la eficacia, la seguridad a corto y largo plazo y la tolerabilidad.
who_for: Active acute leukemia with at least 5% bone marrow blasts, or blasts back in the blood.
Age 30 days or older.
ECOG performance status 0-2, or Karnofsky/Lansky score of 50 or higher.
Side effects from earlier treatment resolved to grade 1 or lower before enrollment.
White blood cell count below 25,000 per microliter at enrollment.
not_for: Diagnosis of active acute promyelocytic leukemia.
Active central nervous system disease.
Detectable HIV viral load within the previous 6 months, or hepatitis B or C.
Pregnant or nursing women.
Heart events within 6 months, or QTc above 450 milliseconds.

NCT07711002.summary_en: This Phase 3 study tests saruparib added to a hormone pathway drug (ARPI) chosen by the physician, compared with placebo plus that drug, in men with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer. These men previously had docetaxel or lutetium-177 PSMA therapy and have no disease progression. Saruparib 60 mg is taken by mouth once daily in 28-day cycles, and the ARPI is enzalutamide, darolutamide, or abiraterone, chosen by the physician. The record says the main goal is to measure efficacy compared with placebo, but the specific outcome measure is not stated.
NCT07711002.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 evalúa saruparib añadido a un medicamento de la vía de las hormonas (ARPI) elegido por el médico, comparado con placebo más ese medicamento, en hombres con cáncer de próstata metastásico sensible a hormonas. Estos hombres recibieron antes docetaxel o terapia con PSMA y lutecio-177, y no tienen progresión de la enfermedad. Saruparib 60 mg se toma por vía oral una vez al día en ciclos de 28 días, y el ARPI es enzalutamida, darolutamida o abiraterona, elegido por el médico. El registro indica que el objetivo principal es medir la eficacia frente a placebo, pero la medida de resultado específica no se indica.
who_for: Men aged 18 or older with metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate adenocarcinoma.
Previously treated with docetaxel or lutetium-177 PSMA therapy, with last dose within 6 months.
No disease progression, with PSA at least 0.2 ng/mL within 14 days before randomization.
Receiving GnRH analogue hormone therapy or has had bilateral orchiectomy.
Tumor tissue and blood sample provided; HRRm, HRD and PTEN status confirmed.
not_for: Prior treatment with a PARP inhibitor or platinum chemotherapy.
ARPI switched earlier for mHSPC because of disease progression.
Severe cytopenia lasting more than 2 weeks, or history of MDS or AML.
Spinal cord compression or brain metastases unless asymptomatic and stable.
Seizure history, or loss of consciousness or TIA within 12 months of enrolment.

NCT06130995.summary_en: This Phase 1b study tests relugolix and enzalutamide, two oral medicines, given before and after radiation therapy or surgery in men with high-risk locally advanced prostate cancer. Relugolix is taken once daily with a 360 mg loading dose on day 1, and enzalutamide is taken once daily. The plan is 6 months of hormone therapy before treatment, hormone therapy during radiation, and then 18 more months of maintenance hormone therapy. The record does not state a primary outcome measure; its stated questions ask whether the combination helps increase the chance of cure and whether patients live longer without the cancer getting worse.
NCT06130995.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1b evalúa relugolix y enzalutamida, dos medicamentos orales, administrados antes y después de la radioterapia o la cirugía en hombres con cáncer de próstata localmente avanzado de alto riesgo. El relugolix se toma una vez al día con una dosis de carga de 360 mg el día 1, y la enzalutamida también se toma una vez al día. El plan incluye 6 meses de terapia hormonal antes del tratamiento, terapia hormonal durante la radioterapia y luego 18 meses adicionales de terapia hormonal de mantenimiento. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; sus preguntas planteadas son si la combinación ayuda a aumentar la probabilidad de curación y si los pacientes viven más tiempo sin que el cáncer empeore.
who_for: Men 18 years or older with prostate adenocarcinoma confirmed by pathology
Locally advanced high-risk disease, defined by PSA, grade, or clinical stage criteria
ECOG performance status 0 to 2
Life expectancy of at least 6 months in the investigator's opinion
Normal organ and bone marrow function at screening, and willingness to use contraception
not_for: Major heart event, new heart failure, or stroke within the past 6 months
Receiving other investigational agents
Distant metastatic cancer
Active second cancer requiring treatment
Not a candidate for surgery or radiation therapy

NCT04329728.summary_en: This study tests AVM0703 in people with lymphoid malignancies, which are cancers that start in lymphoid cells. The record lists several lymphomas and leukemias, including diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and chronic lymphocytic leukemia. AVM0703 is given as a single intravenous infusion over about 1 hour. The study measures safety, tolerability, how the drug moves through the body (pharmacokinetics), and early signs of antitumor activity. It is a Phase 1/2 study.
NCT04329728.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa AVM0703 en personas con neoplasias linfoides, que son cánceres que se originan en las células linfoides. El registro incluye varios linfomas y leucemias, entre ellos el linfoma difuso de células B grandes y la leucemia linfocítica crónica. AVM0703 se administra como una sola infusión intravenosa de aproximadamente 1 hora. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, cómo se mueve el medicamento por el cuerpo (farmacocinética) y las primeras señales de actividad antitumoral. Es un estudio de Fase 1/2.
who_for: Age 12 years or older and weight at least 40 kg.
Lymphoid cancer of a listed type that has returned or did not respond to prior treatment.
Lansky or Karnofsky performance status of 50 or higher.
Blood counts, liver tests, kidney function and lung reserve within the limits set in the record.
Able to give written informed consent; minors need parent or guardian consent and their own assent.
not_for: History of another cancer, except the listed exceptions.
Significant heart disease, heart rhythm problems, or uncontrolled high blood pressure as defined in the record.
Known stomach or duodenal ulcer, or uncontrolled diabetes.
Untreated active infection, including hepatitis B, hepatitis C, HIV, or tuberculosis under the listed conditions.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or taking part in another therapeutic clinical study (except AVM0703-001).

NCT05422911.summary_en: This Phase 2 study randomly assigns Veterans with castrate-sensitive prostate cancer to first-line treatment with abiraterone acetate, enzalutamide, or apalutamide. All three drugs are taken by mouth once daily, and abiraterone is taken with a steroid (methylprednisolone or prednisone). The record does not state how long treatment lasts, and it does not state a main outcome measure; the study is listed as Phase 2.
NCT05422911.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 asigna de forma aleatoria a veteranos con cáncer de próstata sensible a la castración a un tratamiento de primera línea con acetato de abiraterona, enzalutamida o apalutamida. Los tres medicamentos se toman por vía oral una vez al día, y la abiraterona se toma con un esteroide (metilprednisolona o prednisona). El registro no indica cuánto dura el tratamiento ni establece una medida de resultado principal; el estudio figura como fase 2.
who_for: Veterans who can give written informed consent
Age 18 years or older
ECOG performance status of 2 or less
Confirmed prostate adenocarcinoma without small-cell features
Androgen-deprivation therapy started within 120 days before randomization, planned, or prior bilateral orchiectomy
not_for: Prior chemotherapy or prostate cancer treatment with abiraterone, apalutamide, enzalutamide, darolutamide, aminoglutethimide, or ketoconazole, except placebo
History of seizure or conditions that may predispose to seizure
Receiving other investigational agents at the same time
NYHA Class III-IV heart disease
Child-Pugh Class B or C liver disease

NCT06146257.summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests GLB-001, a drug taken by mouth, in adults with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia or relapsed or refractory higher-risk myelodysplastic syndromes. It is given by mouth according to the assigned treatment schedule, and how long or how often is not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, how the body processes the drug, and early signs of effect, and it aims to find the maximum tolerated dose.
NCT06146257.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa GLB-001, un medicamento que se toma por vía oral, en adultos con leucemia mieloide aguda recidivante o refractaria, o con síndromes mielodisplásicos de alto riesgo recidivantes o refractarios. Se administra por vía oral según el esquema de tratamiento asignado; la duración y la frecuencia no están indicadas. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, cómo el cuerpo procesa el medicamento y los primeros signos de efecto, y busca determinar la dosis máxima tolerada.
who_for: Age 18 years or older and able to sign the consent form
Confirmed acute myeloid leukemia, including secondary AML from MDS, or confirmed higher-risk MDS
Relapsed or refractory disease that failed or is not eligible for all available therapies that may help
White blood cell count below 25 x 10^9/L and adequate liver, kidney and clotting test values
ECOG performance status 0 to 2 and life expectancy of at least 12 weeks
not_for: Acute promyelocytic leukemia
Known leukemia involvement of the central nervous system
Active cancer other than AML or MDS
Known chronic active hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or HIV
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or unable to swallow oral medicines

NCT07693452.summary_en: This small pilot study tests metformin in people with pseudomyxoma peritonei caused by appendiceal mucinous neoplasms. The study is open-label, so the treatment is known to both patients and study staff. The record states that the goal is to find out whether metformin therapy is feasible.
NCT07693452.summary_es: Este pequeño estudio piloto prueba la metformina en personas con pseudomixoma peritoneal causado por neoplasias mucinosas del apéndice. El estudio es abierto, por lo que se conoce el tratamiento tanto para los pacientes como para el personal del estudio. El registro indica que el objetivo es averiguar si el tratamiento con metformina es factible.
who_for: Adults 18 years and older
Pseudomyxoma peritonei from presumed appendiceal mucinous neoplasm that is recurrent or refractory after surgery and HIPEC
Pseudomyxoma peritonei that is unresectable
Pseudomyxoma peritonei without planned surgery and HIPEC
ECOG performance status 2 or lower
not_for: Resectable disease that is planned for cytoreductive surgery and HIPEC
Currently taking metformin for another medical reason
Prior adverse event to metformin

NCT07219147.summary_en: This Phase 1 trial tests lutetium Lu 177 vipivotide tetraxetan (177Lu-PSMA-617) given with sipuleucel-T, compared with 177Lu-PSMA-617 alone, in men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. Lutetium Lu 177 vipivotide tetraxetan is given by IV every 6 weeks for up to 6 cycles, and sipuleucel-T is given by IV over 1 hour every 2 weeks for up to 3 doses, starting in week 8 of treatment. The main outcome is not stated in the record; this is a Phase 1 trial.
NCT07219147.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 1 evalúa lutecio Lu 177 vipivotida tetraxetán (177Lu-PSMA-617) administrado junto con sipuleucel-T, en comparación con 177Lu-PSMA-617 solo, en hombres con cáncer de próstata metastásico resistente a la castración. El lutecio Lu 177 vipivotida tetraxetán se administra por vía intravenosa cada 6 semanas, hasta 6 ciclos, y el sipuleucel-T se administra por vía intravenosa durante 1 hora cada 2 semanas, hasta 3 dosis, comenzando en la semana 8 del tratamiento. El resultado principal no está indicado en el registro; se trata de un ensayo de fase 1.
who_for: Men aged 18 years or older
Progressive metastatic castration-resistant prostate adenocarcinoma without small cell features
ECOG performance status of 1 or less
On androgen deprivation therapy for at least 3 months with castrate testosterone levels
Blood counts, liver and kidney tests within the study limits
not_for: Prior treatment with 177Lu-PSMA-617 or sipuleucel-T
Anticancer, hormonal or radiation therapy within set time windows before study start
Known clinically significant liver disease
Primary CNS malignancy or symptomatic brain metastases
Another active malignancy needing treatment, or one diagnosed within 3 years

NCT07751991.summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests CHM-029, an investigational oral medicine, in adults with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (AML) that has NPM1 mutations or KMT2A or NUP98 rearrangements. CHM-029 is taken by mouth, and how often doses are given and how long treatment lasts are not stated. The study aims to find an appropriate dose, identify side effects, and learn how the body processes CHM-029.
NCT07751991.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa CHM-029, un medicamento oral en investigación, en adultos con leucemia mieloide aguda (LMA) recidivante o refractaria que tiene mutaciones de NPM1 o reordenamientos de KMT2A o NUP98. CHM-029 se administra por vía oral; la frecuencia de las dosis y la duración del tratamiento no se indican. El estudio busca determinar una dosis adecuada, identificar los efectos secundarios y conocer cómo el organismo procesa CHM-029.
who_for: 18 years of age or older
Relapsed or refractory AML after treatment with standard therapies
Positive for NPM1 mutation, or KMT2A or NUP98 rearrangement
not_for: WBC count above 25,000 that cannot be kept below threshold with hydroxyurea
Extramedullary-only AML or acute promyelocytic leukemia
Current complications related to a stem cell transplant, or other cancers needing treatment
Active hepatitis or HIV, or moderate liver or kidney impairment
Baseline QTc of 470 ms or more, NYHA class 3 or 4 heart failure, or CNS disease refractory to standard treatment

NCT06696768.summary_en: This phase I study tests CA-4948 (emavusertib) given together with FOLFOX (fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin) plus bevacizumab as first treatment for metastatic colorectal cancer. CA-4948 is taken by mouth twice a day on days 1 to 14 of each 14-day cycle, and the other drugs are given through a vein, with treatment continuing for up to 2 years if the disease does not progress and side effects are not unacceptable. The record describes the study's aims as side effects and best dose, and no primary outcome measure is listed.
NCT06696768.summary_es: Este estudio de fase I evalúa CA-4948 (emavusertib) administrado junto con FOLFOX (fluorouracilo, leucovorina, oxaliplatino) más bevacizumab como tratamiento inicial para el cáncer colorrectal metastásico. CA-4948 se toma por vía oral dos veces al día en los días 1 a 14 de cada ciclo de 14 días, y los demás medicamentos se administran por vena; el tratamiento puede continuar hasta 2 años si la enfermedad no progresa y los efectos secundarios no son inaceptables. El registro describe los objetivos del estudio como los efectos secundarios y la mejor dosis, y no se indica una medida de resultado principal.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older.
Colorectal adenocarcinoma confirmed by tissue or cell testing.
Unresectable or metastatic disease that can be measured on imaging.
ECOG performance status 2 or better, or Karnofsky 60% or higher.
Adequate blood counts, liver and kidney tests, and heart function (NYHA class II or better if heart disease history).
not_for: Colorectal cancer that is MSI-H or dMMR.
Prior chemotherapy in any setting, or prior bevacizumab or similar antiangiogenic drugs.
QTcF interval above 450 ms on screening ECG.
Currently receiving other investigational agents.
Pregnant women, or women who are breastfeeding while treated.

NCT05652335.summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests JNJ-79635322, a trispecific antibody, in adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma or previously treated AL amyloidosis. The study drug is given as a subcutaneous injection, and how often and for how long it is given is not stated. The main goal is to find the recommended phase 2 dose and schedule that is safe, and to measure safety and tolerability.
NCT05652335.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa JNJ-79635322, un anticuerpo trispecífico, en adultos con mieloma múltiple recidivante o refractario o con amiloidosis AL previamente tratada. El medicamento se administra como inyección subcutánea; la frecuencia y la duración no se indican. El objetivo principal es identificar la dosis recomendada para fase 2 y el esquema seguros, y medir la seguridad y la tolerabilidad.
who_for: Adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma previously treated with a proteasome inhibitor, IMiD and anti-CD38 therapy.
Adults with previously treated AL amyloidosis who are not candidates for available therapy with established benefit.
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status of 0 or 1 (myeloma participants).
Measurable disease by M-protein, free light chain levels, or extramedullary disease, as defined in the record.
Left ventricular ejection fraction of at least 45% (amyloidosis participants).
not_for: Central nervous system or meningeal involvement of myeloma or amyloidosis.
Any non-AL amyloidosis, including transthyretin (ATTR) amyloidosis.
Pulmonary compromise needing supplemental oxygen, or serious active infection.
Stroke or seizure within 6 months before the first dose.
Recent anticancer, transplant, or live vaccine treatment within the time windows listed in the record.

NCT07465276.summary_en: This study tests ficerafusp alfa given together with pembrolizumab before surgery in people with resectable, high-risk, locoregionally advanced, PD-L1-positive squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck. Both drugs are given by intravenous infusion, with pembrolizumab on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle and ficerafusp alfa on Days 1, 8, and 15 of cycle 1 and on Day 1 of cycle 2, followed by standard surgery. The record states that the study measures safety and efficacy, but a specific primary outcome is not stated; this is a Phase 2 trial.
NCT07465276.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa ficerafusp alfa combinado con pembrolizumab antes de la cirugía en personas con carcinoma de células escamosas de cabeza y cuello resecable, de alto riesgo, localmente avanzado y positivo para PD-L1. Ambos medicamentos se administran por infusión intravenosa: el pembrolizumab el Día 1 de cada ciclo de 21 días, y el ficerafusp alfa los Días 1, 8 y 15 del ciclo 1 y el Día 1 del ciclo 2, seguido de cirugía estándar. El registro indica que el estudio mide la seguridad y la eficacia, pero no se indica una medida de resultado principal específica; es un estudio de Fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with newly diagnosed, untreated, locoregionally advanced head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
Tumor arises from the oral cavity, oropharynx (HPV-negative), larynx, or hypopharynx.
Disease is resectable in the opinion of the treating surgical oncologist.
Tumor is PD-L1 positive, with a CPS score of 1 or greater.
ECOG performance status 0 or 1, and willing to provide blood and tissue samples.
not_for: Recurrent or metastatic head and neck cancer, or very early stage (stage I or II) disease.
HPV-associated oropharyngeal cancer.
Prior anti-EGFR antibody or anti-PD-1 immunotherapy.
Active autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment in the past 2 years.
Active hepatitis B or C, HIV, or prior organ transplant, as listed in the exclusion criteria.
cancer_types: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck

NCT06054776.summary_en: This study tests acalabrutinib, obinutuzumab, and glofitamab given together for mantle cell lymphoma that has come back after a period of improvement or did not respond to earlier treatment. Acalabrutinib is taken by mouth twice a day, obinutuzumab and glofitamab are given through a vein, and treatment repeats every 21 days for up to 12 cycles unless the disease progresses or side effects are unacceptable. The record does not state a main outcome; it is a phase 2 study of side effects and how well the drugs work together.
NCT06054776.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa acalabrutinib, obinutuzumab y glofitamab administrados juntos para el linfoma de células del manto que regresó después de un periodo de mejoría o que no respondió a tratamientos previos. El acalabrutinib se toma por vía oral dos veces al día, mientras que el obinutuzumab y el glofitamab se administran por vena, y el tratamiento se repite cada 21 días hasta por 12 ciclos, salvo que la enfermedad progrese o los efectos secundarios sean inaceptables. El registro no indica un resultado principal; es un estudio de fase 2 sobre los efectos secundarios y qué tan bien funcionan los medicamentos juntos.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older
Mantle cell lymphoma that has come back or did not respond after at least one prior systemic therapy
Tumor that is CD20-positive after the most recent therapy
Disease that is measurable on imaging under Lugano criteria
ECOG performance status of 2 or lower, with blood counts and organ function in set ranges
not_for: Prior treatment with a T-cell engaging bispecific antibody
More than 180 cumulative days of prior BTK inhibitor use without progression
CAR T cell therapy within 6 months before starting study treatment
Prior allogeneic stem cell transplant or autologous transplant within 3 months
Known active lymphoma involving the central nervous system

NCT04701476.summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests Trans-Arterial Tirapazamine Embolization (TATE) given with pembrolizumab in people with liver metastases from colorectal cancer or non-small cell lung cancer. All liver metastatic lesions are treated with TATE, and pembrolizumab is given by IV infusion every 3 or 6 weeks until progression or for a maximum of 2 years. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is Phase 2.
NCT04701476.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa la embolización transarterial con tirapazamina (TATE) combinada con pembrolizumab en personas con metástasis hepáticas de cáncer colorrectal o de cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas. Todas las lesiones metastásicas del hígado se tratan con TATE, y el pembrolizumab se administra por infusión intravenosa cada 3 o 6 semanas hasta la progresión o por un máximo de 2 años. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Liver metastatic MSS colorectal cancer or NSCLC without EGFR or AKT mutations
Colorectal cancer progressed on at least two chemotherapy lines, or NSCLC progressed on chemotherapy and an immune checkpoint inhibitor
Measurable disease and ECOG 0-1
At least 4 weeks from prior chemotherapy and free from chemotherapy-related toxicity
Adequate organ function
not_for: Prior organ transplantation
Liver metastases involving more than 50% of the liver
Oxygen saturation below 92% on room air
Prior autoimmune disorder or CNS metastasis
Major GI bleeding in the last 2 months

NCT06613217.summary_en: Oral zelenirstat (also called PCLX-001) is being tested in adults with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (AML). It is taken by mouth once daily at the same time each day, in 28-day cycles, at dose levels from 40 mg to 280 mg daily, and the number of cycles is not stated. This is a Phase 1 dose-finding study with dose escalation and dose expansion parts; the main outcome is not stated, but each dose level is checked for dose-limiting toxicity (DLT) before moving to the next.
NCT06613217.summary_es: Se está probando zelenirstat por vía oral (también llamado PCLX-001) en adultos con leucemia mieloide aguda (LMA) recidivante o refractaria. Se toma por vía oral una vez al día, a la misma hora cada día, en ciclos de 28 días, con niveles de dosis de 40 mg a 280 mg diarios; el número de ciclos no está indicado.
