The surgery removes a 1 cm or 2 cm margin of skin and is done on the same day as a sentinel lymph node biopsy. The main outcome measured is disease-free survival.
NCT03860883.summary_es: Este estudio compara dos márgenes de seguridad de extirpación quirúrgica, de 1 cm y de 2 cm, para el melanoma cutáneo primario en etapa II. La cirugía retira un margen de piel de 1 cm o 2 cm y se realiza el mismo día que la biopsia de ganglio centinela. La medida principal es la supervivencia libre de enfermedad.
who_for: Stage II primary invasive cutaneous melanoma, with Breslow thickness and ulceration criteria as stated in the record
Melanoma on the head, neck, trunk, extremity, scalp, palm or sole
A 2 cm margin around the biopsy scar or melanoma must be technically feasible
Surgery completed within 120 days of diagnosis and within 28 days of randomisation
Age 18 or older, able to give informed consent, ECOG performance score 0 to 1, life expectancy of at least 5 years
not_for: Uncertain melanoma diagnosis, such as a melanocytic lesion of unknown malignant potential
Perineural invasion or neurotropic melanoma, or pure desmoplastic melanoma
Subungual melanoma or melanoma at excluded sites such as the nose tip, eyelids, ear, genitalia or mucous membranes
Physical, clinical, radiographic or pathologic evidence of metastatic, satellite or in-transit melanoma
Other solid tumour or blood cancer in the past 5 years, with stated exceptions for some skin cancers and uterine or cervical cancer

NCT07822919.summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests AWT020, a study drug, in adults with advanced solid tumors. AWT020 is given as an intravenous infusion once every three weeks at designated dose levels, and the length of treatment is not stated. The study aims to establish the maximum tolerated dose and/or recommended Phase 2 dose, and to learn about safety, tolerability, efficacy, pharmacokinetics and immunogenicity.
NCT07822919.summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 evalúa AWT020, un medicamento en investigación, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados. AWT020 se administra como infusión intravenosa una vez cada tres semanas, en niveles de dosis designados; la duración del tratamiento no se indica. El estudio busca establecer la dosis máxima tolerada y/o la dosis recomendada para Fase 2, y conocer la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la eficacia, la farmacocinética y la inmunogenicidad.
who_for: Age 18 or older and able to give written informed consent.
Unresectable advanced solid tumor confirmed by pathology.
Disease progressed after at least one systemic therapy, with no beneficial standard option available or tolerated.
At least one measurable lesion by RECIST 1.1, ECOG 0 or 1, and life expectancy of at least 3 months.
Adequate bone marrow, kidney, liver, clotting and heart function as defined in the protocol.
not_for: Prior immunotherapy stopped because of an immune-related adverse event, or hypersensitivity to study treatment or related therapies.
Untreated or unstable brain metastases, leptomeningeal disease, or brainstem metastases.
Autoimmune or skin disease needing systemic treatment, or current or past interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis.
Active or recent severe infection, or other uncontrolled medical condition.
Pregnancy or breastfeeding, or another malignancy within 5 years (low-risk or in situ cancers permitted).

NCT03586609.summary_en: This phase 2 study tests venetoclax added to cladribine and low dose cytarabine, followed by cladribine, low dose cytarabine, and azacitidine, in patients with previously untreated acute myeloid leukemia. Venetoclax is taken by mouth, cladribine is given into a vein, cytarabine is given under the skin, and azacitidine is given under the skin or into a vein; how often and for how long is not stated. The record does not state the main outcome measured, and the study is listed as Phase 2.
NCT03586609.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa venetoclax añadido a cladribina y citarabina en dosis bajas, seguido de cladribina, citarabina en dosis bajas y azacitidina, en pacientes con leucemia mieloide aguda no tratada previamente. El venetoclax se toma por vía oral, la cladribina se administra por vena, la citarabina se aplica debajo de la piel y la azacitidina se aplica debajo de la piel o por vena; la frecuencia y la duración no se indican. El registro no indica el resultado principal que se mide, y el estudio figura como de fase 2.
who_for: Previously untreated acute myeloid leukemia (AML)
Age 50 years or older
Adequate liver and kidney function
ECOG performance status of 2 or less
Able to understand the study and sign informed consent
not_for: Pregnant or breastfeeding women, or those of childbearing potential not using contraception
Uncontrolled illness such as active infection, symptomatic heart failure, unstable angina, or cardiac arrhythmia
Documented hypersensitivity to components of the chemotherapy program
Prior therapy with venetoclax
Acute promyelocytic leukemia (AML-M3)

NCT05687136.summary_en: This phase 1 trial tests peposertib (M3814) combined with tuvusertib (M1774) in patients with advanced solid tumors that are metastatic or unresectable. Peposertib is taken by mouth once or twice daily on days 2 to 14 of cycle 1 and on days 1 to 14 of later cycles, and tuvusertib is taken by mouth once daily on days 1 to 14 of each cycle, with cycles repeating every 28 days. The record does not state a primary outcome measure; it says the study looks at safety, side effects and the best dose.
NCT05687136.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 1 evalúa peposertib (M3814) combinado con tuvusertib (M1774) en pacientes con tumores sólidos avanzados, metastásicos o no resecables. Peposertib se toma por vía oral una o dos veces al día en los días 2 al 14 del ciclo 1 y en los días 1 al 14 de los ciclos siguientes, y tuvusertib se toma por vía oral una vez al día en los días 1 al 14 de cada ciclo; los ciclos se repiten cada 28 días. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; señala que el estudio evalúa la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la mejor dosis.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with a solid tumor that is metastatic or unresectable
Tumor with a stated alteration such as ATM mutation, MYC amplification, FBXW7 mutation, CCNE1 amplification, or SWI/SNF gene change
Progression on at least one prior standard therapy, or no standard therapy exists and the investigator deems it appropriate
Measurable disease by RECIST 1.1 (non-measurable disease allowed in dose escalation)
ECOG performance status 2 or better and life expectancy over 3 months
not_for: Children under 18 years of age
Immunotherapy within 21 days, radiation within 21 days, or major surgery within 21 days before cycle 1 day 1
Residual toxicity above grade 1 from prior anti-cancer therapy, with some exceptions
Currently receiving other investigational agents
Pregnant or breastfeeding women, QTcF of 470 msec or more, or uncontrolled intercurrent illness

NCT05055609.summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests TRE-515, a pill-form drug that works by inhibiting deoxycytidine kinase (dCK), in adults with advanced solid tumors. TRE-515 is taken by mouth once daily, at about the same time each day, at least 1 hour before or 2 hours after eating, with no breaks between cycles, and continues as long as the cancer does not progress, side effects stay acceptable, and the sponsor and study doctor agree it is in the patient's best interest. The main goal is to measure the safety of TRE-515 and the highest dose that can be tolerated.
NCT05055609.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa TRE-515, un medicamento en cápsulas que actúa inhibiendo la desoxicitidina cinasa (dCK), en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados. TRE-515 se toma por vía oral una vez al día, a más o menos la misma hora cada día, al menos 1 hora antes o 2 horas después de comer, sin pausas entre ciclos, y continúa mientras el cáncer no progrese, los efectos secundarios sean aceptables y el patrocinador y el médico del estudio consideren que es lo mejor para el paciente. El objetivo principal es medir la seguridad de TRE-515 y la dosis más alta que puede tolerarse.
who_for: Histologically or cytologically confirmed solid tumor that is advanced and refractory, with no effective standard treatment left
Measurable disease per RECIST v1.1, or a positive known marker of progression (such as PSA or CA-125) if no measurable disease
Age 18 or older and able to give signed informed consent
ECOG performance status of 0 to 2
Adequate blood counts, liver and kidney function, and willingness to use contraception during study and for 3 months after last dose
not_for: Candidates for potentially curative therapy
Other active cancers, with listed exceptions
Pregnant or currently breast-feeding
Known HIV, or active hepatitis B or C infection
Significant heart problems, heart attack within 6 months, or stroke or transient ischemic attack within 6 months

NCT07165132.summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests RYZ401, a radiopharmaceutical labeled with actinium-225, in neuroendocrine tumors and other solid tumors that express somatostatin receptors. How the drug is given, and how often, is not stated in the record. The main goals are to find the recommended Phase 2 dose and best treatment schedule, to assess safety and tolerability, and to evaluate early signs of effect.
NCT07165132.summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 evalúa RYZ401, un radiofármaco marcado con actinio-225, en tumores neuroendocrinos y otros tumores sólidos que expresan receptores de somatostatina. La forma de administración y la frecuencia no se indican en el registro. Los objetivos principales son determinar la dosis recomendada para la Fase 2 y el mejor esquema de tratamiento, evaluar la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, y estudiar los primeros signos de efecto.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older at consent.
Histologically confirmed grade 1-3 well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumor, metastatic or unresectable, from any primary site (dose escalation).
Expansion cohort A: grade 1-3 gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, metastatic or unresectable.
Expansion cohort B: certain non-GI/pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors or grade 1-3 meningioma, SSTR-positive on SSTR-PET imaging.
Adequate renal, hematologic and hepatic function (cohort B).
not_for: Prior radiopharmaceutical therapy, including Lu-177.
Prior solid organ or bone marrow transplant.
Use of chronic systemic steroid therapy.
Significant cardiovascular disease, resistant hypertension, or uncontrolled diabetes.
Prior liver cirrhosis, HIV, hepatitis B, or known active hepatitis C.

NCT00412594.summary_en: This study tests cladribine given with rituximab in adults with hairy cell leukemia, including cases that have come back. Cladribine is given through a vein over 2 hours on days 1 to 5, and rituximab is given through a vein once a week for 8 weeks, starting on day 28, unless the disease gets worse or side effects are unacceptable. This is a Phase II study, and the main outcome measure is not stated.
NCT00412594.summary_es: Este estudio prueba cladribina combinada con rituximab en adultos con leucemia de células pilosas, incluidos los casos que han recaído. La cladribina se administra por vena durante 2 horas los días 1 al 5, y el rituximab se administra por vena una vez por semana durante 8 semanas, a partir del día 28, a menos que la enfermedad empeore o los efectos secundarios sean inaceptables. Es un estudio de fase II, y la medida de resultado principal no está indicada.
who_for: Age 18 years or older
Hairy cell leukemia confirmed by bone marrow exam
Relapsed disease allowed if no more than one prior therapy
Women who could become pregnant must use birth control during the study
Performance status of 3 or less, with kidney, liver and bilirubin limits
not_for: Known HIV, hepatitis B or hepatitis C infection
Active infection
Cancer spread to the brain or central nervous system
New York Heart Association class III or IV heart disease
Chemotherapy in the last 4 weeks

NCT05529069.summary_en: This study tests pirtobrutinib (also called LOXO-305) given with venetoclax in adults with relapsed or refractory mantle cell lymphoma. Both study drugs are taken by mouth, and the record does not state how long treatment lasts. Study visits are weekly during Cycle 1, then on Day 1 of every cycle for the first year, then on Day 1 of every 2 cycles. The study is Phase 2, and the main outcome measure is not stated.
NCT05529069.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa pirtobrutinib (también llamado LOXO-305) combinado con venetoclax en adultos con linfoma de células del manto recidivante o refractario. Ambos medicamentos del estudio se toman por vía oral, y el registro no indica cuánto tiempo dura el tratamiento. Las visitas del estudio son semanales durante el Ciclo 1, luego el Día 1 de cada ciclo durante el primer año, y después el Día 1 de cada 2 ciclos. El estudio es de Fase 2, y la medida de resultado principal no está indicada.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with mantle cell lymphoma that has relapsed or not responded to therapy.
Lymphoma confirmed by tissue biopsy.
Able to take oral medications.
ECOG performance status of 2 or less.
Prior BTK inhibitor or anti-CD19 CAR-T therapy allowed if no prior venetoclax.
not_for: Known lymphoma involving the central nervous system, with exceptions described in the record.
History of a bleeding disorder.
Stroke or intracranial hemorrhage within 6 months of Cycle 1 Day 1.
Pregnant or breastfeeding.
Known uncontrolled HIV infection, with conditions for participants with HIV listed in the record.

NCT06241456.summary_en: This study tests FT825 (also known as ONO-8250), an off-the-shelf HER2 CAR T-cell therapy, with or without monoclonal antibody therapy, in people with advanced solid tumors. FT825 is given by intravenous infusion after chemotherapy in Cycle 1, and each cycle is about 61 days; a second cycle may be considered based on safety and clinical benefit. The study measures safety, tolerability, and antitumor activity, and it is a Phase 1 study.
NCT06241456.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa FT825 (también conocido como ONO-8250), una terapia de células T CAR dirigida a HER2 de tipo disponible para uso inmediato, con o sin anticuerpos monoclonales, en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados. FT825 se administra por infusión intravenosa después de la quimioterapia en el Ciclo 1, y cada ciclo dura aproximadamente 61 días; se podría considerar un segundo ciclo según la seguridad y el beneficio clínico. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad y la actividad antitumoral, y es un estudio de Fase 1.
who_for: Histopathological or cytologic confirmation of locally advanced or metastatic cancer that meets protocol criteria.
Disease not amenable to curative therapy.
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
Measurable disease by RECIST 1.1 within 28 days before first study treatment.
Anticipated life expectancy of at least 3 months.
not_for: Women who are pregnant or breastfeeding.
Known active central nervous system involvement by cancer.
Prior CAR T-cell therapy, other cellular therapy, or a Fate iPSC product.
Current or past interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis requiring steroids, or suspected and not ruled out by imaging.
Active or past autoimmune disease or immune deficiency.

NCT05456256.summary_en: This Phase II study tests LP-300 given with carboplatin and pemetrexed in people who have never smoked and have advanced lung adenocarcinoma that has returned after treatment with tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs). LP-300, carboplatin and pemetrexed are each given by intravenous infusion over 30 minutes every 21 days for 4 to 6 cycles, with the number of cycles set by the investigator. The study measures progression-free survival and overall survival.
NCT05456256.summary_es: Este estudio de fase II evalúa LP-300 administrado con carboplatino y pemetrexed en personas que nunca han fumado y tienen adenocarcinoma de pulmón avanzado que reapareció después de tratamiento con inhibidores de tirosina cinasa (TKI). LP-300, carboplatino y pemetrexed se administran cada uno por infusión intravenosa durante 30 minutos cada 21 días, por 4 a 6 ciclos, y el investigador determina el número de ciclos. El estudio mide la supervivencia libre de progresión y la supervivencia global.
who_for: Inoperable stage III or IV lung adenocarcinoma with a specific actionable genomic alteration.
Never smoker, or fewer than 100 cigarette-equivalents in lifetime (some former smokers may be considered with sponsor approval).
Previously treated with TKIs and had progression, unacceptable toxicity, or cannot tolerate further TKIs.
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1, and at least 18 years of age.
Adequate blood counts, liver function and kidney function within 21 days before enrollment.
not_for: Small cell, squamous, large cell, undifferentiated, mesothelioma, or mixed lung cancer types.
Disease that progressed while on chemotherapy or immunotherapy.
Known positive for HIV, hepatitis B surface antigen, or hepatitis C.
Pregnant or breastfeeding.
Heart events within 6 months, or QTcF above 470 msec.

NCT02843945.summary_en: This study tests the CivaSheet, a flat, low-dose-rate (LDR) directional radiation implant, combined with external beam radiation for pancreatic cancer that is borderline resectable or locally advanced. The sheet is placed during surgery, either a Whipple procedure or a distal pancreatectomy, and how long it stays in place or how often it is given is not stated. The study measures local control and the preferred method of attaching the sheet, and it is a Phase 1/Phase 2 study.
NCT02843945.summary_es: Este estudio prueba la CivaSheet, un implante de radiación plano de baja tasa de dosis (LDR) y direccional, combinado con radioterapia de haz externo para el cáncer de páncreas que es borderline resecable o localmente avanzado. El implante se coloca durante la cirugía, ya sea un procedimiento de Whipple o una pancreatectomía distal, y no se indica cuánto tiempo permanece colocado ni con qué frecuencia se administra. El estudio mide el control local y el método preferido para fijar la lámina, y es un estudio de Fase 1/Fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 or older who signed informed consent.
Scheduled for a Whipple procedure or distal pancreatectomy.
Borderline resectable or locally advanced pancreatic adenocarcinoma, without metastatic disease.
Close surgical margins expected.
Neoadjuvant chemoradiation given 4 to 10 weeks before surgery.
not_for: Not a surgical candidate.
Other invasive cancer in the past 5 years, except basal or squamous cell skin cancer.
Candidate for percutaneous irreversible electroporation (IRE).
Recurrent or previously resected tumors.
History of alcoholism or drug abuse, or currently in other clinical trials.

NCT07867002.summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares one year versus two years of maintenance anti-PD-1 immunotherapy (pembrolizumab or dostarlimab) in people with advanced, metastatic, or recurrent endometrial cancer who have finished chemoimmunotherapy. Participants are randomized 1:1 to receive either one year or two years of maintenance anti-PD-1 therapy, and the route and dosing frequency are not stated. The main outcome is progression-free survival, followed for at least 3 years from randomization; overall survival and immune-related adverse events are secondary outcomes.
NCT07867002.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 compara un año frente a dos años de inmunoterapia anti-PD-1 de mantenimiento (pembrolizumab o dostarlimab) en personas con cáncer endometrial avanzado, metastásico o recurrente que terminaron la quimioinmunoterapia. Los participantes se asignan al azar en proporción 1:1 a recibir un año o dos años de terapia anti-PD-1 de mantenimiento, y la vía de administración y la frecuencia de dosis no se indican. El resultado principal es la supervivencia libre de progresión, con seguimiento de al menos 3 años desde la aleatorización; la supervivencia global y los eventos adversos relacionados con la inmunidad son resultados secundarios.
who_for: Age 18 or older at consent.
Advanced stage III or IV, or recurrent endometrial cancer.
Histological or cytological confirmation of any endometrial cancer subtype, including carcinosarcoma.
Completed standard carboplatin/taxol plus anti-PD-1 therapy, with a plan for maintenance anti-PD-1 therapy.
not_for: Tumors with unknown mismatch repair protein status.
Receiving other anticancer drugs such as bevacizumab, lenvatinib, or progestins, beyond chemo given with PD-1 drug at maintenance start.

NCT05489211.summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests datopotamab deruxtecan (Dato-DXd), alone and with other anticancer drugs, in adults with advanced or metastatic solid tumours, including endometrial, gastric, prostate, ovarian, colorectal, urothelial, and biliary tract cancers. Dato-DXd is given by intravenous (IV) infusion, and some study arms add oral capecitabine, oral prednisone/prednisolone, or other IV drugs; how long or how often is not stated. The record does not state a main outcome measure, but the study aims to look at safety, tolerability, and anti-tumour activity.
NCT05489211.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa el datopotamab deruxtecan (Dato-DXd), solo y con otros medicamentos contra el cáncer, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados o metastásicos, incluidos los cánceres endometrial, gástrico, de próstata, de ovario, colorrectal, urotelial y de vías biliares. El Dato-DXd se administra por infusión intravenosa (IV), y algunos grupos del estudio agregan capecitabina oral, prednisona/prednisolona oral u otros medicamentos IV; la duración o la frecuencia no están indicadas. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal, pero el estudio busca evaluar la seguridad, la tolerabilidad y la actividad antitumoral.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with documented advanced or metastatic cancer
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1 with no decline in the 2 weeks before dosing
Must provide a tumour sample for tissue analysis
At least one measurable lesion not previously irradiated (prostate substudy allows non-measurable bone disease)
Minimum life expectancy of 12 weeks
not_for: Prior treatment with TROP2-directed therapy or an antibody-drug conjugate with a deruxtecan payload
Brain metastases or spinal cord compression, unless treated
History of non-infectious interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis that needed steroids
Active hepatitis B or C, or uncontrolled infection needing IV treatment
Pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning pregnancy

NCT07319871.summary_en: Pasritamig (JNJ-78278343) is being tested with JNJ-86974680 in men with advanced prostate cancer that has spread and no longer responds to castration (metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer). Pasritamig is given intravenously and JNJ-86974680 is given orally; how often and for how long are not stated. The study aims to find the recommended phase 2 combination dose in Part 1 and to measure safety and tolerability in Part 2; it is a Phase 1b study.
NCT07319871.summary_es: Pasritamig (JNJ-78278343) se está probando junto con JNJ-86974680 en hombres con cáncer de próstata avanzado que se ha diseminado y ya no responde a la castración (cáncer de próstata metastásico resistente a la castración). Pasritamig se administra por vía intravenosa y JNJ-86974680 por vía oral; la frecuencia y la duración no se indican. El estudio busca identificar la dosis combinada recomendada para fase 2 en la Parte 1 y medir la seguridad y la tolerabilidad en la Parte 2; es un estudio de fase 1b.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older.
Metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer that has spread to bone, lymph nodes, or both.
Prior orchiectomy, or ongoing GnRH analog hormone therapy throughout treatment.
PSA of 2 ng/mL or higher at screening.
Measurable or evaluable disease and ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
not_for: Primary small cell, carcinoid, or pure neuroendocrine carcinoma of the prostate.
Side effects from prior cancer therapy not recovered to grade 1 or lower, or baseline.
Known allergy or intolerance to components of either study drug.
Active infection needing systemic antibiotics within 7 days before first dose, or leptomeningeal disease or untreated brain metastases.
Serious medical conditions or other issues that would impair treatment, consent, or study assessments, in the investigator's opinion.

NCT05947851.summary_en: This study compares nemtabrutinib plus venetoclax with venetoclax plus rituximab in adults with relapsed or refractory chronic lymphocytic leukemia or small lymphocytic lymphoma. Nemtabrutinib and venetoclax are given as daily oral tablets in 4-week cycles, with venetoclax starting at Cycle 2 Day 1, for up to 2 years or until progression or discontinuation. The main outcome is progression-free survival by iwCLL 2018 criteria, as assessed by blinded independent central review.
NCT05947851.summary_es: Este estudio compara nemtabrutinib más venetoclax con venetoclax más rituximab en adultos con leucemia linfocítica crónica o linfoma linfocítico de pequeñas células recidivante o refractario. Nemtabrutinib y venetoclax se administran como tabletas orales diarias en ciclos de 4 semanas, y el venetoclax comienza en el Ciclo 2 Día 1, durante hasta 2 años o hasta la progresión o la suspensión. El resultado principal es la supervivencia libre de progresión según los criterios iwCLL 2018, evaluada por revisión central independiente y ciega.
who_for: Confirmed CLL or SLL with active disease that is clearly documented as needing treatment.
Relapsed or refractory after at least 1 prior available therapy.
Has at least 1 marker of disease burden.
ECOG performance status of 0 to 2 and life expectancy of at least 3 months.
Able to swallow and retain oral medication.
not_for: Active hepatitis B or hepatitis C virus infection.
Richter transformation or active central nervous system involvement by CLL/SLL.
Another malignancy that is progressing or needed active treatment within the past 2 years.
Clinically significant cardiovascular disease.
Prior BCL2 inhibitor within 12 months before randomization.

NCT07326566.summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests silevertinib, an oral EGFR inhibitor, combined with temozolomide in people with newly diagnosed glioblastoma. Silevertinib is taken by mouth once daily with temozolomide on days 1 to 5 of each 28-day cycle; silevertinib continues until disease progression, and temozolomide is given for a maximum of 6 cycles. The study measures whether participants live longer without disease progression compared with temozolomide alone, as stated in the brief summary; a separate primary outcome measure is not stated.
NCT07326566.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa silevertinib, un inhibidor oral de EGFR, combinado con temozolomida en personas con glioblastoma de diagnóstico reciente. Silevertinib se toma por vía oral una vez al día junto con temozolomida los días 1 a 5 de cada ciclo de 28 días; silevertinib continúa hasta la progresión de la enfermedad, y la temozolomida se administra por un máximo de 6 ciclos. El estudio mide si los participantes viven más tiempo sin progresión de la enfermedad en comparación con la temozolomida sola, según se indica en el resumen breve; un desenlace primario separado no se indica.
who_for: Newly diagnosed glioblastoma that is IDH wild type, confirmed by tissue examination
Positive EGFR status in the brain tumor; EGFRvIII and unmethylated MGMT promoter required for Part 2
Surgery followed by standard radiation (54 to 60 Gy) and temozolomide, with no other treatment for newly diagnosed GBM
At least 4 weeks since radiation ended, with a post-radiation MRI showing no progression
not_for: Recurrent multifocal, metastatic, leptomeningeal, or extracranial GBM, or gliomatosis cerebri
Progression of GBM before enrollment, screening, or randomization, or biopsy-only without resectional surgery
Prior or planned treatment for GBM with an EGFR-targeting agent, bevacizumab, chemotherapy, immunotherapy, experimental therapy, or intratumoral therapy
Intent to use Optune (TTF), significant uncontrolled health conditions, or other malignancies

NCT04812366.summary_en: This phase 2 study tests whether treatment chosen by genomic testing of prostate tumor tissue improves clinical response in high-risk localized prostate cancer. All participants first receive a luteinizing hormone-releasing hormone agonist (LHRHa) plus apalutamide for 8 weeks while genomic testing is done, then are assigned to arms that add other drugs, given by mouth or by infusion for periods that vary by arm. The study measures response rate and outcomes after radical prostatectomy in each arm.
NCT04812366.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa si un tratamiento elegido según las pruebas genómicas del tejido tumoral de próstata mejora la respuesta clínica en el cáncer de próstata localizado de alto riesgo. Todos los participantes reciben primero un agonista de la hormona liberadora de la hormona luteinizante (LHRHa) más apalutamida durante 8 semanas, mientras se realizan las pruebas genómicas; después, según los resultados, se asignan a brazos que añaden otros medicamentos, administrados por vía oral o por infusión durante periodos que varían según el brazo. El estudio mide la tasa de respuesta y los resultados después de la prostatectomía radical en cada brazo.
who_for: Men 18 years or older with high-risk localized prostate cancer based on biopsy criteria
No prior systemic or localized prostate cancer treatment, except up to 12 weeks of LHRHa or bicalutamide
ECOG performance status 0 or 1 and life expectancy of 3 years or more
Archival tumor tissue available for genetic analysis, with consent to testing
not_for: Stage T4 prostate cancer by exam or imaging
Metastatic disease (M1) on conventional imaging or PSMA-PET, with an oligometastatic exception
Prior androgen deprivation, chemotherapy, surgery, or radiation for prostate cancer
Uncontrolled hypertension or diabetes, or certain recent serious heart conditions
Inability to swallow oral medicines or GI disease that may significantly alter drug absorption

NCT07357519.summary_en: This study tests LNTH-2403, a monoclonal antibody that targets LRRC15 and is labeled with lutetium-177, in people with relapsed or refractory osteosarcoma. In the dose-finding phase, the drug is given once every 8 weeks, and other schedules may be explored based on dosimetry, pharmacokinetic, safety, and tolerability data; the route of administration is not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, how the drug moves through the body, radiation dose, and early signs of anti-cancer activity.
NCT07357519.summary_es: Este estudio prueba LNTH-2403, un anticuerpo monoclonal dirigido a LRRC15 y marcado con lutecio-177, en personas con osteosarcoma recidivante o refractario. En la fase de búsqueda de dosis, el medicamento se administra una vez cada 8 semanas, y podrían explorarse otros esquemas según los datos de dosimetría, farmacocinética, seguridad y tolerancia; la vía de administración no se indica. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerancia, cómo se mueve el medicamento en el cuerpo, la dosis de radiación y las primeras señales de actividad contra el cáncer.
who_for: Relapsed or refractory osteosarcoma confirmed by tumor pathology.
Measurable or evaluable disease, or bone-only disease that is FDG-PET avid.
Age 12 or older in later cohorts; 18 or older for the first Phase 1 cohort.
ECOG performance status 0 to 2 or Lansky score of 50 or more, and weight of 30 kg or more.
Disease progression after at least one course of chemotherapy.
not_for: Known allergy or intolerance to LNTH-2403 or its excipients.
Concurrent anti-cancer treatment, including localized radiation therapy.
Participation in another interventional study of an investigational agent.
Known active infection or known HIV positive status.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or major surgery within 28 days of the first dose.

NCT05504707.summary_en: This phase 1 study tests an investigational dendritic cell vaccine, primed with HER2 or HER3, in people with early-stage triple negative breast cancer or HR-low positive breast cancer. Participants receive 8 ultrasound-guided injections into the tumor, given twice per week and alternating HER2-primed and HER3-primed cells, together with standard of care chemotherapy drugs. The study measures the maximum tolerated dose (MTD) of the vaccine.
NCT05504707.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa una vacuna experimental de células dendríticas, activadas con HER2 o HER3, en personas con cáncer de mama triple negativo en etapa temprana o cáncer de mama con bajo nivel de receptores hormonales positivo. Los participantes reciben 8 inyecciones en el tumor guiadas por ultrasonido, dos veces por semana, alternando células activadas con HER2 y células activadas con HER3, junto con medicamentos de quimioterapia estándar. El estudio mide la dosis máxima tolerada (MTD) de la vacuna.
who_for: Diagnosis of HER2-negative breast cancer
Tumor is HR-negative or HR-low positive
Early-stage tumor size and lymph node criteria as stated in the record
Medically and surgically able to receive neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by standard local therapy
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 or 1
not_for: Prior anthracycline-based chemotherapy for any cancer
Inflammatory breast cancer
Active autoimmune disease, or chronic systemic corticosteroid use of one month or more
History of HIV, or hepatitis B or C infection
Prior treatment with any HER2- or HER3-primed dendritic cell therapy

NCT06287229.summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study is testing brexucabtagene autoleucel in adults with relapsed or refractory B-cell acute lymphocytic leukemia, and in some adults with newly diagnosed high-risk B-cell acute lymphocytic leukemia. Participants first receive cytoreductive therapy with inotuzumab ozogamicin, blinatumomab, and either hyper-CVAD or mini-hyper-CVD, then lymphodepletion chemotherapy and one dose of brexucabtagene autoleucel; how long or how often is not stated. The study aims to learn about safety and whether it can help control the disease; a primary outcome measure is not stated.
NCT06287229.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa brexucabtagene autoleucel en adultos con leucemia linfoblástica aguda de células B recidivante o refractaria, y en algunos adultos con leucemia linfoblástica aguda de células B de alto riesgo recién diagnosticada. Primero, los participantes reciben terapia citorreductora con inotuzumab ozogamicina, blinatumomab y hyper-CVAD o mini-hyper-CVD, luego quimioterapia de linfodepleción y una dosis de brexucabtagene autoleucel; la duración o la frecuencia no se indican. El estudio busca conocer la seguridad y si puede ayudar a controlar la enfermedad; el resultado principal no se indica.
who_for: Age 18 or older with relapsed or refractory B-cell ALL.
Or newly diagnosed high-risk B-cell ALL with listed genetic features.
Performance status of 0, 1, or 2.
Adequate kidney, liver and bilirubin levels, as defined in the record.
CD19 expression above 50% before enrollment.
not_for: Philadelphia positive B-cell ALL.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or a woman who could become pregnant without a negative pregnancy test.
Prior brexu-cel or other anti-CD19 CAR T cell therapy.
Active and uncontrolled disease or infection, as judged by the treating physician.
Unable or unwilling to sign consent, or receiving other investigational therapy within 14 days.

NCT05922501.summary_en: This phase II study tests isatuximab, belantamab mafodotin, pomalidomide, and dexamethasone together in relapsed and refractory multiple myeloma. Isatuximab and belantamab mafodotin are given into a vein, and pomalidomide and dexamethasone are taken by mouth; each cycle is 28 days. The study measures overall response rate.
NCT05922501.summary_es: Este estudio de fase II evalúa isatuximab, belantamab mafodotina, pomalidomida y dexametasona juntos en mieloma múltiple recidivante y refractario. Isatuximab y belantamab mafodotina se administran por vena, y la pomalidomida y la dexametasona se toman por vía oral; cada ciclo dura 28 días. El estudio mide la tasa de respuesta global.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older.
ECOG performance status of 2 or lower.
Relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma after at least one prior line of therapy.
Prior lenalidomide and proteasome inhibitor therapy, with disease progression on or within 60 days of last therapy.
Blood counts, kidney, and liver function within limits set by the study.
not_for: Prior anti-CD38 antibody therapy within six months.
Any prior anti-BCMA therapy.
Primary refractory disease.
Pregnancy, lactation, or planned breastfeeding.
Active plasma cell leukemia, POEMS syndrome, or primary AL amyloidosis.

NCT06158828.summary_en: This phase I/II pilot study tests memory-like natural killer (ML NK) cells given after a TCRαβ-depleted haploidentical stem cell transplant in people with high-risk acute myeloid leukemia (AML). Patients receive conditioning drugs before a donor stem cell graft on day 0, ML NK cells on day +7, and IL-2 under the skin on 7 doses every other day through day +19. The study's main objective is to establish the safety and feasibility of generating and infusing ML NK cells.
NCT06158828.summary_es: Este estudio piloto de fase I/II evalúa las células asesinas naturales de memoria (ML NK) administradas después de un trasplante de células madre haploidénticas con depleción de linfocitos T TCRαβ, en personas con leucemia mieloide aguda (LMA) de alto riesgo. Los pacientes reciben medicamentos de acondicionamiento antes de un injerto de células madre del donante el día 0, células ML NK el día +7 e IL-2 por vía subcutánea en 7 dosis, cada dos días, hasta el día +19. El objetivo principal del estudio es establecer la seguridad y la viabilidad de generar y administrar las células ML NK.
who_for: Adults up to 40 years old with high-risk AML in remission, morphologic leukemia-free state, or refractory or multiply relapsed disease.
Karnofsky (age 16 and older) or Lansky (under 16) performance status above 60%.
Adequate liver, kidney, heart and lung function, as defined in the criteria.
Has an available familial haploidentical donor willing to give two leukapheresis collections.
Able to give informed consent, or has a guardian who can consent.
not_for: Active graft-versus-host disease, or prior GvHD without being off immunosuppression for at least 3 months.
Active non-hematologic malignancy.
Currently receiving other investigational agents at the time of transplant.
Active central nervous system or extramedullary disease.
Allergy to compounds similar to study agents, or inability to stop medicines such as glucocorticoids.

NCT06807619.summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests sotorasib in people with brain tumors that have a KRAS G12C change. Participants receive sotorasib at the FDA-recommended dose or continue their previous dose as their doctor directs, and the route, duration and frequency are not stated. The record does not name a main outcome measure; it says the study will look at how well sotorasib gets into the tumor and whether it is safe in people having surgery.
NCT06807619.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 prueba sotorasib en personas con tumores cerebrales que tienen un cambio KRAS G12C. Los participantes reciben sotorasib a la dosis recomendada por la FDA o continúan con la dosis que recibían, según indique su médico; la vía, la duración y la frecuencia no se indican. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; el estudio busca saber qué tan bien sotorasib llega al tumor cerebral y si es seguro en personas que se someten a cirugía.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with one or more brain tumors planned for surgical removal or biopsy.
People with leptomeningeal spread are eligible if they also have brain tumor needing removal or biopsy.
Karnofsky performance status of at least 60.
Life expectancy longer than 12 weeks.
Adequate blood counts, kidney, liver and clotting values within 7 days before treatment.
not_for: Known allergy or hypersensitivity to the study treatment or its excipients.
Multiple primary cancers within 3 years, with listed exceptions such as curatively treated in-situ disease.
Need for ongoing transfusions or growth factor support to keep platelets or hemoglobin at required levels.
Creatinine clearance below 30 mL/min.
Liver enzyme or bilirubin levels above the stated limits.

NCT07661095.summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests CRD3874-SI, a STING agonist, in people with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia. How the drug is given, how often, and for how long are not stated in the record. The record says the study aims to find out whether CRD3874-SI is safe, and the main outcome measure is not stated.
NCT07661095.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa CRD3874-SI, un agonista de STING, en personas con leucemia mieloide aguda recidivante o refractaria. La forma de administración, la frecuencia y la duración no se indican en el registro. El registro indica que el estudio busca saber si CRD3874-SI es seguro, y la medida de resultado principal no se indica.
who_for: Relapsed or refractory AML, using the record's stated definitions.
Age 18 years or older at consent.
Weight of at least 40 kg.
ECOG performance status of 0 to 2.
Organ function within stated limits, including ejection fraction of 50% or higher.
not_for: Acute promyelocytic leukemia or isolated myeloid sarcoma.
Blast phase of chronic myeloid leukemia or known active CNS leukemia.
Active graft versus host disease of grade 2 or higher needing systemic treatment.
Symptomatic or recently treated autoimmune disease, or clinically significant immunosuppression.
Significant cardiac disease within 6 months, or QTcF of 470 ms or higher.

NCT04747912.summary_en: This study tests adding inotuzumab ozogamicin (InO) to a treatment plan with dasatinib and other anti-cancer drugs for newly diagnosed Philadelphia chromosome-positive acute lymphoblastic leukemia. Treatment is given in 28-day courses, with the first phase lasting 60 days, and 84 days of maintenance treatment follow if complete molecular remission has not been reached. The study looks at whether adding InO leads to quicker complete molecular remission, meaning no detectable disease on very sensitive tests; the formal outcome measure is not stated. It is a Phase 2 study.
NCT04747912.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa agregar inotuzumab ozogamicina (InO) a un plan de tratamiento con dasatinib y otros medicamentos contra el cáncer, para leucemia linfoblástica aguda Filadelfia positiva recién diagnosticada. El tratamiento se administra en ciclos de 28 días; la primera fase dura 60 días, y si no se alcanza la remisión molecular completa, siguen 84 días de tratamiento de mantenimiento. El estudio busca saber si agregar InO lleva a una remisión molecular completa más rápida, es decir, sin enfermedad detectable con pruebas muy sensibles; la medida de resultado formal no se indica. Es un estudio de fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older
Newly diagnosed, untreated Ph+ B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia
CD22 expression on at least 20% of blasts
At least 20% lymphoblasts in bone marrow, with BCR-ABL1 shown by FISH or PCR
ECOG performance status 0 to 2
not_for: Active leukemia in the central nervous system
Prior therapy for ALL, apart from limited steroids, hydroxyurea, or one intrathecal dose
Current or chronic hepatitis B or C, or HIV unless viral load is undetectable
Chronic liver disease, cirrhosis, or suspected alcohol abuse
Uncontrolled cardiac disease or QTcF above 500 msec

NCT07250477.summary_en: This phase 2 study tests risk-adapted systemic therapy guided by the PROphet CB proteomic assay and the CARG-TT assessment, compared with standard biomarker testing followed by standard first-line treatment, in people with previously untreated advanced non-small cell lung cancer. The trial chooses the immune checkpoint inhibitor-based treatment according to the PROphet CB and CARG-TT results, and how it is given and for how long are not stated. The main outcome is 12-month progression-free survival.
NCT07250477.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa un tratamiento sistémico adaptado al riesgo, guiado por la prueba proteómica PROphet CB y la evaluación CARG-TT, comparado con la prueba estándar de biomarcadores seguida del tratamiento estándar de primera línea, en personas con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas avanzado que no han recibido tratamiento sistémico previo. El estudio elige el tratamiento a base de inhibidores de puntos de control inmunitarios según los resultados de PROphet CB y CARG-TT; la forma de administración y la duración no se indican. El resultado principal es la supervivencia libre de progresión a los 12 meses.
who_for: Histologically confirmed non-small cell lung cancer that is metastatic or unresectable (stage IIIC or IV).
Age 18 years or older at the time of consent.
ECOG performance status 2 or better (Karnofsky 50% or higher).
Able to understand and sign the informed consent form.
Stated ability and willingness to follow all protocol requirements.
not_for: Tumor with a known sensitizing change in ALK, EGFR, HER2, MET exon 14, NTRK, RET, or ROS1.
Medical conditions that rule out immune checkpoint inhibitor-based therapy, per the treating investigator.
Prior systemic therapy for metastatic stage IIIC or IV non-small cell lung cancer.
Any condition the investigator judges would interfere with safety or ability to comply with the study.

NCT07354919.summary_en: This phase II trial tests axelopran, an oral capsule, in adults with advanced breast, lung, pancreas, or prostate cancer who are taking opioid pain medicine. Participants take axelopran capsules by mouth once daily for up to 1 year, or longer if they are deriving benefit. The main outcome is whether axelopran affects cancer control, measured through day 43 (6 weeks) with repeat imaging.
NCT07354919.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase II prueba axelopran, una cápsula oral, en adultos con cáncer de mama, de pulmón, de páncreas o de próstata avanzado que toman medicamentos opioides para el dolor. Los participantes toman las cápsulas de axelopran por vía oral una vez al día durante hasta 1 año, o más tiempo si obtienen beneficio. El resultado principal es si axelopran afecta el control del cáncer, medido hasta el día 43 (6 semanas) con estudios de imagen repetidos.
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older.
Advanced breast, lung (non-small cell), pancreas, or prostate cancer that has relapsed or progressed after standard treatment including chemotherapy.
Current opioid use averaging at least 5 mg OME per day over the past 3 days.
At least one measurable lesion meeting RECIST v1.1 criteria.
Life expectancy of at least 2 months at screening.
not_for: Previous gastrointestinal surgery, except uncomplicated appendectomy or cholecystectomy.
Fecal incontinence, irritable bowel syndrome, inflammatory bowel disease, or intestinal obstruction.
Current, active, untreated brain metastases.
Recent use of certain medicines, such as naloxone, buprenorphine, or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women, or women of childbearing potential not using birth control.

NCT06395519.summary_en: This two-part Phase 1/2 study tests the drug ETX-19477, a PARG inhibitor, in people with advanced or metastatic solid tumors such as breast, ovarian, prostate, endometrial, colorectal and gastric cancer. The drug is taken by mouth once daily, and how long treatment lasts is not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, how the body processes the drug, and anti-tumor activity, and no single primary outcome is stated.
NCT06395519.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2, de dos partes, evalúa el medicamento ETX-19477, un inhibidor de PARG, en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados o metastásicos, como cáncer de mama, de ovario, de próstata, endometrial, colorrectal y gástrico. El medicamento se toma por vía oral una vez al día, y no se indica cuánto tiempo dura el tratamiento. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, cómo el cuerpo procesa el medicamento y la actividad antitumoral, y no se indica un único resultado principal.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with advanced cancer that cannot be cured by surgery.
Cancer has grown or returned after, or was not tolerated with, the most recent systemic therapy.
Has measurable disease under RECIST v1.1 criteria.
ECOG performance status 0 to 1.
Life expectancy of at least 3 months.
not_for: Primary tumors of the central nervous system.
Symptomatic brain metastases that are untreated or growing.
Resting QTcF above 470 msec on 2 or more timepoints, or a history of long QT syndrome.
Heart attack or unstable angina within 6 months, or other significant heart disease.
Taking proton pump inhibitors, strong CYP3A or P-gp inhibitors or inducers, or warfarin or other coumarin anticoagulants.

NCT05642572.summary_en: This phase II study tests capmatinib and osimertinib, with or without ramucirumab, in non-small cell lung cancer that is advanced and has EGFR and MET gene changes. Capmatinib and osimertinib are taken by mouth, and ramucirumab is given through a vein; how often and for how long are not stated. The record does not state the main outcome measure; this is a phase II study.
NCT05642572.summary_es: Este estudio de fase II prueba capmatinib y osimertinib, con o sin ramucirumab, en cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas avanzado con cambios en los genes EGFR y MET. Capmatinib y osimertinib se toman por vía oral, y ramucirumab se administra por vena; la frecuencia y la duración no se indican en el registro. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; este es un estudio de fase II.
who_for: Advanced or recurrent non-small cell lung cancer with a sensitizing EGFR mutation
Disease progressed on osimertinib, which was the most recent line of therapy
MET amplification found by a qualifying next generation sequencing test after osimertinib progression
Measurable or non-measurable disease documented by CT or MRI
Zubrod performance status 0 to 1, with blood counts and organ function within set limits
not_for: Prior treatment with an anti-VEGF, VEGFR, or MET inhibitor
Anti-cancer drug other than osimertinib within 21 days before randomization
Radiation therapy within 14 days or major surgery within 14 days before randomization
Pregnant or breastfeeding
Certain interacting drugs within 7 days before registration, or uncontrolled blood pressure

NCT06622057.summary_en: The study tests D07001 softgel capsules plus capecitabine against placebo plus capecitabine in adults with advanced biliary tract cancer that has progressed after earlier chemotherapy. D07001 capsules are taken by mouth three times a week in 21-day cycles at 60 mg or 100 mg per day, or a placebo is taken, and capecitabine is taken by mouth twice a day for 14 days of each 21-day cycle. Treatment continues until disease progression, death, withdrawal of consent, or 12 cycles, whichever occurs first, and the main outcome measured is overall survival.
NCT06622057.summary_es: El estudio evalúa las cápsulas blandas D07001 más capecitabina frente a placebo más capecitabina en adultos con cáncer de vías biliares avanzado que progresó después de quimioterapia previa. Las cápsulas D07001 se toman por vía oral tres veces por semana en ciclos de 21 días, a dosis de 60 mg o 100 mg por día, o se toma placebo, y la capecitabina se toma por vía oral dos veces al día durante 14 días de cada ciclo de 21 días. El tratamiento continúa hasta la progresión de la enfermedad, la muerte, el retiro del consentimiento o 12 ciclos, lo que ocurra primero, y el resultado principal medido es la supervivencia global.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic biliary tract cancer.
Measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 on central review.
Prior gemcitabine plus cisplatin-based chemotherapy failed, and FOLFOX or irinotecan plus fluorouracil failed or was refused.
ECOG performance status of 0 to 2 and life expectancy of at least 12 weeks.
Blood count, liver, kidney and clotting results within the levels specified in the record.
not_for: Active cancer other than biliary tract cancer within the past 2 years, with some exceptions.
Known brain or leptomeningeal metastases.
Grade 2 or higher residual toxicity from prior chemotherapy or chemoradiation.
Gastrointestinal conditions or surgery that would significantly impede oral drug absorption.
Uncontrolled heart disease, active uncontrolled infection, or other serious condition judged by the investigator to preclude safe participation.

NCT07365995.summary_en: This Phase 3 trial tests BNT324 against docetaxel with prednisone or prednisolone in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. BNT324 and docetaxel are given by intravenous infusion, and prednisone or prednisolone is taken by mouth; how often and for how long is not stated. The study measures radiographic progression-free survival and overall survival.
NCT07365995.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 3 compara BNT324 con docetaxel junto con prednisona o prednisolona en el cáncer de próstata metastásico resistente a la castración. BNT324 y docetaxel se administran por infusión intravenosa, y la prednisona o prednisolona se toma por vía oral; la frecuencia y la duración no se indican. El estudio mide la supervivencia libre de progresión radiográfica y la supervivencia global.
who_for: Adult men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer that has progressed.
Progression shown by rising PSA, soft tissue spread on imaging, or bone disease progression.
Prior treatment with one or two androgen receptor pathway inhibitors, with progression during or after at least 8 weeks.
No prior chemotherapy for metastatic castration-resistant disease, including taxane-based chemotherapy.
Castrate-level testosterone with ongoing hormone therapy or prior orchiectomy; ECOG performance score 0 or 1.
not_for: Prior treatment with B7-H3 targeted therapy, including B7-H3 antibody-drug conjugates.
Uncontrolled or significant cardiovascular disease, as defined in the protocol.
History of non-infectious interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis that needed steroids.
Current interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis.
Other protocol-defined criteria apply; details not stated.

NCT05735080.summary_en: INX-315, an oral CDK2 inhibitor, is being tested in adults with advanced or metastatic cancer, including hormone receptor positive, HER2-negative breast cancer that progressed after a CDK4/6 inhibitor, and CCNE1-amplified solid tumors such as ovarian cancer. INX-315 is taken by mouth, alone or with fulvestrant (given as an injection into muscle) or abemaciclib (taken by mouth); how long or how often is not stated. This Phase 1/2 study measures safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and preliminary antitumor activity.
NCT05735080.summary_es: INX-315, un inhibidor oral de CDK2, se está probando en adultos con cáncer avanzado o metastásico, incluido cáncer de mama con receptores hormonales positivos y HER2 negativo que progresó después de un inhibidor de CDK4/6, y tumores sólidos con amplificación de CCNE1, como el cáncer de ovario. INX-315 se toma por vía oral, solo o con fulvestrant (administrado como inyección intramuscular) o abemaciclib (por vía oral); la duración o la frecuencia no se indican. Este estudio de fase 1/2 mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética y la actividad antitumoral preliminar.
who_for: Advanced or metastatic HR+/HER2- breast cancer that progressed after a CDK4/6 inhibitor
Platinum-resistant or platinum-refractory high grade serous ovarian, fallopian tube, or peritoneal cancer with CCNE1 amplification that progressed after standar
Advanced solid tumor with CCNE1 amplification that progressed after standard therapy or where standard therapy was not tolerated or not suitable
At least one measurable lesion that has not been irradiated
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1 and adequate blood, kidney, and liver test results
not_for: Previous treatment with a CDK2, CDK4/6, or CDK2/4/6 inhibitor
Brain metastases or spinal cord compression with progressive symptoms or a need for steroids
Resting QTcF above 470 msec or a history of prolonged QT syndrome
Uncontrolled cardiovascular disease, including hypertension
Other cancer history (with listed exceptions), HIV, or active uncontrolled infection, including hepatitis B or C

NCT06915246.summary_en: This study compares two forms of carmustine, VI-0609 (carmustine with propylene glycol) and BiCNU (carmustine with ethanol), as part of BEAM chemotherapy before autologous stem cell transplant in people with lymphoma. The record does not state the route, the dose, or how long or how often the drugs are given. The main outcome is not stated; the study is a randomized Phase 2 study.
NCT06915246.summary_es: Este estudio compara dos formas de carmustina, VI-0609 (carmustina con propilenglicol) y BiCNU (carmustina con etanol), como parte de la quimioterapia BEAM antes de un trasplante autólogo de células madre en personas con linfoma. El registro no indica la vía, la dosis, ni cuánto tiempo o con qué frecuencia se administran los medicamentos. El resultado principal no se indica; el estudio es un estudio aleatorizado de fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with a life expectancy of at least 6 months.
Confirmed Hodgkin or non-Hodgkin lymphoma.
Candidate for autologous transplant, with a complete or partial response to prior treatment.
Karnofsky performance status of at least 70%.
Has collected at least 2.0 x 10^6 CD34 cells/kg, with heart and lung function within study limits.
not_for: Prior high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell transplant, or prior allogeneic transplant.
Any active cancer other than lymphoma, or other cancer in remission less than 5 years.
Myelodysplasia or a bone marrow abnormality linked to myelodysplasia.
More than 10% lymphoma in the bone marrow after salvage therapy and before stem cell collection.
Active hepatitis B or C, HBsAg positive, or positive HIV antibody.

NCT06395402.summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests whether dosing lutetium Lu 177 dotatate (Lutathera) based on individualized dosimetry improves treatment outcomes compared with standard dosing, in adults with unresectable neuroendocrine tumors. The drug is given into a vein once every 8 weeks for up to 4 cycles, with cycle 1 at 200 mCi and later cycles based on radiation dosimetry, and participants are randomized to standard or individualized dosing. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is listed as Phase 2.
NCT06395402.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 busca saber si dosificar lutetium Lu 177 dotatate (Lutathera) según dosimetría individualizada mejora los resultados del tratamiento en comparación con la dosis estándar, en adultos con tumores neuroendocrinos no resecables. El medicamento se administra por vena cada 8 semanas, hasta 4 ciclos; el ciclo 1 es de 200 mCi y los siguientes se basan en la dosimetría de radiación, y los participantes son asignados al azar a dosis estándar o individualizada. El resultado principal no está indicado en el registro; el estudio aparece como fase 2.
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older who signed informed consent
Well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumor with Ki-67 of 20% or less, believed to be gastroenteropancreatic origin
Disease at least 1.5 cm on CT or MRI with SSTR2 PET uptake above liver background, scan within 90 days
Recommended Lutathera for unresectable or metastatic neuroendocrine disease
ECOG 0 or 1, or Karnofsky of 70 or higher, with normal neutrophil and platelet counts within 28 days
not_for: Pregnant or breastfeeding individuals
Prior peptide-receptor radiotherapy (PRRT)
Prior external beam kidney radiation dose above 10 Gy
Uncontrolled illness, including active infection or unstable heart conditions
Surgery, radiation, or chemotherapy within 4 weeks, or allergy to similar compounds to Octreoscan or Netspot

NCT07189195.summary_en: This phase 1 study tests TR-002, a drug given into a vein, in people with advanced or metastatic solid tumors and in people with treatment-refractory pancreatic adenocarcinoma. TR-002 is given as an intravenous infusion over 1 hour on days 1, 8, 15 and 22 of each 28-day cycle, and cycles repeat if the disease does not progress and side effects are acceptable. The study measures safety, side effects and the best dose of TR-002.
NCT07189195.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa TR-002, un medicamento que se administra en una vena, en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados o metastásicos y en personas con adenocarcinoma de páncreas refractario al tratamiento. TR-002 se administra como infusión intravenosa durante 1 hora los días 1, 8, 15 y 22 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y los ciclos se repiten si la enfermedad no progresa y los efectos secundarios son aceptables. El estudio mide la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la dosis óptima de TR-002.
who_for: Aged 18 or older at the time of consent.
Metastatic or unresectable solid tumor for which standard treatments no longer work or are not tolerated.
Expansion cohort: metastatic or unresectable pancreatic adenocarcinoma refractory or intolerant to standard treatments.
Heart function with left ventricular ejection fraction above 50%, and ECOG performance status of 2 or less.
Blood counts, liver and kidney function within the limits stated in the record.
not_for: Pregnant or breastfeeding, or of reproductive potential and not using effective contraception.
Heart attack or unstable angina within 6 months, or stroke or TIA within 6 months.
NYHA Class II or greater heart failure, certain heart rhythm problems, or QTc above 470 msec.
Active bacterial, fungal, or viral infection.
Known hypersensitivity to 4-aminoquinolone compounds, retinal or visual field changes, psoriasis, porphyria, G6PD deficiency, or seizure disorder.

NCT02074839.summary_en: The study tests AG-120, a drug taken by mouth, in advanced blood cancers that have an IDH1 mutation. AG-120 is taken once every day of a 28-day cycle, and treatment continues until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity, or stem cell transplant. This Phase I study evaluates safety, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics and clinical activity, and a primary outcome measure is not stated.
NCT02074839.summary_es: El estudio evalúa AG-120, un medicamento que se toma por vía oral, en cánceres de la sangre avanzados que tienen una mutación de IDH1. AG-120 se toma una vez al día durante cada ciclo de 28 días, y el tratamiento continúa hasta que la enfermedad progrese, aparezca una toxicidad inaceptable o se realice un trasplante de células madre. Este estudio de Fase I evalúa la seguridad, la farmacocinética, la farmacodinamia y la actividad clínica, y no se indica una medida de resultado principal.
who_for: Age 18 years or older.
Advanced blood cancer with an IDH1 R132 gene mutation.
Able to have repeated bone marrow biopsies and blood and urine samples taken.
ECOG performance status 0 to 2.
Platelet count at least 20,000/µL (transfusions allowed).
not_for: Stem cell transplant within 60 days, or on immunosuppressive therapy, or with significant graft-versus-host disease.
Anticancer therapy or radiotherapy within 14 days, or an investigational agent within 14 days (hydroxyurea allowed).
Pregnant or breastfeeding.
Heart failure NYHA class III or IV, LVEF below 40%, or heart attack within 6 months.
Known HIV, active hepatitis B or C, or known or suspected active leukemia in the central nervous system.

NCT04883437.summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests acalabrutinib plus obinutuzumab in adults with untreated follicular lymphoma or other indolent non-Hodgkin lymphomas. Acalabrutinib is taken by mouth twice a day on days 1-28 of each 28-day cycle, and obinutuzumab is given by IV on days 1, 8, and 15 of cycle 3 and on day 1 of cycles 4-8, for up to 12 cycles if the disease does not progress and side effects are acceptable. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is a Phase 2 trial.
NCT04883437.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa acalabrutinib junto con obinutuzumab en adultos con linfoma folicular no tratado u otros linfomas no Hodgkin indolentes. El acalabrutinib se toma por vía oral dos veces al día durante los días 1 a 28 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y el obinutuzumab se administra por vía intravenosa los días 1, 8 y 15 del ciclo 3 y el día 1 de los ciclos 4 a 8, por hasta 12 ciclos si la enfermedad no progresa y los efectos secundarios son aceptables. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es un ensayo de fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older.
Previously untreated follicular lymphoma grade 1 to 3a, or certain other indolent B-cell lymphomas or mantle cell lymphoma, in the listed scenarios.
Measurable or assessable disease, such as a node or site of at least 1.5 cm, or bone marrow or blood involvement that can be reassessed.
ECOG performance status of 0 to 2.
Agrees to use contraception and is willing to complete all study evaluations.
not_for: Histologically transformed or co-existing high-grade or aggressive non-Hodgkin lymphoma.
Confirmed active or prior central nervous system disease.
Prior lymphoma-directed therapy or prior antibody-based therapy, with listed exceptions.
Clinically significant heart disease, or stroke or intracranial hemorrhage within 6 months.
Active bleeding, or a bleeding disorder, or uncontrolled AIHA or ITP.

NCT06679829.summary_en: This study compares siltuximab plus melphalan dosed by population pharmacokinetics (PK) with the usual melphalan dosing based on body surface area, in adults aged 60 or older with multiple myeloma who are having an autologous stem cell transplant. Siltuximab (11 mg/kg) is given 7 days before and 14 days after the stem cell infusion (plus or minus 2 days), and melphalan is infused over 30 minutes on Day -2. The record does not state a primary outcome measure; it says the study will compare how well the treatments work, look at symptoms after transplant, and study the safety of siltuximab. This is a Phase 2 randomized trial.
NCT06679829.summary_es: Este estudio compara siltuximab más melfalán dosificado según la farmacocinética poblacional (PK) con la dosificación habitual de melfalán basada en la superficie corporal, en adultos de 60 años o más con mieloma múltiple que se someten a un trasplante autólogo de células madre. El siltuximab (11 mg/kg) se administra 7 días antes y 14 días después de la infusión de células madre (más o menos 2 días), y el melfalán se infunde durante 30 minutos el Día -2. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; señala que el estudio comparará qué tan bien funcionan los tratamientos, observará los síntomas después del trasplante y estudiará la seguridad del siltuximab. Es un ensayo aleatorizado de Fase 2.
who_for: Age 60 years or older
Symptomatic multiple myeloma planned for autologous stem cell transplant with melphalan 140 or 200 mg/m2
At least 3 million CD34+ cells/kg available for infusion
Performance status: Karnofsky above 60% or ECOG 0-2
Organ function tests within 6 weeks before enrollment, including heart ejection fraction above 45% and adequate lung, blood count, liver and kidney values
not_for: Prior treatment with agents that target IL-6 or the IL-6 receptor
Other cancer within the past 2 years, with some skin and cervical cancer exceptions
Uncontrolled heart failure, uncontrolled arrhythmia, or QTc above 460 ms, or recent heart intervention
Clinically significant infection, including active hepatitis B or uncontrolled HIV or hepatitis C
Investigational drug use within 14 days, or live attenuated vaccine within 4 weeks of first study drug

NCT04332874.summary_en: This study tests pembrolizumab given with melphalan and dactinomycin, which are delivered directly to the affected arm or leg by isolated limb infusion (ILI), in patients with extremity sarcoma. Pembrolizumab is given into a vein at 200 mg on Day 1 and every 3 weeks, and the ILI procedure is done within 18 days after pembrolizumab starts. The study aims to learn whether the treatment is safe and can delay disease progression; the primary outcome measure is not stated, and it is a Phase 2 study.
NCT04332874.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa pembrolizumab administrado junto con melfalán y dactinomicina, que se aplican directamente en el brazo o la pierna afectados mediante perfusión aislada de extremidad (ILI), en pacientes con sarcoma de extremidad. El pembrolizumab se administra en una vena a 200 mg el Día 1 y cada 3 semanas, y el procedimiento ILI se realiza dentro de los 18 días posteriores al inicio del pembrolizumab. El estudio busca saber si el tratamiento es seguro y si puede retrasar la progresión de la enfermedad; la medida de resultado principal no está indicada, y es un estudio de Fase 2.
who_for: Age 12 years or older at the time of consent
Histologically confirmed metastatic and/or locally advanced sarcoma
Eligible for standard pembrolizumab and for isolated limb infusion as judged by the treating physician
Prior at least one line of systemic therapy, or declined the standard systemic option
Measurable disease per RECIST 1.1 or clinical measurement, and ECOG 2 or less or KPS 60% or more
not_for: Another malignancy that requires active treatment
Known active brain metastases or sarcomatous meningitis (some treated, stable brain metastases allowed)
Autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment in the past 2 years
Known active hepatitis B or C, or active tuberculosis
Pregnant or breast-feeding, or planning pregnancy

NCT06409390.summary_en: This Phase 2 pilot study tests a sequence of currently approved cancer drugs, given in order as "strikes," in people with hormone positive, HER2 negative metastatic breast cancer. The strikes include Taxotere, Cytoxan, sacituzumab govitecan or trastuzumab deruxtecan, Xeloda, and fulvestrant with ribociclib or abemaciclib, and most strikes are given every 21 days for 4 or 5 cycles. The main outcome is not stated; the record says the study aims to see whether this sequence is practical to give.
NCT06409390.summary_es: Este estudio piloto de fase 2 evalúa una secuencia de medicamentos contra el cáncer ya aprobados, administrados en orden como "golpes", en personas con cáncer de mama metastásico positivo para hormonas y negativo para HER2. Los golpes incluyen Taxotere, Cytoxan, sacituzumab govitecan o trastuzumab deruxtecan, Xeloda, y fulvestrant con ribociclib o abemaciclib, y la mayoría de los golpes se administran cada 21 días durante 4 o 5 ciclos. El resultado principal no se indica; el registro señala que el estudio busca saber si esta secuencia es práctica de administrar.
who_for: Women 18 years or older
Hormone positive, HER2 negative metastatic breast cancer confirmed by biopsy
Previously treated with an aromatase inhibitor or tamoxifen
Measurable disease on imaging (RECIST v1.1)
ECOG performance status 0 to 1
not_for: Previously received fulvestrant for breast cancer
Brain or other active central nervous system metastases
Active infection, including HIV, hepatitis B or hepatitis C, under the stated rules
Pregnant or breastfeeding
Investigational drug within 30 days before the first study dose

NCT06562179.summary_en: This study tests the da Vinci SP single-port robotic surgical system in operations on the gallbladder, stomach, esophagus, pancreas and liver, for benign and malignant disease. Each participant has one operation with the system, and the number of operations per stage is stated, but how long or how often is not stated. The study measures the safety and performance of the system and its instruments and accessories.
NCT06562179.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa el sistema quirúrgico robótico de puerto único da Vinci SP en operaciones del hígado, la vesícula biliar, el estómago, el esófago y el páncreas, para enfermedades benignas y malignas. Cada participante tiene una operación con el sistema; la duración o la frecuencia no se indican. El estudio mide la seguridad y el desempeño del sistema, sus instrumentos y sus accesorios.
who_for: Adults aged 18 to 80 years
BMI 26 kg/m2 or lower
ASA score 3 or lower
Diagnosed with a benign or malignant condition in one of the listed operation groups
Free of metastatic disease (stage-specific criteria apply)
not_for: Pregnant or nursing
BMI above 26 kg/m2
Previous abdominal surgery
Requires an emergency operation
Unable to give informed consent or contraindicated for general anesthesia or minimally invasive surgery

NCT07235280.summary_en: This early phase 1 study tests the safety and side effects of dapagliflozin given before surgery in people with stage IA lung adenocarcinoma. Participants take dapagliflozin by mouth once a day for 30 days, as long as the disease does not get worse and side effects remain acceptable. The study measures safety and tolerability.
NCT07235280.summary_es: Este estudio piloto de fase temprana 1 evalúa la seguridad y los efectos secundarios de la dapagliflozina administrada antes de la cirugía en personas con adenocarcinoma de pulmón en estadio IA. Los participantes toman dapagliflozina por vía oral una vez al día durante 30 días, siempre que la enfermedad no empeore y los efectos secundarios sean aceptables. El estudio mide la seguridad y la tolerabilidad.
who_for: Able to give written informed consent
Age 22 years or older
Biopsy-confirmed stage IA lung adenocarcinoma, with tissue available for Ki-67 testing
Planning surgery for lung adenocarcinoma
Willing to have a research CT-guided lung biopsy
not_for: Current or past treatment with SGLT2 inhibitors
Other cancers not fully treated at least 2 years before registration, with exceptions
Currently receiving other investigational agents
Regular systemic steroids above 10 mg prednisone daily or equivalent
Pregnant, breastfeeding, or unwilling to use birth control

NCT03567889.summary_en: This Phase 3 study tests Daromun, given into the tumor before surgery, in adults with stage IIIB, IIIC, or IIID melanoma that can be surgically removed. Daromun is given as intratumoral injections once weekly for up to 4 weeks, followed by surgery within a maximum of 4 weeks and then adjuvant therapy at the investigator's discretion. The main outcome stated is recurrence-free survival (RFS), compared with surgery and adjuvant therapy alone.
NCT03567889.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 evalúa Daromun, administrado dentro del tumor antes de la cirugía, en adultos con melanoma en estadio IIIB, IIIC o IIID que puede extirparse quirúrgicamente. Daromun se administra como inyecciones intratumorales una vez por semana durante hasta 4 semanas, seguidas de cirugía en un máximo de 4 semanas y de terapia adyuvante a criterio del investigador. El resultado principal indicado es la supervivencia libre de recurrencia (RFS, por sus siglas en inglés), comparada con cirugía y terapia adyuvante solas.
who_for: Stage IIIB, IIIC, or IIID melanoma that can be fully surgically removed.
At least one injectable skin, under-skin, or lymph node lesion of 10 mm or more, or several injectable lesions adding up to 10 mm or more.
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 1 or lower.
Life expectancy longer than 24 months.
Blood count, liver, and kidney test results within the limits set in the record.
not_for: Uveal or mucosal melanoma.
Distant metastases found at screening.
Heart attack or unstable angina within the past year, or heart insufficiency above NYHA grade II.
Left ventricular ejection fraction of 50% or lower, or clinically significant heart test abnormalities.
Known allergy to IL2, TNF, or other components of the product.

NCT04421560.summary_en: This study tests three drugs given together: pembrolizumab, ibrutinib and rituximab (or a biosimilar), in people with refractory or relapsed primary central nervous system lymphoma. Pembrolizumab is given by IV every 3 weeks, rituximab by IV once a week for 4 weeks, and ibrutinib by mouth at 560 mg or 840 mg, with the record listing its frequency as both daily and twice daily. The record does not state the main outcome; it is a Phase 1b/2 study.
NCT04421560.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa tres medicamentos administrados juntos: pembrolizumab, ibrutinib y rituximab (o un biosimilar), en personas con linfoma primario del sistema nervioso central refractario o recidivante. El pembrolizumab se administra por vía intravenosa cada 3 semanas, el rituximab por vía intravenosa una vez por semana durante 4 semanas, y el ibrutinib por vía oral en dosis de 560 mg o 840 mg, aunque el registro indica su frecuencia como diaria en una parte y dos veces al día en otra. El registro no indica el resultado principal; es un estudio de Fase 1b/2.
who_for: Pathologically confirmed primary CNS lymphoma that progressed after CNS therapy, is refractory, or has relapsed.
Evidence of disease on brain MRI or CSF cytology; ocular-only recurrence is allowed.
ECOG performance status of 0 to 1.
Age 18 years or older.
Life expectancy greater than 3 months, in the investigator's opinion.
not_for: Cannot undergo brain MRI.
Prior anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, anti-PD-L2, or other T-cell co-inhibitory or stimulatory receptor agent.
Previously progressed on ibrutinib or another BTK inhibitor.
Intracranial hemorrhage greater than Grade 2, or arterial thromboembolic event within 3 months.
Active autoimmune disease needing immunosuppressants or steroids above set limits.

NCT06510361.summary_en: This study is testing epcoritamab in adults with follicular lymphoma and marginal zone lymphoma who did not reach a complete response after first-line (upfront) therapy. Epcoritamab is given as a subcutaneous injection under the skin, in 28-day cycles, for up to 12 cycles, with the dosing days changing across cycles as set by the protocol. The record does not state the main outcome measure; the study is Phase 2.
NCT06510361.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa epcoritamab en adultos con linfoma folicular y linfoma de zona marginal que no lograron una respuesta completa después del tratamiento inicial (de primera línea). El epcoritamab se administra como inyección subcutánea, debajo de la piel, en ciclos de 28 días, por hasta 12 ciclos, con días de dosis que cambian entre ciclos según el protocolo. El registro no indica la medida principal de resultado; el estudio es de Fase 2.
who_for: Biopsy-confirmed follicular lymphoma, grade 1 to 3A, that is CD20 positive.
Stage III or IV at first diagnosis, with measurable disease on baseline PET/CT.
Received at least 3 cycles of first-line anti-CD20 antibody plus chemotherapy, with partial response or stable disease as best response.
Age 18 or older, ECOG performance status 2 or lower, and life expectancy over 2 years.
Adequate blood counts, liver, kidney and bone marrow function, and completed prior therapy at least 28 days before starting.
not_for: Progressive disease after upfront therapy.
Known or suspected brain or spinal fluid (CNS or leptomeningeal) involvement.
Uncontrolled active infection needing hospital care or intravenous antibiotics within 4 weeks.
Uncontrolled heart or neurologic conditions, or ejection fraction below 45%.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, HIV, or unwilling to use highly effective contraception.

NCT04585750.summary_en: The study tests rezatapopt (PC14586), an oral p53 reactivator, alone or with pembrolizumab, in advanced solid tumors that have a TP53 Y220C mutation. Rezatapopt is taken by mouth once daily, with doses increased in steps during Phase 1 and 2000 mg daily with food in the expansion cohorts, and pembrolizumab 200 mg IV is given every 3 weeks in the combination arms; treatment duration is not stated. The record does not state a primary outcome measure; it describes assessing safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and efficacy, and the study is Phase 1/2.
