The study is a single-arm pilot of about 20 people, and its stated focus is safety; a formal main outcome measure is not stated.
NCT06073067.summary_es: El estudio prueba la radioterapia GRID, administrada antes de la radiación estándar y la cirugía, en adultos con sarcoma de tejidos blandos de extremidades que puede extirparse. Se administra una dosis inicial única de GRID antes de la radioterapia convencional (XRT) y la extirpación del tumor; la duración de la XRT no se indica. Es un estudio piloto de un solo grupo con alrededor de 20 personas, cuyo enfoque declarado es la seguridad; no se indica una medida de resultado principal formal.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older who gave written informed consent.
ECOG performance status 0 to 2 (Karnofsky 50 to 100).
Biopsy-confirmed extremity soft tissue sarcoma.
If tissue is insufficient, must agree to a pre-treatment core-needle biopsy.
Some patients whose surgery for presumed benign disease showed malignancy, if no complete resection was done and at least 5 cm of tumor remains.
not_for: Prior radiotherapy to the tumor site.
Complete resection of the primary tumor, or tumor recurrence after resection.
Serious or non-healing wound, ulcer, or bone fracture in the treated limb within 5 years.
Clinically significant lymphedema in the treated limb.
Lupus, scleroderma, Sjogren's syndrome, Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, or other collagen vascular disease.

NCT05068232.summary_en: This study tests adding ablative radiation, a highly focused high-dose radiation treatment, to durvalumab, carboplatin and etoposide in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer that has not been treated before. Participants receive up to four 21-day cycles of carboplatin, etoposide and durvalumab, with ablative radiation added in cycle 2, and then continue durvalumab alone until the cancer progresses or the study ends. The main outcome measured is progression-free survival, and the study is in Phase 2.
NCT05068232.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa agregar radiación ablativa, un tratamiento de radiación muy enfocado y de dosis alta, a durvalumab, carboplatino y etopósido en el cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas en etapa extensa que no ha sido tratado antes. Los participantes reciben hasta cuatro ciclos de 21 días de carboplatino, etopósido y durvalumab, con radiación ablativa agregada en el ciclo 2, y luego continúan solo con durvalumab hasta que el cáncer progrese o el estudio termine. El resultado principal que se mide es la supervivencia libre de progresión, y el estudio está en Fase 2.
who_for: Age 18 years or older with small cell lung cancer that has spread (metastatic).
Suitable for platinum-based chemotherapy as first-line treatment for extensive-stage disease.
ECOG performance status of 0, 1 or 2.
Life expectancy of at least 12 weeks.
Measurable disease, including at least one lesion suitable for ablative radiation (about 0.25 to 65 cc).
not_for: Prior chemotherapy, immunotherapy or thoracic radiation for small cell lung cancer.
Prior anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1 or anti-CTLA-4 therapy.
Active or prior autoimmune or inflammatory disorders, with listed exceptions.
Active infection, including tuberculosis, hepatitis B, hepatitis C or HIV, with listed exceptions.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or not willing to use effective birth control.

NCT07368998.summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests inavolisib given with fulvestrant in adults with PIK3CA-mutated, hormone receptor-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer that is locally advanced or metastatic. Inavolisib is taken by mouth as a tablet, and fulvestrant is given as an intramuscular injection; the study compares two inavolisib dose levels, and the treatment schedule is in the protocol and not stated in the record. The main outcome the study measures is not stated, and the study is a Phase 2 trial.
NCT07368998.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa inavolisib junto con fulvestrant en adultos con cáncer de mama con mutación en PIK3CA, positivo para receptores hormonales y negativo para HER2, que es localmente avanzado o metastásico. El inavolisib se toma por vía oral en forma de tableta, y el fulvestrant se administra como inyección intramuscular; el estudio compara dos dosis de inavolisib, y el calendario de tratamiento está en el protocolo y no se indica en el registro. El resultado principal que mide el estudio no se indica, y el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Age 18 years or older
ER-positive and HER2-negative tumor by ASCO/CAP guidelines
Disease progressed after or during a CDK4/6 inhibitor plus endocrine therapy, with no more than 1 prior line in the advanced setting
Measurable or evaluable disease by RECIST v1.1, with at least one PIK3CA mutation confirmed and life expectancy over 6 months
not_for: Metaplastic breast cancer
Prior chemotherapy in the recurrent, locally advanced or metastatic setting
Type 2 diabetes needing ongoing systemic treatment, or any history of type 1 diabetes
Prior PI3K, Akt or mTOR inhibitor treatment in the recurrent, locally advanced or metastatic setting
Daily supplemental oxygen need or symptomatic active lung disease, including pneumonitis

NCT05733598.summary_en: The study tests RP2, a genetically modified herpes simplex type 1 virus used as oncolytic immunotherapy, alone or with other cancer drugs, in hepatocellular carcinoma (liver cancer) and biliary tract cancer. RP2 is injected into the tumor every 2 weeks; in one liver cancer group it is given for 4 doses then every 3 weeks for 4 doses, in another for 8 doses, combined with atezolizumab and bevacizumab, and the liver cancer monotherapy group receives RP2 alone every 2 weeks, while the biliary tract cohort receives durvalumab with RP2 (the biliary schedule is not stated). The record does not state a main outcome measure; it is a Phase 2 study that aims to assess efficacy and safety.
NCT05733598.summary_es: El estudio evalúa RP2, un virus del herpes simple tipo 1 modificado genéticamente que se usa como inmunoterapia oncolítica, solo o con otros medicamentos contra el cáncer, en el carcinoma hepatocelular (cáncer de hígado) y en el cáncer de vías biliares. RP2 se inyecta en el tumor cada 2 semanas; en un grupo de cáncer de hígado se da en 4 dosis y luego cada 3 semanas en 4 dosis más, en otro grupo se da en 8 dosis, combinado con atezolizumab y bevacizumab, y el grupo de monoterapia para cáncer de hígado recibe solo RP2 cada 2 semanas, mientras que el grupo de vías biliares recibe durvalumab con RP2 (el esquema para vías biliares no está indicado). El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; es un estudio de Fase 2 que busca evaluar la eficacia y la seguridad.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older.
Liver cancer: progressed after one prior systemic treatment that included anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1 therapy.
Liver cancer: Child-Pugh A liver function.
At least one measurable tumor of 1 cm or more, and injectable tumor(s) totaling at least 1 cm.
Biliary tract cancer: unresectable, not progressed on gemcitabine, platinum chemotherapy and checkpoint inhibitor given for 12 to 24 weeks.
not_for: Liver cancer: Child-Pugh B or C liver function.
Untreated or high-risk esophageal or gastric varices, or significant bleeding in the last 12 months.
Known HIV infection.
Active significant herpes infection, or need for chronic antivirals with anti-herpes activity.
Known brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis.

NCT02523014.summary_en: This phase II trial tests vismodegib, the FAK inhibitor GSK2256098, capivasertib, and abemaciclib in patients with progressive intracranial meningioma. All four drugs are taken by mouth: vismodegib once daily, the FAK inhibitor twice daily, capivasertib twice daily on days 1 to 4 of each 28-day cycle, and abemaciclib every 12 hours, with cycles repeating every 28 days without disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. The record does not state a main outcome measure; it is a phase II trial.
NCT02523014.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase II evalúa vismodegib, el inhibidor de FAK GSK2256098, capivasertib y abemaciclib en pacientes con meningioma intracraneal progresivo. Los cuatro medicamentos se toman por vía oral: vismodegib una vez al día, el inhibidor de FAK dos veces al día, capivasertib dos veces al día los días 1 a 4 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y abemaciclib cada 12 horas; los ciclos se repiten cada 28 días mientras no haya progresión de la enfermedad ni toxicidad inaceptable. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; es un ensayo de fase II.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with progressive or residual intracranial meningioma confirmed by central pathology review.
Tumor sample with a listed gene mutation or copy number change, confirmed by the central laboratory.
Measurable disease of at least 10 mm in both dimensions on MRI or CT.
ECOG performance status of 2 or less.
Blood counts, kidney function, and liver tests within the limits set by the study.
not_for: Metastatic meningioma outside the central nervous system.
Known active hepatitis B or C.
Uncontrolled blood pressure above 140/90.
Past or current interstitial lung disease.
Chemotherapy within 28 days, or nitrosourea or mitomycin C within 6 weeks, before registration.

NCT06564038.summary_en: The study tests surovatamig (also called AZD0486), a CD19 by CD3 bispecific T-cell engager, alone or with other anticancer drugs, in adults with mature B-cell malignancies such as chronic lymphocytic leukemia, small lymphocytic lymphoma, mantle-cell lymphoma, large B-cell lymphoma, and B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. Surovatamig is given as a subcutaneous injection or an intravenous infusion, and some arms add oral acalabrutinib twice daily or intravenous R-CHOP chemotherapy with step-up dosing; the overall duration and frequency are not stated. The study measures safety and efficacy, but the specific main outcome is not stated, and the study is Phase 1/2.
NCT06564038.summary_es: El estudio evalúa surovatamig (también llamado AZD0486), un activador de linfocitos T biespecífico CD19 por CD3, solo o con otros medicamentos contra el cáncer, en adultos con neoplasias malignas maduras de células B, como leucemia linfocítica crónica, linfoma linfocítico de células pequeñas, linfoma de células del manto, linfoma de células B grandes y linfoma no Hodgkin de células B. El surovatamig se administra como inyección subcutánea o infusión intravenosa, y algunos grupos añaden acalabrutinib oral dos veces al día o quimioterapia R-CHOP intravenosa con dosis escalonadas; la duración y la frecuencia generales no se indican. El estudio mide la seguridad y la eficacia, pero el resultado principal específico no se indica, y el estudio es de Fase 1/2.
who_for: ECOG performance status of 0 to 2
Agrees to use contraception during treatment and for at least 90 days after the final dose
CLL or SLL requiring treatment by iwCLL criteria, with prior therapy lines specified by cohort
MCL or large B-cell lymphoma with prior therapy lines specified by cohort
Age 18 years or older
not_for: Central nervous system lymphoma
Prior CAR T-cell therapy or autologous stem cell transplant within 12 weeks, or prior T-cell engager within 8 weeks
Prior grade above 3 cytokine release syndrome or immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome
Active uncontrolled infection or autoimmune disease needing systemic therapy, or known history of HLH
Cumulative anthracycline dose above 150 mg/m2 (substudy 3)

NCT04872478.summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests MRX-2843, a capsule taken by mouth, in adolescents and adults with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia, acute lymphoblastic leukemia, or mixed phenotype acute leukemia. Patients take MRX-2843 once daily in 28-day cycles, with dose levels increased in predefined cohorts. The record does not state a main outcome measure; the title says the study evaluates safety and how the body processes the drug (pharmacokinetics).
NCT04872478.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa MRX-2843, una cápsula que se toma por vía oral, en adolescentes y adultos con leucemia mieloide aguda, leucemia linfoblástica aguda o leucemia aguda de fenotipo mixto recidivante o refractaria. Los pacientes toman MRX-2843 una vez al día en ciclos de 28 días, y las dosis aumentan en grupos predefinidos. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; el título señala que el estudio evalúa la seguridad y la forma en que el cuerpo procesa el medicamento (farmacocinética).
who_for: Male or female, at least 12 years old, weighing at least 40 kg.
Confirmed AML, ALL, or MPAL in second or later relapse, or refractory to at least one induction regimen.
Able to swallow oral medication.
ECOG performance status 0-2, or Lansky/Karnofsky score of 50 or higher.
For the FLT3-ITD expansion cohort, prior treatment with at least one FLT3 inhibitor.
not_for: Acute promyelocytic leukemia (AML M3).
Known active leukemia in the central nervous system.
Active, clinically significant graft-versus-host disease.
Treatment-dose anticoagulants or antiplatelet agents (low-dose aspirin and prophylactic heparin are allowed).
QTcF greater than 480 ms.

NCT07046078.summary_en: This phase 2 study tests FLAG-Ida chemotherapy followed right after reduced-intensity total body irradiation (TBI) and donor stem cell transplant. It is for adults age 60 and older with newly diagnosed adverse-risk acute myeloid leukemia or other high-grade myeloid cancer. Fludarabine, cytarabine and idarubicin are given into a vein, with G-CSF given under the skin, starting on day -9 or -8 and ending before TBI on days -1 and 0, with transplant on day 0 or 1; treatment continues unless the disease progresses or toxicity is unacceptable. The record does not state a primary outcome; it says the study tests safety, side effects and how well the treatment works.
NCT07046078.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa la quimioterapia FLAG-Ida seguida de inmediato por radioterapia corporal total (TBI) de intensidad reducida y trasplante de células madre de donante. Está dirigido a adultos de 60 años o más con leucemia mieloide aguda de riesgo adverso o con otro cáncer mieloide de alto grado, recién diagnosticado. Fludarabina, citarabina e idarubicina se administran por vena, y el G-CSF se administra debajo de la piel, desde el día -9 u -8 hasta antes de la TBI en los días -1 y 0, con el trasplante el día 0 o 1; el tratamiento continúa salvo que la enfermedad progrese o la toxicidad sea inaceptable. El registro no indica un desenlace principal; señala que el estudio evalúa la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y qué tan bien funciona el tratamiento.
who_for: Age 60 or older; adults under 60 may qualify if judged unsuitable for myeloablative conditioning
Newly diagnosed, untreated high-risk myeloid neoplasm, such as adverse-risk AML or high-risk MDS or CMML
Interest in pursuing allogeneic stem cell transplant
Has an available caregiver
Karnofsky score of 70 or higher, or ECOG performance status 0 to 2
not_for: Active central nervous system disease
Decompensated heart failure, uncontrolled arrhythmia, or cardiac history precluding transplant
Significant lung disease or symptoms precluding transplant
Treatment with another approved or investigational anti-leukemia agent at study start
Serum creatinine above 1.5 mg/dL

NCT06297525.summary_en: The study tests STP938 (also called dencatistat), a CTPS1 inhibitor, in adults with advanced solid tumors. A safety expansion is also planned for advanced CTPS2 null ovarian cancer. STP938 is given by mouth as a single agent at up to 5 dose levels, and the duration and frequency of dosing are not stated. The official title says the study is Phase 1 and aims to evaluate safety, tolerability and pharmacokinetics.
NCT06297525.summary_es: El estudio evalúa STP938 (también llamado dencatistat), un inhibidor de CTPS1, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados. También se planea una expansión de seguridad en cáncer de ovario avanzado con CTPS2 nulo. STP938 se administra por vía oral como único medicamento, en hasta 5 niveles de dosis, y la duración y la frecuencia de la dosis no se indican. El título oficial indica que el estudio es de Fase 1 y busca evaluar la seguridad, la tolerabilidad y la farmacocinética.
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older with advanced disease that cannot be cured by available therapies and needs systemic therapy
Histologically confirmed eligible cancer type
Measurable disease
ECOG performance status of 2 or lower
Life expectancy over 3 months, per the investigator; tumor tissue available for biomarker testing
not_for: Pregnant or breastfeeding women, or women of childbearing potential or men unwilling to use contraception
Known active or symptomatic brain metastases, carcinomatous meningitis, leptomeningeal disease, or prior spinal cord compression
Active malignancy within 2 years of enrollment
Known active or chronic hepatitis B or active hepatitis C infection
Corrected QT interval (QTcF) above 470 msec

NCT05413850.summary_en: This study tests Lutetium (177Lu) rhPSMA-10.1 Injection in men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer whose tumors express PSMA. The drug is given as an injection in treatment cycles, and the dose and schedule vary by study arm, with up to 3 cycles in some arms and up to 8 doses in another. The study measures dose, safety, radiation dosimetry and anti-tumour activity, and it is a combined phase 1 and phase 2 study.
NCT05413850.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la inyección de Lutetium (177Lu) rhPSMA-10.1 en hombres con cáncer de próstata metastásico resistente a la castración cuyos tumores expresan PSMA. El medicamento se administra por inyección en ciclos de tratamiento, y la dosis y el esquema varían según el grupo del estudio, con hasta 3 ciclos en algunos grupos y hasta 8 dosis en otro. El estudio mide la dosis, la seguridad, la dosimetría de radiación y la actividad antitumoral, y es un estudio combinado de fase 1 y fase 2.
who_for: Men aged 18 or older with confirmed prostate adenocarcinoma.
Testosterone below a stated level after surgical or continued chemical castration.
PSMA-positive disease confirmed on PSMA PET/CT scan.
ECOG performance status 0 to 2 with life expectancy of at least 6 months.
Disease progression after at least one NAAD treatment, with taxane chemotherapy rules that differ by phase.
not_for: Known hypersensitivity to the study drug or any of its components.
Significant PSMA-negative disease on CT or MRI scan.
Symptomatic spinal cord compression or findings suggesting impending spinal cord compression.
Known brain (CNS) metastases or neuroendocrine histology of prostate cancer.
Ongoing bisphosphonate treatment for bone-targeted therapy.

NCT06826768.summary_en: This study tests REGN5678 plus cemiplimab in men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. Both drugs are given by IV infusion. REGN5678 is given as three weekly doses in a lead-in phase, then the combination is given every three weeks; the total length of treatment is not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated; the study is listed as Phase 1.
NCT06826768.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa REGN5678 junto con cemiplimab en hombres con cáncer de próstata metastásico resistente a la castración. Ambos medicamentos se administran por infusión intravenosa. REGN5678 se administra en tres dosis semanales durante una fase inicial, y después la combinación se administra cada tres semanas; la duración total del tratamiento no se indica. La medida de resultado principal no se indica; el estudio figura como Fase 1.
who_for: Men 18 years or older with prostate adenocarcinoma confirmed by tissue or cells, not pure small cell.
Metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer that progressed after at least two systemic therapy lines, including one second-generation anti-androgen.
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
Adequate blood cell counts, kidney function and liver function as defined by the study.
Testosterone below 50 ng/dL with orchiectomy or ongoing LHRH agonist or antagonist therapy.
not_for: Currently in another interventional study, or used an investigational drug within 4 weeks of first dose.
Systemic therapy within 3 weeks, or radiation or major surgery within 14 days, before first dose.
History of autoimmune disease, with listed exceptions; or systemic steroids above 10 mg prednisone daily or immunosuppressants within 14 days.
Active infection needing systemic therapy, or recent heart events such as heart attack, stroke or blood clots within 6 months.
Other progressing cancer or prior cancer within 2 years, with exceptions; or interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis in the past 5 years.

NCT06297226.summary_en: The study tests arlocabtagene autoleucel (BMS-986393), a GPRC5D-directed CAR T cell therapy, in adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. The record says the drug is given at a specified dose on specified days; the route and total duration are not stated. The study is Phase 2 and aims to evaluate effectiveness and safety; the specific main outcome is not stated.
NCT06297226.summary_es: El estudio evalúa arlocabtagene autoleucel (BMS-986393), una terapia con células CAR T dirigida a GPRC5D, en adultos con mieloma múltiple recidivante o refractario. El registro indica que el medicamento se administra en una dosis específica en días específicos; la vía y la duración total no se indican. El estudio es de Fase 2 y busca evaluar la eficacia y la seguridad; el resultado principal específico no se indica.
who_for: Diagnosis of multiple myeloma by IMWG criteria
Prior treatment with at least 4 classes of myeloma drugs, including IMiD, proteasome inhibitor, anti-CD38 and anti-BCMA therapy
At least 3 prior lines of therapy
Disease progression during or after the last anti-myeloma regimen
Measurable disease at screening and ECOG performance status 0 or 1
not_for: Active or past central nervous system involvement with myeloma
Active infection at the time of leukapheresis
Severe infection, severe sepsis or bacteremia in the 28 days before leukapheresis
Prior GPRC5D-directed therapy
Other prior myeloma treatment without the required washout before leukapheresis

NCT06066333.summary_en: This phase 2 study tests whether pembrolizumab given after ablative radiotherapy is safe in people with advanced adrenocortical carcinoma. All participants first receive ablative radiotherapy, and pembrolizumab may begin after that radiotherapy is finished; the length and schedule of pembrolizumab treatment are not stated. The study's main goal is to determine whether pembrolizumab after this radiotherapy is safe and causes few or mild side effects.
NCT06066333.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa si el pembrolizumab administrado después de radioterapia ablativa es seguro en personas con carcinoma adrenocortical avanzado. Todos los participantes reciben primero radioterapia ablativa, y el pembrolizumab puede iniciarse después de terminar la radioterapia; la duración y el calendario del tratamiento con pembrolizumab no se indican. El objetivo principal del estudio es determinar si el pembrolizumab después de esta radioterapia es seguro y causa pocos efectos secundarios o efectos leves.
who_for: Histologically or cytologically confirmed metastatic adrenocortical carcinoma with symptomatic liver metastases.
Measurable disease by RECIST v1.1, with radiologic evidence of extrahepatic metastases.
At least 15 years old on the day of informed consent.
ECOG performance status 0, or Karnofsky at least 50% (Lansky at least 50% if under 16).
Adequate blood, kidney, liver and clotting lab values within 28 days of treatment start.
not_for: Prior anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, anti-PD-L2, anti-CD137, or anti-CTLA-4 antibody therapy.
Active brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis.
Active autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment in the past 3 months, or systemic steroids or immunosuppressants within 7 days before study Day 1.
Interstitial lung disease, current pneumonitis, or past non-infectious pneumonitis that needed steroids.
Known HIV, or active hepatitis B or hepatitis C.

NCT06062498.summary_en: This Phase 2 study compares elacestrant alone with elacestrant plus a CDK4/6 inhibitor in people with ER-positive, HER2-negative advanced or metastatic breast cancer who had prior CDK4/6 inhibitor treatment. Elacestrant is taken by mouth once a day in 28-day cycles, repeated until the disease progresses. In the combination arm, palbociclib or ribociclib is taken for 21 of every 28 days, or abemaciclib is taken twice a day. The main outcome is not stated; the study is a randomized Phase 2 trial.
NCT06062498.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 compara elacestrant solo con elacestrant más un inhibidor de CDK4/6 en personas con cáncer de mama avanzado o metastásico, positivo para receptor de estrógeno y negativo para HER2, que ya habían recibido un inhibidor de CDK4/6. El elacestrant se toma por vía oral una vez al día en ciclos de 28 días, que se repiten hasta que la enfermedad progresa. En el grupo de combinación, el palbociclib o el ribociclib se toman durante 21 de cada 28 días, o el abemaciclib se toma dos veces al día. El desenlace principal no está indicado en el registro; el estudio es un ensayo aleatorizado de fase 2.
who_for: ER-positive and HER2-negative breast cancer confirmed by tests
Confirmed ESR1 mutation
At least one measurable lesion, or a mainly lytic bone lesion that meets the stated criteria
At least 2 prior endocrine therapies, including a CDK4/6 inhibitor in the metastatic setting
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 or 1
not_for: Prior treatment with elacestrant
Chemotherapy or radiotherapy within 28 days before registration (6 weeks for nitrosoureas or mitomycin C)
Brain metastases, except stable, treated ones that meet the stated conditions
Documented pneumonitis or interstitial lung disease before registration
Taking strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers or inhibitors

NCT05440708.summary_en: The study tests TTI-101 alone and combined with other drugs in hepatocellular carcinoma, a type of liver cancer that is locally advanced or metastatic and cannot be removed by surgery. TTI-101 is taken as an oral tablet, and pembrolizumab, atezolizumab, or bevacizumab is given by intravenous (IV) infusion in the combination groups; how often and for how long is not stated. The main outcome is safety and tolerability, with the phase 1b part also finding the maximum tolerated dose or recommended phase 2 dose, and the phase 2 part also assessing preliminary efficacy.
NCT05440708.summary_es: El estudio evalúa TTI-101 solo y combinado con otros medicamentos en el carcinoma hepatocelular, un tipo de cáncer de hígado que es localmente avanzado o metastásico y no puede extirparse con cirugía. TTI-101 se toma como tableta oral, y pembrolizumab, atezolizumab o bevacizumab se administran por infusión intravenosa (IV) en los grupos de combinación; la frecuencia y la duración no se indican. El resultado principal es la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, y en la fase 1b también se busca la dosis máxima tolerada o la dosis recomendada para la fase 2; la fase 2 además evalúa la eficacia preliminar.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older who can give informed consent.
Locally advanced, metastatic, or unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma with measurable disease.
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1 and Child-Pugh class A or B7.
Cohort A: progression on up to 3 prior lines of systemic therapy.
Cohort B: progression after at least 2 cycles of first-line anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1 therapy. Cohort C: no prior systemic treatment for this cancer.
not_for: Pregnant or breastfeeding.
Known fibrolamellar, sarcomatoid, or mixed cholangiocarcinoma and HCC.
Prior treatment of this cancer with a STAT inhibitor.
History of hepatic encephalopathy or stroke within the previous 2 years.
Significant heart problems, or left ventricular ejection fraction below 50%.

NCT07217301.summary_en: This study compares TAK-928 with docetaxel in adults with unresectable, advanced or metastatic squamous or nonsquamous non-small cell lung cancer whose disease progressed after immunotherapy and platinum-based chemotherapy. TAK-928 and the comparator docetaxel are both given by IV infusion, and treatment can last up to 24 months, depending on response and side effects. The main aim is to learn how well TAK-928 works compared with docetaxel; the specific primary outcome measure is not stated, and the study is a Phase 3 trial.
NCT07217301.summary_es: Este estudio compara TAK-928 con docetaxel en adultos con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas escamoso o no escamoso, irresecable, avanzado o metastásico, cuya enfermedad progresó después de inmunoterapia y quimioterapia basada en platino. TAK-928 y el medicamento de comparación, docetaxel, se administran ambos por infusión intravenosa, y el tratamiento puede durar hasta 24 meses, según la respuesta y los efectos secundarios. El objetivo principal es conocer qué tan bien funciona TAK-928 en comparación con docetaxel; la medida de resultado principal específica no está indicada, y el estudio es de Fase 3.
who_for: Unresectable, advanced or metastatic squamous or nonsquamous NSCLC with radiographic disease progression.
Progression on or after anti-PD-1/PD-L1 therapy and platinum-based doublet chemotherapy, with at least 6 weeks of anti-PD-1/PD-L1 exposure.
At least one measurable lesion by CT or MRI per RECIST v1.1.
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
Expected survival of at least 3 months.
not_for: Squamous NSCLC with a known actionable genomic alteration in the listed driver genes.
Nonsquamous NSCLC without prior documented negative testing for the listed driver gene mutations.
Enlarging or symptomatic brain metastases.
Low blood counts, or abnormal liver or kidney test results at baseline.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or intending to become pregnant during or within 6 months after treatment.

NCT05289687.summary_en: This study tests daratumumab-hyaluronidase in T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (T-ALL) that has persistent or recurrent minimal residual disease (MRD) after chemotherapy. The drug is given as an injection once weekly for 4 doses, with later doses every 2 weeks for patients who become MRD negative, and with chemotherapy added for patients who remain MRD positive. The record does not state the main outcome measure; the study is a Phase 2 trial.
NCT05289687.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa daratumumab-hialuronidasa en la leucemia linfoblástica aguda de células T (T-ALL) con enfermedad residual mínima (MRD) persistente o recurrente después de quimioterapia. El fármaco se administra por inyección una vez por semana durante 4 dosis, con dosis posteriores cada 2 semanas para los pacientes con MRD negativa, y con quimioterapia añadida para los pacientes que siguen con MRD positiva. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Has T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia in first or later complete remission (CR or CRi) after at least 2 blocks of intensive chemotherapy.
Has persistent or recurrent MRD at or above 10^-4 by flow cytometry, confirmed by a central test.
Is 18 years or older with ECOG performance status 0 to 2.
Has blood counts, liver and kidney tests within the required limits, obtained within 7 days before registration.
May have had a prior allogeneic stem cell transplant if no GVHD needs ongoing immunosuppression.
not_for: Is pregnant or breastfeeding.
Has graft versus host disease that needs ongoing immunosuppression (prednisone up to 10 mg per day is allowed).
Has active central nervous system involvement at the time of registration.
Has heart disease or cardiac function worse than New York Heart Association class 2B.

NCT05030298.summary_en: This phase 1 study tests radiosurgery given before surgery for high grade glioma, a type of malignant glioma. Radiosurgery is one large dose given within 14 days of registration, followed by surgery, then standard radiation over 30 fractions and daily temozolomide, with or without tumor treating fields at the neuro-oncologist's discretion, starting within 4 to 6 weeks. The main outcome measure is not stated; the record describes the study as looking at possible benefits and side effects.
NCT05030298.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa la radiocirugía administrada antes de la cirugía para el glioma de alto grado, un tipo de glioma maligno. La radiocirugía consiste en una dosis única y grande, administrada dentro de los 14 días posteriores al registro, seguida de cirugía, luego radiación estándar en 30 fracciones y temozolomida diaria, con o sin terapia de campos tumorales según el criterio del neurooncólogo, iniciada en un plazo de 4 a 6 semanas. La medida de resultado principal no se indica; el registro describe el estudio como una evaluación de posibles beneficios y efectos secundarios.
who_for: Age 18 years or older.
Primary high grade glioma (WHO grade III-IV, including glioblastoma) judged by the Mayo neuro-oncology team.
Prior biopsy confirming high grade glioma is acceptable.
Planned neurosurgical resection of the tumor.
ECOG performance status 0, 1, or 2, and willing to receive adjuvant radiotherapy at the enrolling institution.
not_for: Pregnant women, or nursing women unwilling to stop nursing during therapy.
Prior history of cranial radiotherapy.
Use of systemic anti-cancer therapy within the previous 3 months.
Non-MRI compatible implanted medical device.
Pathology showing grade I-II glioma, brain metastasis, or other brain tumor, or primary spinal cord or brainstem glioma.

NCT07783581.summary_en: This phase II trial tests adding proton spatially fractionated radiotherapy (SFRT) or photon stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT) to pembrolizumab before surgery. It studies patients with locally advanced or locoregionally recurrent oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma who have not had prior radiation. Patients receive SFRT or SBRT every other day for up to 3 treatments over 1 week, and pembrolizumab IV on day 1 of each 3-week cycle for up to 2 cycles. Surgery is planned within 8 weeks after finishing pembrolizumab. The record does not state a main outcome; it is a phase 2 study.
NCT07783581.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase II evalúa agregar radioterapia de fraccionamiento espacial con protones (SFRT) o radioterapia estereotáctica corporal con fotones (SBRT) a pembrolizumab antes de la cirugía. Incluye a pacientes con carcinoma de células escamosas de cavidad oral localmente avanzado o recurrente en la región, que no han recibido radioterapia previa. Los pacientes reciben SFRT o SBRT en días alternos, hasta 3 tratamientos en una semana, y pembrolizumab por vía intravenosa el día 1 de cada ciclo de 3 semanas, hasta 2 ciclos. La cirugía está prevista dentro de las 8 semanas posteriores a terminar el pembrolizumab. El registro no indica un resultado principal; es un estudio de fase 2.
who_for: Oral cavity squamous cell cancer that is not linked to HPV or p16, and is locally advanced (T3-T4) without spread
Oral cavity cancer that has come back in the region and has not had radiation before
Age 18 or older
ECOG performance status of 2 or lower
Eligible for immunotherapy after multidisciplinary review, with PD-L1 combined positive score of 1 or more
not_for: Participation in another study with an investigational product in the last 3 months
Contraindication to pembrolizumab
Prior radiation therapy to the head and neck
Anticancer therapy within 30 days before registration, or without an adequate washout period
Uncontrolled medical or psychiatric conditions that limit consent or ability to take part
cancer_types: locally advanced oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma
locally recurrent oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma

NCT07025564.summary_en: This phase 1 trial tests miRisten, a miR-126 inhibitor, in adults with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (AML). miRisten is given through a vein (IV) over 30 minutes, twice a day, on days 1-5, 8-12 and 15-19, as long as the disease does not progress and side effects are not unacceptable. The study measures safety, side effects and the best dose of miRisten.
NCT07025564.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 1 evalúa miRisten, un inhibidor de miR-126, en adultos con leucemia mieloide aguda (LMA) recidivante o refractaria. Se administra por vía intravenosa durante 30 minutos, dos veces al día, en los días 1 a 5, 8 a 12 y 15 a 19, siempre que la enfermedad no progrese y los efectos secundarios no sean inaceptables. El estudio mide la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la mejor dosis de miRisten.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with relapsed or refractory AML
ECOG performance status of 2 or lower
Has failed treatment with, or cannot receive, available AML therapies
Recovered to grade 1 or lower from side effects of prior cancer treatment (except hair loss)
Life expectancy of at least 3 months
not_for: Allogeneic stem cell transplant within 3 months before starting treatment
Chemotherapy, radiation or immunotherapy within 14 days (hydroxyurea allowed)
Acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL)
Unstable heart disease, or acute coronary syndrome or revascularization within 6 months
Other active cancer, or pregnant or breastfeeding

NCT06932757.summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests quisinostat, a capsule drug, in adults with high-risk uveal melanoma after their primary tumor has been treated. Participants take 12 mg by mouth three times per week in 21-day cycles, for up to 17 cycles (up to 51 weeks), and are followed for up to 2 years after treatment ends. The main outcome measure is not stated; the stated purpose is to see whether quisinostat prevents the tumor from spreading.
NCT06932757.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa quisinostat, un medicamento en cápsulas, en adultos con melanoma uveal de alto riesgo después de que se trató el tumor primario. Los participantes toman 12 mg por vía oral tres veces por semana en ciclos de 21 días, por hasta 17 ciclos (hasta 51 semanas), y se les da seguimiento hasta 2 años después de terminar el tratamiento. El resultado principal no está indicado; el propósito indicado es ver si quisinostat evita que el tumor se propague.
who_for: Uveal melanoma with a tumor at least 12 mm wide, with primary treatment finished within 183 days of starting study drug.
High-risk (class 2) result on a gene expression profiling test.
No evidence of metastatic disease.
Age over 18, ECOG performance status 0 to 1, and life expectancy over 3 months.
Able to swallow and keep down oral medicine, and agree to use birth control.
not_for: Another cancer that is progressing or needs active treatment, with listed exceptions.
Prior adjuvant treatment for uveal melanoma after primary tumor therapy.
Prior use of histone deacetylase (HDAC) inhibitors.
Known HIV, hepatitis B, or hepatitis C infection, with listed exceptions; HIV patients on combination antiretroviral therapy are excluded.
QTcB of 480 msec or higher, or a history of long QT syndrome.

NCT07291037.summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares datopotamab deruxtecan with docetaxel in adults with previously treated, TROP2-positive, non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer without certain actionable genomic alterations. Both drugs are given by intravenous (IV) infusion once every 3 weeks on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle; total duration is not stated. The study will measure efficacy and safety; the specific primary outcome is not stated.
NCT07291037.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 compara datopotamab deruxtecan con docetaxel en adultos con cáncer de pulmón no escamoso de células no pequeñas, previamente tratado, TROP2 positivo, sin ciertas alteraciones genómicas accionables. Ambos medicamentos se administran por infusión intravenosa (IV) una vez cada 3 semanas, el día 1 de cada ciclo de 21 días; la duración total no se indica. El estudio medirá la eficacia y la seguridad; el resultado principal específico no se indica.
who_for: Stage IIIB, IIIC, or IV non-squamous NSCLC without actionable genomic alterations.
TROP2 NMR positive on a prospective central test.
Radiographic progression after platinum chemotherapy plus anti-PD-1/PD-L1 antibody, as the only one or two prior lines.
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
At least one measurable lesion per RECIST 1.1 that was not previously irradiated.
not_for: Squamous, mixed NSCLC, or small cell lung cancer histology.
NSCLC eligible for definitive local therapy alone.
Another primary cancer within 3 years, unless curatively treated with low recurrence risk.
Symptomatic brain metastases or spinal cord compression.
History of interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis, or suspected ILD not ruled out by imaging.

NCT06852222.summary_en: This study tests bleximenib added to venetoclax and azacitidine, compared with placebo added to venetoclax and azacitidine, in newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia with a KMT2A rearrangement or NPM1 mutation. Bleximenib, venetoclax and placebo are taken by mouth, and azacitidine is given into a vein or under the skin, in 28-day cycles that continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is Phase 3.
NCT06852222.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa bleximenib añadido a venetoclax y azacitidina, comparado con placebo añadido a venetoclax y azacitidina, en leucemia mieloide aguda recién diagnosticada con una reordenación de KMT2A o una mutación de NPM1. Bleximenib, venetoclax y el placebo se toman por vía oral, y la azacitidina se administra por vena o debajo de la piel, en ciclos de 28 días que continúan hasta la progresión o una toxicidad inaceptable. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es de Fase 3.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older.
Newly diagnosed AML with a KMT2A rearrangement or NPM1 mutation, with at least 10% bone marrow blasts.
Not eligible for intensive chemotherapy because of age or health conditions, as judged by the care team.
Adequate liver and kidney function.
Agrees to pregnancy and contraception rules and signs informed consent.
not_for: Acute promyelocytic leukemia.
Known active leukemia in the central nervous system.
Recipient of a solid organ transplant.
Heart events within 6 months of randomization, such as heart attack or heart failure.
Active infectious hepatitis, or a live attenuated vaccine within 4 weeks of randomization.

NCT07408856.summary_en: This study tests CAN1012, a TLR7 agonist, injected into the lesion in people with ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS) or lobular carcinoma in situ (LCIS). CAN1012 is given as a single injection directly into the target lesion on Day 0, before surgery, and the record does not state any further dosing schedule. The record does not list a primary outcome; it says tissue from standard surgery will be checked for immune changes compared with baseline on several days, and the study is Phase I/Ib.
NCT07408856.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa CAN1012, un agonista de TLR7, inyectado en la lesión en personas con carcinoma ductal in situ (DCIS) o carcinoma lobulillar in situ (LCIS). CAN1012 se administra como una sola inyección directamente en la lesión objetivo el Día 0, antes de la cirugía, y el registro no indica otro esquema de dosis. El registro no enumera un desenlace principal; señala que el tejido de la cirugía estándar será evaluado para detectar cambios inmunológicos comparados con el basal en varios días, y el estudio es de Fase I/Ib.
who_for: Adults 18 or older who can give consent and follow the protocol.
DCIS or LCIS found on core biopsy.
A single lesion 1 to 5 cm by imaging, with no invasive disease on biopsy and no suspicious ipsilateral lymph nodes on ultrasound.
ECOG performance status 0 to 1.
Lab values within 72 hours of Day 0 that meet set limits; people able to conceive must use non-hormonal contraception.
not_for: Serious underlying medical or psychiatric condition that the investigator judges a safety risk.
Need for corticosteroids of 10 mg or more prednisone daily equivalent (inhaled steroids allowed).
Need for hormonal contraception or medicines that are sensitive substrates of major CYP enzymes.
Active or significant autoimmune disease, prior bone marrow transplant, or prior oral GVHD.
Active infection needing systemic therapy, or active or uncontrolled hepatitis B, hepatitis C, or HIV with AIDS.

NCT04198766.summary_en: This study tests INBRX-106, a hexavalent OX40 agonist antibody, alone or with pembrolizumab, in people with locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors, including lung, head and neck, melanoma, stomach, kidney and bladder cancers. Pembrolizumab is given by intravenous (IV) infusion, at 200 mg every 3 weeks or 400 mg every 6 weeks depending on the arm, and the route for INBRX-106 is not stated. The study aims to determine safety and identify the maximum tolerated dose or recommended Phase 2 dose, and the primary outcome measure is not stated.
NCT04198766.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa INBRX-106, un anticuerpo agonista de OX40 hexavalente, solo o con pembrolizumab, en personas con tumores sólidos localmente avanzados o metastásicos, incluidos cánceres de pulmón, cabeza y cuello, melanoma, estómago, riñón y vejiga. El pembrolizumab se administra por infusión intravenosa (IV), a 200 mg cada 3 semanas o 400 mg cada 6 semanas según el grupo, y la vía de administración de INBRX-106 no se indica. El estudio busca determinar la seguridad e identificar la dosis máxima tolerada o la dosis recomendada para fase 2, y la medida de resultado principal no se indica.
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older.
Locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors that progressed on standard therapy or have no standard option left.
Certain cancers in expansion cohorts, such as lung, melanoma, head and neck, stomach, kidney or bladder cancer, with PD-L1 criteria per protocol.
Previously untreated resectable Stage II to IIIB lung cancer, able to have planned surgery (one cohort).
Adequate blood, liver and kidney function and ECOG performance score as defined in the protocol.
not_for: Prior exposure to OX40 agonists or to anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L2 or other co-stimulatory pathway agents.
Hematologic malignancies such as leukemia, lymphoma or multiple myeloma.
Grade 3 or higher immune-related adverse events, or one that led to stopping prior immunotherapy.
Active autoimmune disease or history requiring systemic treatment.
History of hepatitis B, hepatitis C or HIV infection.

NCT06220656.summary_en: This study compares two ways to manage thyroid nodules that look likely to be cancerous on ultrasound: an immediate needle biopsy, which is usual care, or active monitoring with ultrasound and check-ups. The biopsy uses a small needle guided by ultrasound, usually with local anesthetic, while active monitoring includes an ultrasound and check-up every six months for two years, then less often. The main outcome is anxiety at 6 months, measured with the Anxiety-CA instrument, and the study also measures thyroid quality of life.
NCT06220656.summary_es: Este estudio compara dos formas de manejar nódulos tiroideos que, según el ultrasonido, parecen probablemente cancerosos: una biopsia con aguja inmediata, que es la atención habitual, o el monitoreo activo con ultrasonido y consultas de control. La biopsia usa una aguja pequeña guiada por ultrasonido, generalmente con anestesia local, mientras que el monitoreo activo incluye un ultrasonido y una consulta cada seis meses durante dos años, y luego con menos frecuencia. El resultado principal es la ansiedad a los 6 meses, medida con el instrumento Anxiety-CA, y el estudio también mide la calidad de vida relacionada con la tiroides.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older who can give informed consent, or have a surrogate who can.
No symptoms from the nodule, such as trouble swallowing, or the nodule is visible or bothersome.
Thyroid nodule rated TI-RADS 4 or 5.
Nodule is 2 cm or smaller in largest diameter.
Being considered for biopsy; prior papillary thyroid cancer is allowed.
not_for: Unable to provide informed consent.
Biopsy is not being considered.
Prior thyroid cancer other than papillary thyroid cancer.
Prior neck radiation, or no thyroid gland (athyroidal).
Ultrasound signs of airway invasion, nerve involvement, or spread outside the thyroid; or a prior biopsy of the nodule.

NCT06548412.summary_en: This Phase 1/Phase 2 study tests adding CTX-009 to standard gemcitabine, cisplatin, and durvalumab as first-line treatment for unresectable or metastatic biliary tract cancer. All study drugs are given by IV, and participants receive treatment on an outpatient basis; how often and for how long are not stated. The main outcome the study measures is not stated in the record.
NCT06548412.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/fase 2 evalúa agregar CTX-009 al tratamiento estándar con gemcitabina, cisplatino y durvalumab como primera línea para cáncer de vías biliares no resecable o metastásico. Todos los medicamentos del estudio se administran por vía intravenosa y el tratamiento es ambulatorio; la frecuencia y la duración no están indicadas. El resultado principal que mide el estudio no se indica en el registro.
who_for: Age 18 or older.
Biliary tract cancer that is unresectable, advanced, metastatic, or recurrent, with no prior treatment in the metastatic setting.
Measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 criteria.
ECOG performance status of 2 or lower.
Adequate blood counts, liver, kidney, and albumin levels within 14 days of treatment.
not_for: Prior treatment for the current cancer, except perioperative (adjuvant or neoadjuvant) treatment.
Pregnant or breastfeeding women.
Active, uncontrolled autoimmune disease.
History of active interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis.
Antiplatelet or anticoagulant drug use within 2 weeks before screening, or expected need during the study.

NCT05919238.summary_en: This study tests padeliporfin vascular targeted photodynamic therapy (VTP) in people with locally advanced, unresectable pancreatic adenocarcinoma. The treatment is placed through a catheter into an artery near the pancreas, with a balloon inflated for a total of 10 minutes during light illumination, and the study escalates light doses of 200, 400 and 600 mW/cm. Frequency beyond a single dose is not stated. The study is a Phase 1 trial that measures safety and preliminary efficacy and aims to find the maximum tolerated light dose and/or recommended phase 2 dose.
NCT05919238.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la terapia fotodinámica dirigida a vasos con padeliporfina (VTP) en personas con adenocarcinoma de páncreas localmente avanzado e irresecable. El tratamiento se aplica mediante un catéter colocado en una arteria cercana al páncreas, con un balón inflado durante un total de 10 minutos mientras se ilumina; el estudio aumenta las dosis de luz de 200, 400 y 600 mW/cm. La frecuencia más allá de una dosis única no se indica. Es un estudio de Fase 1 que mide la seguridad y la eficacia preliminar, y busca determinar la dosis máxima de luz tolerada y/o la dosis recomendada para fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 years and older who can give written informed consent
Stage III pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma with an unresectable tumor in the head or uncinate process
Measurable disease by RECIST 1.1
ECOG performance status of 1 or less and life expectancy of at least 6 months
Target artery tumor contact and artery diameter within the stated limits
not_for: Metastatic (stage IV) disease
Previous radiotherapy to the pancreas for pancreatic cancer
Cystic component of 25% or more of the tumor volume
Congestive heart failure or myocardial infarction or ischemic event within the past 6 months
Known hypersensitivity to iodine contrast

NCT06500481.summary_en: This Phase III trial compares proton craniospinal irradiation (pCSI) with involved-field radiation therapy (IFRT) in patients with breast cancer or non-small cell lung cancer that has spread to the cerebrospinal fluid (leptomeningeal metastasis). Both treatments are given 5 days a week for a total of 10 days of treatment. The main outcome is not stated; the record lists the trial as Phase III.
NCT06500481.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase III compara la radioterapia craneoespinal con protones (pCSI) con la radioterapia de campo involucrado (IFRT) en pacientes con cáncer de mama o cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas que se ha diseminado al líquido cefalorraquídeo (metástasis leptomeníngea). Ambos tratamientos se administran 5 días a la semana, por un total de 10 días de tratamiento. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el ensayo es de fase III.
who_for: Breast cancer or non-small cell lung cancer with newly diagnosed leptomeningeal metastasis, confirmed by spinal fluid testing or by imaging and typical symptoms
Age 18 or older
Considered a candidate for radiation therapy for leptomeningeal metastasis
Karnofsky performance status of 60 or higher
Blood counts, liver tests and heart function within the limits listed in the record (heart function NYHA class II or better)
not_for: Prior radiation to the spinal cord or cauda equina above the dose limits listed
Prior treatment for leptomeningeal metastasis
Unstable angina needing hospital care, or heart attack, within the last 3 months
NYHA class III or IV heart disease
Pregnancy or breastfeeding, or an active infection needing IV antibiotics

NCT06216938.summary_en: The study tests vusolimogene oderparepvec (RP1), a genetically modified oncolytic herpes simplex type 1 virus, in primary melanoma to see whether it reduces the risk of sentinel lymph node metastasis. RP1 is injected into the skin at the tumor biopsy site on day 1, day 15 and day 21, and definitive surgery is planned up to 28 to 35 days after the first injection. The main outcome is not stated; the study is labeled early phase 1.
NCT06216938.summary_es: El estudio evalúa vusolimogene oderparepvec (RP1), un virus herpes simple tipo 1 modificado genéticamente con actividad oncolítica, en melanoma primario, para ver si reduce el riesgo de metástasis en el ganglio linfático centinela. RP1 se inyecta en la piel en el sitio de la biopsia del tumor el día 1, el día 15 y el día 21, y la cirugía definitiva está prevista hasta 28 a 35 días después de la primera inyección. El resultado principal no está indicado; el estudio está clasificado como fase temprana 1.
who_for: Age 18 or older
Melanoma staged pT3b, T4a or T4b on biopsy
Grossly visible residual tumor or positive deep or lateral margin on initial biopsy
ECOG performance status 0 or 1
People of reproductive potential agree to highly effective contraception
not_for: Prior treatment with an oncolytic virus therapy
Active hepatitis B or C, or HIV infection
Investigational agent or device use within four weeks before first dose
Live vaccine within 30 days before first dose
Uveal melanoma, or tumors near critical structures such as the carotid artery or portal vein

NCT07546500.summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares azenosertib with chemotherapy chosen by the investigator in women with platinum-resistant high-grade serous ovarian, primary peritoneal, or fallopian tube cancer whose tumors are positive for cyclin E1 protein. Azenosertib 400 mg is taken by mouth, and the chemotherapy (paclitaxel, gemcitabine, pegylated liposomal doxorubicin, or topotecan, chosen by the investigator) is given intravenously; the duration and schedule are not stated. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is randomized, open-label, and Phase 3.
NCT07546500.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 compara azenosertib con quimioterapia elegida por el investigador en mujeres con cáncer de ovario seroso de alto grado resistente al platino, cáncer peritoneal primario o cáncer de trompa de Falopio cuyos tumores son positivos para la proteína ciclina E1. El azenosertib de 400 mg se toma por vía oral, y la quimioterapia (paclitaxel, gemcitabina, doxorrubicina liposomal pegilada o topotecán, elegida por el investigador) se administra por vía intravenosa; la duración y el esquema no se indican. El desenlace principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es aleatorizado, abierto y de fase 3.
who_for: Women 18 or older with high-grade serous ovarian, peritoneal, or fallopian tube cancer.
Platinum-resistant disease with 1 to 3 prior treatment lines (up to 4 if prior mirvetuximab).
Tumor positive for cyclin E1 protein by the sponsor's test.
Measurable disease and ECOG performance status of 0 to 1.
Prior bevacizumab, PARP inhibitor (if BRCA or HRD), or mirvetuximab required when standard of care allows.
not_for: Primary platinum-refractory disease.
Prior WEE1, ATR, CHK1/2, or PKMYT1 inhibitor for ovarian cancer.
Another cancer within the previous 2 years, with listed exceptions.
Recent chemotherapy, targeted therapy, radiation, major surgery, or investigational drug within set time frames.
Serious conditions such as unstable brain metastases, bowel obstruction, or active hepatitis B or C.

NCT05417308.summary_en: This early phase I trial tests topical (applied to the scalp) or oral minoxidil to treat hair loss caused by endocrine therapy in people with stage I to IV breast cancer. Patients apply minoxidil foam to the scalp once a day, or take minoxidil by mouth once a day, for up to 12 months if the disease does not progress and side effects are not unacceptable. The main outcome measure is not stated; the trial is labeled early phase I.
NCT05417308.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase temprana I evalúa minoxidil tópico (aplicado en el cuero cabelludo) u oral para tratar la caída del cabello causada por la terapia endocrina en personas con cáncer de mama en etapas I a IV. Los pacientes se aplican espuma de minoxidil en el cuero cabelludo una vez al día, o toman minoxidil por vía oral una vez al día, durante hasta 12 meses si la enfermedad no progresa y los efectos secundarios no son inaceptables. La medida principal de resultado no se indica en el registro; el ensayo está clasificado como fase temprana I.
who_for: Women 18 years or older
Breast cancer diagnosed at stage I to IV
Taking tamoxifen or an aromatase inhibitor, with or without ovarian function suppression
Self-reports hair loss since starting endocrine therapy
not_for: Pregnant or nursing women
Current chemotherapy, or chemotherapy within the last 2 years
History of scarring alopecia or alopecia areata
Prior minoxidil use, or current or prior spironolactone use
Known minoxidil sensitivity, or untreated hypothyroidism or iron deficiency

NCT07284758.summary_en: This Phase 2, open-label, single-arm study tests cemsidomide plus dexamethasone in adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. Cemsidomide is taken by mouth once a day for 14 days, then stopped for 14 days, in each 28-day cycle; dexamethasone is taken by mouth once a week on Days 1, 8, 15 and 22 of each cycle, and treatment continues until a discontinuation criterion is met. The study aims to assess antimyeloma activity, and also safety, tolerability, PK and PD; the primary outcome measure is not stated.
NCT07284758.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2, abierto y de un solo grupo, evalúa cemsidomida combinada con dexametasona en adultos con mieloma múltiple recidivante o refractario. La cemsidomida se toma por vía oral una vez al día durante 14 días, seguida de 14 días sin tratamiento, en cada ciclo de 28 días; la dexametasona se toma por vía oral una vez por semana los días 1, 8, 15 y 22 de cada ciclo, y el tratamiento continúa hasta que se cumpla un criterio de suspensión. El estudio busca evaluar la actividad antimieloma, y también la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética y la farmacodinamia; la medida de resultado principal no está indicada.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with multiple myeloma that has relapsed or is refractory.
Measurable disease at the time of enrollment.
At least 3 prior myeloma regimens, including an immunomodulatory drug, proteasome inhibitor, anti-CD38 antibody, and T-cell engager or CAR-T.
Adequate organ function.
Side effects from prior cancer treatment resolved to baseline or grade 1 or lower.
not_for: Myeloma in the central nervous system.
Systemic light chain amyloidosis, POEMS syndrome, or myelodysplastic syndrome.
Previous treatment with cemsidomide.
Significant cardiac disease or impaired heart function.
Blood clot event within 3 months before enrollment.

NCT06376526.summary_en: This study tests linvoseltamab in adults with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma who still have minimal residual disease after initial combination treatment. Linvoseltamab is given intravenously in 28-day cycles using a step-up dosing schedule, with four cycles for participants who are MRD-negative and six cycles for those who are MRD-positive after four cycles. The study measures whether treatment converts MRD-positive disease to MRD-negative and how long the disease stays controlled; it is a Phase 2 study.
NCT06376526.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa linvoseltamab en adultos con mieloma múltiple recién diagnosticado que aún tienen enfermedad residual mínima después del tratamiento combinado inicial. Linvoseltamab se administra por vena (infusión intravenosa) en ciclos de 28 días, con un esquema de dosis escalonado; los participantes reciben cuatro ciclos si son negativos para enfermedad residual mínima, y seis ciclos si siguen siendo positivos después de cuatro. El estudio mide si el tratamiento convierte la enfermedad residual mínima positiva en negativa y cuánto tiempo se mantiene controlada la enfermedad; es un estudio de fase 2.
who_for: Adults aged 18 years or older
Newly diagnosed multiple myeloma treated with a triplet or quadruplet initial combination therapy
Best response of partial response or better, but still MRD-positive after at least 4 cycles
ECOG performance status of 1 or less
Adequate blood counts, liver, kidney and organ function
not_for: Prior myeloma therapy other than the initial combination, including high-dose melphalan with stem cell transplant
Receiving any other investigational agent
Live attenuated vaccine within 4 weeks of planned treatment
Active HIV, hepatitis B or active hepatitis C infection
Certain heart conditions, or active cancer other than myeloma requiring treatment in the past 12 months

NCT07579208.summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests engineered natural killer (NK) cells that carry a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) aimed at IL13Ra and EGFvIII, with IL-21 secretion and deleted TGF-BetaR2 and NR3C1, in recurrent glioblastoma. The record lists delivery by Ommaya reservoir, intravenous, intra-tumoral and intra-arterial routes; how long or how often is not stated. The main outcome is not stated; this is a Phase 1 study whose stated aim is to find the best way to give NK cells.
NCT07579208.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 prueba células asesinas naturales (NK) modificadas que tienen un receptor de antígeno quimérico (CAR) dirigido a IL13Ra y EGFvIII, con secreción de IL-21 y eliminación de TGF-BetaR2 y NR3C1, en glioblastoma recurrente. El registro indica administración por reservorio de Ommaya, intravenosa, intratumoral e intraarterial; la duración y la frecuencia no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica; es un estudio de fase 1 cuyo objetivo declarado es encontrar la mejor forma de administrar las células NK.
who_for: Adults aged 18 years or older.
Recurrent supratentorial glioblastoma, gliosarcoma, or recurrent IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma.
Prior radiation and temozolomide therapy received.
Single tumor no larger than 5 cm in greatest diameter.
Karnofsky Performance Status score above 70.
not_for: Prior interstitial brachytherapy, implanted chemotherapy, or local injection or convection enhanced delivery.
Investigational agent or device use within 4 weeks of last dose.
Known HIV, HTLV, active hepatitis B or hepatitis C.
Immunodeficiency or recent immunosuppressive therapy.
Multifocal disease, brainstem or spinal cord tumor, or gliomatous meningitis.

NCT06543576.summary_en: This Phase 1/Phase 2 trial tests external beam radiation therapy and brachytherapy with cisplatin and paclitaxel chemotherapy and pembrolizumab and bevacizumab immunotherapy for stage IVB cervical cancer. Part 1 gives cisplatin, paclitaxel, pembrolizumab, and bevacizumab through an IV every 21 days for 6 cycles, followed by 3 weeks with no treatment; Part 2 gives external beam radiation for 25 treatments over 5 weeks, brachytherapy over 3 to 5 treatments, and pembrolizumab and bevacizumab through an IV every 21 days for a total of 2 years. The record does not state a specific main outcome measure; the study is described as testing safety and effectiveness.
NCT06543576.summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 1/fase 2 evalúa la radioterapia de haz externo y la braquiterapia junto con quimioterapia con cisplatino y paclitaxel e inmunoterapia con pembrolizumab y bevacizumab para el cáncer de cuello uterino en estadio IVB. La parte 1 administra cisplatino, paclitaxel, pembrolizumab y bevacizumab por vía intravenosa cada 21 días durante 6 ciclos, seguidos de 3 semanas sin tratamiento; la parte 2 administra radioterapia de haz externo en 25 sesiones durante 5 semanas, braquiterapia en 3 a 5 sesiones, y pembrolizumab y bevacizumab por vía intravenosa cada 21 días durante un total de 2 años. El registro no indica un resultado principal específico; el estudio se describe como una prueba de la seguridad y la eficacia.
who_for: At least 18 years old on the day consent is signed
Newly diagnosed stage IVB adenocarcinoma, adenosquamous carcinoma, or squamous cell carcinoma of the cervix, not yet treated with chemotherapy or radiation
Has measurable disease by RECIST 1.1 criteria
PD-L1 combined positive score (CPS) above 1
ECOG performance status of 0 to 1
not_for: Prior anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, anti-PD-L2, or similar T-cell checkpoint agent
Prior hysterectomy
Prior radiotherapy for cervical cancer
Hepatitis B (HBsAg reactive) or active hepatitis C infection
Active autoimmune disease that needed systemic treatment in the past 2 years

NCT07428616.summary_en: This study tests zanzalintinib in people with meningioma that has come back or is growing and has not responded to standard therapies. Participants receive zanzalintinib once daily (QD), and the length of treatment is not stated. The study measures efficacy and safety, the specific main outcome is not stated, and it is a Phase 2 study.
NCT07428616.summary_es: Este estudio prueba zanzalintinib en personas con meningioma recurrente o progresivo que no ha respondido a las terapias estándar. Los participantes reciben zanzalintinib una vez al día (QD), y la duración del tratamiento no se indica. El estudio mide la eficacia y la seguridad, el resultado principal específico no se indica, y es un estudio de Fase 2.
who_for: Histologically confirmed WHO grade 1, 2, or 3 meningioma
Recurrent or progressive disease after standard therapy, or ineligible for these therapies
At least one prior meningioma-directed radiotherapy course, if not contraindicated
Radiologic progression within the prior 6 months or new lesions, with measurable disease by RANO criteria
Karnofsky performance status of at least 60%, with adequate organ and marrow function
not_for: History of hypertensive encephalopathy
Extracranial lesions invading major blood vessels such as the aorta or inferior vena cava
Contraindication to MRI
Systemic anticancer therapy within 4 weeks or 5 half-lives before treatment, whichever is shorter
Uncontrolled significant illness, such as uncontrolled hypertension, high perforation or fistula risk, or significant bleeding

NCT06555133.summary_en: This Phase 2 pilot study tests yttrium-90 radioembolization given with capecitabine and atezolizumab for colorectal cancer that has spread to the liver and cannot be surgically removed. Yttrium-90 is given to one or both liver halves (hemilivers), atezolizumab is given by IV every 3 weeks for 5 doses, and capecitabine is taken by mouth twice a day for 2 weeks, starting with each yttrium-90 treatment. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is Phase 2.
NCT06555133.summary_es: Este estudio piloto de fase 2 evalúa la radioembolización con itrio-90 combinada con capecitabina y atezolizumab para el cáncer colorrectal que se ha extendido al hígado y no puede extirparse quirúrgicamente. El itrio-90 se administra en uno o ambos lóbulos hepáticos, el atezolizumab se da por vía intravenosa cada 3 semanas durante 5 dosis, y la capecitabina se toma por vía oral dos veces al día durante 2 semanas, comenzando con cada tratamiento de itrio-90. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Colorectal adenocarcinoma that cannot be surgically removed, with disease mainly in the liver.
Disease that progressed after two or more lines of systemic therapy.
ECOG performance status 0 or 1.
Less than 50% of liver volume replaced by metastatic disease, per investigator.
Blood count, kidney, liver and clotting lab values within the stated limits.
not_for: Prior yttrium-90 therapy or prior external beam radiation to the liver.
Known mismatch repair deficiency, MSI-H, or high tumor mutational burden.
Prior treatment with CD137 agonists or anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, or anti-CTLA4 antibodies.
Active hepatitis B, active hepatitis C, HIV, or active tuberculosis.
History of autoimmune disease, apart from the listed exceptions.

NCT07169734.summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests ALE.P03, a claudin-1 targeted antibody-drug conjugate, given alone to adults with selected advanced or metastatic CLDN1-positive solid tumors, including cervical squamous cell carcinoma, squamous non-small cell lung cancer, colorectal cancer, intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, and urothelial carcinoma. ALE.P03 is given as an intravenous infusion, and the dosing schedule and how often it is given are not stated. The study measures safety and tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, early anti-tumor activity, and aims to identify the recommended Phase II dose.
NCT07169734.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa ALE.P03, un conjugado anticuerpo-fármaco dirigido a claudina-1, administrado solo a adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados o metastásicos seleccionados y CLDN1 positivos, incluidos carcinoma de células escamosas cervical, carcinoma de pulmón de células no pequeñas de tipo escamoso, cáncer colorrectal, colangiocarcinoma intrahepático y carcinoma urotelial. ALE.P03 se administra como infusión intravenosa; el esquema de dosis y la frecuencia no se indican. El estudio mide seguridad y tolerabilidad, farmacocinética, farmacodinamia y actividad antitumoral preliminar, y busca identificar la dosis recomendada para la fase II.
who_for: Adults aged 18 years or older.
Advanced or metastatic colorectal cancer, intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, squamous non-small cell lung cancer, urothelial carcinoma, or cervical squamous cell
Radiological disease progression at study entry.
Tissue provided for CLDN1 analysis at a central laboratory.
Refractory or intolerant to standard treatment, with measurable disease and ECOG performance status 0 or 1.
not_for: Squamous lung or cervical tumors with a predominantly non-squamous or adenocarcinoma histology.
Antineoplastic therapy received before study treatment within a specified time frame (time frame not stated).
Rapidly progressing disease.
Known active brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis.
Non-infectious interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis requiring steroids, or clinically significant gastrointestinal bleeding.

NCT07116616.summary_en: This study tests mRNA-2808 in adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. The study is a Phase 1/2 trial, and the drug is given intravenously or subcutaneously; how long or how often is not stated. The study measures safety and tolerability, which is the stated purpose of the trial.
NCT07116616.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa mRNA-2808 en adultos con mieloma múltiple recidivante o refractario. Es un estudio de fase 1/2, y el medicamento se administra por vía intravenosa o subcutánea; la duración o la frecuencia no están indicadas. El estudio mide la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, que es el propósito indicado del ensayo.
who_for: Relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma.
Prior treatment with a proteasome inhibitor, an immunomodulatory drug, and an anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody.
Measurable disease by serum or urine M-protein, free light chain, plasmacytoma, or bone marrow plasma cells.
Age 18 years or older.
not_for: Myeloma involving the central nervous system, or signs of it.
Active plasma cell leukemia, with 20% or more plasma cells in the blood.
Radiotherapy or chemotherapy within 2 weeks before baseline; limited palliative radiotherapy may be allowed after discussion with the sponsor.
Certain antibody therapies within 21 days, or a proteasome inhibitor or immunomodulator within 14 days, before baseline.
Recent stem cell transplant, cell therapy, or high-dose corticosteroids within the windows stated in the record.

NCT05417321.summary_en: This study tests HB0036, a drug sponsored by Shanghai Huaota Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd., in people with advanced solid tumors, including non-small cell lung cancer. HB0036 is given as an intravenous infusion every 3 weeks, and how long treatment lasts is not stated. The study evaluates safety, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and efficacy, and it is a Phase I/II study.
NCT05417321.summary_es: Este estudio evalúa HB0036, un fármaco patrocinado por Shanghai Huaota Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd., en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados, incluido el cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas. HB0036 se administra por infusión intravenosa cada 3 semanas, y la duración del tratamiento no está especificada. El estudio evalúa la seguridad, la farmacocinética, la farmacodinamia y la eficacia, y es un estudio de fase I/II.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with advanced or recurrent solid tumor that progressed after standard therapy (Phase I).
Phase II: advanced non-small cell lung cancer with PD-L1 TPS of 1% or higher and no actionable markers such as EGFR or ALK.
At least one measurable lesion per RECIST v1.1.
ECOG performance status of 0 to 1 and life expectancy of at least 12 weeks.
Adequate blood counts, kidney, liver and clotting test results within 14 days of first dose.
not_for: Phase II: prior simultaneous therapy with a PD-1 pathway inhibitor and a TIGIT inhibitor.
Autoimmune disease requiring systemic therapy within the past 2 years, with some exceptions.
History of interstitial lung disease or non-infectious pneumonitis (except from radiotherapy).
Clinically active brain or meningeal metastases.
Positive HIV test or active hepatitis B or C.

NCT07130903.summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests adding the TheraBionic P1 device, which uses amplitude-modulated radiofrequency electromagnetic fields, to the drug fruquintinib. It is for metastatic colorectal cancer that has not responded to other standard treatment. The device is used three times daily on a continuous basis, and fruquintinib is taken daily for 3 weeks on and 1 week off, with total study length not stated. The study aims to learn whether adding the device is effective in improving survival and whether it is safe and tolerable.
NCT07130903.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa agregar el dispositivo TheraBionic P1, que usa campos electromagnéticos de radiofrecuencia modulados en amplitud, al medicamento fruquintinib. Es para cáncer colorrectal metastásico que no ha respondido a otros tratamientos estándar. El dispositivo se usa tres veces al día de forma continua, y el fruquintinib se toma a diario durante 3 semanas seguidas y 1 semana de descanso; la duración total del estudio no se indica. El estudio busca saber si agregar el dispositivo es eficaz para mejorar la supervivencia y si es seguro y tolerable.
who_for: Metastatic colorectal adenocarcinoma confirmed by tissue or cell testing, with RAS, BRAF and HER2 status documented.
Progression on or intolerance to fluoropyrimidine, oxaliplatin or irinotecan chemotherapy.
Prior anti-VEGF therapy and, if RAS is wild type, prior anti-EGFR therapy.
Disease that can be evaluated by CT, MRI or PET scan.
Age 22 or older, body weight at least 40 kg, and ECOG performance status 0 to 2.
not_for: Uncontrolled high blood pressure, or gastrointestinal ulcer, bleeding or perforation risk.
Recent blood clot, stroke or transient ischemic attack, or significant heart disease as listed.
Prolonged QT interval, QT risk factors, or medicines that prolong QT.
Recent systemic cancer treatment, prior fruquintinib, or pregnancy or breastfeeding.
Live vaccine within 28 days, or use of calcium channel blockers.

NCT07218809.summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares AZD5335 with mirvetuximab soravtansine (FRα-high cohort) or with investigator's choice chemotherapy (FRα-low cohort) in women with platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer. AZD5335 and the comparator drugs are given by intravenous (IV) infusion, and the dosing schedule and how often they are given are not stated. The main outcome is progression-free survival (PFS), and the study aims to show that AZD5335 is superior to standard care.
NCT07218809.summary_es: Este estudio de fase 3 compara AZD5335 con mirvetuximab soravtansine (cohorte con FRα alta) o con quimioterapia elegida por el investigador (cohorte con FRα baja) en mujeres con cáncer epitelial de ovario, de trompa de Falopio o peritoneal primario resistente al platino. AZD5335 y los medicamentos de comparación se administran por infusión intravenosa (IV), y el esquema y la frecuencia de dosis no se indican. El resultado principal es la supervivencia libre de progresión (SLP), y el estudio busca demostrar que AZD5335 es superior al tratamiento estándar.
who_for: Confirmed high-grade serous ovarian, primary peritoneal, or fallopian tube cancer.
Platinum-resistant disease, with progression within set time limits after the last platinum dose.
Radiological progression on or after the most recent line of therapy.
One to three prior systemic lines, with single-agent therapy suitable as the next treatment.
If BRCA mutated and eligible, prior PARP inhibitor required; FFPE tumour tissue sample must be provided.
not_for: Endometrioid, clear cell, mucinous, sarcomatous, low-grade, or borderline ovarian tumour histology.
Primary platinum-refractory disease, progressing within 3 months of first-line platinum.
History or suspicion of non-infectious interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis.
Prior FRα-targeted therapy or any TOP1 inhibitor antibody drug conjugate.
Current signs or tests suggesting bowel obstruction, including sub-occlusive disease.

NCT07102394.summary_en: This study tests IMLYGIC, given alone, as a possible treatment for cutaneous neurofibromas in adults with neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1). IMLYGIC is injected directly into the tumors on Days 1 and 21 of each 28-day cycle, for up to 4 cycles (8 treatments in total). The record does not state a main outcome measure; it is a Phase 1 study with a safety run-in to assess feasibility and efficacy.
NCT07102394.summary_es: Este estudio prueba IMLYGIC, administrado solo, como posible tratamiento de neurofibromas cutáneos en adultos con neurofibromatosis tipo 1 (NF1). IMLYGIC se inyecta directamente en los tumores los días 1 y 21 de cada ciclo de 28 días, durante hasta 4 ciclos (8 tratamientos en total). El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; es un estudio de Fase 1 con una etapa inicial de seguridad para evaluar la factibilidad y la eficacia.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with NF1 diagnosis by NIH clinical criteria
At least 8 measurable cutaneous neurofibromas, with specific size and location rules
Karnofsky performance level of 80% or higher
Blood counts, liver, kidney and albumin values within stated limits
Willing and able to follow the protocol and sign written consent
not_for: Pregnant or breastfeeding women, or women who are not using approved birth control
